'+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')</span>] [DAEMON] $*"</span>; }</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">while</span> <span class="literal">true</span>; <span class="keyword">do</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">log</span> <span class="string">"启动: <span class="variable">$COMMAND</span>"</span></span><br><span class="line"> START_TIME=<span class="variable">$SECONDS</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># 运行目标命令</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="variable">$COMMAND</span> &</span><br><span class="line"> CHILD_PID=$!</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># 等待子进程退出</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">wait</span> <span class="variable">$CHILD_PID</span></span><br><span class="line"> EXIT_CODE=$?</span><br><span class="line"> DURATION=$((SECONDS - START_TIME))</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">log</span> <span class="string">"进程退出 (exit=<span class="variable">$EXIT_CODE</span>, 运行=<span class="variable">${DURATION}</span>s)"</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># 如果运行了很久才退出（非异常），重置计数</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> [[ <span class="variable">$DURATION</span> -gt 60 ]]; <span class="keyword">then</span></span><br><span class="line"> RESTART_COUNT=0</span><br><span class="line"> BACKOFF=1</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">fi</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># 检查重启风暴</span></span><br><span class="line"> NOW=<span class="variable">$SECONDS</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> [[ $((NOW - LAST_RESTART)) -gt <span class="variable">$RESTART_WINDOW</span> ]]; <span class="keyword">then</span></span><br><span class="line"> RESTART_COUNT=0 <span class="comment"># 窗口外，重置</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">fi</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> RESTART_COUNT=$((RESTART_COUNT + <span class="number">1</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> LAST_RESTART=<span class="variable">$NOW</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> [[ <span class="variable">$RESTART_COUNT</span> -gt <span class="variable">$MAX_RESTARTS</span> ]]; <span class="keyword">then</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">log</span> <span class="string">"连续重启 <span class="variable">$MAX_RESTARTS</span> 次，放弃！"</span> >&2</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">exit</span> 1</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">fi</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># 退避重启</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">log</span> <span class="string">"第 <span class="variable">$RESTART_COUNT</span> 次重启，等待 <span class="variable">${BACKOFF}</span>s..."</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">sleep</span> <span class="variable">$BACKOFF</span></span><br><span class="line"> BACKOFF=$((BACKOFF * <span class="number">2</span>)) <span class="comment"># 指数退避</span></span><br><span class="line"> [[ <span class="variable">$BACKOFF</span> -gt 60 ]] && BACKOFF=60 <span class="comment"># 上限 60s</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">done</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 使用示例</span></span><br><span class="line">./daemon.sh /usr/local/bin/myapp --config /etc/myapp.yaml</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>重启风暴防护</strong>：指数退避（1s → 2s → 4s → 8s… → 60s）配合最大重试次数，防止 bug 导致无限重启循环。StackStorm/Supervisor 等成熟方案也采用类似策略</li> <li><strong>信号转发</strong>：守护脚本收到 SIGTERM 时应转发给子进程（<code>trap 'kill -TERM $CHILD_PID' TERM</code>），否则 kill 守护脚本时子进程变成孤儿</li> <li><strong>vs systemd</strong>：systemd 的 <code>Restart=on-failure</code> + <code>RestartSec=5s</code> + <code>StartLimitBurst=5</code> 提供了原生的进程守护能力，生产环境应优先用 systemd 而非自定义守护脚本</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：Unix Daemon 编程实践, systemd.service(5)</p> <h3 id="11-awk-sed-生产日志分析实战案例"><a href="#11-awk-sed-生产日志分析实战案例" class="headerlink" title="11. awk/sed 生产日志分析实战案例"></a>11. awk/sed 生产日志分析实战案例</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>以下三个案例来自真实生产环境：</p> <p><strong>案例 1：Nginx 访问日志 P99 延迟分析</strong></p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 日志格式: $remote_addr - [$time_local] "$request" $status $body_bytes_sent "$http_referer" "$http_user_agent" $request_time</span></span><br><span class="line">awk <span class="string">'{</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> # 提取 URL 路径（去掉参数）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> split($7, parts, "?")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> path = parts[1]</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> rt = $NF # request_time 在最后一列</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> </span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> # 按路径分组，记录所有响应时间</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> times[path] = times[path] " " rt</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> count[path]++</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">}</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">END {</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> for (path in times) {</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> # 排序并计算 P50/P95/P99</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> n = split(times[path], arr, " ")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> asort(arr)</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> p50 = arr[int(n * 0.5)]</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> p95 = arr[int(n * 0.95)]</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> p99 = arr[int(n * 0.99)]</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> </span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> printf "%-50s count=%-6d p50=%-8.3f p95=%-8.3f p99=%-8.3f max=%-8.3f\n", </span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> path, count[path], p50, p95, p99, arr[n]</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> }</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">}'</span> access.log | <span class="built_in">sort</span> -t<span class="string">'='</span> -k5 -rn | <span class="built_in">head</span> -20</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>案例 2：多文件日志时间线合并（sed 预处理 + awk 合并）</strong></p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 场景：K8s 中多个 Pod 的日志，按时间戳合并排序</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">for</span> pod <span class="keyword">in</span> $(kubectl get pods -l app=myapp -o name); <span class="keyword">do</span></span><br><span class="line"> kubectl logs <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$pod</span>"</span> --<span class="built_in">tail</span>=5000 | \</span><br><span class="line"> sed <span class="string">"s/^/[<span class="variable">${pod#pod/}</span>] /"</span> <span class="comment"># 每行前加 Pod 名</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">done</span> | <span class="built_in">sort</span> -k2,3 | <span class="built_in">tail</span> -100 <span class="comment"># 按时间戳排序</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>案例 3：awk 实现滑动窗口异常检测</strong></p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br><span class="line">27</span><br><span class="line">28</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 检测某分钟内错误数超过阈值的告警</span></span><br><span class="line">WINDOW=60 <span class="comment"># 60 秒窗口</span></span><br><span class="line">THRESHOLD=10 <span class="comment"># 阈值</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">awk -v window=<span class="variable">$WINDOW</span> -v threshold=<span class="variable">$THRESHOLD</span> <span class="string">'</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">/ERROR/ {</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> # 提取时间戳为秒数</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> cmd = "date -d \"" $1 " " $2 "\" +%s"</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> cmd | getline ts</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> close(cmd)</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> </span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> errors[ts]++</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">}</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">END {</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> # 滑动窗口统计</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> for (t in errors) {</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> window_count = 0</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> for (dt = 0; dt < window; dt++) {</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> window_count += errors[t + dt]</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> }</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> if (window_count >= threshold) {</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> cmd = "date -d @" t " \"+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\""</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> cmd | getline timestr</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> close(cmd)</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> printf "ALERT: %s - %d errors in %ds window\n", timestr, window_count, window</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> }</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> }</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">}'</span> app.log | <span class="built_in">sort</span> -u</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>awk 内存管理</strong>：大型文件（10GB+）的 END 块可能内存溢出。因为 awk 在 END 块执行前将所有数组和变量保留在内存中。解决方案：用 <code>awk '{...}' file | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn</code> 管道分流（sort 使用磁盘临时文件）</li> <li><strong>sed 流式处理</strong>：<code>sed</code> 是逐行处理的，不占用额外内存，适合流式管道。但 <code>sed -i</code> 实际上是先写临时文件再 rename，大文件的 <code>-i</code> 会占用双倍磁盘空间</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：gawk 的 <code>@include</code> 机制可以复用公共函数库。如 <code>@include "json"</code> 配合 gawk-json 扩展解析 JSON 日志，比 jq 更适合流式处理</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：gawk manual, The AWK Programming Language (Aho/Kernighan/Weinberger)</p> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-生产脚本：防御式编程与错误处理"><a href="#0x05-生产脚本：防御式编程与错误处理" class="headerlink" title="0x05 生产脚本：防御式编程与错误处理"></a>0x05 生产脚本：防御式编程与错误处理</h2><h3 id="9-set-euo-pipefail-的隐藏陷阱？SIGPIPE-141-为什么会让脚本意外退出？"><a href="#9-set-euo-pipefail-的隐藏陷阱？SIGPIPE-141-为什么会让脚本意外退出？" class="headerlink" title="9. set -euo pipefail 的隐藏陷阱？SIGPIPE (141) 为什么会让脚本意外退出？"></a>9. <code>set -euo pipefail</code> 的隐藏陷阱？SIGPIPE (141) 为什么会让脚本意外退出？</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐（专家）<br><strong>问题</strong>：某运维团队在 CI/CD 脚本中加上了 <code>set -euo pipefail</code> 来保证严格模式，结果发现脚本在正常处理大量文件时意外退出，排查发现是 exit code 141（SIGPIPE）导致的。为什么 <code>set -o pipefail</code> + <code>grep -q</code> 的组合会出问题？如何修复？</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><code>set -o pipefail</code>：管道中任何命令失败（非 0 退出码），管道整体返回该失败码</li> <li><code>set -e</code>（errexit）：任何命令返回非 0 时立即退出脚本</li> <li><strong>SIGPIPE（信号 13，退出码 141 = 128+13）</strong>：当管道的读取端提前关闭，写入端仍在写时，操作系统发送 SIGPIPE 信号</li> <li>经典场景：<code>big_generator | head -n 5</code> → head 读取 5 行后关闭，big_generator 继续写时收到 SIGPIPE → 退出码 141</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <p><strong>🔥 踩坑案例：某日志采集脚本 pipefail+SIGPIPE 导致数据丢失</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：Shell 脚本每日凌晨从 100+ 台服务器采集日志，核心 pipeline：<figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">#!/bin/bash</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">set</span> -euo pipefail</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 检查日志中是否有 ERROR</span></span><br><span class="line">grep -q <span class="string">"ERROR"</span> /var/log/app/*.<span class="built_in">log</span> | <span class="built_in">head</span> -100 > /tmp/errors.txt</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：脚本执行到一半退出，/tmp/errors.txt 为空或内容不全。排查日志发现 <code>exit code 141</code></li> <li><strong>排查过程</strong>：<ol> <li>手动模拟：<code>seq 1 100000 | grep "5" | head -3</code> → 立即退出且 <code>echo $?</code> = 141</li> <li>检查 <code>set -o pipefail</code> 的语义：管道退出码以最后一个非 0 命令为准</li> <li><code>head</code> 读取足够行后关闭管道 → <code>grep</code> 收到 SIGPIPE → <code>set -e</code> 看到 141 立即退出</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<ul> <li><code>set -o pipefail</code>：管道的退出码是 <code>grep</code>（141）而非 <code>head</code>（0）</li> <li><code>set -e</code>：看到非 0 退出码立即终止整个脚本</li> <li>问题本质：<code>grep -q</code> + <code>pipefail</code> 是已知的「Bash 陷阱 #1」</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>修复方案</strong>：</li> </ul> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">#!/bin/bash</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">set</span> -euo pipefail</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案 1：禁用 pipefail 对特定管道的 SIGPIPE（最佳）</span></span><br><span class="line">big_generator | <span class="built_in">head</span> -5 || [[ $? -eq 141 ]] <span class="comment"># ✅ 允许 SIGPIPE</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案 2：在管道末尾显式处理 141</span></span><br><span class="line">errors=$(grep -q <span class="string">"ERROR"</span> /var/log/app/*.<span class="built_in">log</span> | <span class="built_in">head</span> -100) || <span class="literal">true</span> <span class="comment"># ❌ 太宽泛，会吞掉真实错误</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案 3：只忽略 141（推荐）</span></span><br><span class="line">output=$(grep -q <span class="string">"ERROR"</span> /var/log/app/*.<span class="built_in">log</span> | <span class="built_in">head</span> -100) || {</span><br><span class="line"> rc=$?</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> [[ <span class="variable">$rc</span> -ne 141 ]]; <span class="keyword">then</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">exit</span> <span class="variable">$rc</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">fi</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案 4：使用 tee 替代 head（维护管道化语义）</span></span><br><span class="line">grep -q <span class="string">"ERROR"</span> /var/log/app/*.<span class="built_in">log</span> | <span class="built_in">tee</span> /tmp/errors.txt | <span class="built_in">head</span> -100</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>哪个 exit code 可能来自 SIGPIPE？</strong></p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># SIGPIPE = signal 13</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># exit code = 128 + 13 = 141</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 其他常见信号：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># SIGINT (2) → 130</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># SIGTERM (15) → 143</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># SIGSEGV (11) → 139</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>对比延伸</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>场景</th> <th>无 pipefail</th> <th>有 pipefail</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>`cmd</td> <td>head`（head 提前关闭）</td> <td>✅ head 退出码 0</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>grep -q pattern</code>（无匹配）</td> <td>✅ grep 退出码 1</td> <td>❌ pipefail 传递 1</td> </tr> <tr> <td>`cmd</td> <td>true`</td> <td>✅ 无错误</td> </tr> <tr> <td>`false</td> <td>true`</td> <td>✅ true 返回 0</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>「<code>set -euo pipefail</code> 是 Shell 脚本的安全带，但 SIGPIPE（141）是安全带上的一个易撕口——<code>grep | head</code> 这类管道中读取端提前关闭时，写入端收到 SIGPIPE 退出码 141，在 <code>pipefail</code> 作用下导致整个脚本意外终止。正确做法是用 <code>|| [[ $? -eq 141 ]]</code> 显式放行 SIGPIPE。」</p> </blockquote> <p><strong>参考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://mywiki.wooledge.org/BashPitfalls">Bash Pitfalls #1: for f in $(ls *.mp3)</a></li> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://stackoverflow.com/questions/77843350/bash-surprising-behavior-of-fc-list-grep-q-with-pipefail">StackOverflow: pipefail + SIGPIPE (141)</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="10-生产级-Shell-脚本如何实现优雅的-trap-清理模式？如何保证原子性？"><a href="#10-生产级-Shell-脚本如何实现优雅的-trap-清理模式？如何保证原子性？" class="headerlink" title="10. 生产级 Shell 脚本如何实现优雅的 trap 清理模式？如何保证原子性？"></a>10. 生产级 Shell 脚本如何实现优雅的 <code>trap</code> 清理模式？如何保证原子性？</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐（高级）<br><strong>问题</strong>：某团队生产脚本在运行中途被 <code>kill -9</code> 后，残留的临时文件和锁文件污染了下次运行结果。如何用 <code>trap</code> 构建坚不可摧的清理机制？</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><code>trap</code> 命令：在接收到指定信号时执行清理函数</li> <li>关键信号：<ul> <li><code>EXIT</code>：脚本正常/异常退出时触发（<code>exit</code>、<code>set -e</code>、脚本末尾）</li> <li><code>ERR</code>：命令返回非 0 时触发（需配合 <code>set -e</code> 和 <code>set -E</code> 继承到函数）</li> <li><code>INT</code>/<code>TERM</code>：Ctrl+C / kill 发送的信号</li> </ul> </li> <li>陷阱：<code>trap 'cleanup' EXIT</code> 比 <code>trap 'cleanup' INT TERM</code> 更可靠——EXIT 在任何退出路径上都触发</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <p><strong>🔥 踩坑案例：某定时备份脚本残留文件导致备份失败</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：每日 02:00 用脚本备份数据库 → 压缩 → 上传 S3 → 删除本地临时文件</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：某次备份中途磁盘满导致脚本异常退出，残留了 20GB 未压缩的 <code>.sql</code> 文件。第二天同样脚本运行时发现磁盘空间不够，备份失败</li> <li><strong>原始脚本</strong>：<figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">BACKUP_DIR=<span class="string">"/tmp/backup_<span class="subst">$(date +%Y%m%d)</span>"</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">mkdir</span> -p <span class="variable">$BACKUP_DIR</span>/db.sql.gz"</span> s3://my-backup/ <span class="comment"># ③ 或这步出错...</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">rm</span> -rf <span <span class="keyword">then</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"⚠️ 备份脚本异常退出 (exit: <span class="variable">$rc</span>)"</span> | mail -s <span class="string">"Backup Alert"</span> ops@company.com</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">fi</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">exit</span> <span class="variable">$rc</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">trap</span> cleanup EXIT INT TERM</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 防重复运行（文件锁）</span></span><br><span class="line">LOCK_FILE=<span class="string">"/tmp/backup.lock"</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">if</span> ! <span class="built_in">mkdir</span> <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$LOCK_FILE</span>"</span> 2>/dev/null; <span class="keyword">then</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"另一个备份进程正在运行，退出"</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">exit</span> 1</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">fi</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">BACKUP_DIR=<span class="string">"/tmp/backup_<span class="subst">$(date +%Y%m%d)</span>"</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">mkdir</span> -p <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$BACKUP_DIR</span>"</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">mysqldump -u root mydb > <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$BACKUP_DIR</span>/db.sql"</span></span><br><span class="line">gzip <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$BACKUP_DIR</span>/db.sql"</span></span><br><span class="line">aws s3 <span class="built_in">cp</span> <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$BACKUP_DIR</span>/db.sql.gz"</span> s3://my-backup/</span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">rm</span> -rf <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$BACKUP_DIR</span>"</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">rmdir</span> <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$LOCK_FILE</span>"</span> <span class="comment"># 手动释放锁，但 EXIT trap 也兜底</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> </ul> <p><strong>trap 模式对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>模式</th> <th>代码示例</th> <th>可靠性</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>单 trap EXIT</td> <td><code>trap cleanup EXIT</code></td> <td>⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐</td> <td>通用，所有退出路径</td> </tr> <tr> <td>多信号 trap</td> <td><code>trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT</code></td> <td>⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐</td> <td>需区分正常/异常</td> </tr> <tr> <td>trap + readonly 变量</td> <td><code>readonly start_time</code></td> <td>⭐⭐⭐⭐</td> <td>需要不可变状态</td> </tr> <tr> <td>trap + 嵌套函数</td> <td><code>trap 'cleanup $?' 脚本的清理机制不能靠「记住在末尾 cleanup」——任何中间步骤的 <code>set -e</code>、<code>kill -9</code>、网络超时都会跳过正常退出路径。正确模式是 <code>trap cleanup EXIT</code> 配合目录锁 <code>mkdir</code>（原子操作），确保临时文件在任意退出路径上都被清理。」</p> </blockquote> id="11-set-e-在哪些场景下「不生效」？Shell-脚本错误处理的边界情况？"><a href="#11-set-e-在哪些场景下「不生效」？Shell-脚本错误处理的边界情况？" class="headerlink" title="11. set -e 在哪些场景下「不生效」？Shell 脚本错误处理的边界情况？"></a>11. <code>set -e</code> 在哪些场景下「不生效」？Shell 脚本错误处理的边界情况？</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐（专家）<br><strong>问题</strong>：某面试者自信地说「我在脚本开头写了 <code>set -e</code>，所以所有错误都能被捕获」。但生产环境中发现管道命令、逻辑判断、子 shell 等场景下 <code>set -e</code> 悄悄「失效」。<code>set -e</code> 有哪些著名的边界情况？</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><code>set -e</code>（errexit）在以下场景中<strong>不生效</strong>（按 POSIX 规范 + Bash 行为）：<ol> <li><strong>管道中非最后一个命令</strong>：<code>false | echo ok</code> → <code>set -e</code> 不会退出（除非 <code>pipefail</code>）</li> <li><strong>逻辑运算符的短路部分</strong>：<code>false && true</code> → <code>false</code> 不会触发退出（这是条件判断）</li> <li><strong><code>if</code> / <code>while</code> / <code>until</code> 的条件部分</strong>：<code>if false; then</code> → expected，不退出</li> <li><strong>函数/子 shell 中用 <code>!</code> 取反</strong>：<code>! false</code> → 预期退出码 0，不退出</li> <li><strong><code>grep -q</code> 无匹配</strong>：<code>set -e; grep -q pattern file</code> → 退出码 1，set -e 会退出—但注意这是故意的，不是失效</li> <li><strong>后续命令是 <code>|| true</code></strong>：<code>cmd_fails || true</code> → 不退出（true 覆盖了错误）</li> <li><strong>函数调用中的 <code>return</code></strong>：函数内 <code>return 1</code> → 可能被外部 if/|| 吞掉</li> </ol> </li> <li>真正易踩的失效场景是上述 #1（无 pipefail 时）和 #6（期望 fail 但被掩盖）</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <p><strong>🔥 踩坑案例：某自动化部署脚本 <code>set -e</code> 失效导致生产事故</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：部署脚本，核心逻辑：<figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">#!/bin/bash</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">set</span> -e</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"=== 检查服务健康 ==="</span></span><br><span class="line">curl -f http://localhost:8080/health | grep -q <span class="string">"OK"</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"健康检查通过"</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"=== 回滚 ==="</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="function"><span class="title">deploy_rollback</span></span>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"部署失败，回滚中..."</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">exit</span> 1</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">trap</span> deploy_rollback ERR</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>预期</strong>：健康检查失败时，<code>set -e</code> 使脚本退出，然后 <code>trap ERR</code> 触发回滚</li> <li><strong>实际</strong>：健康检查返回 503，<code>curl -f</code> 返回 22，但 <code>grep -q</code> 的退出码 1 被 pipefail 吞掉（没有 pipefail），脚本继续执行，打印”健康检查通过”并继续部署到坏的版本！</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<ol> <li>没有 <code>set -o pipefail</code>，管道返回的是 <code>grep</code> 退出码而非 <code>curl</code> 退出码</li> <li><code>curl -f</code> 失败时，<code>grep</code> 读取空输入 → <code>grep -q</code> 退出码 1</li> <li><code>set -e</code> 看到 1 → 退出，但！这里的退出是因为 <code>grep</code> 无匹配，不是因为 <code>curl</code> 失败</li> <li>再加上 <code>trap ERR</code> 没有 <code>set -E</code>（errtrace），函数内 ERR 不触发顶层 trap</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：<figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">#!/bin/bash</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">set</span> -euo pipefail</span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">set</span> -E <span class="comment"># ✅ 让 ERR trap 继承到函数和子 shell</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="function"><span class="title">cleanup</span></span>() { ... }</span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">trap</span> cleanup ERR EXIT</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 正确做法：分步骤检查</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"=== 检查服务健康 ==="</span></span><br><span class="line">HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w <span class="string">"%{http_code}"</span> http://localhost:8080/health)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">if</span> [[ <span class="string">"<span class="variable">$HTTP_CODE</span>"</span> != <span class="string">"200"</span> ]]; <span class="keyword">then</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"健康检查失败: HTTP <span class="variable">$HTTP_CODE</span>"</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">exit</span> 1</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">fi</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">echo</span> <span class="string">"健康检查通过 (200)"</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> </ul> <p><strong><code>set -e</code> 失效场景速查表</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># ❌ 不会触发 set -e</span></span><br><span class="line">cmd1 | cmd2 <span class="comment"># cmd1 失败但 cmd2 成功 → 不退出</span></span><br><span class="line">! cmd <span class="comment"># 取反后退出码 0 → 不退出</span></span><br><span class="line">cmd || <span class="literal">true</span> <span class="comment"># true 覆盖错误 → 不退出</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">if</span> cmd; <span class="keyword">then</span> ... <span class="comment"># if 条件中的 cmd → 不退出</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">while</span> cmd; <span class="keyword">do</span> ... <span class="comment"># while 条件中的 cmd → 不退出</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="function"><span class="title">func</span></span>() { <span class="built_in">return</span> 1; } <span class="comment"># 函数 return 1 不触发 ERR trap（除非 set -E）</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># ✅ 会触发 set -e</span></span><br><span class="line">cmd <span class="comment"># 简单命令失败</span></span><br><span class="line">cmd1 | cmd2 <span class="comment"># 配合 pipefail 时任一失败</span></span><br><span class="line">( cmd ) <span class="comment"># 子 shell 失败</span></span><br><span class="line">{ cmd; } <span class="comment"># 花括号命令组失败</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>「<code>set -e</code> 不是银弹——管道中非末尾命令的失败被静默忽略、<code>|| true</code> 掩盖错误、函数 <code>return</code> 不触发 ERR trap，都让它的保护有漏洞。生产脚本铁三角：<code>set -euo pipefail</code> + <code>set -E</code> + <code>trap cleanup EXIT</code>，再加 <code>|| [[ $? -eq 141 ]]</code> 处理 SIGPIPE。」</p> </blockquote> <p><strong>参考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/html_node/The-Set-Builtin.html">Bash Reference Manual: The Set Builtin</a></li> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://stackoverflow.com/questions/19622198/what-does-set-e-mean-in-a-bash-script">StackOverflow: set -e behavior</a></li> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/majiayu000/claude-skill-registry/blob/main/skills/other/bash-defensive-patterns/SKILL.md">Bash Defensive Patterns (GitHub)</a></li> </ul> <hr> <blockquote> <p>本文将持续更新。</p> itemprop="name">DevOps</span></a> </span> </span> </div> </div> </header> <div class="post-body" itemprop="articleBody"> <blockquote> <p>Kubernetes 高级面试全解，覆盖 Pod/Service 原理、调度与资源管理、网络模型和常见排障。</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x00-核心概念"><a href="#0x00-核心概念" class="headerlink" title="0x00 核心概念"></a>0x00 核心概念</h2><h3 id="1-Pod-的生命周期和探针？"><a href="#1-Pod-的生命周期和探针？" class="headerlink" title="1. Pod 的生命周期和探针？"></a>1. Pod 的生命周期和探针？</h3><figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Pending → Running → Succeeded/Failed</span><br><span class="line"> ↓</span><br><span class="line"> ContainerCreating → Running</span><br><span class="line"> ↓</span><br><span class="line"> (liveness 失败) → Restart → CrashLoopBackOff</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>三种探针</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>探针</th> <th>作用</th> <th>失败后果</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>livenessProbe</strong></td> <td>容器是否存活</td> <td>重启容器</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>readinessProbe</strong></td> <td>容器是否就绪</td> <td>从 Service 摘除</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>startupProbe</strong></td> <td>容器是否启动完成</td> <td>阻塞 liveness/readiness</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">livenessProbe:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">httpGet:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">path:</span> <span class="string">/actuator/health/liveness</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">port:</span> <span class="number">8080</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">initialDelaySeconds:</span> <span class="number">30</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">periodSeconds:</span> <span class="number">10</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">failureThreshold:</span> <span class="number">3</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">readinessProbe:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">httpGet:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">path:</span> <span class="string">/actuator/health/readiness</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">port:</span> <span class="number">8080</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">periodSeconds:</span> <span class="number">5</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">startupProbe:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">httpGet:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">path:</span> <span class="string">/actuator/health</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">port:</span> <span class="number">8080</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">failureThreshold:</span> <span class="number">30</span> <span class="comment"># 最多等 30×10=300s 启动</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">periodSeconds:</span> <span class="number">10</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：<code>readinessProbe</code> 失败不重启容器，只是摘流量。这让你可以在不重启的情况下做限流降级</li> </ul> <h3 id="2-Service-的三种类型和原理？"><a href="#2-Service-的三种类型和原理？" class="headerlink" title="2. Service 的三种类型和原理？"></a>2. Service 的三种类型和原理？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>类型</th> <th>集群外可访问</th> <th>实现</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>ClusterIP</strong></td> <td>❌（集群内）</td> <td>kube-proxy iptables/IPVS 规则</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>NodePort</strong></td> <td>✅ <code>NodeIP:30000-32767</code></td> <td>ClusterIP + 每个 Node 开端口</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>LoadBalancer</strong></td> <td>✅ 外部 LB IP</td> <td>云厂商 LB → NodePort</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">apiVersion:</span> <span class="string">v1</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">kind:</span> <span class="string">Service</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">metadata:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">name:</span> <span class="string">myapp</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">spec:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">type:</span> <span class="string">ClusterIP</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">selector:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">app:</span> <span class="string">myapp</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">ports:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">port:</span> <span class="number">80</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">targetPort:</span> <span class="number">8080</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>iptables 模式流程</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Client → Service IP (10.96.0.1:80) → iptables DNAT → Pod IP (10.244.1.5:8080)</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>IPVS 模式</strong>（推荐，K8s 1.11+）：支持更多负载均衡算法（rr/lc/sh/dh），性能远高于 iptables</p> <h3 id="3-Ingress-和-Service-的关系？"><a href="#3-Ingress-和-Service-的关系？" class="headerlink" title="3. Ingress 和 Service 的关系？"></a>3. Ingress 和 Service 的关系？</h3><figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">外部流量 → Ingress Controller (Nginx/Traefik)</span><br><span class="line"> → 根据 Host/Path 规则路由</span><br><span class="line"> → Service (ClusterIP)</span><br><span class="line"> → Pod</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">apiVersion:</span> <span class="string">networking.k8s.io/v1</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">kind:</span> <span class="string">Ingress</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">metadata:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">name:</span> <span class="string">myapp</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">spec:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">rules:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">host:</span> <span class="string">api.example.com</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">http:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">paths:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">path:</span> <span class="string">/orders</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">pathType:</span> <span class="string">Prefix</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">backend:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">service:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">name:</span> <span class="string">order-service</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">port:</span> { <span class="attr">number:</span> <span class="number">80</span> }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">path:</span> <span class="string">/users</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">pathType:</span> <span class="string">Prefix</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">backend:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">service:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">name:</span> <span class="string">user-service</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">port:</span> { <span class="attr">number:</span> <span class="number">80</span> }</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <h2 id="0x02-调度与资源"><a href="#0x02-调度与资源" class="headerlink" title="0x02 调度与资源"></a>0x02 调度与资源</h2><h3 id="4-Pod-调度流程和亲和性？"><a href="#4-Pod-调度流程和亲和性？" class="headerlink" title="4. Pod 调度流程和亲和性？"></a>4. Pod 调度流程和亲和性？</h3><figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Pod 创建 → Scheduler </span><br><span class="line"> → Filter（过滤不满足条件的 Node: CPU/内存/污点）</span><br><span class="line"> → Score（给剩余 Node 打分: 资源均衡/亲和性）</span><br><span class="line"> → Bind（绑定到最优 Node）</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 节点选择器</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">nodeSelector:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">disktype:</span> <span class="string">ssd</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Pod 亲和性/反亲和性（更强表达能力）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">affinity:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">podAntiAffinity:</span> <span class="comment"># 反亲和：不和 label=app=redis 的 Pod 同机</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">labelSelector:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">matchLabels:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">app:</span> <span class="string">redis</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">topologyKey:</span> <span class="string">kubernetes.io/hostname</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 污点与容忍</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">tolerations:</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">key:</span> <span class="string">"gpu"</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">operator:</span> <span class="string">"Equal"</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">value:</span> <span class="string">"true"</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">effect:</span> <span class="string">"NoSchedule"</span> <span class="comment"># 允许调度到有 gpu=true 污点的 Node</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="5-Resource-的-requests-和-limits-怎么设？"><a href="#5-Resource-的-requests-和-limits-怎么设？" class="headerlink" title="5. Resource 的 requests 和 limits 怎么设？"></a>5. Resource 的 requests 和 limits 怎么设？</h3><figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">resources:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">requests:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">memory:</span> <span class="string">"512Mi"</span> <span class="comment"># 调度保证量</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">cpu:</span> <span class="string">"500m"</span> <span class="comment"># 0.5 核</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">limits:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">memory:</span> <span class="string">"1Gi"</span> <span class="comment"># 硬上限，超出 OOMKilled</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">cpu:</span> <span class="string">"2"</span> <span class="comment"># 可 burst 到 2 核（throttle）</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>QoS 等级</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>Guaranteed</strong>：<code>requests=limits</code>（内存 CPU 都要），最高优先级</li> <li><strong>Burstable</strong>：<code>requests < limits</code>，中等优先级</li> <li><strong>BestEffort</strong>：没设 requests/limits，最低优先级，Node 压力大时先被杀</li> </ul> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：CPU limits 不要设太低，否则即使 Node 有空闲 CPU，容器也会被 throttle。CPU requests 影响调度，CPU limits 影响使用。内存 limits 是硬限制，超过就 OOM Kill</li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x03-常用命令与排障"><a href="#0x03-常用命令与排障" class="headerlink" title="0x03 常用命令与排障"></a>0x03 常用命令与排障</h2><h3 id="6-常用-kubectl-命令"><a href="#6-常用-kubectl-命令" class="headerlink" title="6. 常用 kubectl 命令"></a>6. 常用 kubectl 命令</h3><figure class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Pod 管理</span></span><br><span class="line">kubectl get pods -n namespace</span><br><span class="line">kubectl describe pod pod-name</span><br><span class="line">kubectl logs -f pod-name -c container-name --<span class="built_in">tail</span>=100</span><br><span class="line">kubectl <span class="built_in">exec</span> -it pod-name -- /bin/bash</span><br><span class="line">kubectl port-forward pod-name 8080:8080</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 诊断</span></span><br><span class="line">kubectl top pods -n namespace <span class="comment"># 资源使用</span></span><br><span class="line">kubectl get events -n namespace --sort-by=<span class="string">'.lastTimestamp'</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 滚动更新</span></span><br><span class="line">kubectl rollout status deployment/myapp</span><br><span class="line">kubectl rollout undo deployment/myapp <span class="comment"># 回滚</span></span><br><span class="line">kubectl rollout <span class="built_in">history</span> deployment/myapp</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># YAML 操作</span></span><br><span class="line">kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml</span><br><span class="line">kubectl delete -f deployment.yaml</span><br><span class="line">kubectl edit deployment myapp <span class="built_in">rm</span> -it --image=busybox -- /bin/sh</span><br><span class="line">kubectl get pods -o wide <span class="comment"># 看 Pod IP 和 Node</span></span><br><span class="line">kubectl
