class="string">"localhost"</span>]</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">volumes:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">db_data:</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-基础概念与原理"><a href="#0x05-基础概念与原理" class="headerlink" title="0x05 基础概念与原理"></a>0x05 基础概念与原理</h2><h3 id="7-什么是-Docker？"><a href="#7-什么是-Docker？" class="headerlink" title="7. 什么是 Docker？"></a>7. 什么是 Docker？</h3><p><strong>答案</strong>：<br>Docker 是一个容器化平台，将应用及其所有依赖环境打包成一个标准化的容器，保证应用在不同的平台（开发、测试、生产）上可以无缝运行。</p> <p>Docker 容器将一个软件包装在一个完整的文件系统中，包含运行所需的一切：代码、运行时、系统工具、系统库等，可以安装在服务器上的任何东西。</p> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="8-Docker-与虚拟机的区别？"><a href="#8-Docker-与虚拟机的区别？" class="headerlink" title="8. Docker 与虚拟机的区别？"></a>8. Docker 与虚拟机的区别？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>Docker 容器</th> <th>虚拟机</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>内核</strong></td> <td>共享宿主机内核</td> <td>每个 VM 有独立内核</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>启动时间</strong></td> <td>毫秒级</td> <td>分钟级</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>资源损耗</strong></td> <td>仅进程级隔离，几乎无损耗</td> <td>Hypervisor 层占用大量资源</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>隔离性</strong></td> <td>通过 namespace/cgroup 实现进程隔离</td> <td>完全虚拟化，安全性更高</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>密度</strong></td> <td>同等资源可运行数十倍于 VM 的容器</td> <td>数量有限</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>安全权衡</strong>：Docker 与宿主机共享内核，容器逃逸风险比 VM 高。生产环境建议：敏感业务用 VM，微服务/无状态应用用容器</li> <li><strong>性能</strong>：Docker 网络和 IO 接近原生，VM 因虚拟化层有 5-15% 性能损耗</li> </ul> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="9-Docker-三大核心组件是什么？"><a href="#9-Docker-三大核心组件是什么？" class="headerlink" title="9. Docker 三大核心组件是什么？"></a>9. Docker 三大核心组件是什么？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>组件</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>镜像（Image）</strong></td> <td>创建容器的基础，类似 VM 快照。一个只读模板，包含运行应用所需的所有内容（代码、运行时、库、环境变量、配置文件）。实际上是一个压缩包，包含完整操作系统文件</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>容器（Container）</strong></td> <td>从镜像创建的运行实例。可启动、停止、删除。每个容器相互隔离，可看作一个简易版 Linux 环境（root 用户、文件空间、网络空间）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>仓库（Registry）</strong></td> <td>存放镜像的服务器。每个仓库含多个镜像，每个镜像有不同 tag。公开仓库（Docker Hub）和私有仓库</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="10-Docker-后台的标准运行过程？"><a href="#10-Docker-后台的标准运行过程？" class="headerlink" title="10. Docker 后台的标准运行过程？"></a>10. Docker 后台的标准运行过程？</h3><p>当执行 <code>docker run</code> 创建容器时，后台执行流程：</p> <ol> <li>检查本地是否存在指定镜像，不存在则从仓库下载</li> <li>利用镜像创建并启动一个容器</li> <li>分配文件系统给容器，在只读镜像层外挂载一层可读写层</li> <li>从宿主机网桥接口桥接一个虚拟接口到容器</li> <li>分配 IP 地址给容器</li> <li>执行用户指定的应用程序，执行完毕后容器终止</li> </ol> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="11-镜像本地存放在哪里？容器退出后数据会丢失吗？"><a href="#11-镜像本地存放在哪里？容器退出后数据会丢失吗？" class="headerlink" title="11. 镜像本地存放在哪里？容器退出后数据会丢失吗？"></a>11. 镜像本地存放在哪里？容器退出后数据会丢失吗？</h3><p><strong>镜像存储位置</strong>：<br>Docker 本地资源存放在 <code>/var/lib/docker/</code> 目录下：</p> <ul> <li><code>container/</code> — 存放容器信息</li> <li><code>image/</code> — 存放镜像信息</li> <li><code>overlay2/</code> — 存放具体的镜像底层文件</li> </ul> <p><strong>容器数据</strong>：<br>容器退出后处于 Exited 状态，通过 <code>docker ps -a</code> 可以查看。数据不会丢失，可通过 <code>docker start</code> 重新启动。只有执行 <code>docker rm</code> 删除容器才会清除数据。</p> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="12-Docker-容器的运行阶段有哪些？"><a href="#12-Docker-容器的运行阶段有哪些？" class="headerlink" title="12. Docker 容器的运行阶段有哪些？"></a>12. Docker 容器的运行阶段有哪些？</h3><p>Docker 容器有四种运行阶段：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>状态</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>Running</strong></td> <td>运行中</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Paused</strong></td> <td>已暂停</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Restarting</strong></td> <td>重启中</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Exited</strong></td> <td>已退出</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p>查看命令：<code>docker ps -a</code>（列出所有容器及其状态）</p> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="13-如何停止所有容器-批量清理？"><a href="#13-如何停止所有容器-批量清理？" class="headerlink" title="13. 如何停止所有容器 / 批量清理？"></a>13. 如何停止所有容器 / 批量清理？</h3><figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 停止所有运行的容器</span></span><br><span class="line">docker <span class="built_in">kill</span> $(docker ps -q)</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 清理所有已停止的容器</span></span><br><span class="line">docker <span class="built_in">rm</span> $(docker ps -a -q)</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 一键清理未使用的镜像、容器、网络、缓存</span></span><br><span class="line">docker system prune -a -f</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="14-如何临时退出容器终端而不终止？"><a href="#14-如何临时退出容器终端而不终止？" class="headerlink" title="14. 如何临时退出容器终端而不终止？"></a>14. 如何临时退出容器终端而不终止？</h3><p>按 <code>Ctrl+P</code> 然后按 <code>Ctrl+Q</code>。</p> <p>注意：按 <code>Ctrl+C</code> 会向容器内应用进程发送 SIGINT 信号，导致容器终止。</p> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="15-可以在一个容器中运行多个应用进程吗？"><a href="#15-可以在一个容器中运行多个应用进程吗？" class="headerlink" title="15. 可以在一个容器中运行多个应用进程吗？"></a>15. 可以在一个容器中运行多个应用进程吗？</h3><p>一般不推荐。如果需要，可以通过额外的进程管理机制实现，例如使用 <code>supervisord</code> 来管理多个进程。</p> <p><strong>最佳实践</strong>：一个容器只运行一个进程/服务，便于管理、监控和扩缩容。</p> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="16-Dockerfile-中-COPY-和-ADD-的区别？"><a href="#16-Dockerfile-中-COPY-和-ADD-的区别？" class="headerlink" title="16. Dockerfile 中 COPY 和 ADD 的区别？"></a>16. Dockerfile 中 COPY 和 ADD 的区别？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>指令</th> <th>说明</th> <th>推荐</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>COPY</strong></td> <td>仅将本地文件拷贝到容器中，行为简单直观</td> <td>✅ 默认推荐</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>ADD</strong></td> <td>除了 COPY 的功能，还支持本地归档自动解压（如 <code>ADD rootfs.tar.xz /</code>）和远程 URL 下载</td> <td>仅在需要自动解压时使用</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>最佳实践</strong>：能用 COPY 就用 COPY，ADD 的额外特性可能带来意外行为。</p> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="17-如何查看-Docker-容器的环境变量？"><a href="#17-如何查看-Docker-容器的环境变量？" class="headerlink" title="17. 如何查看 Docker 容器的环境变量？"></a>17. 如何查看 Docker 容器的环境变量？</h3><p><strong>四种方案</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案1：docker inspect（查看所有信息，JSON 格式）</span></span><br><span class="line">docker inspect container_name | jq <span class="string">'.[0].Config.Env'</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案2：Dockerfile 中 ENV 指令设置</span></span><br><span class="line">ENV SERVER_PORT 80</span><br><span class="line">ENV APP_NAME pkslow</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案3：启动时 --env / -e 参数</span></span><br><span class="line">docker run -itd --name=centos -e SERVER_PORT=80 --<span class="built_in">env</span> APP_NAME=pkslow centos:7</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案4：从文件读取环境变量</span></span><br><span class="line">docker run -itd --name=centos --env-file env.list centos:7</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># env.list 内容：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># VAR1=www</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># VAR2=pkslow.com</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>小技巧</strong>：把宿主所有环境变量传入容器：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="built_in">env</span> > env.list && docker run -itd --env-file env.list centos:7</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="18-Docker-应用流程是怎样的？"><a href="#18-Docker-应用流程是怎样的？" class="headerlink" title="18. Docker 应用流程是怎样的？"></a>18. Docker 应用流程是怎样的？</h3><figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Dockerfile → docker build → Image → 推送 Registry → 拉取镜像 → docker run → Container</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <ol> <li><strong>Dockerfile</strong> — 定义应用的构建方式（源代码）</li> <li><strong>docker build</strong> — 构建镜像（编译产物）</li> <li><strong>Registry</strong> — 发布/共享镜像（类似 Git 仓库）</li> <li><strong>docker run</strong> — 从镜像启动容器运行</li> </ol> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="19-如何创建与环境无关的容器系统？"><a href="#19-如何创建与环境无关的容器系统？" class="headerlink" title="19. 如何创建与环境无关的容器系统？"></a>19. 如何创建与环境无关的容器系统？</h3><p>三种关键技术：</p> <ol> <li><strong>存储卷（Volumes）</strong> — 将数据持久化到宿主机，与容器生命周期解耦</li> <li><strong>环境变量注入（Environment Variable Injection）</strong> — 通过 <code>-e</code> 或 <code>--env-file</code> 注入配置</li> <li><strong>只读文件系统（Read-only）</strong> — 容器根文件系统设为只读，强制数据写入 Volume</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">docker run --read-only -v /data mysql</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <h3 id="20-DevOps-有哪些优势？"><a href="#20-DevOps-有哪些优势？" class="headerlink" title="20. DevOps 有哪些优势？"></a>20. DevOps 有哪些优势？</h3><ol> <li><strong>持续交付能力</strong> — 自动化构建、测试、部署流水线</li> <li><strong>快速修复问题</strong> — 容器化应用可以快速回滚和更新</li> <li><strong>更快的解决问题的速度</strong> — 统一环境降低了「在我机器上是好的」问题</li> </ol> <p><strong>出处</strong>：《Docker 那点破事》— Tom哥</p> <hr> <hr> <h2 id="0x06-Docker-26-新特性与生产进阶"><a href="#0x06-Docker-26-新特性与生产进阶" class="headerlink" title="0x06 Docker 26+ 新特性与生产进阶"></a>0x06 Docker 26+ 新特性与生产进阶</h2><h3 id="21-BuildKit-有哪些高级特性？（-mount-type-cache-mount-type-secret-Here-Docs）"><a href="#21-BuildKit-有哪些高级特性？（-mount-type-cache-mount-type-secret-Here-Docs）" class="headerlink" title="21. BuildKit 有哪些高级特性？（--mount=type=cache / --mount=type=secret / Here-Docs）"></a>21. BuildKit 有哪些高级特性？（<code>--mount=type=cache</code> / <code>--mount=type=secret</code> / Here-Docs）</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Docker 26+（BuildKit 已成默认 Builder）引入了多项 Dockerfile 高级指令，大幅提升构建效率：</p> <figure class="highlight dockerfile"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># syntax=docker/dockerfile:1</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. cache mount：缓存依赖，跨构建复用</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">FROM</span> golang:<span class="number">1.22</span> AS builder</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">RUN</span><span class="language-bash"> --mount=<span class="built_in">type</span>=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="language-bash"> --mount=<span class="built_in">type</span>=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="language-bash"> go build -o /app ./...</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. secret mount：构建时安全访问密钥</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">RUN</span><span class="language-bash"> --mount=<span class="built_in">type</span>=secret,<span class="built_in">id</span>=github_token \</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="language-bash"> GITHUB_TOKEN=$(<span class="built_in">cat</span> /run/secrets/github_token) \</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="language-bash"> go mod download</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. Here-Docs：多行内联脚本，减少 RUN 层数</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">RUN</span><span class="language-bash"> <<<span class="string">EOF</span></span></span><br><span class="line"> apt-get update</span><br><span class="line"> apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates</span><br><span class="line"> rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*</span><br><span class="line">EOF</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 4. --mount=type=bind：从宿主挂载（开发热更新）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">RUN</span><span class="language-bash"><span class="string"> --mount=type=bind,source=.,target=/src \</span></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"><span class="language-bash"> cd /src && go build -o /app</span></span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 5. --mount=type=ssh：构建时使用 SSH Agent</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">RUN</span><span class="language-bash"><span class="string"> --mount=type=ssh ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no git@github.com</span></span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 构建时传参</span></span><br><span class="line">docker build --secret <span class="built_in">id</span>=github_token,src=./token.txt -t myapp .</span><br><span class="line">docker build --ssh default -t myapp .</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：<code>--mount=type=cache</code> 是 CI/CD 构建提速的关键。Go 的 <code>/go/pkg/mod</code>、npm 的 <code>~/.npm</code>、pip 的 <code>~/.cache/pip</code> 都适合缓存。CI 环境需确保 Docker daemon 支持 BuildKit（<code>DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1</code>）</li> <li><strong>安全</strong>：<code>--mount=type=secret</code> 在最终镜像中不保留密钥文件（构建完成后自动清除），比 <code>COPY token.txt / && RUN ... && rm token.txt</code> 安全（后者会在镜像层历史中残留）</li> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：Here-Docs 中的变量默认不展开（字面传递），需要使用 <code>RUN <<'EOF'</code> 禁止展开或 <code>RUN <<EOF</code> 允许展开</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：Docker BuildKit Documentation, Docker Engine 26+ Release Notes</p> <h3 id="22-Docker-Compose-Watch-是什么？解决了什么痛点？"><a href="#22-Docker-Compose-Watch-是什么？解决了什么痛点？" class="headerlink" title="22. Docker Compose Watch 是什么？解决了什么痛点？"></a>22. Docker Compose Watch 是什么？解决了什么痛点？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Docker Compose Watch（Docker 26+，Compose v2.22+）实现了开发时的文件热同步，无需重建镜像即可将本地代码变更实时注入容器：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># compose.yaml</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">services:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">web:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">build:</span> <span class="string">.</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">develop:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">watch:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">action:</span> <span class="string">sync</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">path:</span> <span class="string">./src</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">target:</span> <span class="string">/app/src</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">action:</span> <span class="string">rebuild</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">path:</span> <span class="string">./package.json</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">action:</span> <span class="string">sync+restart</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">path:</span> <span class="string">./config</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">target:</span> <span class="string">/app/config</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>action</th> <th>行为</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>sync</strong></td> <td>文件变更时直接拷贝到容器</td> <td>源代码热更新（不重启）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>rebuild</strong></td> <td>文件变更时重建镜像并重启</td> <td>依赖变更（package.json）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>sync+restart</strong></td> <td>sync 后自动重启容器</td> <td>配置文件变更</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 启动并监听文件变更</span></span><br><span class="line">docker compose watch</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 或</span></span><br><span class="line">docker compose up --watch</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>对比 bind mount</strong>：bind mount 也能实现文件同步，但 Compose Watch 更精细——可以根据文件类型选择 sync/rebuild/sync+restart，且不会因宿主机和容器文件系统差异导致权限问题</li> <li><strong>性能</strong>：sync 使用 <code>docker cp</code> 机制实现增量同步，比 bind mount 在 macOS/Windows 文件系统性能更好（避免 osxfs 性能损耗）</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：<code>node_modules</code> 等大型依赖目录应排除在 sync 之外（通过 <code>.dockerignore</code>），避免同步大量依赖文件拖慢开发体验</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：Docker Compose Watch Documentation</p> <h3 id="23-Docker-的新镜像存储后端（containerd-image-store）有什么变化？"><a href="#23-Docker-的新镜像存储后端（containerd-image-store）有什么变化？" class="headerlink" title="23. Docker 的新镜像存储后端（containerd image store）有什么变化？"></a>23. Docker 的新镜像存储后端（containerd image store）有什么变化？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Docker 26+ 引入了 <strong>containerd image store</strong>（替代传统 graphdriver），将镜像管理完全委托给 containerd，消除 Docker daemon 与 containerd 之间的镜像重复存储：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">传统模式： containerd image store：</span><br><span class="line">┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐</span><br><span class="line">│ Docker Daemon│ │ Docker Daemon│</span><br><span class="line">│ overlay2 │ │ (thin) │</span><br><span class="line">│ /var/lib/ │ └──────┬───────┘</span><br><span class="line">│ docker/ │ │ gRPC</span><br><span class="line">└──────┬───────┘ ┌──────▼───────┐</span><br><span class="line"> │ │ containerd │</span><br><span class="line">┌──────▼───────┐ │ + snapshot │</span><br><span class="line">│ containerd │ │ + images │</span><br><span class="line">│ + snapshot │ │ /var/lib/ │</span><br><span class="line">└──────────────┘ │ containerd/ │</span><br><span class="line"> └──────────────┘</span><br><span class="line"> (镜像存两份！) (镜像只存一份)</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight json"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// /etc/docker/daemon.json</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="punctuation">{</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"features"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="punctuation">{</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"containerd-snapshotter"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="literal"><span class="keyword">true</span></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="punctuation">}</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="punctuation">}</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>存量兼容</strong>：开启 containerd image store 后，旧的 overlay2 镜像不会自动迁移。需 <code>docker save</code> 导出再 <code>docker load</code> 导入，或重新 <code>docker pull</code></li> <li><strong>性能收益</strong>：<code>docker pull</code> 速度提升（不再在 Docker daemon 和 containerd 之间拷贝层数据），<code>docker run</code> 启动更快。镜像共用 containerd snapshot，K8s 可以直接复用</li> <li><strong>注意事项</strong>：部分老旧的 Docker 插件不支持 containerd image store。开启前建议在测试环境验证</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：Docker Engine 26+ Release Notes, Moby Project</p> <h3 id="24-Docker-Bake-是什么？如何组织多镜像构建？"><a href="#24-Docker-Bake-是什么？如何组织多镜像构建？" class="headerlink" title="24. Docker Bake 是什么？如何组织多镜像构建？"></a>24. Docker Bake 是什么？如何组织多镜像构建？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Docker Bake（Docker 28+ GA）是声明式的多镜像构建编排工具，用 YAML/HCL/JSON 定义构建矩阵，替代复杂的 shell 脚本：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br><span class="line">27</span><br><span class="line">28</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">// docker-bake.hcl</span><br><span class="line">variable "TAG" { default = "latest" }</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">group "default" {</span><br><span class="line"> targets = ["web", "worker"]</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">target "web" {</span><br><span class="line"> dockerfile = "Dockerfile.web"</span><br><span class="line"> contexts = { src = "." }</span><br><span class="line"> tags = ["myapp/web:${TAG}"]</span><br><span class="line"> platforms = ["linux/amd64", "linux/arm64"]</span><br><span class="line"> args = { APP = "web" }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">target "worker" {</span><br><span class="line"> dockerfile = "Dockerfile.worker"</span><br><span class="line"> contexts = { src = "." }</span><br><span class="line"> tags = ["myapp/worker:${TAG}"]</span><br><span class="line"> platforms = ["linux/amd64"]</span><br><span class="line"> args = { APP = "worker" }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">target "web-alpine" {</span><br><span class="line"> inherits = ["web"]</span><br><span class="line"> args = { BASE = "alpine" }</span><br><span class="line"> tags = ["myapp/web:${TAG}-alpine"]</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 一键构建所有目标</span></span><br><span class="line">docker bake</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 指定变量</span></span><br><span class="line">docker bake --<span class="built_in">set</span> *.tags=myapp/web:v2.0</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 仅构建特定目标</span></span><br><span class="line">docker bake web</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 打印构建计划（不执行）</span></span><br><span class="line">docker bake --<span class="built_in">print</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>vs docker-compose build</strong>：Compose build 是为运行定义的构建，Bake 是为分发定义的构建（多平台、多 tag、矩阵构建）。Bake 支持 <code>--push</code> 直接推送</li> <li><strong>CI/CD 集成</strong>：Bake 文件可以版本管理，CI 中只需要 <code>docker bake --push</code> 一条命令完成所有镜像构建和推送</li> <li><strong>性能</strong>：Bake 自动并行构建不相关的目标，最大化利用 BuildKit 的并发能力</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：Docker Buildx Bake Documentation, Docker Engine 28 Release Notes</p> <h3 id="25-Docker-Scout-和-SBOM-在企业安全合规中的应用？"><a href="#25-Docker-Scout-和-SBOM-在企业安全合规中的应用？" class="headerlink" title="25. Docker Scout 和 SBOM 在企业安全合规中的应用？"></a>25. Docker Scout 和 SBOM 在企业安全合规中的应用？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Docker Scout（Docker 26+ 内建）提供镜像漏洞扫描、SBOM（软件物料清单）生成和策略评估：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 快速扫描镜像</span></span><br><span class="line">docker scout quickview myapp:v1</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 详细 CVE 报告</span></span><br><span class="line">docker scout cves myapp:v1 --format table</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 生成 SBOM（SPDX / CycloneDX 格式）</span></span><br><span class="line">docker scout sbom --format spdx --output sbom.spdx.json myapp:v1</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 策略评估（CI 中阻断不合规镜像）</span></span><br><span class="line">docker scout policy myapp:v1 --org my-org</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>SBOM 的价值</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">供应链透明化 → 知道镜像中包含哪些组件</span><br><span class="line">漏洞精准定位 → 某 CVE 影响哪些镜像的哪个组件</span><br><span class="line">合规要求 → SOC2 / FedRAMP 要求提供 SBOM</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight dockerfile"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Dockerfile 中声明 SBOM 信息</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># syntax=docker/dockerfile:1</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">FROM</span> alpine:<span class="number">3.19</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">LABEL</span><span class="language-bash"> org.opencontainers.image.source=<span class="string">"https://github.com/myorg/myapp"</span></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">LABEL</span><span class="language-bash"> org.opencontainers.image.vendor=<span class="string">"MyCompany"</span></span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>CI 集成</strong>：<code>docker scout policy</code> 返回非 0 退出码当发现高危 CVE 时，可在 CI pipeline 中阻断构建</li> <li><strong>vs Trivy/Grype</strong>：Docker Scout 的优势是与 Docker Hub/SBOM 深度集成，可追踪多阶段构建的完整依赖链。Trivy 更轻量、开源无订阅限制</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：SBOM 不仅是安全需求，也是合规刚需（如美国行政令 14028）。建议在 release pipeline 中自动生成并存档 SBOM</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：Docker Scout Documentation, Docker Desktop 4.38+ Release Notes</p> <hr> <hr> <h2 id="0x07-生产实战：Docker-内存与日志"><a href="#0x07-生产实战：Docker-内存与日志" class="headerlink" title="0x07 生产实战：Docker 内存与日志"></a>0x07 生产实战：Docker 内存与日志</h2><h3 id="25-Docker-容器中-JVM-OOM-的根因是什么？如何配置-JVM-内存限制？"><a href="#25-Docker-容器中-JVM-OOM-的根因是什么？如何配置-JVM-内存限制？" class="headerlink" title="25. Docker 容器中 JVM OOM 的根因是什么？如何配置 JVM 内存限制？"></a>25. Docker 容器中 JVM OOM 的根因是什么？如何配置 JVM 内存限制？</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐（专家）<br><strong>问题</strong>：某金融公司 Java 微服务容器化后，JVM 频繁被 OOM Kill，即使设置了 <code>-Xmx</code> 也无法解决。为什么 JVM 在容器中会超限使用内存？</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>JVM 在 JDK 8u131 之前完全不知道 cgroup 的存在，<code>-Xmx</code> 限制的是 <strong>Heap</strong>，而非整个进程内存</li> <li>JVM 进程 = Heap + Metaspace + Thread Stack + Code Cache + Direct Buffer + Native Memory + JNI</li> <li>这三项最容易超出预期：<ul> <li><strong>Direct Buffer</strong>：<code>-XX:MaxDirectMemorySize</code> 默认等于 <code>-Xmx</code></li> <li><strong>Metaspace</strong>：动态加载类时持续膨胀（无上限）</li> <li><strong>Thread Stack</strong>：每个线程默认 1MB（<code>-Xss</code>），200 个线程 = 200MB</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <p><strong>🔥 踩坑案例：某互金公司电商订单服务（2024）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：8 个 Java 微服务，每个容器 memory limit = 4GB，<code>-Xmx=3GB</code></li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：每天凌晨 02:00-04:00 随机 OOM Kill 3-5 次，<code>docker inspect</code> 显示 <code>OOMKilled: true</code></li> <li><strong>排查过程</strong>：<ol> <li>先用 <code>docker stats</code> 发现容器 RSS 实际使用 3.6-3.9GB（远超 -Xmx 3GB）</li> <li>看 <code>/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.stat</code> → <code>total_rss</code> 3.8GB，<code>total_cache</code> 0.3GB</li> <li>用 <code>jcmd <pid> VM.native_memory summary</code> 发现 Direct Buffer 占用 600MB+NMT overhead 200MB</li> <li>检查 JVM 参数发现未设置 <code>-XX:MaxDirectMemorySize</code> 和 <code>-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize</code></li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<code>-Xmx=3GB</code> 只限制了 Heap，但 Direct Buffer（默认 = -Xmx = 3GB）+ Metaspace（无上限）+ Thread Stack（64 线程×1MB）使总内存远超容器 4GB 限制</li> <li><strong>修复方案</strong>：<figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># JDK 17+ 推荐配置（2 选 1）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案 A：百分比控制（推荐动态环境）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=60.0</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">-XX:MinRAMPercentage=50.0</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=256m</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案 B：固定值控制</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">-Xmx=2.4g</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">-Xms=2.4g</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">-XX:MaxDirectMemorySize=512m</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=256m</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">-Xss=512k</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>修复效果</strong>：容器 RSS 稳定在 3.2-3.5GB，OOM 降为 0</li> </ul> <p><strong>参数调优指南</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>内存项</th> <th>占容器 limit 比例</th> <th>备注</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>Heap（-Xmx / MaxRAM%）</td> <td>50-65%</td> <td>核心业务内存</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Metaspace</td> <td>~256MB</td> <td>框架+业务 Class</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Thread Stack</td> <td>线程数 × 512k-1MB</td> <td>虚拟线程可大幅降低</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Direct Buffer</td> <td>512MB-1GB</td> <td>网络 IO 密集型</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Code Cache</td> <td>64-256MB</td> <td>JIT 编译</td> </tr> <tr> <td>预留余量</td> <td>10-20%</td> <td>避免 OOM</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>源码分析</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>核心类：<code>hotspot/src/share/vm/runtime/os.cpp</code> → <code>os::Linux::container_support()</code>（JDK 8u131+）</li> <li>JDK 10+：<code>-XX:+UseContainerSupport</code> 默认启用，读取 <code>/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes</code></li> <li>JDK 17+：<code>-XX:+UseContainerSupport</code> + <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage</code> 是最优方案</li> <li>关键路径：<code>os::Linux::physical_memory()</code> → <code>OSContainer::memory_limit_in_bytes()</code> → cgroup 文件读取</li> </ul> <p><strong>对比延伸</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>JDK 8u131-</th> <th>JDK 11</th> <th>JDK 17+</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>容器感知</td> <td>❌ 需手动配置</td> <td>✅ 默认启用</td> <td>✅ 默认启用</td> </tr> <tr> <td>推荐参数</td> <td><code>-XX:MaxRAMFraction=2</code></td> <td><code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=70</code></td> <td><code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=60</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td>DirectBuffer</td> <td>手动限制</td> <td>手动限制</td> <td>手动限制</td> </tr> <tr> <td>虚拟线程</td> <td>❌</td> <td>❌</td> <td>✅ 节省 Stack 内存</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>「<code>-Xmx</code> 限制的是 Heap 而非进程内存——JVM 总内存 = Heap + Metaspace + DirectBuffer + Thread Stack + CodeCache + Native，容器的 memory limit 必须为所有这些项的总和预留 20-30% 余量。JDK 17+ 用 <code>-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=60</code> 是最安全的方案。」</p> </blockquote> <p><strong>参考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8146115">JDK-8146115: Container awareness implementation</a></li> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://stackoverflow.com/questions/37490324/limit-jvm-memory-consumption-in-a-docker-container">StackOverflow: Limit JVM memory in Docker</a></li> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://support.huaweicloud.com/cce_faq/cce_faq_00480.html">华为云: Java容器内存虚高以及OOM问题定位</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="26-Docker-日志驱动不配置会有什么后果？如何配置生产级日志轮转？"><a href="#26-Docker-日志驱动不配置会有什么后果？如何配置生产级日志轮转？" class="headerlink" title="26. Docker 日志驱动不配置会有什么后果？如何配置生产级日志轮转？"></a>26. Docker 日志驱动不配置会有什么后果？如何配置生产级日志轮转？</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐（高级）<br><strong>问题</strong>：某团队上线 Docker 微服务后，运行 7 天后宿主机磁盘写满，所有容器异常重启。排查发现是 Docker 日志文件占用 80GB+ 空间。为什么默认日志配置会导致磁盘满？</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Docker 默认日志驱动是 <code>json-file</code>，每个容器的 stdout/stderr 写到一个 JSON 文件中</li> <li><strong>默认无任何日志轮转限制</strong> — 只要容器一直在写，日志文件无限增长</li> <li>日志文件位置：<code>/var/lib/docker/containers/<CONTAINER_ID>/<CONTAINER_ID>-json.log</code></li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <p><strong>🔥 踩坑案例：某 SaaS 公司 API 网关日志撑爆磁盘</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：6 台 Docker 宿主机，每台运行 15-20 个容器，含一个 Nginx 网关容器（日产生 3GB 日志）</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：运行 6 天后，某宿主机 <code>/var/lib/docker/</code> 占用 92%，容器陆续因「设备无空间」报错崩溃</li> <li><strong>排查过程</strong>：<ol> <li><code>du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log</code> → 发现 Nginx 容器的日志文件 47GB</li> <li><code>docker info --format '{{.LogDrv}}'</code> → 确认使用 <code>json-file</code> 驱动</li> <li><code>/etc/docker/daemon.json</code> → 发现未配置任何 log-opts</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：无日志轮转配置，Nginx 容器连续运行 6 天写入了 47GB 日志</li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：即时 <code>truncate -s 0</code> 清空日志（不停容器），配置日志轮转：<figure class="highlight json"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="punctuation">{</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"log-driver"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="string">"json-file"</span><span class="punctuation">,</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"log-opts"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="punctuation">{</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"max-size"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="string">"10m"</span><span class="punctuation">,</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"max-file"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="string">"3"</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="punctuation">}</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="punctuation">}</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>修复效果</strong>：每个容器日志最大 30MB（3×10MB），磁盘使用从 92% 降到 35%</li> </ul> <p><strong>日志驱动对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>驱动</th> <th>性能</th> <th>日志轮转</th> <th>适合场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>json-file</strong>（默认）</td> <td>中等</td> <td>需手动配置</td> <td>单机调试</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>local</strong></td> <td>最佳</td> <td>内置轮转</td> <td>生产单机</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>journald</strong></td> <td>好</td> <td>systemd 管理</td> <td>配合 journalctl</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>fluentd</strong></td> <td>中等</td> <td>外部控制</td> <td>集中式日志</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>gelf</strong></td> <td>中等</td> <td>外部控制</td> <td>Graylog</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>生产配置模板</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight json"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="punctuation">{</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"log-driver"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="string">"local"</span><span class="punctuation">,</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"log-opts"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="punctuation">{</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"max-size"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="string">"10m"</span><span class="punctuation">,</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"max-file"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="string">"5"</span><span class="punctuation">,</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">"compress"</span><span class="punctuation">:</span> <span class="string">"true"</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="punctuation">}</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="punctuation">}</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>排查命令集</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 立即查看哪些容器日志最大</span></span><br><span class="line">find /var/lib/docker/containers/ -name <span class="string">'*-json.log'</span> -<span class="built_in">exec</span> <span class="built_in">ls</span> -lh {} \; | <span class="built_in">sort</span> -k5 -rh | <span class="built_in">head</span> -10</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 安全清空日志（不重启容器）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">truncate</span> -s 0 /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 检查当前日志驱动</span></span><br><span class="line">docker info --format <span class="string">'{{.LogDrv}}'</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>「Docker 默认日志驱动 <code>json-file</code> 不设轮转——容器的 stdout/stderr 会无限制写入宿主机，直到撑满磁盘。生产环境三条铁律：设 <code>local</code> 驱动 + <code>max-size=10m</code> + <code>max-file=3-5</code>，或直接外挂 Fluentd/Vector。」</p> </blockquote> <p><strong>参考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.docker.com/config/containers/logging/">Docker Logging Drivers Documentation</a></li> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://stackoverflow.com/questions/31829587/docker-container-logs-taking-all-my-disk-space">StackOverflow: Docker container logs taking all disk space</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="27-挂载-var-run-docker-sock-有什么安全隐患？如何替代？"><a href="#27-挂载-var-run-docker-sock-有什么安全隐患？如何替代？" class="headerlink" title="27. 挂载 /var/run/docker.sock 有什么安全隐患？如何替代？"></a>27. 挂载 <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code> 有什么安全隐患？如何替代？</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐（专家）<br><strong>问题</strong>：很多 CICD 工具和监控容器需要挂载 docker.sock 来管理其他容器，但安全团队警告这是「打开了通往主机的后门」。docker.sock 被挂载后到底有多危险？有哪些替代方案？</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Docker daemon 通过 <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code> Unix Socket 暴露完整 API（无认证）</li> <li>挂载 docker.sock 的容器内相当于有 Docker 的 root 权限，可以执行任意 docker 命令</li> <li><code>docker run -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock ...</code> 是常见的错误实践</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <p><strong>🔥 踩坑案例：某 CI 工具 docker.sock 容器逃逸事故</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：Jenkins Agent 容器挂载 docker.sock 来构建和推送镜像</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：某次 Jenkins 构建任务被注入恶意代码，攻击者通过 docker.sock 在宿主机上启动了一个挂载 <code>/</code> 的容器，读取了宿主机上所有容器的环境变量（含数据库密码、API Key）</li> <li><strong>攻击链</strong>：<figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">恶意代码进入 Jenkins Agent 容器</span><br><span class="line">→ 利用 docker.sock 执行 docker run -v /:/host alpine chroot /host</span><br><span class="line">→ 获得宿主机文件系统完整访问</span><br><span class="line">→ 遍历 /var/lib/docker/containers/*/config.v2.json 获取所有容器环境变量</span><br><span class="line">→ 提取数据库密码、云厂商 AK/SK → 横向移动</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：docker.sock 提供的是 <strong>Docker API 的 root 权限</strong>，等价于在宿主机上运行 <code>docker</code> 命令</li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：<ol> <li>立即吊销泄露的凭证</li> <li>用 DinD（Docker in Docker）替代 docker.sock</li> <li>配置 Docker daemon 的 TLS 认证（双向证书）</li> <li>最小权限原则：CI 用 kaniko/buildkit 替代 Docker in Docker</li> </ol> </li> </ul> <p><strong>安全替代方案对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>方案</th> <th>权限隔离</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>DinD</strong>（Docker in Docker）</td> <td>⭐⭐⭐ 容器内独立 daemon</td> <td>CI 构建</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Kaniko</strong></td> <td>⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 无 daemon，纯用户态</td> <td>镜像构建</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>BuildKit</strong></td> <td>⭐⭐⭐⭐ 独立 socket</td> <td>构建缓存</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Rootless Docker</strong></td> <td>⭐⭐⭐⭐ 非 root 运行</td> <td>开发环境</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>TLS Daemon</strong></td> <td>⭐⭐⭐⭐ 双向证书认证</td> <td>远程管理</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># ❌ 危险！不要这样</span></span><br><span class="line">docker run -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock jenkins-agent</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># ✅ 安全方案：Kaniko（无 daemon 构建）</span></span><br><span class="line">docker run -v $(<span class="built_in">pwd</span>):/workspace \</span><br><span class="line"> gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor \</span><br><span class="line"> --dockerfile=Dockerfile \</span><br><span class="line"> --destination=myapp:latest</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># ✅ 安全方案：DinD（隔离 daemon）</span></span><br><span class="line">docker run --privileged -d --name dind docker:dind</span><br><span class="line">docker run --<span class="built_in">link</span> dind:docker -e DOCKER_HOST=tcp://dind:2375 jenkins-agent</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>源码分析</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Docker Engine API 端点列表：<code>https://docs.docker.com/engine/api/v1.45/</code></li> <li>关键 API（挂载 docker.sock 后可直接调用）：<ul> <li><code>POST /containers/create</code> — 创建容器</li> <li><code>POST /containers/{id}/start</code> — 启动容器</li> <li><code>POST /containers/{id}/exec</code> — 在容器中执行命令</li> <li><code>GET /containers/{id}/json</code> — 获取容器配置（含环境变量！）</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>「挂载 <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code> 等于给容器内进程发了一把宿主机 root 钥匙——该 socket 暴露的是无认证的完整 Docker API，攻击者可以用它启动一个挂载全盘的特权容器，完成从容器逃逸到宿主机沦陷只需 3 条命令。生产环境永远用 Kaniko/BuildKit/DinD 替代。」</p> </blockquote> <p><strong>参考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.docker.com/engine/security/#docker-daemon-attack-surface">Docker Security: docker.sock risks</a></li> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://lorikeetsecurity.com/blog/container-escape-techniques">Container Escape Techniques: Lorikeet Security</a></li> </ul> <h3 id="28-Docker-Compose-depends-on-的坑是什么？如何实现可靠的启动顺序？"><a href="#28-Docker-Compose-depends-on-的坑是什么？如何实现可靠的启动顺序？" class="headerlink" title="28. Docker Compose depends_on 的坑是什么？如何实现可靠的启动顺序？"></a>28. Docker Compose <code>depends_on</code> 的坑是什么？如何实现可靠的启动顺序？</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐（高级）<br><strong>问题</strong>：某团队用 Docker Compose 编排服务，<code>depends_on: - db</code> 后应用还是报「数据库连接被拒绝」。为什么 <code>depends_on</code> 不够？如何确保服务就绪后才启动依赖方？</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><code>depends_on</code> 只控制容器<strong>启动顺序</strong>（先启动 db），但不等待 db 的<strong>就绪状态</strong></li> <li>容器启动 ≠ 服务就绪——PostgreSQL 启动可能需要 3-15 秒才能接受连接</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <p><strong>🔥 踩坑案例：某初创公司后端服务启动失败</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：Docker Compose 编排 3 个服务（app → db + redis）</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：<code>docker compose up -d</code> 后 app 容器启动又崩溃，日志报 <code>dial tcp 127.0.0.1:5432: connection refused</code></li> <li><strong>排查</strong>：<ol> <li><code>docker compose logs app</code> → 确认是 db 未就绪，Spring Boot 启动太快</li> <li>检查 compose.yaml → <code>depends_on: - db</code> 已配置</li> <li><code>docker compose logs db</code> → db 容器日志显示仍在 recovery 阶段</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<code>depends_on</code> 只保证 db 容器的进程启动了，不保证 PostgreSQL 的 TCP 端口可连接</li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：使用 <code>condition: service_healthy</code>：</li> </ul> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">version:</span> <span class="string">"3.9"</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">services:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">db:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">image:</span> <span class="string">postgres:16</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">environment:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">POSTGRES_DB:</span> <span class="string">myapp</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">healthcheck:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">test:</span> [<span class="string">"CMD-SHELL"</span>, <span class="string">"pg_isready -U postgres"</span>]</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">interval:</span> <span class="string">3s</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">timeout:</span> <span class="string">2s</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">retries:</span> <span class="number">10</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">start_period:</span> <span class="string">10s</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">app:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">build:</span> <span class="string">.</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">depends_on:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">db:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">condition:</span> <span class="string">service_healthy</span> <span class="comment"># ✅ 等待健康检查通过</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">redis:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">condition:</span> <span class="string">service_healthy</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">restart:</span> <span class="string">unless-stopped</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>方案对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>方案</th> <th>可靠性</th> <th>复杂度</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>depends_on</code> 无 condition</td> <td>❌ 低</td> <td>低</td> <td>只保证启动顺序</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>depends_on</code> + <code>service_healthy</code></td> <td>✅ 高</td> <td>中</td> <td>等待就绪</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>restart: always</code> 自愈</td> <td>✅ 中</td> <td>低</td> <td>崩溃后重试</td> </tr> <tr> <td>init container 脚本</td> <td>✅ 高</td> <td>高</td> <td>循环检测端口</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>「<code>depends_on</code> 在 Compose v2 中的应用层启动保证机制——<code>depends_on</code> 只管容器进程启动，不管服务就绪。生产环境必须用 <code>depends_on: condition: service_healthy</code> 配合 <code>healthcheck</code>，让每个服务自报健康后才启动依赖方。」</p> </blockquote> <p><strong>参考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.docker.com/compose/compose-file/#depends_on">Docker Compose depends_on documentation</a></li> <li><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.docker.com/compose/compose-file/#healthcheck">Docker Compose Healthcheck</a></li> </ul> <blockquote> <p>本文将持续更新。</p> </blockquote> </div> <footer class="post-footer"> <div class="post-eof"></div> </footer> </article> </div> <div class="post-block"> <article itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Article" class="post-content" lang=""> <link itemprop="mainEntityOfPage" itemtype="http://schema.org/Person"> <meta itemprop="image" content="/images/avatar.gif"> <meta itemprop="name" content="xiaoxin1024"> </span> <span hidden itemprop="publisher" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Organization"> <meta itemprop="name" content="xiaoxin1024's Blog"> <meta itemprop="description" content="大海里的一粒沙"> </span> <span hidden itemprop="post" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/CreativeWork"> <meta itemprop="name" content=" | xiaoxin1024's Blog"> <meta itemprop="description" content=""> </span> <header class="post-header"> <h2 class="post-title" itemprop="name headline"> <a href="/2026/06/07/%E5%A4%A7%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E9%9D%A2%E8%AF%95%E9%A2%98-Kafka-%E9%9D%A2%E8%AF%95%E5%85%A8%E8%A7%A3/" class="post-title-link" itemprop="url">大数据面试题：Kafka 面试全解</a> </h2> <div class="post-meta-container"> <div class="post-meta"> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">发表于</span> <time title="创建时间：2026-06-07 18:30:00" itemprop="dateCreated datePublished" datetime="2026-06-07T18:30:00+08:00">2026-06-07</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar-check"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">更新于</span> <time title="修改时间：2026-06-11 10:06:15" itemprop="dateModified" datetime="2026-06-11T10:06:15+08:00">2026-06-11</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-folder"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">分类于</span> <span itemprop="about" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Thing"> <a href="/categories/%E5%A4%A7%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE/" itemprop="url" rel="index"><span itemprop="name">大数据</span></a> </span> </span> </div> </div> </header> <div class="post-body" itemprop="articleBody"> <blockquote> <p>Kafka 高级面试全解，覆盖 ISR 机制、高性能设计、Exactly-Once 和常见生产问题。</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x00-核心机制"><a href="#0x00-核心机制" class="headerlink" title="0x00 核心机制"></a>0x00 核心机制</h2><h3 id="1-Kafka-为什么这么快？"><a href="#1-Kafka-为什么这么快？" class="headerlink" title="1. Kafka 为什么这么快？"></a>1. Kafka 为什么这么快？</h3><p>四大设计：</p> <ol> <li><strong>顺序写磁盘</strong>：每个 Partition 是顺序 Append 的日志文件，顺序 IO 接近内存速度</li> <li><strong>零拷贝（Zero-Copy）</strong>：<code>sendfile()</code> 系统调用，数据从 PageCache 直接到网卡，不经过用户态</li> <li><strong>PageCache</strong>：消息先写到 OS 的 PageCache，异步刷盘。读命中 PageCache 时完全不走磁盘</li> <li><strong>批量 + 压缩</strong>：Producer 批量发送（<code>batch.size</code>/<code>linger.ms</code>），Broker 端支持 gzip/snappy/lz4 压缩</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Producer 批量配置</span></span><br><span class="line">props.put(<span class="string">"batch.size"</span>, <span class="number">16384</span>); <span class="comment">// 16KB 一批</span></span><br><span class="line">props.put(<span class="string">"linger.ms"</span>, <span class="number">5</span>); <span class="comment">// 最多等 5ms</span></span><br><span class="line">props.put(<span class="string">"compression.type"</span>, <span class="string">"lz4"</span>);</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：<code>linger.ms=0</code> 时每条消息立即发送，吞吐量骤降。<code>acks=0</code> 最快但不保证送达，<code>acks=all</code> 最安全但延迟最高</li> </ul> <h3 id="2-Kafka-的-ISR-机制是什么？与-acks-的关系？"><a href="#2-Kafka-的-ISR-机制是什么？与-acks-的关系？" class="headerlink" title="2. Kafka 的 ISR 机制是什么？与 acks 的关系？"></a>2. Kafka 的 ISR 机制是什么？与 <code>acks</code> 的关系？</h3><p><strong>ISR（In-Sync Replicas）</strong>：与 Leader 保持同步的 Follower 集合。</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查看 ISR</span></span><br><span class="line">kafka-topics.sh --describe --topic orders</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Topic: orders Partition: 0 Leader: 1 Replicas: 1,2,3 Isr: 1,2</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># ↑ 3 掉队了</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong><code>replica.lag.time.max.ms</code></strong>（默认 30s）：Follower 超过这个时间没跟上 Leader，被踢出 ISR。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th><code>acks</code></th> <th>行为</th> <th>可靠性</th> <th>延迟</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>0</code></td> <td>不等待任何确认</td> <td>可能丢</td> <td>最低</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>1</code></td> <td>Leader 写入即确认</td> <td>Leader 宕机可能丢</td> <td>中</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>all</code>/<code>-1</code></td> <td>所有 ISR 写入才确认</td> <td>最高</td> <td>最高</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 生产推荐：acks=all + min.insync.replicas=2</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Leader +至少 1 个 ISR Follower 确认才返回</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：如果 <code>min.insync.replicas=2</code> 但 ISR 只剩 Leader 一个，<code>acks=all</code> 的写入会一直等待。设 <code>min.insync.replicas=2</code> 时必须 <code>replication.factor >= 2</code></li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x02-消费与-Exactly-Once"><a href="#0x02-消费与-Exactly-Once" class="headerlink" title="0x02 消费与 Exactly-Once"></a>0x02 消费与 Exactly-Once</h2><h3 id="3-Kafka-如何实现-Exactly-Once-语义？"><a href="#3-Kafka-如何实现-Exactly-Once-语义？" class="headerlink" title="3. Kafka 如何实现 Exactly-Once 语义？"></a>3. Kafka 如何实现 Exactly-Once 语义？</h3><p><strong>幂等 Producer</strong>（<code>enable.idempotence=true</code>）：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Producer 给每条消息分配 PID + Sequence Number</span><br><span class="line">Broker 记录每个 Partition 最近的 5 个 Sequence Number</span><br><span class="line">重复消息（SN <= 已记录）→ 丢弃</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>事务 Producer</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">producer.initTransactions();</span><br><span class="line">producer.beginTransaction();</span><br><span class="line">producer.send(record1);</span><br><span class="line">producer.send(record2);</span><br><span class="line">producer.sendOffsetsToTransaction(offsetMap, <span class="string">"consumer-group"</span>);</span><br><span class="line">producer.commitTransaction(); <span class="comment">// 原子提交：消息 + offset 一起提交</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>消费端</strong>：<code>isolation.level=read_committed</code>，只读已提交事务的消息。</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 消费端配置</span></span><br><span class="line">props.put(<span class="string">"isolation.level"</span>, <span class="string">"read_committed"</span>);</span><br><span class="line">props.put(<span class="string">"enable.auto.commit"</span>, <span class="string">"false"</span>); <span class="comment">// 手动提交 offset</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="4-如何避免消息重复消费？"><a href="#4-如何避免消息重复消费？" class="headerlink" title="4. 如何避免消息重复消费？"></a>4. 如何避免消息重复消费？</h3><p><strong>三层防御</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 1. 业务幂等：数据库 unique key 去重</span></span><br><span class="line">INSERT INTO <span class="title function_">order_consumed</span> <span class="params">(order_id, offset)</span> VALUES (?, ?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 2. Redis 去重</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">String</span> <span class="variable">key</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="string">"consumed:"</span> + orderId;</span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">Boolean</span> <span class="variable">success</span> <span class="operator">=</span> redis.setnx(key, <span class="string">"1"</span>, <span class="number">3600</span>); <span class="comment">// 1小时过期</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">if</span> (!success) <span class="keyword">return</span>; <span class="comment">// 已消费，跳过</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 3. HBase/MySQL 记录消费 offset（精确到 Partition + Offset）</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <h2 id="0x03-生产问题"><a href="#0x03-生产问题" class="headerlink" title="0x03 生产问题"></a>0x03 生产问题</h2><h3 id="5-消息积压怎么处理？"><a href="#5-消息积压怎么处理？" class="headerlink" title="5. 消息积压怎么处理？"></a>5. 消息积压怎么处理？</h3><figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. 定位：找到 lag 最大的 Consumer Group</span></span><br><span class="line">kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server broker:9092 --describe --group my-group</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. 临时扩容</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - 增加 Partition（需要先停服务）</span></span><br><span class="line">kafka-topics.sh --alter --topic orders --partitions 20</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - 增加 Consumer 实例（最多 = Partition 数）</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. 临时跳过积压</span></span><br><span class="line">consumer.seekToEnd(partitions); // 跳到最后，丢弃历史</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 4. 长期优化</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - Producer 压缩（lz4 兼顾速度和压缩比）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - Consumer 批量处理（max.poll.records=500）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - 增加 Consumer 线程（多线程处理）</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>排查方向</strong>：Consumer 处理慢 → 检查下游 DB/Redis 的 RT；Producer 太快 → 加限流或扩容 Partition。</p> <hr> <hr> <h2 id="0x04-Kafka-4-0-新特性与-KRaft"><a href="#0x04-Kafka-4-0-新特性与-KRaft" class="headerlink" title="0x04 Kafka 4.0 新特性与 KRaft"></a>0x04 Kafka 4.0 新特性与 KRaft</h2><h3 id="6-Kafka-4-0-KRaft-模式是什么？与-ZooKeeper-模式的核心区别？"><a href="#6-Kafka-4-0-KRaft-模式是什么？与-ZooKeeper-模式的核心区别？" class="headerlink" title="6. Kafka 4.0 KRaft 模式是什么？与 ZooKeeper 模式的核心区别？"></a>6. Kafka 4.0 KRaft 模式是什么？与 ZooKeeper 模式的核心区别？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Kafka 4.0（2025年3月发布）完全移除 ZooKeeper 依赖，KRaft（Kafka Raft）成为唯一元数据管理模式。KRaft 使用 Raft 共识算法直接在 Kafka Broker 内部管理集群元数据，不再需要外部 ZooKeeper 集群。</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Kafka < 4.0: Kafka 4.0+:</span><br><span class="line">┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────────────────┐</span><br><span class="line">│ Broker │ │ Broker │ │ Broker (Controller) │</span><br><span class="line">│ 节点 │ │ 节点 │ │ + KRaft 共识层 │</span><br><span class="line">└────┬─────┘ └────┬─────┘ │ + 元数据存储 │</span><br><span class="line"> │ │ └──────────────────────┘</span><br><span class="line"> └──────┬───────┘</span><br><span class="line"> ┌──────┴──────┐</span><br><span class="line"> │ ZooKeeper │ ← 外部依赖</span><br><span class="line"> │ Ensemble │</span><br><span class="line"> └─────────────┘</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>ZooKeeper 模式</th> <th>KRaft 模式</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>外部依赖</strong></td> <td>需要独立 ZK 集群（3-5节点）</td> <td>零外部依赖</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>元数据存储</strong></td> <td>ZK 树形结构</td> <td>Kafka 内部 Topic <code>@metadata</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Controller 选举</strong></td> <td>ZK 临时节点争抢</td> <td>Raft 共识选举</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>元数据传播</strong></td> <td>Controller → ZK → Broker（两跳）</td> <td>Controller → Broker 直推（一跳）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Partition 上限</strong></td> <td>~200K（ZK 瓶颈）</td> <td>百万级</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Controller 切换</strong></td> <td>秒级</td> <td>亚秒级</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>部署复杂度</strong></td> <td>需管理两套系统</td> <td>单一系统</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>迁移路径</strong>（ZK → KRaft）：通过 <code>kafka-metadata-quorum.sh</code> 分阶段迁移。Phase 1 部署 KRaft Controller Quorum → Phase 2 启用 Broker 双写 → Phase 3 Broker 切到 KRaft → Phase 4 Controller 脱 ZK → Phase 5 移除 ZK。全程滚动操作，零停机</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：KRaft Controller 节点需奇数个（3/5），类似于 ZK 的过半投票。Controller 和 Broker 可以分离部署（<code>process.roles=controller</code> / <code>process.roles=broker</code>）或合并（<code>process.roles=controller,broker</code>），生产建议分离</li> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：KRaft 模式下 <code>min.insync.replicas</code> 语义不变，但 Controller 节点自身故障会触发 Raft 重新选举，需关注 <code>controller.quorum.election.timeout.ms</code></li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：Apache Kafka 4.0 Release Notes, Confluent Blog</p> <h3 id="7-Kafka-4-0-的-Shared-Groups（KIP-932）是什么？与经典-Consumer-Group-有何不同？"><a href="#7-Kafka-4-0-的-Shared-Groups（KIP-932）是什么？与经典-Consumer-Group-有何不同？" class="headerlink" title="7. Kafka 4.0 的 Shared Groups（KIP-932）是什么？与经典 Consumer Group 有何不同？"></a>7. Kafka 4.0 的 Shared Groups（KIP-932）是什么？与经典 Consumer Group 有何不同？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>KIP-932 在 Kafka 4.0 中引入 <strong>Share Groups（共享消费组）</strong>，实现了真正的队列语义——允许 Consumer 数量超过 Partition 数量，并支持单条消息的独立确认（ack/nack）。</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">经典 Consumer Group: Shared Group (KIP-932):</span><br><span class="line">Partition 0 → Consumer A Partition 0 → Consumer A</span><br><span class="line">Partition 1 → Consumer B ↘ Consumer B</span><br><span class="line">Partition 2 → Consumer C Partition 1 → Consumer C</span><br><span class="line">(Consumer D 闲置！) ↘ Consumer D</span><br><span class="line"> (所有 Consumer 都工作！)</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>经典 Consumer Group</th> <th>Shared Group</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>Consumer : Partition</strong></td> <td>Consumer ≤ Partition</td> <td>无限制</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>消息确认</strong></td> <td>仅 offset commit（批次）</td> <td>单条 ack/nack</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>顺序保证</strong></td> <td>单 Partition 内有序</td> <td>尽力而为，不保证顺序</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>消息重试</strong></td> <td>seek 回退 offset，整批重试</td> <td>nack 单条消息即可重投</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>适用场景</strong></td> <td>流处理、有序消费</td> <td>任务队列、工作分发</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 创建 Share Group</span></span><br><span class="line">kafka-share-groups.sh --bootstrap-server broker:9092 --create --group my-share-group</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查看 Share Group 状态</span></span><br><span class="line">kafka-share-groups.sh --describe --group my-share-group</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：Share Group 在 Broker 端维护 <code>__share_group_state</code> 内部 Topic，记录每条消息的 ack 状态。消息投递后进入 “in-flight” 状态，超时未 ack 自动重投（<code>share.group.max.in.flight.records</code> 控制并发度）</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：用 Share Group 替代 “多 Partition + Worker 线程池” 的 hack 方案（如在 Consumer 内部开线程池处理消息再手动 commit），天然支持动态扩缩 Consumer。但需注意：消息顺序丢失，不适合有状态流处理</li> <li><strong>对比</strong>：RabbitMQ 的 competing consumers 模式天然支持队列语义。Kafka 的 Shared Group 弥补了这一短板，但相比 RabbitMQ 持久队列，Kafka 仍基于 Log 存储，回溯能力更强</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：KIP-932, Confluent Blog</p> <h3 id="8-ELR（Eligible-Leader-Replicas）解决了什么问题？"><a href="#8-ELR（Eligible-Leader-Replicas）解决了什么问题？" class="headerlink" title="8. ELR（Eligible Leader Replicas）解决了什么问题？"></a>8. ELR（Eligible Leader Replicas）解决了什么问题？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>ELR（KIP-966）是 Kafka 4.0 引入的预览特性，解决 ISR 机制在极端场景下的数据丢失问题：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">场景：min.insync.replicas=2, acks=all</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">ZK 模式问题：</span><br><span class="line"> ISR = [Broker1(Leader), Broker2]</span><br><span class="line"> Broker2 故障 → ISR = [Broker1] 只剩 Leader</span><br><span class="line"> 此时 acks=all 的写入只需 Leader 确认即可</span><br><span class="line"> 如果此时 Broker1 也故障 → 数据丢失！</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">ELR 方案：</span><br><span class="line"> ISR = [Broker1, Broker2] ELR = [Broker2] ← 记录最后一个已知同步副本</span><br><span class="line"> Broker2 故障 → ISR = [Broker1]</span><br><span class="line"> 但 ELR 仍记录 Broker2，Leader 选举时优先选 ELR 中的副本</span><br><span class="line"> 避免选到落后太多的副本</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：ELR 不是银弹——如果所有 ISR 和 ELR 副本都挂了，仍然可能丢数据。它只是将丢失窗口缩小</li> <li><strong>与传统 ISR 的关系</strong>：ELR 是 ISR 的补充而非替代。正常运行时 ISR=ELR。仅在 ISR 缩减到不满足 min.insync.replicas 时，ELR 发挥作用</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：结合 <code>unclean.leader.election.enable=false</code>（禁止从非 ISR 副本选举 Leader）使用。开启 ELR 后可以更安全地设为 false</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：KIP-966, Apache Kafka 4.0 Release Notes</p> <h3 id="9-Kafka-Tiered-Storage（分层存储）的架构和收益？"><a href="#9-Kafka-Tiered-Storage（分层存储）的架构和收益？" class="headerlink" title="9. Kafka Tiered Storage（分层存储）的架构和收益？"></a>9. Kafka Tiered Storage（分层存储）的架构和收益？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>KIP-405 在 Kafka 3.9 进入生产就绪，4.0 完善。核心思想：热数据本地存储，冷数据自动迁移到对象存储（S3/MinIO），降低存储成本 80%+。</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">┌──────────────────────────────────────┐</span><br><span class="line">│ Kafka Broker │</span><br><span class="line">│ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ 本地 SSD │ ←→ │ Remote Storage│ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ (热数据) │ │ Manager │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ Segment │ └──────┬───────┘ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ 0-100MB │ │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ └──────────┘ ┌──────▼───────┐ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ S3/MinIO │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ (冷数据) │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ Segment │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ 101MB-1GB │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ └──────────────┘ │</span><br><span class="line">└──────────────────────────────────────┘</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight properties"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Broker 端配置</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">remote.log.storage.system.enable</span>=<span class="string">true</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">remote.log.storage.manager.class.name</span>=<span class="string">org.apache.kafka.server.log.remote.storage.RemoteLogManager</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">remote.log.metadata.custom.metadata.max.bytes</span>=<span class="string">128</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">remote.log.storage.manager.impl.prefix</span>=<span class="string">rsm.config.</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">rsm.config.s3.bucket.name</span>=<span class="string">kafka-tiered-storage</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">rsm.config.s3.region</span>=<span class="string">us-east-1</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Topic 级别</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">kafka-configs.sh</span> <span class="string">--alter --topic my-topic \</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> --add-config remote.storage.enable=true,\</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> local.retention.ms=86400000</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>成本对比</strong>：本地 SSD 约 $0.10/GB/月，S3 标准约 $0.023/GB/月。对于保留 30 天数据的 Topic，分层存储可节省 70-85% 存储成本</li> <li><strong>延迟权衡</strong>：消费热数据（本地 Segments）延迟不变。消费冷数据（远程 Segments）首次访问有 S3 GET 延迟（~50-200ms），但会缓存到本地</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：<code>local.retention.ms</code> 控制本地保留时间。设为 1 天意味着最近 24 小时数据全在本地 SSD。设太大会降低分层存储收益，设太小会增加 S3 请求费用</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：KIP-405, Apache Kafka Documentation</p> <h3 id="10-Kafka-4-0-客户端监控新特性（KIP-714-KIP-1076）？"><a href="#10-Kafka-4-0-客户端监控新特性（KIP-714-KIP-1076）？" class="headerlink" title="10. Kafka 4.0 客户端监控新特性（KIP-714 / KIP-1076）？"></a>10. Kafka 4.0 客户端监控新特性（KIP-714 / KIP-1076）？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Kafka 4.0 大幅增强了客户端可观测性。KIP-714 允许客户端将自身指标推送到 Broker，KIP-1076 扩展支持 Kafka Streams 等应用级指标上报。</p> <figure class="highlight properties"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Producer/Consumer 端开启指标推送</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">enable.metrics.push</span>=<span class="string">true</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">metrics.push.interval.ms</span>=<span class="string">10000 # 每10秒推送一次</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>Broker 端自动创建 <code>__client_metrics</code> 内部 Topic 存储所有客户端指标：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查看客户端指标</span></span><br><span class="line">kafka-client-metrics.sh --bootstrap-server broker:9092 --list</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 典型指标</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - produce-total-time-avg: 生产平均延迟</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - fetch-total-time-avg: 消费平均延迟 </span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - io-ratio: IO 线程繁忙度</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - connection-count: 连接数</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - outgoing-byte-rate: 出站流量</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>架构优势</strong>：传统方式需每个客户端部署 Prometheus JMX Exporter，KIP-714 统一了指标采集出口，无需额外组件</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：<code>metrics.push.interval.ms</code> 不宜设太小（如 1s），会产生大量内部 Topic 流量。建议 10-30s。Broker 端 <code>__client_metrics</code> 默认保留 24h，通过 kafka-console-consumer 可直接消费分析</li> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：指标推送使用 Producer 内部线程，不阻塞业务线程。但如果 Broker 不可达，指标会丢失（Fire-and-Forget 模式），不影响业务</li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：KIP-714, KIP-1076, Apache Kafka 4.0 Release Notes</p> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-生产运维与故障排查"><a href="#0x05-生产运维与故障排查" class="headerlink" title="0x05 生产运维与故障排查"></a>0x05 生产运维与故障排查</h2><h3 id="9-Kafka-Consumer-Rebalance-深度故障排查：为什么你的消费者卡住了？"><a href="#9-Kafka-Consumer-Rebalance-深度故障排查：为什么你的消费者卡住了？" class="headerlink" title="9. Kafka Consumer Rebalance 深度故障排查：为什么你的消费者卡住了？"></a>9. Kafka Consumer Rebalance 深度故障排查：为什么你的消费者卡住了？</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Kafka Consumer Group 出现频繁或长时间的 Rebalance，导致消费延迟飙升，如何定位和解决？</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <p>Kafka Consumer Rebalance 是分区所有权重新分配的过程。Kafka 使用 <strong>Cooperative Sticky Assignor</strong>（Kafka 3.1+ 默认）替代了旧的 Eager 协议。</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"># Rebalance 触发条件</span><br><span class="line">1. 新 consumer 加入 group (JoinGroup)</span><br><span class="line">2. 现有 consumer 超时未发心跳 (Session Timeout)</span><br><span class="line">3. Group 订阅 topic 变更</span><br><span class="line">4. Consumer Group 元数据变更</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"># 两种 Rebalance 协议对比</span><br><span class="line">Eager (旧): Stop-the-World → 所有消费者收回分区 → 重新分配 → 恢复消费</span><br><span
