id="0x04-Hive-4-0-与-Iceberg-集成深度解析"><a href="#0x04-Hive-4-0-与-Iceberg-集成深度解析" class="headerlink" title="0x04 Hive 4.0 与 Iceberg 集成深度解析"></a>0x04 Hive 4.0 与 Iceberg 集成深度解析</h2><h3 id="9-Hive-4-0-Iceberg-原生集成"><a href="#9-Hive-4-0-Iceberg-原生集成" class="headerlink" title="9. Hive 4.0 Iceberg 原生集成"></a>9. Hive 4.0 Iceberg 原生集成</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Hive 4.0 如何原生支持 Apache Iceberg？和传统的 Hive 表有什么根本区别？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Hive 4.0 通过 <strong>HiveIcebergStorageHandler</strong> 提供对 Iceberg 表格式的原生支持，使得 Hive 可以直接创建、读取、写入 Iceberg 表。</p> <p><strong>架构差异</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">传统 Hive 表： SQL → Hive Metastore（目录路径）→ 列出目录文件 → 读取</span><br><span class="line">Iceberg 表： SQL → Hive Metastore（metadata 指针）→ Iceberg metadata → 定位文件 → 读取</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>创建 Iceberg 表（Hive 4.0+）</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 使用 STORED BY ICEBERG</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">CREATE TABLE</span> iceberg_orders (</span><br><span class="line"> order_id <span class="type">BIGINT</span>,</span><br><span class="line"> user_id <span class="type">BIGINT</span>,</span><br><span class="line"> amount <span class="type">DECIMAL</span>(<span class="number">10</span>,<span class="number">2</span>),</span><br><span class="line"> order_date <span class="type">DATE</span></span><br><span class="line">)</span><br><span class="line">STORED <span class="keyword">BY</span> <span class="string">'org.apache.iceberg.mr.hive.HiveIcebergStorageHandler'</span></span><br><span class="line">PARTITIONED <span class="keyword">BY</span> (order_date);</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 或使用 STORED AS ICEBERG（简写）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">CREATE TABLE</span> iceberg_orders (...)</span><br><span class="line">STORED <span class="keyword">AS</span> ICEBERG;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>Hive 4.0 Iceberg 支持矩阵</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>特性</th> <th>支持程度</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>CREATE TABLE</td> <td>✅</td> <td>原生创建 Iceberg 表</td> </tr> <tr> <td>SELECT</td> <td>✅</td> <td>完整查询支持</td> </tr> <tr> <td>INSERT INTO/OVERWRITE</td> <td>✅</td> <td>批量写入</td> </tr> <tr> <td>DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE</td> <td>✅</td> <td>需 Tez 引擎（MapReduce 不支持）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>时间旅行</td> <td>⚠️ 有限</td> <td>通过表属性设置快照，不支持 SQL 语法</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Schema Evolution</td> <td>✅</td> <td>ALTER TABLE ADD/RENAME COLUMN</td> </tr> <tr> <td>分区演进</td> <td>⚠️ 有限</td> <td>通过 ALTER TABLE 修改分区策略</td> </tr> <tr> <td>存储策略</td> <td>CoW 仅可读</td> <td>不产生 MoR（Merge-on-Read）文件</td> </tr> <tr> <td>格式版本</td> <td>v1/v2</td> <td>不支持 v3（捆绑 Iceberg 1.4.3）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：Hive 4.0 捆绑的是 Iceberg 1.4.3，功能落后当前最新版本（1.11+）。不支持 Iceberg v3 的 Deletion Vectors、VARIANT 类型等新特性。DELETE/UPDATE/MERGE 只能在 Tez 引擎上运行，MapReduce 模式会失败。不适合作为实时写入入口（建议用 Flink/Spark 写 Iceberg，Hive 纯读）。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>源码层面</strong>：<code>HiveIcebergStorageHandler</code> 实现了 Hive 的 <code>StorageHandler</code> 接口，将 Hive 的 SQL 操作转化为 Iceberg 的 Table API。关键在于 InputFormat/OutputFormat 的实现——<code>HiveIcebergInputFormat</code> 通过 Iceberg 的 TableScan API 定位文件，而非 Hive 传统的目录列表方式。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Hive 4.0 + Iceberg 的方案是”存量 Hive 用户的渐进式迁移路径”。相比直接用 Spark/Flink + Iceberg，优势是不改变用户的 SQL 工具链；劣势是性能不如 Spark/Trino 原生 Iceberg 集成。一个典型混合架构：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">写：Flink/Spark → Iceberg（实时/近实时写入）</span><br><span class="line">读：Hive 4.0 → Iceberg（历史数据查询） + Trino → Iceberg（交互式分析）</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：生产上不建议用 Hive 做 Iceberg 写入——批量写入性能差且不支持 MoR。典型用法是”Spark/Flink 写 Iceberg，Hive 4.0 读 Iceberg”，利用 Hive 已有的 SQL 调度体系。迁移旧 Hive 表到 Iceberg 建议用 <code>ALTER TABLE ... SET STORED AS ICEBERG</code>（见下题）。</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Apache Iceberg Hive Docs: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://iceberg.apache.org/docs/latest/hive">https://iceberg.apache.org/docs/latest/hive</a></li> <li>OLake “Apache Hive 4.0+ & Iceberg Integration”: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://olake.io/iceberg/query-engine/hive">https://olake.io/iceberg/query-engine/hive</a></li> </ul> <hr> <h3 id="10-Hive-表迁移到-Iceberg：ALTER-TABLE-SET-STORED-AS-ICEBERG"><a href="#10-Hive-表迁移到-Iceberg：ALTER-TABLE-SET-STORED-AS-ICEBERG" class="headerlink" title="10. Hive 表迁移到 Iceberg：ALTER TABLE SET STORED AS ICEBERG"></a>10. Hive 表迁移到 Iceberg：ALTER TABLE SET STORED AS ICEBERG</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：如何将已有的 Hive 表迁移到 Iceberg 格式？迁移过程中有哪些注意事项？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Hive 4.0 提供了 <strong>ALTER TABLE SET STORED AS ICEBERG</strong> 命令，可以将现有 Hive 表就地迁移为 Iceberg 格式。</p> <p><strong>迁移步骤</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 1. 迁移表格式（Hive 4.0+）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">ALTER TABLE</span> hive_orders <span class="keyword">SET</span> STORED <span class="keyword">AS</span> ICEBERG;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 2. 可选：后续调整分区策略</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">ALTER TABLE</span> hive_orders <span class="keyword">SET</span> <span class="keyword">PARTITION</span> SPEC (days(order_date));</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 3. 压缩小文件</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">ALTER TABLE</span> hive_orders <span class="keyword">EXECUTE</span> COMPACT;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>迁移原理</strong>：该命令不会重写数据文件，而是在原表目录下生成 Iceberg 的 metadata 文件（metadata.json → manifest list → manifest files），将已有的 Parquet/ORC 文件”纳入”Iceberg 管理。</p> <p><strong>迁移策略对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>策略</th> <th>方式</th> <th>优点</th> <th>缺点</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>就地迁移</td> <td><code>ALTER TABLE SET STORED AS ICEBERG</code></td> <td>零数据拷贝、速度快</td> <td>需 Hive 4.0+；存在回滚风险</td> </tr> <tr> <td>CTAS 迁移</td> <td><code>CREATE TABLE iceberg_tbl STORED AS ICEBERG AS SELECT * FROM hive_tbl</code></td> <td>安全、可灰度</td> <td>全量数据拷贝、耗时长</td> </tr> <tr> <td>增量迁移</td> <td>并行写双表，切流</td> <td>业务无感</td> <td>复杂度高、需双写一致性</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：就地迁移是单向操作，回滚困难——迁移后元数据变为 Iceberg 格式，回退需要重新创建 Hive 表。迁移前务必：</p> <ol> <li>备份 Hive Metastore</li> <li>在测试环境验证</li> <li>检查数据文件兼容性（ORC/Parquet 都支持，但自定义 SerDe 不行）</li> </ol> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：大表（TB 级以上）推荐 CTAS + 灰度验证，小表可以直接就地迁移。迁移后立即验证：<code>SELECT * FROM table FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF ...</code> 确认时间旅行可用。注意：迁移后旧 Hive 的 <code>MSCK REPAIR TABLE</code> 不再有效——Iceberg 自动管理分区。</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>OLake “Hive 4.0 Iceberg Integration”: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://olake.io/iceberg/query-engine/hive">https://olake.io/iceberg/query-engine/hive</a></li> <li>Conduktor “Migrating to Iceberg from Hive”: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.conduktor.io/glossary/migrating-to-apache-iceberg-from-hive-or-parquet">https://www.conduktor.io/glossary/migrating-to-apache-iceberg-from-hive-or-parquet</a></li> </ul> <hr> <h3 id="11-Hive-数据倾斜：动态分区导致的小文件问题"><a href="#11-Hive-数据倾斜：动态分区导致的小文件问题" class="headerlink" title="11. Hive 数据倾斜：动态分区导致的小文件问题"></a>11. Hive 数据倾斜：动态分区导致的小文件问题</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Hive 动态分区写入时产生大量小文件，如何处理？Iceberg 如何解决这个问题？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p><strong>传统 Hive 动态分区问题</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 危险：每个 partition + reduce task 组合生成一个文件</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">INSERT</span> OVERWRITE <span class="keyword">TABLE</span> orders <span class="keyword">PARTITION</span>(dt)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SELECT</span> ..., dt <span class="keyword">FROM</span> source;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 如果有 1000 个分区，每个 200 个 reducer → 最多 200,000 个文件！</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>缓解方案</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 1. 减少 reducer 数量</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SET</span> hive.exec.reducers.bytes.per.reducer<span class="operator">=</span><span class="number">256000000</span>; <span class="comment">-- 256MB per reducer</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 2. 使用 DISTRIBUTE BY 控制文件数</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">INSERT</span> OVERWRITE <span class="keyword">TABLE</span> orders <span class="keyword">PARTITION</span>(dt)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SELECT</span> ..., dt <span class="keyword">FROM</span> source</span><br><span class="line">DISTRIBUTE <span class="keyword">BY</span> dt, <span class="built_in">FLOOR</span>(RAND() <span class="operator">*</span> <span class="number">10</span>); <span class="comment">-- 每个分区最多 10 个文件</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 3. 合并小文件（事后）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SET</span> hive.merge.mapfiles<span class="operator">=</span><span class="literal">true</span>;</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SET</span> hive.merge.mapredfiles<span class="operator">=</span><span class="literal">true</span>;</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SET</span> hive.merge.size.per.task<span class="operator">=</span><span class="number">256000000</span>;</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SET</span> hive.merge.smallfiles.avgsize<span class="operator">=</span><span class="number">128000000</span>;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>Iceberg 的解决方案</strong>：<br>Iceberg 从根本上消除了”文件数 = 分区数 × reducer数”的耦合：</p> <ul> <li><strong>自动合并</strong>：写入时自动匹配合适的文件大小（target file size）</li> <li><strong>Compaction</strong>：定期执行 <code>OPTIMIZE</code> 或 Hive 的 <code>ALTER TABLE EXECUTE COMPACT</code></li> <li><strong>无需 MSCK REPAIR</strong>：Iceberg 通过 metadata 跟踪文件，新增分区无需手动修复</li> </ul> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- Hive 4.0 中 Iceberg 表的 compaction</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">ALTER TABLE</span> iceberg_orders <span class="keyword">EXECUTE</span> COMPACT;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：动态分区上限 <code>hive.exec.max.dynamic.partitions</code> 默认 1000，超出会报错。对于高基数分区字段（如 user_id），绝对不能做动态分区——应该用分桶（Bucketing）替代。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：生产上最实用的组合是 <code>DISTRIBUTE BY dt, CAST(RAND() * N AS INT)</code> 控制每分区文件数 + <code>hive.merge</code> 事后合并。但根本解决方案是迁移到 Iceberg——其自动文件管理和 Compaction 机制从根本上解决了小文件问题。</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Hive LanguageManual DML: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/LanguageManual+DML">https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/LanguageManual+DML</a></li> <li>Iceberg Hive Integration: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://iceberg.apache.org/docs/latest/hive">https://iceberg.apache.org/docs/latest/hive</a></li> </ul> <hr> <h3 id="12-Hive-MERGE-INTO-与-ACID-事务的生产实践"><a href="#12-Hive-MERGE-INTO-与-ACID-事务的生产实践" class="headerlink" title="12. Hive MERGE INTO 与 ACID 事务的生产实践"></a>12. Hive MERGE INTO 与 ACID 事务的生产实践</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Hive 的 MERGE INTO 和 ACID 事务在生产中有哪些实际限制？如何正确使用？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Hive 从 3.0 开始支持 ACID 事务和 MERGE INTO，但生产上有很多限制需要了解。</p> <p><strong>MERGE INTO 语法</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="keyword">MERGE</span> <span class="keyword">INTO</span> target_table <span class="keyword">AS</span> t</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">USING</span> source_table <span class="keyword">AS</span> s</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">ON</span> t.id <span class="operator">=</span> s.id</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">WHEN</span> MATCHED <span class="keyword">AND</span> t.amount <span class="operator"><></span> s.amount <span class="keyword">THEN</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">UPDATE</span> <span class="keyword">SET</span> amount <span class="operator">=</span> s.amount, update_time <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="built_in">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">WHEN</span> <span class="keyword">NOT</span> MATCHED <span class="keyword">THEN</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">INSERT</span> <span class="keyword">VALUES</span> (s.id, s.amount, <span class="built_in">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP</span>)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">WHEN</span> MATCHED <span class="keyword">AND</span> s.deleted <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="literal">true</span> <span class="keyword">THEN</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">DELETE</span>;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>生产限制与注意事项</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>限制</th> <th>说明</th> <th>对策</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>仅支持 ORC</td> <td>ACID 表必须是 ORC 格式，且 <code>transactional=true</code></td> <td>建表时指定 STORED AS ORC</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Bucketing 要求</td> <td>Hive 3.x 要求分桶，4.0 放宽</td> <td>4.0 升级后可省去</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Compaction</td> <td>每次 MERGE 产生 delta 文件，需定期 Compaction</td> <td>配置自动 Compaction</td> </tr> <tr> <td>性能</td> <td>比传统 INSERT OVERWRITE 慢 3-10x</td> <td>小批量用 MERGE，大批量用 INSERT OVERWRITE</td> </tr> <tr> <td>并发限制</td> <td>同一分区同时只能有一个写入</td> <td>按分区粒度调度</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Tez 依赖</td> <td>MERGE/UPDATE/DELETE 必须用 Tez</td> <td>MapReduce 不可用</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：Hive 的 ACID 实现基于”delta 文件 + 基础文件”模型，频繁 MERGE 会导致大量 delta 文件积压，查询时需要合并 delta 和基础文件（读放大）。<code>ALTER TABLE ... COMPACT</code> 的必要性常被忽视，导致查询越来越慢。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Hive ACID vs Iceberg MERGE：</p> <ul> <li>Hive ACID：Hive 原生、SQL 支持好、但性能差、格式绑定 ORC</li> <li>Iceberg MERGE：引擎无关、支持 Parquet/ORC/Avro、性能更好、Hive 4.0 支持</li> <li>建议：新项目直接用 Iceberg 表 + MERGE，旧 Hive ACID 表逐步迁移</li> </ul> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：如果 MERGE 数据量超过表大小的 10%，考虑改用 INSERT OVERWRITE 全量替换分区。Compaction 建议在业务低峰期自动执行（<code>hive.compactor.worker.threads=1</code>），避免和查询争抢资源。</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Hive ACID docs: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/Hive+Transactions">https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/Hive+Transactions</a></li> <li>Cloudera Hive 3 ACID: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.cloudera.com/cdw-runtime/cloud/using-hiveql/topics/hive_3_internals.html">https://docs.cloudera.com/cdw-runtime/cloud/using-hiveql/topics/hive_3_internals.html</a></li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-Hive-4-x-深度调优与生产实践"><a href="#0x05-Hive-4-x-深度调优与生产实践" class="headerlink" title="0x05 Hive 4.x 深度调优与生产实践"></a>0x05 Hive 4.x 深度调优与生产实践</h2><h3 id="13-Hive-LLAP（Live-Long-and-Process）：架构与核心调优参数"><a href="#13-Hive-LLAP（Live-Long-and-Process）：架构与核心调优参数" class="headerlink" title="13. Hive LLAP（Live Long and Process）：架构与核心调优参数"></a>13. Hive LLAP（Live Long and Process）：架构与核心调优参数</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Hive LLAP 是什么？它的架构如何提升查询性能？核心调优参数有哪些？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>LLAP（Live Long and Process）是 Hive 2.0+ 引入的<strong>常驻查询服务</strong>，通过在 DataNode 上运行长期存活的守护进程，大幅减少查询启动开销和中间结果 I/O。</p> <p><strong>架构对比</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">传统 Hive（没有 LLAP）:</span><br><span class="line"> ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐</span><br><span class="line"> │ 客户端 │───→│ Tez AM │───→│ Container │</span><br><span class="line"> │ │ │ (启动) │ │ (启动+停止)│</span><br><span class="line"> └─────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘</span><br><span class="line"> 每次查询：启动 Tez Session → 分配 Container → 执行 → 回收</span><br><span class="line"> 启动时间 5-30s + 数据读取时间长</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">Hive LLAP:</span><br><span class="line"> ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐</span><br><span class="line"> │ 客户端 │───→│ LLAP Worker │───→│ LLAP Daemon │</span><br><span class="line"> │ │ │ (常驻进程) │ │ (Row Store) │</span><br><span class="line"> └─────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘</span><br><span class="line"> 每次查询：直接利用常驻 Worker 进程执行（零启动）</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>LLAP 核心机制</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>常驻 Worker</strong>：每个 DataNode 运行一个 LLAP Daemon 进程（内存 + CPU 预留），永远在线</li> <li><strong>行缓存（Row Store）</strong>：将热数据缓存在 LLAP Daemon 的 off-heap 内存中，避免重复读取 HDFS</li> <li><strong>预取（Prefetch）</strong>：LLAP Worker 在查询执行前预取列存数据，IO 和计算管道化</li> <li><strong>结果缓存</strong>：中间结果在 LLAP 内部传递，避免写 HDFS（Tez 的传统模式需要写 HDFS）</li> </ul> <p><strong>核心配置</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight xml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br><span class="line">27</span><br><span class="line">28</span><br><span class="line">29</span><br><span class="line">30</span><br><span class="line">31</span><br><span class="line">32</span><br><span class="line">33</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"><!-- LLAP 内存配置 --></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"><<span class="name">property</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">name</span>></span>hive.llap.daemon.yarn.container.mb<span class="tag"></<span class="name">name</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">value</span>></span>32768<span class="tag"></<span class="name">value</span>></span> <span class="comment"><!-- 32GB 每个 LLAP Daemon --></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"></<span class="name">property</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"><<span class="line">60</span><br><span class="line">61</span><br><span class="line">62</span><br><span class="line">63</span><br><span class="line">64</span><br><span class="line">65</span><br><span class="line">90</span><br><span class="line">91</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">查询类型 无 LLAP 有 LLAP 提升</span><br><span class="line">简单扫描 (1TB) 45s 8s 5.6x</span><br><span class="line">聚合查询 120s 22s 5.5x</span><br><span class="line">多表 Join 300s 65s 4.6x</span><br><span class="line">**</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">**深入思考**：</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">- **边界情况**：LLAP 不是灵丹妙药。对于一次性的大表扫描（每天一次、全表读取），LLAP 的缓存收益有限——因为缓存只在第二次相同查询时生效。LLAP 最适合**重复执行的仪表盘查询**和**交互式分析**，不适合批处理 ETL。</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">- **源码层面**：LLAP 的 IO 层（`org.apache.hive.llap.io`）使用 DirectByteBuffer 存储缓存数据，通过 `LlapIoMemAllocator` 管理 off-heap 内存。预取通过 `PrefetchRequestHandler` 异步发起 `HDFS readAhead` 调用。核心限制在 `DirectByteBuffer` 的 -XX:MaxDirectMemorySize 参数，生产上需要单独调大。</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">- **对比延伸**：</span><br><span class="line"> - Hive LLAP vs Presto/Trino：LLAP 调度在 YARN 上，资源管理统一（与 MapReduce/Tez 共享集群）；Trino 独立集群，资源隔离好但需额外运维</span><br><span class="line"> - Hive LLAP vs Spark Thrift Server：LLAP 直接运行在 DataNode 上，数据本地性天然保障（NODE_LOCAL）；Spark TSS 依赖 AQE 解决数据本地性</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">- **生产经验**：LLAP 的内存分配是最容易出问题的配置。`hive.llap.daemon.yarn.container.mb` 分配太多会抢占 DataNode 和 YARN NM 的内存；分配太少缓存命中率低。经验公式：LLAP Daemon = 节点总内存 × 40% - DataNode 内存。例如 64GB 节点，DataNode 预留 16GB，则 LLAP 设为 (64-16)×0.4 ≈ 19GB（约 20GB）。</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">**参考来源**：</span><br><span class="line">- LLAP Design Doc: https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/LLAP</span><br><span class="line">- Cloudera LLAP Tuning Guide: https://docs.cloudera.com/cdw-runtime/cloud/tuning-hive/topics/hive-llap-tuning.html</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">---</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">### 14. Hive on Tez：关键配置优化与常见踩坑</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">**难度**：⭐⭐⭐</span><br><span class="line">**问题**：Hive on Tez 的核心优化参数有哪些？生产上常见的 Tez 性能瓶颈有哪些？如何排查？</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">**标准答案**：</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">Tez 是 Hive 3.x/4.x 的默认执行引擎，替代了老旧的 MapReduce。Tez 通过 DAG（有向无环图）表达查询计划，避免 MR 的多阶段写 HDFS 问题。</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">**核心配置**：</span><br><span class="line">```xml</span><br><span class="line"><!-- 1. Tez Session 管理 --></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>hive.tez.container.size</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>4096</value> <!-- 每个 Tez Container 内存 4GB --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>tez.session.client.timeout.secs</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>600</value> <!-- Tez Session 超时 10 分钟 --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>tez.session.am.dag.submit.timeout.secs</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>300</value> <!-- DAG 提交超时 5 分钟 --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><!-- 2. 分组输入（Grouping Input）：合并小文件 --></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>tez.grouping.split-count</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>-1</value> <!-- -1 自动决定 --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>tez.grouping.max-size</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>1073741824</value> <!-- 每个分组最大 1GB --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>tez.grouping.min-size</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>16777216</value> <!-- 每个分组最小 16MB --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><!-- 3. 内存调优 --></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>hive.tez.java.opts</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>-Xmx3g -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200</value></span><br><span class="line"> <!-- Java Heap = Container 的 75% --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>tez.runtime.io.sort.mb</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>512</value> <!-- Shuffle 排序缓冲区 --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>tez.runtime.unordered.output.buffer.size-mb</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>128</value> <!-- 无序输出缓冲区 --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><!-- 4. 并行度 --></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>hive.tez.auto.reducer.parallelism</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>true</value></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>hive.tez.max.partition.factor</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>2.0</value> <!-- Reducer 最大为 Partition 数的 2x --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br><span class="line"><property></span><br><span class="line"> <name>hive.tez.min.partition.factor</name></span><br><span class="line"> <value>0.25</value> <!-- Reducer 最小为 Partition 数的 0.25x --></span><br><span class="line"></property></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>常见踩坑案例：Tez Container OOM（某电商离线数仓）</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：每日 30TB 的订单数据 Join + 聚合，使用 Hive on Tez</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：作业运行 10 分钟后大量 Container 被 YARN Kill（OOM），作业失败</li> <li><strong>排查过程</strong>：<ol> <li>YARN 日志：<code>Container killed by YARN for exceeding memory limits. 8GB of 4GB used</code></li> <li>检查 <code>hive.tez.container.size=4096</code>（4GB），但 <code>hive.tez.java.opts</code> 也设为 4GB</li> <li><strong>问题</strong>：Java Heap 占满 Container 全部内存，没有给 off-heap 和 Tez 自身预留空间</li> <li>YARN 的 <code>memory-vcores</code> 比例还不匹配，导致 Container 被 Kill</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>修复方案</strong>：<figure class="highlight xml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="tag"><<span class="name">property</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">name</span>></span>hive.tez.container.size<span class="tag"></<span class="name">name</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">value</span>></span>6144<span class="tag"></<span class="name">value</span>></span> <span class="comment"><!-- 6GB Container --></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"></<span class="name">property</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"><<span class="name">property</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">name</span>></span>hive.tez.java.opts<span class="tag"></<span class="name">name</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">value</span>></span>-Xmx4g<span class="tag"></<span class="name">value</span>></span> <span class="comment"><!-- Heap 4GB，留给 off-heap 2GB --></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"></<span class="name">property</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"><<span class="name">property</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">name</span>></span>tez.runtime.io.sort.mb<span class="tag"></<span class="name">name</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">value</span>></span>1024<span class="tag"></<span class="name">value</span>></span> <span class="comment"><!-- Shuffle buffer 1GB --></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"></<span class="name">property</span>></span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>修复效果</strong>：Container 不再 OOM，作业在 45 分钟内完成</li> </ul> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：<code>hive.tez.auto.reducer.parallelism</code> 自动决定 Reducer 数量，但在数据倾斜严重时，自动计算的 Reducer 数可能过大（每个分区产生一个 Reducer），导致文件碎片。建议配合 <code>hive.tez.max.partition.factor</code> 限制上限。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：Container 内存与 Java Heap 的比例是 Hive on Tez 最容易被忽视的配置。标准比例：Container = Heap × 1.33（Java Heap 占 75%，off-heap + native 占 25%）。Tez 的 <code>tez.runtime.io.sort.mb</code> 和 <code>tez.runtime.unordered.output.buffer.size-mb</code> 都会从 off-heap 中分配，设太大会撑爆 Container。</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Hive on Tez: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/Hive+on+Tez">https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/Hive+on+Tez</a></li> <li>Apache Tez Configuration: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://tez.apache.org/releases/tez-0-10-1/tez-api-javadocs/configs/TezConfiguration.html">https://tez.apache.org/releases/tez-0-10-1/tez-api-javadocs/configs/TezConfiguration.html</a></li> </ul> <hr> <h3 id="15-Hive-4-0-Materialized-View-与自动查询重写"><a href="#15-Hive-4-0-Materialized-View-与自动查询重写" class="headerlink" title="15. Hive 4.0 Materialized View 与自动查询重写"></a>15. Hive 4.0 Materialized View 与自动查询重写</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Hive 4.0 的 Materialized View（物化视图）和自动查询重写是什么？如何利用它加速报表查询？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Hive 4.0 引入了真正的 Materialized View 支持——用户定义预计算逻辑，Hive 自动维护物化视图的增量更新，并在查询时自动重写。</p> <p><strong>创建物化视图</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 创建物化视图，指定刷新模式</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">CREATE</span> MATERIALIZED <span class="keyword">VIEW</span> mv_daily_stats</span><br><span class="line">PARTITIONED <span class="keyword">ON</span> (order_date)</span><br><span class="line">STORED <span class="keyword">AS</span> ORC</span><br><span class="line">TBLPROPERTIES (</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="string">'materialized.view.refresh.mode'</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="string">'INCREMENTAL'</span>, <span class="comment">-- 增量维护</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="string">'materialized.view.auto.refresh'</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="string">'true'</span> <span class="comment">-- 自动刷新</span></span><br><span class="line">)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">AS</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SELECT</span></span><br><span class="line"> order_date,</span><br><span class="line"> product_id,</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">COUNT</span>(<span class="keyword">DISTINCT</span> user_id) <span class="keyword">AS</span> uv,</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">SUM</span>(amount) <span class="keyword">AS</span> total_amount</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">FROM</span> orders</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">GROUP</span> <span class="keyword">BY</span> order_date, product_id;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>自动查询重写</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 用户查询：底层表</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SELECT</span> order_date, product_id, <span class="built_in">COUNT</span>(<span class="keyword">DISTINCT</span> user_id) <span class="keyword">AS</span> uv</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">FROM</span> orders</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">WHERE</span> order_date <span class="operator">>=</span> <span class="string">'2026-06-01'</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">GROUP</span> <span class="keyword">BY</span> order_date, product_id;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- Hive 自动检测到 mv_daily_stats 可以满足此查询</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 自动重写为：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SELECT</span> order_date, product_id, uv</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">FROM</span> mv_daily_stats</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">WHERE</span> order_date <span class="operator">>=</span> <span class="string">'2026-06-01'</span>;</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 用户无感知，执行时间从 120s 降到 3s</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>物化视图 vs 普通视图/表</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>普通视图</th> <th>物化视图</th> <th>手动预聚合表</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>存储</strong></td> <td>不存储（纯逻辑）</td> <td>存储预计算结果</td> <td>存储预计算结果</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>查询性能</strong></td> <td>与查询原表相同</td> <td><strong>极快</strong>（预计算）</td> <td>快</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>数据新鲜度</strong></td> <td>实时</td> <td>取决于刷新频率</td> <td>取决于 ETL 调度</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>自动维护</strong></td> <td>无</td> <td>✅ 自动增量刷新</td> <td>❌ 需 ETL 作业</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>查询重写</strong></td> <td>❌</td> <td>✅ 自动匹配</td> <td>❌</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>适合场景</strong></td> <td>简化 SQL</td> <td>报表/仪表盘加速</td> <td>批量 ETL</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：Hive 4.0 的物化视图自动查询重写有局限性——只支持等值匹配和范围匹配，不支持子查询、非等值 Join、窗口函数的重写。如果查询包含 <code>ROW_NUMBER()</code> 或 <code>LAG()</code>，物化视图不会被命中。另外，物化视图的增量刷新依赖底表的更新日志——如果原表被 TRUNCATE 或 DROP PARTITION，物化视图不会自动感知。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Hive Materialized View vs Trino Materialized View：</p> <ul> <li>Hive：调度在 YARN 上，自动增量刷新，适合 Hive 生态的报表场景</li> <li>Trino：内存计算，无持久化存储，物化视图需外接 Iceberg/Hudi 等存储</li> <li>建议：存量 Hive 用户的报表查询先建 <code>CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW</code> 试水，迁移成本最低</li> </ul> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：物化视图的自动刷新频率通过 <code>materialized.view.auto.refresh.interval</code> 控制（默认 60 分钟）。对于实时性要求高的场景（<5 分钟），物化视图的刷新延迟不可接受——这种情况下建议直接查原表或改用 OLAP 引擎。</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Hive Materialized Views: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/Materialized+Views">https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/Hive/Materialized+Views</a></li> <li>Apache Hive 4.0 Release Notes</li> </ul> class="post-meta-item-text">分类于</span> <span itemprop="about" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Thing"> <a href="/categories/%E5%A4%A7%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE/" itemprop="url" rel="index"><span itemprop="name">大数据</span></a> </span> </span> </div> </div> </header> <div class="post-body" itemprop="articleBody"> <blockquote> <p>Spark 高级面试全解，覆盖 Shuffle 原理、内存管理、Spark SQL 优化和流处理。面向高级研发。</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x00-核心架构"><a href="#0x00-核心架构" class="headerlink" title="0x00 核心架构"></a>0x00 核心架构</h2><h3 id="1-Spark-的-Job、Stage、Task-是怎么划分的？"><a href="#1-Spark-的-Job、Stage、Task-是怎么划分的？" class="headerlink" title="1. Spark 的 Job、Stage、Task 是怎么划分的？"></a>1. Spark 的 Job、Stage、Task 是怎么划分的？</h3><figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Action → Job → 宽依赖切分 Stage → Stage 内 Task（并行度）</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> map reduceByKey map collect</span><br><span class="line">RDD ──→ RDD ────→ RDD ───→ RDD ──→ Action</span><br><span class="line"> 窄依赖 宽依赖(Shuffle) 窄依赖</span><br><span class="line"> Stage0 Stage1 Stage2</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <ul> <li><strong>Job</strong>：一个 Action 操作触发一个 Job</li> <li><strong>Stage</strong>：遇到 Shuffle 依赖（宽依赖）时切分。Stage 内全是窄依赖（pipeline 执行）</li> <li><strong>Task</strong>：Stage 内每个分区对应一个 Task。Task 数 = Stage 最后一个 RDD 的分区数</li> </ul> <figure class="highlight scala"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 这段代码产生 1 个 Job、2 个 Stage</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">val</span> rdd = sc.textFile(<span class="string">"hdfs://..."</span>) <span class="comment">// Stage0 开始</span></span><br><span class="line"> .flatMap(_.split(<span class="string">" "</span>)) <span class="comment">// Stage0（窄依赖）</span></span><br><span class="line"> .map((_, <span class="number">1</span>)) <span class="comment">// Stage0（窄依赖）</span></span><br><span class="line"> .reduceByKey(_ + _) <span class="comment">// Shuffle → Stage1</span></span><br><span class="line"> .collect() <span class="comment">// Action → Job</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：Shuffle 是 Spark 的最大瓶颈。减少 Shuffle 次数是最有效的优化手段——能用 <code>reduceByKey</code> 不用 <code>groupByKey</code></li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/job-scheduling.html">Spark 调度文档</a></p> <h3 id="2-Spark-Shuffle-的三种实现及演进？"><a href="#2-Spark-Shuffle-的三种实现及演进？" class="headerlink" title="2. Spark Shuffle 的三种实现及演进？"></a>2. Spark Shuffle 的三种实现及演进？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>版本</th> <th>实现</th> <th>特点</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>Spark 1.x</td> <td><strong>HashShuffle</strong></td> <td>每个 Task 为每个下游分区创建文件，M×N 个文件。不实用</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Spark 1.2+</td> <td><strong>SortShuffle</strong></td> <td>每个 Task 写一个文件 + 索引。文件数降为 M</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Spark 2.0+</td> <td><strong>Tungsten-Sort</strong></td> <td>堆外内存 + 指针排序，避免 GC。默认启用</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>SortShuffle 流程</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Map Task:</span><br><span class="line"> 数据 → 内存缓冲区(5MB) → 满则溢出排序 → 磁盘 Spill 文件</span><br><span class="line"> → 全部处理完后 Merge Spill 文件 → 输出 1 个数据文件 + 1 个索引文件</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">Reduce Task:</span><br><span class="line"> 读取索引文件 → 按偏移量拉取自己那部分数据 → 归并排序</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight scala"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 绕过 SortShuffle（确定不需要排序时）</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.set(<span class="string">"spark.shuffle.sort.bypassMergeThreshold"</span>, <span class="string">"200"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 当 Map 端分区数 < 200 时，用 BypassMergeSortShuffleWriter</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 每个分区单独文件，直接拼接无需排序</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <h2 id="0x02-内存管理"><a href="#0x02-内存管理" class="headerlink" title="0x02 内存管理"></a>0x02 内存管理</h2><h3 id="3-Spark-统一内存模型是怎样的？"><a href="#3-Spark-统一内存模型是怎样的？" class="headerlink" title="3. Spark 统一内存模型是怎样的？"></a>3. Spark 统一内存模型是怎样的？</h3><figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">JVM Heap (spark.executor.memory = 4g)</span><br><span class="line">├── Reserved Memory (300MB, Spark 内部保留)</span><br><span class="line">├── User Memory (40% × (4g-300m) ≈ 1.5g)</span><br><span class="line">└── Unified Memory (60% × (4g-300m) ≈ 2.3g)</span><br><span class="line"> ├── Storage Memory (50%) — RDD 缓存 / broadcast</span><br><span class="line"> └── Execution Memory (50%) — Shuffle / Join / Sort / Agg</span><br><span class="line"> ↑ 可互相借用（对方不使用时）</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight scala"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 配置</span></span><br><span class="line">--conf spark.memory.fraction=<span class="number">0.6</span> <span class="comment">// Unified Memory 占比</span></span><br><span class="line">--conf spark.memory.storageFraction=<span class="number">0.5</span> <span class="comment">// Storage 在 Unified 中的占比</span></span><br><span class="line">--conf spark.executor.memory=<span class="number">4</span>g</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：OOM 排查第一步——看是 Execution Memory 还是 User Memory 溢出。(1) Execution OOM → 增加分区数、减少单分区数据量；(2) Storage OOM → 用 <code>MEMORY_AND_DISK_SER</code> 溢出到磁盘；(3) User Memory OOM → 减少 UDF 中创建的大对象</li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x03-Spark-SQL-优化"><a href="#0x03-Spark-SQL-优化" class="headerlink" title="0x03 Spark SQL 优化"></a>0x03 Spark SQL 优化</h2><h3 id="4-DataFrame-比-RDD-为什么快？"><a href="#4-DataFrame-比-RDD-为什么快？" class="headerlink" title="4. DataFrame 比 RDD 为什么快？"></a>4. DataFrame 比 RDD 为什么快？</h3><ol> <li><strong>Catalyst 优化器</strong>：逻辑计划 → 优化 → 物理计划 → 代码生成</li> <li><strong>Tungsten 执行引擎</strong>：堆外内存 + 直接操作二进制数据</li> <li><strong>列式存储</strong>：只读需要的列，减少 IO 和内存</li> <li><strong>Whole-Stage Code Generation</strong>：把多个算子编译成一个函数，减少虚函数调用</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight sql"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- Catalyst 自动优化</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">SELECT</span> <span class="operator">*</span> <span class="keyword">FROM</span> orders <span class="keyword">WHERE</span> amount <span class="operator">></span> <span class="number">100</span>;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 优化过程：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 1. 列裁剪：只读 amount 列</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 2. 谓词下推：在 Scan 阶段过滤</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">-- 3. 常量折叠：amount > 100 预编译</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="5-数据倾斜怎么解决？"><a href="#5-数据倾斜怎么解决？" class="headerlink" title="5. 数据倾斜怎么解决？"></a>5. 数据倾斜怎么解决？</h3><p><strong>发现倾斜</strong>：某个 Task 处理时间远超其他（Spark UI 可直观看到）</p> <p><strong>分场景解决</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>场景</th> <th>方案</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>GroupBy 倾斜</strong></td> <td>两阶段聚合（加盐去盐）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Join 倾斜</strong></td> <td>广播小表（Broadcast Join）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>大表 Join 大表倾斜</strong></td> <td>倾斜 key 单独处理</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight scala"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 两阶段聚合：加盐去盐</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">val</span> salted = df.withColumn(<span class="string">"salted_key"</span>, </span><br><span class="line"> concat(col(<span class="string">"key"</span>), lit(<span class="string">"_"</span>), (rand() * <span class="number">10</span>).cast(<span class="string">"int"</span>)))</span><br><span class="line"> .groupBy(<span class="string">"salted_key"</span>).agg(sum(<span class="string">"value"</span>).as(<span class="string">"partial_sum"</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .withColumn(<span class="string">"key"</span>, substring_index(col(<span class="string">"salted_key"</span>), <span class="string">"_"</span>, <span class="number">1</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .groupBy(<span class="string">"key"</span>).agg(sum(<span class="string">"partial_sum"</span>).as(<span class="string">"total_sum"</span>))</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Broadcast Join：小表 < 10MB 时自动触发</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.set(<span class="string">"spark.sql.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold"</span>, <span class="number">10</span>L * <span class="number">1024</span> * <span class="number">1024</span>)</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 倾斜 key 分离</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">val</span> commonKeys = df.filter(col(<span class="string">"key"</span>) =!= <span class="string">"hot_key"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">val</span> hotKey = df.filter(col(<span class="string">"key"</span>) === <span class="string">"hot_key"</span>).hint(<span class="string">"skew"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// hot_key 单独加盐 join，commonKeys 正常 join，最后 union</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <h2 id="0x04-流处理"><a href="#0x04-流处理" class="headerlink" title="0x04 流处理"></a>0x04 流处理</h2><h3 id="6-Structured-Streaming-的-Exactly-Once-怎么保证？"><a href="#6-Structured-Streaming-的-Exactly-Once-怎么保证？" class="headerlink" title="6. Structured Streaming 的 Exactly-Once 怎么保证？"></a>6. Structured Streaming 的 Exactly-Once 怎么保证？</h3><p>Structured Streaming 通过 <strong>WAL（Write-Ahead Log）+ 幂等 Sink</strong> 保证端到端 Exactly-Once：</p> <ol> <li><strong>Source</strong>：Kafka offset 存储在 Checkpoint</li> <li><strong>State</strong>：状态通过 Checkpoint 持久化到 HDFS/S3</li> <li><strong>Sink</strong>：<code>foreachBatch</code> 幂等写（如 upsert 到 MySQL）</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight scala"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Exactly-Once Kafka Sink</span></span><br><span class="line">df.writeStream</span><br><span class="line"> .format(<span class="string">"kafka"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .option(<span class="string">"kafka.bootstrap.servers"</span>, <span class="string">"broker:9092"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .option(<span class="string">"topic"</span>, <span class="string">"output"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .option(<span class="string">"checkpointLocation"</span>, <span class="string">"hdfs://.../checkpoint"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .outputMode(<span class="type">OutputMode</span>.<span class="type">Append</span>())</span><br><span class="line"> .start()</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 手动控制幂等</span></span><br><span class="line">df.writeStream.foreachBatch { (batchDF, batchId) =></span><br><span class="line"> batchDF.write</span><br><span class="line"> .mode(<span class="string">"append"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .jdbc(url, <span class="string">"table"</span>, props)</span><br><span class="line">}.start()</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-场景设计"><a href="#0x05-场景设计" class="headerlink" title="0x05 场景设计"></a>0x05 场景设计</h2><h3 id="7-Spark-内存管理模型"><a href="#7-Spark-内存管理模型" class="headerlink" title="7. Spark 内存管理模型"></a>7. Spark 内存管理模型</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Spark 3.x 的统一内存管理是如何分配内存的？</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：<br>Spark 将 JVM 堆内内存分为三大区域（spark.memory.fraction=0.6）：</p> <ul> <li><strong>Storage Memory</strong>：<code>spark.memory.fraction * spark.memory.storageFraction</code>（默认 0.6 * 0.5 = 0.3）<ul> <li>用途：缓存 RDD、Broadcast 变量</li> <li>可被 Execution 抢占</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Execution Memory</strong>：同上，与 Storage 共享剩余 50%<ul> <li>用途：shuffle、join、sort、aggregation 的中间缓冲区</li> <li>可抢占 Storage 的空间</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Reserved Memory</strong>：300MB，保护 JVM OOM</li> </ul> <p><strong>动态占用</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Execution 可占用 Storage 的闲置空间，反之亦然</li> <li>如果 Storage 需要空间而 Execution 正在使用，不会被强制回收（避免性能退化）</li> </ul> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 调优参数</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.memory.fraction=0.75 <span class="comment"># 总可用内存比例（默认 0.6）</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.memory.storageFraction=0.5 <span class="comment"># 内部 Storage 比例</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.executor.memory=8g <span class="comment"># Executor 总 JVM 堆</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <h2 id="0x07-流处理对比与演进"><a href="#0x07-流处理对比与演进" class="headerlink" title="0x07 流处理对比与演进"></a>0x07 流处理对比与演进</h2><h3 id="8-Spark-Streaming-与-Structured-Streaming"><a href="#8-Spark-Streaming-与-Structured-Streaming" class="headerlink" title="8. Spark Streaming 与 Structured Streaming"></a>8. Spark Streaming 与 Structured Streaming</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Spark Streaming（DStream）和 Structured Streaming 的区别？Structured Streaming 的”端到端 Exactly-Once”是如何实现的？</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：<br><strong>区别</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>Spark Streaming</th> <th>Structured Streaming</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>语义模型</td> <td>DStream（离散化流）</td> <td>无界 DataFrame</td> </tr> <tr> <td>时间语义</td> <td>基于批处理间隔</td> <td>Event Time 原生支持</td> </tr> <tr> <td>一致性</td> <td>At-Least-Once</td> <td>Exactly-Once（提交式 Sink）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>延迟</td> <td>秒级（mini-batch）</td> <td>毫秒级（Continuous Processing）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Watermark</td> <td>需要手动实现</td> <td>内置 Watermark 支持</td> </tr> <tr> <td>API</td> <td>DStream API</td> <td>DataFrame/SQL API</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>Exactly-Once 实现</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><strong>Source</strong>：Kafka 偏移量记录在 checkpoint</li> <li><strong>处理</strong>：幂等计算 + 预写日志（WAL）</li> <li><strong>Sink</strong>：幂等写入（如 Kafka 的 idempotent producer）或事务写入（如 FileSink 的 <code>_SUCCESS</code> 文件）</li> <li><strong>失败恢复</strong>：从 checkpoint 恢复偏移量重新处理，通过 WAL + 幂等 Sink 保证结果不重复</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight scala"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">val</span> df = spark</span><br><span class="line"> .readStream</span><br><span class="line"> .format(<span class="string">"kafka"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .option(<span class="string">"kafka.bootstrap.servers"</span>, <span class="string">"localhost:9092"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .option(<span class="string">"subscribe"</span>, <span class="string">"topic1"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .option(<span class="string">"failOnDataLoss"</span>, <span class="string">"false"</span>) <span class="comment">// Exactly-Once 保证</span></span><br><span class="line"> .load()</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">df.writeStream</span><br><span class="line"> .format(<span .option(<span class="string">"topic"</span>, <span class="string">"output"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .option(<span class="string">"checkpointLocation"</span>, <span
