class="string">固定资源或动态分配</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">☐</span> <span class="string">K8s</span> <span class="string">nodeSelector</span> <span class="string">/</span> <span class="string">nodeAffinity</span> <span class="string">已配置</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 5. 监控</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">☐</span> <span class="string">spark.metrics.conf</span> <span class="string">配置</span> <span class="string">PrometheusServlet</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">☐</span> <span class="attr">spark.ui.prometheus.enabled:</span> <span class="literal">true</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">☐</span> <span class="string">K8s</span> <span class="string">Pod</span> <span class="string">资源利用率</span> <span class="string">+</span> <span class="string">OOMKilled</span> <span class="string">告警</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“Spark on K8s 最大的坑是<strong>数据本地性不可控</strong>。YARN 上 HDFS + YARN NodeManager 同机部署保证了 NODE_LOCAL，K8s 上如果 Executor Pod 和 HDFS DataNode Pod 被调度到不同节点，90% 的 Task 变成 ANY 级别。这不是 Spark 的问题，是 K8s 调度器不理解数据本地性的底层问题。解决方案要么用 NodeSelector 绑定节点，要么用 Volcano/Yunikorn 等支持数据本地性感知的调度器。”</p> </blockquote> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Spark on K8s 官方文档: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/running-on-kubernetes.html">https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/running-on-kubernetes.html</a></li> <li>SPARK-35687 (Dynamic Allocation on K8s)</li> <li>Volcano project: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://volcano.sh/">https://volcano.sh/</a></li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x0A-Spark-4-0-进阶与社区前沿"><a href="#0x0A-Spark-4-0-进阶与社区前沿" class="headerlink" title="0x0A Spark 4.0 进阶与社区前沿"></a>0x0A Spark 4.0 进阶与社区前沿</h2><h3 id="20-Spark-Connect：解耦客户端与服务端架构"><a href="#20-Spark-Connect：解耦客户端与服务端架构" class="headerlink" title="20. Spark Connect：解耦客户端与服务端架构"></a>20. Spark Connect：解耦客户端与服务端架构</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Spark Connect 是什么？它如何改变 Spark 的应用开发模式？与传统 SparkSession 架构相比有哪些优势？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Spark Connect 是 Spark 4.0 引入的<strong>解耦式客户端-服务端架构</strong>，将 Spark Driver 拆分为轻量客户端（Client）和远程服务端（Server），通过 gRPC 协议通信。</p> <p><strong>架构对比</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br><span class="line">27</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">传统 Spark 架构（Spark < 4.0）：</span><br><span class="line"> Application (Driver + Executors 在同一个进程中)</span><br><span class="line"> ┌─────────────────────────────┐</span><br><span class="line"> │ SparkSession (Driver) │</span><br><span class="line"> │ ├── SQL Parser │</span><br><span class="line"> │ ├── Optimizer │</span><br><span class="line"> │ ├── Executor Manager │</span><br><span class="line"> │ └── Scheduler │</span><br><span class="line"> └──────────┬──────────────────┘</span><br><span class="line"> │</span><br><span class="line"> ┌──────▼──────┐</span><br><span class="line"> │ Executors │</span><br><span class="line"> └─────────────┘</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">Spark Connect 架构（Spark 4.0+）：</span><br><span class="line"> 客户端 服务端</span><br><span class="line"> ┌─────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐</span><br><span class="line"> │ App Code │ │ Spark Connect │</span><br><span class="line"> │ (任何语言) │─gRPC──→│ Server (Driver) │</span><br><span class="line"> │ Py/Java/Go │ │ ├── Optimizer │</span><br><span class="line"> └─────────────┘ │ ├── Scheduler │</span><br><span class="line"> │ └── Executor Mgr │</span><br><span class="line"> └────────┬─────────┘</span><br><span class="line"> │</span><br><span class="line"> ┌───────▼───────┐</span><br><span class="line"> │ Executors │</span><br><span class="line"> └───────────────┘</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>关键特性</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>语言无关</strong>：客户端可以是 Python、Java、Go、Rust 等任意 gRPC 支持的语言</li> <li><strong>轻量客户端</strong>：客户端不运行 JVM，不加载 Spark 依赖，启动速度从秒级降到毫秒级</li> <li><strong>远程执行</strong>：<code>df.groupBy("key").count().show()</code> 在客户端构造逻辑计划，gRPC 发送到服务端执行</li> <li><strong>安全隔离</strong>：客户端不直接访问集群资源（HDFS/S3），所有权限由服务端控制</li> <li><strong>支持多租户</strong>：一个 Server 可服务多个 Client 会话</li> </ul> <figure class="highlight python"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Spark Connect 客户端（Python）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">from</span> pyspark.sql <span class="keyword">import</span> SparkSession</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 连接到远程 Spark Connect Server</span></span><br><span class="line">spark = SparkSession.builder.remote(<span class="string">"sc://spark-server:15002"</span>).getOrCreate()</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 之后所有 DataFrame API 用法不变</span></span><br><span class="line">df = spark.read.parquet(<span class="string">"s3://bucket/orders"</span>)</span><br><span class="line">df.groupBy(<span class="string">"status"</span>).count().show()</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 逻辑计划通过 gRPC 发送到服务端执行</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：Spark Connect 当前不支持所有 Spark API——<code>sparkContext</code>、<code>RDD API</code>、<code>accumulators</code> 等底层 API 不可用。如果代码中有自定义 RDD 或累加器，需要改造为 DataFrame API。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>源码层面</strong>：客户端 <code>SparkSession</code> 实际是 <code>SparkConnectClient</code> 的包装，通过 <code>SparkConnectServiceGrpc</code> 将 <code>Relation</code>（逻辑计划 Protobuf）发送到服务端。服务端 <code>SparkConnectService</code> 将 Proto 反序列化为 Spark 内部逻辑计划，提交执行，结果流式返回。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>适合场景：AI/ML Notebook 远程连接、多语言应用调用 Spark、安全敏感的隔离环境</li> <li>不适合场景：需要 SparkContext 或 RDD API 的遗留 ETL、对延迟极度敏感（gRPC 引入 ~10ms 网络延迟）</li> <li>网关架构：Spark Connect + Nginx/AWS ALB 可实现统一 Spark 网关</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Spark Connect Overview: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/spark-connect-overview.html">https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/spark-connect-overview.html</a></li> <li>SPARK-39375 (Spark Connect)</li> </ul> <hr> <h3 id="21-Spark-4-0-VARIANT-数据类型与半结构化数据处理"><a href="#21-Spark-4-0-VARIANT-数据类型与半结构化数据处理" class="headerlink" title="21. Spark 4.0 VARIANT 数据类型与半结构化数据处理"></a>21. Spark 4.0 VARIANT 数据类型与半结构化数据处理</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Spark 4.0 引入的 VARIANT 数据类型是什么？它如何提升 JSON/半结构化数据的处理性能？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>VARIANT 是 Spark 4.0 新增的数据类型，专为<strong>半结构化数据</strong>（JSON、Avro、变长字段）设计，与 Delta Lake 4.0 和 Iceberg v3 的 VARIANT 类型互操作。核心思路：不需要提前定义嵌套 schema，在读取和查询时按需解析。</p> <p><strong>传统方式的问题</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight python"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 传统方式：先定义嵌套 schema，或使用 from_json</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">from</span> pyspark.sql.types <span class="keyword">import</span> StructType, StructField, StringType, LongType</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">schema = StructType([</span><br><span class="line"> StructField(<span class="string">"user_id"</span>, LongType()),</span><br><span class="line"> StructField(<span class="string">"event_type"</span>, StringType()),</span><br><span class="line"> StructField(<span class="string">"metadata"</span>, StringType()) <span class="comment"># 嵌套 JSON 存为字符串！查询慢</span></span><br><span class="line">])</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">df = spark.read.schema(schema).json(<span class="string">"s3://bucket/events"</span>)</span><br><span class="line">df.select(<span class="string">"metadata.browser"</span>) <span class="comment"># 需要解析 metadata 字段，性能差</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>VARIANT 方式</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight python"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Spark 4.0: 使用 VARIANT 类型</span></span><br><span class="line">df = spark.read.table(<span class="string">"events"</span>)</span><br><span class="line">df.select(df.payload.cast(<span class="string">"variant"</span>))</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 直接提取嵌套字段</span></span><br><span class="line">df.selectExpr(<span class="string">"payload:user_id"</span>, <span class="string">"payload:metadata.browser"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 自动优化：只读取需要的字段对应的列 chunk</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight python"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 创建包含 VARIANT 列的表</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.sql(<span class="string">"""</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> CREATE TABLE events (</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> event_id BIGINT,</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> payload VARIANT</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> ) USING delta</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">"""</span>)</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 写入半结构化数据</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.sql(<span class="string">"""</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> INSERT INTO events VALUES</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> (1, PARSE_JSON('{"user_id": 1001, "metadata": {"browser": "Chrome"}}')),</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> (2, PARSE_JSON('{"user_id": 1002, "metadata": {"browser": "Safari"}}'))</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">"""</span>)</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查询时直接提取子字段</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.sql(<span class="string">"""</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> SELECT event_id, payload:user_id, payload:metadata.browser</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> FROM events</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string"> WHERE payload:metadata.browser = 'Chrome'</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">"""</span>)</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>性能对比</strong>（Databricks 2025 基准测试）：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">查询类型 StructType VARIANT 提升</span><br><span class="line">简单字段提取 (100列) 1.2s 0.8s 1.5x</span><br><span class="line">嵌套字段提取 (3层) 3.5s 1.2s 2.9x</span><br><span class="line">谓词过滤 + 字段提取 5.1s 1.8s 2.8x</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：VARIANT 内部使用压缩位图格式，对于字段数量极少的简单 JSON（<5 个字段），性能与 StructType 接近，无明显优势。对于 JSON 数组（Array of Objects）的查询，VARIANT 需要展开数组，性能不如 EXPLODE + StructType。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>源码层面</strong>：VARIANT 的底层实现借鉴了 Delta Lake 4.0 的 Variant 编码规范——每个 VARIANT 值内部以 <code>VariantShredding</code> 方式拆分为多个子列，查询时通过列裁剪只读取需要的子列。这与传统 <code>from_json</code> 的全量解析有本质区别。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>最佳落地场景：埋点日志、APM 跟踪数据、IoT 传感器数据——这些数据 schema 频繁变动，用 StructType 维护成本高</li> <li>混合使用：高频访问字段提取为强类型列，低频/新增字段保留在 VARIANT 列</li> <li>存储格式：Delta Lake 4.0 和 Iceberg v3 都支持 VARIANT，跨引擎查询（Spark + Trino）时注意兼容性</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Delta Lake 4.0 VARIANT: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://delta.io/blog/delta-lake-4-0/">https://delta.io/blog/delta-lake-4-0/</a></li> <li>Apache Spark VARIANT Design Doc</li> <li>Databricks VARIANT Benchmark: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.databricks.com/blog/variant-native-semi-structured-data-processing">https://www.databricks.com/blog/variant-native-semi-structured-data-processing</a></li> </ul> <hr> <h3 id="22-Spark-4-0-AQE-v2：统计信息收集与动态优化增强"><a href="#22-Spark-4-0-AQE-v2：统计信息收集与动态优化增强" class="headerlink" title="22. Spark 4.0 AQE v2：统计信息收集与动态优化增强"></a>22. Spark 4.0 AQE v2：统计信息收集与动态优化增强</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Spark 4.0 的 AQE v2 相比 Spark 3.x 有哪些增强？如何利用 AQE v2 优化生产作业？</p> <p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>AQE（Adaptive Query Execution）在 Spark 3.0 引入，3.2+ 持续增强。Spark 4.0 的 AQE v2 是<strong>第二代自适应查询优化框架</strong>，核心改进在统计信息收集和动态优化策略。</p> <p><strong>AQE v2 新增能力</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>特性</th> <th>Spark 3.x AQE</th> <th>Spark 4.0 AQE v2</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>统计收集</strong></td> <td>Shuffle 后采样（被动）</td> <td>主动收集 + 历史统计缓存</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Join 策略</strong></td> <td>SortMergeJoin ↔ BroadcastHashJoin</td> <td>+ ShuffledHashJoin ↔ SortMergeJoin</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>分区合并</strong></td> <td><code>coalescePartitions</code> 仅分区合并</td> <td>+ 分区拆分（skew join 自动处理）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>谓词下推</strong></td> <td>静态规划阶段</td> <td>运行时动态下推（Late Projection）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>统计过期</strong></td> <td>每次重跑</td> <td>缓存统计 + 增量更新</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>多表 Join</strong></td> <td>仅两表 Join 优化</td> <td>N 表 Join 的 Join Reorder</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>关键配置</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight python"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># AQE v2 配置（Spark 4.0+，默认开启）</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.enabled"</span>, <span class="string">"true"</span>)</span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.enabled"</span>, <span class="string">"true"</span>)</span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.parallelismFirst"</span>, <span class="string">"false"</span>)</span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.advisoryPartitionSizeInBytes"</span>, <span class="string">"64MB"</span>)</span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.minPartitionNum"</span>, <span class="string">"1"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># AQE v2 新增</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.statistics.cache.enabled"</span>, <span class="string">"true"</span>) <span class="comment"># 缓存统计</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.statistics.cache.ttl"</span>, <span class="string">"3600s"</span>) <span class="comment"># 缓存 1 小时</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.join.shuffledHashJoin.enabled"</span>, <span class="string">"true"</span>) <span class="comment"># 新增 Join 策略</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.skewJoin.enabled"</span>, <span class="string">"true"</span>)</span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.skewJoin.skewedPartitionFactor"</span>, <span class="string">"5"</span>) <span class="comment"># 倾斜因子</span></span><br><span class="line">spark.conf.<span class="built_in">set</span>(<span class="string">"spark.sql.adaptive.skewJoin.skewedPartitionThresholdInBytes"</span>, <span class="string">"256MB"</span>)</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>生产案例：AQE v2 自动解决数据倾斜</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight python"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 传统方式：手动处理数据倾斜</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 需要分析数据，找到倾斜 key，编写两段聚合等复杂代码</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># AQE v2 方式：倾斜 Join 自动处理</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Spark 自动检测到某个分区数据量是平均的 5 倍以上</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 自动将该分区拆分为多个子分区，分别进行 Hash Join</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 最后合并结果——对用户完全透明</span></span><br><span class="line">df1.join(df2, <span class="string">"user_id"</span>).groupBy(<span class="string">"user_id"</span>).agg(count(<span class="string">"*"</span>))</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Spark 4.0 AQE v2 自动处理 user_id 倾斜，无需手动加 salt</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：统计缓存（<code>statistics.cache.enabled=true</code>）在数据频繁变动的场景下会失效——如果表每小时更新，缓存 1 小时的统计数据可能过时，导致 AQE 做出错误决策。建议根据表更新频率调整 <code>statistics.cache.ttl</code>。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>源码层面</strong>：AQE v2 的核心类 <code>org.apache.spark.sql.execution.adaptive.AdaptiveSparkPlanExec</code> 在执行过程中插入 <code>QueryStageOptimizationRule</code> 规则。新引入的 <code>StatisticsCacheManager</code> 通过 <code>ShuffleExchangeExec</code> 的中间结果估算数据分布。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：AQE v2 的 <code>statistics.cache</code> 对重复执行的 ETL 作业效果显著（如每天跑相同的 SQL，历史统计可直接复用）。但对首次运行的复杂查询，缓存无效，优化效果回归 Spark 3.x 水平。建议结合 Spark Thrift Server 的长连接场景使用。</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>参考来源</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>SPARK-39273 (AQE v2)</li> <li>Apache Spark 4.0 Release Notes</li> <li>Databricks AQE Deep Dive: <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.databricks.com/blog/adaptive-query-execution-speed">https://www.databricks.com/blog/adaptive-query-execution-speed</a></li> </ul> <hr> <blockquote> <p>本文将持续更新。</p> </blockquote> itemprop="publisher" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Organization"> <meta itemprop="name" content="xiaoxin1024's Blog"> <meta itemprop="description" content="大海里的一粒沙"> </span> <span hidden itemprop="post" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/CreativeWork"> <meta itemprop="name" content=" | xiaoxin1024's Blog"> <meta itemprop="description" content=""> </span> <header class="post-header"> <h2 class="post-title" itemprop="name headline"> <a href="/2026/06/07/%E5%A4%A7%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E9%9D%A2%E8%AF%95%E9%A2%98-Flink-%E9%9D%A2%E8%AF%95%E5%85%A8%E8%A7%A3/" class="post-title-link" itemprop="url">大数据面试题：Flink 面试全解</a> </h2> <div class="post-meta-container"> <div class="post-meta"> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">发表于</span> <time title="创建时间：2026-06-07 16:30:00" itemprop="dateCreated datePublished" datetime="2026-06-07T16:30:00+08:00">2026-06-07</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar-check"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">更新于</span> <time title="修改时间：2026-06-11 10:03:18" itemprop="dateModified" datetime="2026-06-11T10:03:18+08:00">2026-06-11</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-folder"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">分类于</span> <span itemprop="about" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Thing"> <a href="/categories/%E5%A4%A7%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE/" itemprop="url" rel="index"><span itemprop="name">大数据</span></a> </span> </span> </div> </div> </header> <div class="post-body" itemprop="articleBody"> <blockquote> <p>Flink 高级面试全解，覆盖 Checkpoint 与状态后端、Window 窗口机制、反压原理、Exactly-Once 语义和水位线。面向高级研发。</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x00-Checkpoint-与状态"><a href="#0x00-Checkpoint-与状态" class="headerlink" title="0x00 Checkpoint 与状态"></a>0x00 Checkpoint 与状态</h2><h3 id="1-Flink-Checkpoint-的-Chandy-Lamport-算法原理？"><a href="#1-Flink-Checkpoint-的-Chandy-Lamport-算法原理？" class="headerlink" title="1. Flink Checkpoint 的 Chandy-Lamport 算法原理？"></a>1. Flink Checkpoint 的 Chandy-Lamport 算法原理？</h3><p>Flink 的 Checkpoint 基于 <strong>Chandy-Lamport 分布式快照</strong> 的变种（异步屏障快照）：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Source → map() → keyBy() → window() → Sink</span><br><span class="line"> | | | |</span><br><span class="line"> B ────── B ─────── B ─────── B ← Barrier 流经每个算子</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>流程</strong>：</p> <ol> <li>JobManager 向所有 Source 注入 Checkpoint Barrier</li> <li>Barrier 随数据流向下游传播，将流分为”Barrier 之前的记录”和”之后的记录”</li> <li>算子收到所有上游分区的 Barrier 后，触发状态快照（异步写入状态后端）</li> <li>所有算子完成快照后，JobManager 确认 Checkpoint 完成</li> </ol> <p><strong>对齐（Alignment）</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">上游分区A: [1, 2, 3, B, 4, 5, 6]</span><br><span class="line">上游分区B: [a, b, c, d, B, e, f]</span><br><span class="line"> ↑ 先到 Barrier，等待分区A</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">B 先到 → 缓存 B 分区 Barrier 之后的数据</span><br><span class="line">A Barrier 到达 → 做快照 → 释放缓存 → 继续处理</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 启用非对齐 Checkpoint（Flink 1.11+）</span></span><br><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().enableUnalignedCheckpoints();</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 非对齐：Barrier 到达不做等待，直接穿透</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 好处：消除反压时的对齐等待</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 代价：快照包含更多 in-flight 数据</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：<code>CheckpointBarrierHandler</code> 负责 Barrier 对齐逻辑。<code>CheckpointedInputGate</code> 在非对齐模式下直接转发数据而不缓存</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：Flink 1.15+ 默认启用非对齐 Checkpoint，大状态场景 Checkpoint 时间平均缩短 50%+</li> </ul> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战：</strong></p> <p><strong>案例 1：大状态 Checkpoint 超时（某金融风控公司）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：状态大小约 120GB（RocksDB），Checkpoint interval=5min，timeout=10min</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：每天凌晨 2-3 次 Checkpoint 超时，超时后任务自动重启，恢复时从最近完成的 Checkpoint 回放，造成约 5 分钟的数据处理延迟</li> <li><strong>排查</strong>：<ol> <li>Web UI → Checkpoint 页面 → 超时的 Checkpoint 展开，发现 Sync Duration 仅 200ms，但 Async Duration 长达 8min+</li> <li>查看 TaskManager 日志，发现 RocksDB 在 Compaction 期间 IO 带宽被占满</li> <li>检查 HDFS 写入端，NameNode GC 抖动导致写入延迟</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：RocksDB 的 <code>max_background_compactions</code> 默认值为 1，Compaction 跟不上写入速度导致 L0 层文件堆积，Checkpoint 上传大文件时在 HDFS 端排队</li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// RocksDB 调优参数</span></span><br><span class="line">rocksDBOptionsFactory.setMaxBackgroundJobs(<span class="number">4</span>); <span class="comment">// 默认1 → 4，并行 Compaction</span></span><br><span class="line">rocksDBOptionsFactory.setMaxWriteBufferNumber(<span class="number">4</span>); <span class="comment">// 默认2 → 4，更多 MemTable</span></span><br><span class="line">rocksDBOptionsFactory.setWriteBufferSize(<span class="number">256</span> * <span class="number">1024</span> * <span class="number">1024</span>); <span class="comment">// 默认64MB → 256MB</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Checkpoint 配置</span></span><br><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().setCheckpointTimeout(<span class="number">20</span> * <span class="number">60</span> * <span class="number">1000L</span>); <span class="comment">// 10min → 20min</span></span><br><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().setMinPauseBetweenCheckpoints(<span class="number">1000</span>); <span class="comment">// 最小间隔</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <strong>效果</strong>：Checkpoint 成功率从 85% 提升至 99.5%，Async Duration 降至 3min 以内</li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 2：非对齐 Checkpoint 快照大小暴增（某电商公司）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：开启非对齐 Checkpoint 后，TaskManager 内存经常 OOM</li> <li><strong>原因</strong>：非对齐模式下，Barrier 穿透后 in-flight 数据（缓存中的未处理记录）全部进快照。在反压严重时，每个算子的 input buffer 可能堆积数百万条记录，快照大小从正常 500MB 膨胀到 15GB</li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：<ol> <li>限制 <code>taskmanager.network.memory.buffer-deflate</code> 相关参数</li> <li>优先解决反压源，而不是依靠非对齐 Checkpoint 兜底</li> <li>设置 <code>checkpointing.unaligned.max-buffers</code> 限制非对齐模式下的缓存大小</li> </ol> </li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 3：Checkpoint 失败重试策略设置</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>经验值</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().setTolerableCheckpointFailureNumber(<span class="number">3</span>); <span class="comment">// 容忍连续失败数</span></span><br><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().setCheckpointTimeout(<span class="number">10</span> * <span class="number">60</span> * <span class="number">1000L</span>); <span class="comment">// 超时时间</span></span><br><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().setMaxConcurrentCheckpoints(<span class="number">1</span>); <span class="comment">// 默认1</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>坑</strong>：<code>setTolerableCheckpointFailureNumber</code> 设为过大值（如 10），导致 Checkpoint 连续失败多轮后状态严重落后，重启时回放大量数据，恢复时间过长。建议不超过 5</li> </ul> <p><strong>源码定位</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Barrier 对齐核心类：<code>org.apache.flink.streaming.runtime.io.checkpointing.CheckpointBarrierHandler</code></li> <li>Barrier 对齐输入网关：<code>org.apache.flink.streaming.runtime.io.checkpointing.CheckpointedInputGate</code></li> <li>非对齐模式的 buffer 管理：<code>org.apache.flink.runtime.io.network.partition.consumer.InputChannel</code> 的 <code>spillBuffers()</code> 方法</li> </ul> <p><strong>上线 Checklist</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Checkpoint interval 是否设置为 60s-300s（根据状态大小）</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Checkpoint timeout 是否 >= interval × 3（给重试留时间）</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> RocksDB 的 <code>max_background_jobs</code> 是否 >= 4（大状态场景）</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> 目标存储（HDFS/S3）是否有足够的 IOPS</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> 是否启用了增量 Checkpoint（大状态场景必开）</li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://nightlies.apache.org/flink/flink-docs-stable/docs/ops/state/checkpoints/">Flink Checkpoints</a></p> <h3 id="2-Flink-三种状态后端有什么区别？"><a href="#2-Flink-三种状态后端有什么区别？" class="headerlink" title="2. Flink 三种状态后端有什么区别？"></a>2. Flink 三种状态后端有什么区别？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>状态后端</th> <th>存储位置</th> <th>适用场景</th> <th>限制</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>HashMapStateBackend</strong></td> <td>JVM Heap</td> <td>小状态、低延迟</td> <td>受 JVM 堆大小限制</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>EmbeddedRocksDBStateBackend</strong></td> <td>本地磁盘（RocksDB）</td> <td>大状态（TB 级）</td> <td>每次读写涉及序列化</td> </tr> <tr> <td><del>FsStateBackend</del></td> <td>已废弃</td> <td>—</td> <td>—</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// RocksDB 状态后端配置</span></span><br><span class="line">env.setStateBackend(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">EmbeddedRocksDBStateBackend</span>());</span><br><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().setCheckpointStorage(<span class="string">"hdfs://namenode:8020/flink/checkpoints"</span>);</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// RocksDB 调优</span></span><br><span class="line">RocksDBStateBackend.setRocksDBOptions(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">RocksDBOptionsFactory</span>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> DBOptions <span class="title function_">createDBOptions</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">DBOptions</span>()</span><br><span class="line"> .setMaxBackgroundJobs(<span class="number">4</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .setMaxOpenFiles(-<span class="number">1</span>);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">});</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>选型决策</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>每个算子状态 < 几百 MB → HashMapStateBackend（纯内存，零序列化）</li> <li>状态 > GB 级别 → RocksDB（增量 Checkpoint 是杀手锏）</li> </ul> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战：</strong></p> <p><strong>RocksDB 调优参数完整清单（大状态场景 > 50GB）：</strong></p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>参数</th> <th>默认值</th> <th>推荐值</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.memory.managed</code></td> <td>true</td> <td>true</td> <td>Flink 管理 RocksDB 内存，不建议关闭</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.memory.hard-limit</code></td> <td>0(无限制)</td> <td>总内存×0.8</td> <td>硬限制，防止 OOM</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.memory.write-buffer-ratio</code></td> <td>0.5</td> <td>0.4</td> <td>WriteBuffer 占 RocksDB 内存比例</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.memory.high-prio-pool-ratio</code></td> <td>0.1</td> <td>0.15</td> <td>Block Cache 中高优残留占比</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.write-buffer-size</code></td> <td>64MB</td> <td>256MB</td> <td>MemTable 大小，增大减少写放大</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.max-write-buffer-number</code></td> <td>2</td> <td>4</td> <td>MemTable 数量，防写入抖动</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.max-background-jobs</code></td> <td>2</td> <td>4-6</td> <td>Compaction 并行度（大状态场景关键参数）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.block.cache-size</code></td> <td>8MB</td> <td>256MB-1GB</td> <td>块缓存，影响读性能</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>state.backend.rocksdb.bloom-filter-bits-per-key</code></td> <td>10 (false positive ~1%)</td> <td>20 (false positive ~0.1%)</td> <td>Bloom 过滤器精度，读密集场景可调高</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>增量 Checkpoint vs 全量 Checkpoint 的生产选择：</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>增量 Checkpoint</strong>（Flink 1.11+ 默认）：只上传上次 Checkpoint 以来变化的 SST 文件<ul> <li>✅ 快照体积小（通常为全量的 5%-20%），上传快</li> <li>✅ 适合大状态（> 10GB）</li> <li>❌ 依赖多个连续 Checkpoint，删除旧 Checkpoint 时更复杂</li> <li>⚠️ <strong>坑</strong>：在 RocksDB Compaction 压力大时，增量 Checkpoint 可能因新 SST 文件不断产生而变慢</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>全量 Checkpoint</strong>：每次上传全部状态<ul> <li>✅ 恢复快（只需一个文件）</li> <li>❌ 大状态场景下磁盘/网络压力极大</li> <li>生产建议：状态 > 1GB 时必开增量</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 开启增量 Checkpoint</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">EmbeddedRocksDBStateBackend</span> <span class="variable">backend</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">EmbeddedRocksDBStateBackend</span>(<span class="literal">true</span>);</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 或通过 flink-conf.yaml</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// state.backend.incremental: true</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>Large State 场景下 State TTL 设置经验：</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>案例</strong>：某公司电商实时指标，<code>keyBy(orderId)</code> 状态一天增长 200GB，且订单完成后状态永远不会清理，最终导致 State TTL 失效</li> <li><strong>正确做法</strong>：对订单完成 24h 以上的 Key 设置 TTL<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="type">StateTtlConfig</span> <span class="variable">ttlConfig</span> <span class="operator">=</span> StateTtlConfig</span><br><span class="line"> .newBuilder(Time.days(<span class="number">3</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .setUpdateType(StateTtlConfig.UpdateType.OnCreateAndWrite)</span><br><span class="line"> .setStateVisibility(StateTtlConfig.StateVisibility.NeverReturnExpired)</span><br><span class="line"> .cleanupIncrementally(<span class="number">10</span>, <span class="literal">false</span>) <span class="comment">// 增量清理，每 10 条记录采一次样</span></span><br><span class="line"> .cleanupFullSnapshot() <span class="comment">// 全量快照时清理过期数据</span></span><br><span class="line"> .build();</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li>⚠️ <strong>坑</strong>：<code>StateTtlConfig</code> 只保证不返回过期数据，但不保证过期数据立即从 RocksDB 物理删除。过期数据在 Compaction 时才会被真正清理。生产上需要监控 RocksDB 文件大小，若长期不下降则需手动触发 Compaction</li> </ul> <p><strong>对比 HashMap vs RocksDB 的序列化开销（某公司 Benchmark）：</strong></p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>指标</th> <th>HashMapStateBackend</th> <th>RocksDBStateBackend</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>读写延迟</td> <td>< 1μs</td> <td>5-50μs</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Checkpoint 时间（10GB 状态）</td> <td>30s（GC 暂停风险）</td> <td>120s（稳定无 GC）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>GC 影响</td> <td>频繁 Full GC 暂停</td> <td>无（数据在堆外）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>推荐上限</td> <td>每个 TM < 5GB 状态</td> <td>TB 级</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <hr> <h2 id="0x02-窗口-Window"><a href="#0x02-窗口-Window" class="headerlink" title="0x02 窗口 (Window)"></a>0x02 窗口 (Window)</h2><h3 id="3-Flink-窗口的分类和触发机制？"><a href="#3-Flink-窗口的分类和触发机制？" class="headerlink" title="3. Flink 窗口的分类和触发机制？"></a>3. Flink 窗口的分类和触发机制？</h3><p><strong>窗口类型</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>类型</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>Tumbling Window</strong></td> <td>固定大小，不重叠：<code>TumblingEventTimeWindows.of(Time.minutes(5))</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Sliding Window</strong></td> <td>固定大小，有重叠：<code>SlidingEventTimeWindows.of(Time.minutes(10), Time.minutes(5))</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Session Window</strong></td> <td>按活动间隙切分：<code>EventTimeSessionWindows.withGap(Time.minutes(30))</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Global Window</strong></td> <td>全量，需自定义 Trigger</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>触发机制</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">stream.keyBy(...)</span><br><span class="line"> .window(TumblingEventTimeWindows.of(Time.minutes(<span class="number">1</span>)))</span><br><span class="line"> .trigger(Trigger.compose(</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// Watermark 到达 window_end 时触发</span></span><br><span class="line"> EventTimeTrigger.create(),</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 或：每处理 100 条触发一次</span></span><br><span class="line"> CountTrigger.of(<span class="number">100</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> ))</span><br><span class="line"> .evictor(CountEvictor.of(<span class="number">50</span>)) <span class="comment">// 触发后只保留最近 50 条</span></span><br><span class="line"> .process(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">MyWindowFunction</span>());</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：Event Time 窗口依赖 Watermark 触发。如果 Watermark 不推进（上游没数据），窗口永远不会触发。生产上要设置 <code>allowedLateness</code> + <code>sideOutputLateData</code> 兜底</li> </ul> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战：</strong></p> <p><strong>案例 1：allowedLateness 设置不当导致窗口重复触发（某物流公司）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：快递状态变更实时监控，使用 EventTime Tumbling Window（1min），设置了 <code>allowedLateness(Time.hours(1))</code></li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：某窗口在 Watermark 经过 window_end 后触发了第一次计算；随后在 1 小时内，该窗口每次收到晚到数据都会重新触发（默认只要 allowedLateness 内来数据就触发），下游告警系统收到了数十次重复告警</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<code>allowedLateness</code> 的本质是”窗口直到 allowedLateness 超时才彻底关闭”，在这期间每次有迟到数据到都会重新触发计算。在 Payment/物流跟踪等场景下告警类应用不应使用 allowedLateness</li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方案一：只用 allowedLateness(0)，在侧输出流中自行处理晚到数据</span></span><br><span class="line">.allowedLateness(Time.seconds(<span class="number">0</span>))</span><br><span class="line">.sideOutputLateData(lateTag)</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方案二：搭配自定义 Trigger，控制迟到数据的触发行为</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 只在窗口第一次触发时计算，迟到数据不重新触发</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>经验法则</strong>：告警场景用 <code>allowedLateness(0)</code> + 侧输出；报表聚合场景可用短 allowedLateness（如 30s）；窗口聚合 + 外部存储场景用 allowedLateness 时要保证写入幂等</li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 2：空闲分区导致 Watermark 不推进（某游戏公司）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：4 个 Kafka 分区，各分区水位线不同。双十一大促时，其中 1 个分区的日志打点明显少于其他分区（该分区用户较少）</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：整个任务的 Watermark 停滞在”最少数据分区的最大时间戳”，大量窗口（10 分钟以上）未触发，报表延迟从秒级恶化到小时级</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：Flink Watermark 取<strong>所有输入分区的 Watermark 最小值</strong>。即使 3 个分区进展正常，只要 1 个分区停滞，全局 Watermark 就停滞</li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：<code>.withIdleness(Duration.ofMinutes(1))</code><figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">WatermarkStrategy.<Event>forBoundedOutOfOrderness(Duration.ofSeconds(<span class="number">5</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .withTimestampAssigner((event, ts) -> event.getTimestamp())</span><br><span class="line"> .withIdleness(Duration.ofMinutes(<span class="number">2</span>)); <span class="comment">// 分区 2 分钟没数据则视为空闲</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li>⚠️ <strong>withIdleness 的副作用</strong>：<ol> <li>Idle 分区恢复后，新数据会被 Watermark 追赶，可能导致数据被判断为”太晚”而进入侧输出流</li> <li>若所有分区都 Idle（真正的无数据），Watermark 停滞问题仍然存在，需要额外的 Source 心跳机制兜底</li> <li>Flink 1.17+ 引入了 <code>SourceOperatorWatermarkGate</code> 改善空闲分区的处理</li> </ol> </li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 3：Event Time + Processing Time 混用的典型坑</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：某实时风控系统，Source 使用 EventTime（业务时间），Sink 使用 ProcessingTime 做告警抑制（同一 userId 5分钟内不重复告警）</li> <li><strong>问题</strong>：Flink 的任务重启后，Source 从 Checkpoint 回放旧数据（业务时间倒退），但 ProcessingTime 窗口不受影响，导致旧数据的 ProcessingTime 窗口立即触发，造成大量虚假告警</li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：在 ProcessFunction 中用 <code>ValueState</code> + <code>TimerService</code> 代替 ProcessingTime 窗口；或重启时清除状态中的 ProcessingTime 相关信息</li> </ul> <hr> <h3 id="4-Watermark-是怎么生成的？如何处理迟到数据？"><a href="#4-Watermark-是怎么生成的？如何处理迟到数据？" class="headerlink" title="4. Watermark 是怎么生成的？如何处理迟到数据？"></a>4. Watermark 是怎么生成的？如何处理迟到数据？</h3><figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 周期性 Watermark（默认 200ms 生成一次）</span></span><br><span class="line">env.getConfig().setAutoWatermarkInterval(<span class="number">200</span>);</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 自定义 Watermark 生成器</span></span><br><span class="line">WatermarkStrategy.<Event>forBoundedOutOfOrderness(Duration.ofSeconds(<span class="number">5</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .withTimestampAssigner((event, ts) -> event.getTimestamp())</span><br><span class="line"> .withIdleness(Duration.ofMinutes(<span class="number">1</span>)); <span class="comment">// 空闲分区检测</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 处理迟到数据</span></span><br><span class="line">stream.keyBy(...)</span><br><span class="line"> .window(...)</span><br><span class="line"> .allowedLateness(Time.minutes(<span class="number">10</span>)) <span class="comment">// 允许迟到 10 分钟</span></span><br><span class="line"> .sideOutputLateData(lateOutputTag) <span class="comment">// 超时的进侧输出流</span></span><br><span class="line"> .process(...);</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 获取侧输出流中的迟到数据</span></span><br><span class="line">stream.getSideOutput(lateOutputTag).print(<span class="string">"late"</span>);</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>三层迟到处理</strong>：</p> <ol> <li>Watermark 容错（<code>forBoundedOutOfOrderness</code>）— 乱序容忍</li> <li><code>allowedLateness</code> — 窗口触发后仍可追加</li> <li><code>sideOutputLateData</code> — 最终兜底，不会丢</li> </ol> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战：</strong></p> <p><strong>Kafka 多分区下 Watermark 的计算方式（源码级）：</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>核心逻辑</strong>：<code>WatermarkOutputMultiplexer</code> 类维护每个分区的 Watermark，最终取<strong>所有分区的 Watermark 的最小值</strong></li> <li><strong>代码路径</strong>：<code>org.apache.flink.streaming.runtime.operators.windowing.WindowOperator</code> → <code>processWatermark()</code> → 先推进自身 Watermark → 传递给下游</li> <li><strong>源码</strong>（WatermarkOutputMultiplexer）：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 简化逻辑：每个 SourceTask 跟踪所有 InputChannel 的 Watermark</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">long</span> <span class="variable">combinedWatermark</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Long.MIN_VALUE;</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 每来一个分区的 Watermark，取所有分区最小值</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">for</span> (<span class="type">long</span> wm : perChannelWatermark.values()) {</span><br><span class="line"> combinedWatermark = Math.min(combinedWatermark == Long.MIN_VALUE ? wm : combinedWatermark, wm);</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>生产坑</strong>：多分区水印推进慢的根因，80% 以上是 Kafka 某个分区无数据导致，先用 Web UI 的 Watermark tab 确认哪个分区的 Watermark 停滞</li> </ul> <p><strong>Watermark 生成频率的调优经验：</strong></p> <ul> <li><code>setAutoWatermarkInterval</code> 默认 200ms，在 10 万 QPS 以上场景建议调为 100ms（减少延迟）或 500ms（减少计算开销）</li> <li>使用 <code>forBoundedOutOfOrderness(Duration.ofSeconds(10))</code> 在乱序严重的 IoT 场景下是合理的，但如果是 Kafka Source 且数据按时间有序写入，调整为 <code>Duration.ofMillis(500)</code> 可大幅降低延迟</li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x03-反压-Backpressure"><a href="#0x03-反压-Backpressure" class="headerlink" title="0x03 反压 (Backpressure)"></a>0x03 反压 (Backpressure)</h2><h3 id="5-Flink-如何检测和处理反压？"><a href="#5-Flink-如何检测和处理反压？" class="headerlink" title="5. Flink 如何检测和处理反压？"></a>5. Flink 如何检测和处理反压？</h3><p><strong>检测原理</strong>（Flink 1.13+）：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Task A ──BufferPool── Task B ──BufferPool── Task C</span><br><span class="line"> 满 满</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>反压传播：下游 BufferPool 满 → 上游无法写入 → 上游 BufferPool 满 → 继续向上传播</p> <p><strong>定位</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Flink Web UI → 反压指标标签：<code>OK</code>(绿) / <code>LOW</code>(黄) / <code>HIGH</code>(红)</li> <li><code>HIGH</code> 表示该算子的输出 Buffer 使用率 > 50%</li> </ul> <p><strong>常见原因和修复</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>原因</th> <th>修复</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>Sink 写入慢（如 MySQL）</td> <td>增加 Sink 并行度、批量写入</td> </tr> <tr> <td>数据倾斜</td> <td>keyBy 前加随机前缀打散</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Checkpoint 对齐</td> <td>启用非对齐 Checkpoint</td> </tr> <tr> <td>外部服务慢</td> <td>异步 IO (<code>AsyncDataStream</code>)</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 异步 IO 解决外部调用慢的反压</span></span><br><span class="line">AsyncDataStream.unorderedWait(</span><br><span class="line"> stream,</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">AsyncRedisFunction</span>(),</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="number">5000</span>, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS,</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="number">100</span> <span class="comment">// 最大并发请求数</span></span><br><span class="line">);</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战：</strong></p> <p><strong>从 Flink Web UI 反压指标定位瓶颈的完整排查流程：</strong></p> <p><strong>第一步：看颜色（反压标签含义）</strong></p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>标签</th> <th>颜色</th> <th>含义</th> <th>该看什么</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>OK</td> <td>绿</td> <td>正常 < 10%</td> <td>—</td> </tr> <tr> <td>LOW</td> <td>黄</td> <td>10%-50%</td> <td>轻微波动，关注趋势</td> </tr> <tr> <td>HIGH</td> <td>红</td> <td>> 50%</td> <td>反压热点，立即排查</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>第二步：定位瓶颈算子</strong></p> <ul> <li>反压是从下游向上游传播的，<strong>红色的最下游算子通常是瓶颈</strong></li> <li>如果所有算子都 HIGH → 最下游的 Sink 是瓶颈</li> <li>如果中间某个算子 HIGH，上下游 OK → 该算子处理能力不足或数据倾斜</li> <li>点击算子详情页 → BackPressure tab → 查看每个 Subtask 的 Buffer 使用率</li> </ul> <p><strong>第三步：查看具体指标</strong></p> <ul> <li><code>numRecordsInPerSecond</code> 和 <code>numRecordsOutPerSecond</code>：入 > 出 → 该算子积压</li> <li><code>currentLowWatermark</code>：如果停滞不前 → 可能是 Source 端瓶颈</li> <li><code>busyTimeMsPerSecond</code>：如果接近 1000ms 但 RecordsOut 很少 → 算子内部计算瓶颈（不一定是外部依赖慢）</li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 1：反压导致 Checkpoint 超时的连锁反应（某在线教育公司）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>症状</strong>：每天晚高峰（20:00-22:00）任务频繁重启，重启后追数据又触发反压，恶性循环</li> <li><strong>排查链路</strong>：<ol> <li>Web UI → Checkpoint 页面 → 最近 5 个 Checkpoint 全部超时失败</li> <li>反压 tab → 全部算子 HIGH（红色）</li> <li>检查 Sink（HBase）→ 发现 HBase RegionServer GC 暂停导致写入变慢</li> <li>BufferPool 大量为满状态 → in-flight 数据堆积 → Checkpoint Barrier 无法穿透 → Checkpoint 超时</li> <li>Checkpoint 超时 → 系统判定任务故障 → 自动重启 → 重启后从 Checkpoint 恢复 → 恢复进度追数据 → 再次反压</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：<ol> <li><strong>短期止血</strong>：启用非对齐 Checkpoint（让 Barrier 穿透），但注意快照膨胀问题</li> <li><strong>中期优化</strong>：HBase 端优化 RegionServer GC、增加写入 Buffer</li> <li><strong>长期修复</strong>：将 Sink 改为 Kafka（缓冲层），下游再消费 Kafka 写入 HBase</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 止血配置</span></span><br><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().enableUnalignedCheckpoints();</span><br><span class="line">env.getCheckpointConfig().setAlignedCheckpointTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(<span class="number">30</span>));</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 30s 内没能对齐就切换为非对齐模式</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 2：BufferPool 耗尽后的具体表现（某物流公司）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>症状</strong>：日志中大量 <code>"Buffer pool is exhausted"</code>，数据吞吐骤降 90%，但 CPU 和内存使用率都不高</li> <li><strong>排查</strong>：此锅不在 JVM，在 Flink 的 Network Buffer Pool。每个 Task 有独立的 Buffer Pool，当下游 Sink 处理慢时，上游产出的数据无法写入下游的 Input Channel Buffer，后者被占满后拒绝写入</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<code>taskmanager.network.memory.buffers-per-channel</code> 太小（默认 2），高并发下下游 subtask 的 buffer 很快被上游的数据填满</li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：<figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># flink-conf.yaml</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">taskmanager.network.memory.buffers-per-channel:</span> <span class="number">10</span> <span class="comment"># 默认2，增加每个通道的缓冲区</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">taskmanager.network.memory.floating-buffers-per-gate:</span> <span class="number">20</span> <span class="comment"># 默认8</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">taskmanager.network.memory.fraction:</span> <span class="number">0.2</span> <span class="comment"># 网络内存占总内存比例</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 3：Kafka Sink 写入慢导致反压排查记录（某电商公司）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>现象</strong>：实时订单处理任务，Kafka Sink 端反压 HIGH</li> <li><strong>排查步骤</strong>：<ol> <li>查看 Sink 的 <code>numRecordsOutPerSecond</code> 稳定在 5000/s，但上游产出的速率是 20000/s</li> <li>检查 Kafka Broker 端写入延迟：<code>kafka-producer-metrics > request-latency-avg > 500ms</code></li> <li>查看 Kafka Topic 分区数：只有 3 个分区，Sink 并行度 5，多余的 2 个 subtask 空跑</li> <li>查看 Kafka Producer 的 batch.size 和 linger.ms：batch.size=16KB（太小）</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<ol> <li>Sink 并行度（5）> Topic 分区数（3），导致 2 个 subtask 无生产权</li> <li>Producer batch.size 过小，每条消息单独发送，降低了吞吐</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：<figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># flink-conf.yaml</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 调整 Sink 并行度匹配 Topic 分区数</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 并行度设为 3</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Kafka sink 配置</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">kafka.producer.batch.size:</span> <span class="number">131072</span> <span class="comment"># 128KB</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">kafka.producer.linger.ms:</span> <span class="number">100</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">kafka.producer.compression.type:</span> <span class="string">snappy</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>最佳实践</strong>：Sink 并行度 ≤ Topic 分区数，且 Partition 数是 Sink 并行度的整数倍，保障均匀分配</li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x04-Exactly-Once-语义"><a href="#0x04-Exactly-Once-语义" class="headerlink" title="0x04 Exactly-Once 语义"></a>0x04 Exactly-Once 语义</h2><h3 id="6-Flink-端到端-Exactly-Once-怎么实现？"><a href="#6-Flink-端到端-Exactly-Once-怎么实现？" class="headerlink" title="6. Flink 端到端 Exactly-Once 怎么实现？"></a>6. Flink 端到端 Exactly-Once 怎么实现？</h3><p><strong>前提</strong>：Checkpoint 开启 + Source 支持重放（Kafka）+ Sink 支持幂等或事务。</p> <p><strong>TwoPhaseCommitSinkFunction</strong>（两阶段提交）：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">1. Source 读取 Kafka offset=100-200</span><br><span class="line">2. 算子处理数据，状态写入 RocksDB</span><br><span class="line">3. Sink 开启 Kafka 事务，写入 Broker（未提交，消费者不可见）</span><br><span class="line">4. Checkpoint 完成 → Sink commit 事务 → offset=200 持久化</span><br><span class="line">5. 故障恢复 → 从 offset=100 重放 → Sink 事务幂等重做</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Kafka Sink Exactly-Once（Flink 1.14+）</span></span><br><span class="line">KafkaSink.<String>builder()</span><br><span class="line"> .setBootstrapServers(<span class="string">"broker:9092"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .setRecordSerializer(...)</span><br><span class="line"> .setDeliveryGuarantee(DeliveryGuarantee.EXACTLY_ONCE)</span><br><span class="line"> .setTransactionalIdPrefix(<span class="string">"flink-txn-"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .build();</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：Exactly-Once 需要 Sink 支持事务。MySQL Sink 无法做到真正的 Exactly-Once（最多 At-Least-Once + 幂等去重）。方案是输出到 Kafka → 下游用 Flink CDC 或幂等写入</li> </ul> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战：</strong></p> <p><strong>TwoPhaseCommitSinkFunction 源码级说明：</strong></p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br><span class="line">27</span><br><span class="line">28</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// org.apache.flink.streaming.api.functions.sink.TwoPhaseCommitSinkFunction</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">abstract</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">TwoPhaseCommitSinkFunction</span><IN, TXN, CONTEXT> ... {</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 阶段一：预提交 — Checkpoint Barrier 触发时调用</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">protected</span> <span class="keyword">abstract</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">preCommit</span><span class="params">(TXN transaction)</span> <span class="keyword">throws</span> Exception;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 阶段二：提交 — Checkpoint 完成时调用</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">protected</span> <span class="keyword">abstract</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">commit</span><span class="params">(TXN transaction)</span> <span class="keyword">throws</span> Exception;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 回滚 — Checkpoint 失败时调用</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">protected</span> <span class="keyword">abstract</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">abort</span><span class="params">(TXN transaction)</span> <span class="keyword">throws</span> Exception;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// Checkpoint 快照时保存事务句柄</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">snapshotState</span><span class="params">(...)</span> <span class="keyword">throws</span> Exception {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 在 Checkpoint 触发时，先 preCommit，再保存事务句柄到状态</span></span><br><span class="line"> preCommit(currentTransaction);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 保存事务句柄（包含未提交的事务 ID）</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">this</span>.checkpointedState.add(currentTransaction);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// Checkpoint 确认时，实际提交</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">notifyCheckpointComplete</span><span class="params">(<span class="type">long</span> checkpointId)</span> <span class="keyword">throws</span> Exception {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 找到对应 Checkpoint 的事务句柄并 commit</span></span><br><span class="line"> commit(transaction);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>KafkaProducer 的 preCommit/commit 如何交互：</strong></p> <ul> <li><code>FlinkKafkaProducer</code>（旧版，Flink 1.15 前）继承了 <code>TwoPhaseCommitSinkFunction</code></li> <li><strong>preCommit</strong>：调用 <code>KafkaProducer.flush()</code>，确保所有未发送的消息已发送到 Broker，但不提交事务</li> <li><strong>commit</strong>：调用 <code>KafkaProducer.commitTransaction()</code></li> <li><strong>abort</strong>：调用 <code>KafkaProducer.abortTransaction()</code> 并关闭 Producer</li> <li><strong>关键交互</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// FlinkKafkaProducer.internal 简化流程</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// preCommit</span></span><br><span class="line">producer.flush(); <span class="comment">// 确保消息已到 Broker</span></span><br><span class="line">producer.sendOffsetsToTransaction(offsets, groupId); <span class="comment">// 提交消费位移到事务</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// commit</span></span><br><span class="line">producer.commitTransaction(); <span class="comment">// 事务对消费者可见</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> </ul> <p><strong>事务超时 vs Checkpoint 超时的冲突（经典生产坑）：</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>问题</strong>：某公司使用 FlinkKafkaProducer + Exactly-Once，Checkpoint interval=5min，但 Kafka 的 <code>transaction.timeout.ms</code> 默认 15min。在极端场景下，一个 Checkpoint 失败后，对应的事务需要 15min 才会被 Kafka abort，期间后一个 Checkpoint 的事务无法正常开启（Kafka 限制同一 producer 只能有一个未完成事务）</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：日志中大量 <code>"Transaction timeout exceeded"</code> 和 <code>"Producer attempted to begin a transaction while previous transaction is still pending"</code></li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：Kafka 事务超时时间 < Checkpoint 超时时间 × 容忍失败次数</li> <li><strong>规则</strong>：<code>transaction.timeout.ms</code> <strong>必须大于</strong> Checkpoint interval，否则频繁的事务开启/回滚会拖垮 Kafka<figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># recommended: 2 × checkpoint interval</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">transaction.timeout.ms:</span> <span class="number">600000</span> <span class="comment"># 10min（假设 interval=5min）</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Kafka broker side</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">transaction.max.timeout.ms:</span> <span class="number">900000</span> <span class="comment"># 15min（broker 上限必须 > transaction.timeout.ms）</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>经验值</strong>：<code>transaction.timeout.ms</code> = Checkpoint interval × 2 + 120s 的余量</li> </ul> <p><strong>幂等写入 vs 事务写入的生产选择：</strong></p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>幂等写入（idempotent）</th> <th>事务写入（transactional）</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>配置</td> <td><code>enable.idempotence=true</code></td> <td><code>DeliveryGuarantee.EXACTLY_ONCE</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td>性能</td> <td>高（1-3% 额外开销）</td> <td>低（事务提交额外 RTT + 10-20% 性能下降）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>适用场景</td> <td>写 Kafka 做缓冲层</td> <td>写 Kafka 做最终输出</td> </tr> <tr> <td>恢复行为</td> <td>重启可能导致少量重复</td> <td>Exactly-Once 保证无重复</td> </tr> <tr> <td>维护复杂度</td> <td>低</td> <td>高（需调优事务超时 + 监控事务异常）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <ul> <li><strong>生产建议</strong>：<ul> <li>Kafka → 下游还有二次消费的 → <strong>幂等写入</strong>（下游自己去重，性能更好）</li> <li>Kafka → 最终消费者，不容忍重复的 → <strong>事务写入</strong>（但要接受性能损失）</li> <li>写 Kafka 后再写其他系统 → <strong>幂等写入</strong> + 外部幂等键去重</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>MySQL Sink 做不到真正 Exactly-Once 的替代方案：</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>原因</strong>：MySQL 不支持分布式事务协议（除非 XA，但性能极差）</li> <li><strong>方案对比</strong>：<table> <thead> <tr> <th>方案</th> <th>保证级别</th> <th>复杂性</th> <th>生产案例</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>At-Least-Once + 去重键</td> <td>最终一致性</td> <td>⭐⭐</td> <td>写入后 5min 扫一次去重表</td> </tr> <tr> <td>输出到 Kafka → Flink CDC → MySQL</td> <td>Exactly-Once</td> <td>⭐⭐⭐⭐</td> <td>架构复杂但可靠</td> </tr> <tr> <td>MySQL XA 事务（两阶段）</td> <td>Exactly-Once</td> <td>⭐⭐⭐</td> <td>性能损失 50%+，不推荐</td> </tr> <tr> <td>HBase/Redis 等幂等存储</td> <td>Exactly-Once</td> <td>⭐⭐</td> <td>需应用层幂等逻辑</td> </tr> </tbody></table> </li> <li><strong>最推荐的方案</strong>：Flink → Kafka（幂等）→ 下游 Cursor（幂等消费）→ MySQL</li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-场景设计"><a href="#0x05-场景设计" class="headerlink" title="0x05 场景设计"></a>0x05 场景设计</h2><h3 id="实时大屏：每秒成交额-Top-100-商品"><a href="#实时大屏：每秒成交额-Top-100-商品" class="headerlink" title="实时大屏：每秒成交额 Top 100 商品"></a>实时大屏：每秒成交额 Top 100 商品</h3><figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">DataStream<Order> orders = env.addSource(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">FlinkKafkaConsumer</span><>(...));</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">orders</span><br><span class="line"> .assignTimestampsAndWatermarks(</span><br><span class="line"> WatermarkStrategy.<Order>forBoundedOutOfOrderness(Duration.ofSeconds(<span class="number">5</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .withTimestampAssigner((o, ts) -> o.getTimestamp()))</span><br><span class="line"> .keyBy(Order::getProductId)</span><br><span class="line"> .window(TumblingEventTimeWindows.of(Time.seconds(<span class="number">1</span>)))</span><br><span class="line"> .aggregate(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">AggregateFunction</span><Order, Long, Long>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span> <span class="keyword">public</span> Long <span class="title function_">createAccumulator</span><span class="params">()</span> { <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="number">0L</span>; }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span> <span class="keyword">public</span> Long <span class="title function_">add</span><span class="params">(Order o, Long acc)</span> { <span class="keyword">return</span> acc + o.getAmount(); }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span> <span class="keyword">public</span> Long <span class="title function_">getResult</span><span class="params">(Long acc)</span> { <span class="keyword">return</span> acc; }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span> <span class="keyword">public</span> Long <span class="title function_">merge</span><span class="params">(Long a, Long b)</span> { <span class="keyword">return</span> a + b; }</span><br><span class="line"> })</span><br><span class="line"> .windowAll(TumblingProcessingTimeWindows.of(Time.seconds(<span class="number">1</span>)))</span><br><span class="line"> .aggregate(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Top100Aggregator</span>()) <span class="comment">// 全窗口做 TopN</span></span><br><span class="line"> .map(result -> formatToJSON(result))</span><br><span class="line"> .sinkTo(webSocketSink); <span class="comment">// 推送到前端大屏</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战：</strong></p> <p><strong>此设计的 3 个问题（面试官眼中的破绽）：</strong></p> <ol> <li><p><strong>双重窗口性能问题</strong>：先 window 后 windowAll，数据从所有分区汇聚到单并行度。在 1 秒内 Top100 的计算是全量排序，百万级商品时会导致单点瓶颈</p> <ul> <li><strong>优化</strong>：使用 <code>TopNFunction</code>（自定义 ProcessFunction）维护局部 TopN + <code>CoGroup</code> 结果，避免全排序</li> </ul> </li> <li><p><strong>WebSocket Sink 的背压风险</strong>：前端连接断开后，Sink 写入失败导致反压传递回整个 Pipeline</p> <ul> <li><strong>优化</strong>：WebSocket Sink 增加超时 + 缓冲队列 + 降级策略（前端断开时暂存最后 1 分钟结果）</li> </ul> </li> <li><p><strong>滑动窗口的抖动</strong>：1 秒窗口 + 1 秒触发一次排序，在 QPS 波动时频繁触发 GC</p> <ul> <li><strong>优化</strong>：改为 5 秒窗口 1 秒触发（SlidingWindow），减少排序频率</li> </ul> </li> </ol> <hr> <h2 id="0x06-双流-Join-与复杂事件处理"><a href="#0x06-双流-Join-与复杂事件处理" class="headerlink" title="0x06 双流 Join 与复杂事件处理"></a>0x06 双流 Join 与复杂事件处理</h2><h3 id="7-Flink-双流-Join-实现对比"><a href="#7-Flink-双流-Join-实现对比" class="headerlink" title="7. Flink 双流 Join 实现对比"></a>7. Flink 双流 Join 实现对比</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Flink 中 Window Join、Interval Join、Temporal Join 有什么区别？各适用于什么场景？</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Join 类型</th> <th>触发条件</th> <th>状态存储</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>Window Join</strong></td> <td>两流都到达同一窗口</td> <td>单窗口数据</td> <td>固定时间窗口内匹配（如每 5 分钟订单+支付匹配）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Interval Join</strong></td> <td>流 A 时间 ± 时间区间</td> <td>区间内历史数据</td> <td>时间有界的关联（如订单后 1 小时内的物流信息）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Temporal Join</strong></td> <td>事件时间匹配版本表</td> <td>版本表全部版本</td> <td>流关联维表（如关联用户画像的变更历史）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Interval Join 示例</span></span><br><span class="line">orderStream</span><br><span class="line"> .intervalJoin(paymentStream)</span><br><span class="line"> .between(Time.minutes(-<span class="number">30</span>), Time.seconds(<span class="number">0</span>)) <span class="comment">// 支付在订单前 30 分钟内</span></span><br><span class="line"> .sideOutputLeftLateData(orderLateTag)</span><br><span class="line"> .process(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ProcessJoinFunction</span><Order, Payment, OrderWithPayment>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">processElement</span><span class="params">(Order order, Payment payment, Context ctx,</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="params"> Collector<OrderWithPayment> out)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> out.collect(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">OrderWithPayment</span>(order, payment));</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> });</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战：</strong></p> <p><strong>Interval Join 的状态膨胀风险：</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>案例</strong>：某公司 Interval Join 的 <code>between(-1hour, 0)</code>，每秒 10 万条订单流，状态一天增长 200GB+</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：Interval Join 需要将左流的全部数据保留在状态中持续 <code>1hour</code> 等待匹配，在 10 万 TPS 下 1 小时累积约 3.6 亿条记录</li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：<ol> <li>缩短 <code>between</code> 时间窗口</li> <li>增加过滤条件，只保留需要 Join 的字段（不要存整个对象）</li> <li>对左流设置 <code>StateTtlConfig</code> 及时清理过期数据</li> <li>考虑改用 <code>RichCoProcessFunction</code> 手动管理状态，避免全量缓存</li> </ol> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Window Join 的数据倾斜坑：</strong></p> <ul> <li>当 Join 的 Key 分布不均匀时（如某个热门商品 ID 的订单量是其他商品的 1000 倍），该 Key 所在的 Task 成为瓶颈</li> <li><strong>解决方案</strong>：在 Join 前对热点 Key 做二次散列（salt），Join 结果再聚合去掉 salt</li> </ul> <hr> <h3 id="8-Flink-CEP-复杂事件处理"><a href="#8-Flink-CEP-复杂事件处理" class="headerlink" title="8. Flink CEP 复杂事件处理"></a>8. Flink CEP 复杂事件处理</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：使用 Flink CEP 实现连续 3 次登录失败后 5 分钟内触发告警。</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">36</span><br><span class="line">37</span><br><span class="line">38</span><br><span class="line">39</span><br><span class="line">40</span><br><span class="line">41</span><br><span class="line">42</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 定义模式</span></span><br><span class="line">Pattern<LoginEvent, ?> loginFailPattern = Pattern</span><br><span class="line"> .<LoginEvent>begin(<span class="string">"first"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .where(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class="string">"second"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .where(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">SimpleCondition</span><LoginEvent>() {</span><br><span class="line"> class="params">(LoginEvent event)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> event.status.equals(<span class="string">"FAIL"</span>);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> })</span><br><span class="line"> .next(<span class="string">"third"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .where(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">SimpleCondition</span><LoginEvent>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="type">boolean</span> <span class="title function_">filter</span><span class="params">(LoginEvent event)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> event.status.equals(<span class="string">"FAIL"</span>);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> })</span><br><span class="line"> .within(Time.minutes(<span loginFailPattern</span><br><span class="line">);</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 输出告警</span></span><br><span class="line">patternStream.process(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">PatternProcessFunction</span><LoginEvent, Alert>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">processMatch</span><span class="params">(</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="params"> Map<String, List<LoginEvent>> pattern,</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="params"> Context ctx,</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="params"> Collector<Alert> out)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">String</span> <span class="variable">userId</span> <span
