公平锁实现</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 尝试获取锁</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">protected</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">boolean</span> <span class="title function_">tryAcquire</span><span class="params">(<span class="type">int</span> acquires)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">Thread</span> <span class="variable">current</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Thread.currentThread();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">c</span> <span class="operator">=</span> getState();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (c == <span class="number">0</span>) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 公平锁：先检查队列里有没有前驱节点</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (!hasQueuedPredecessors() && </span><br><span class="line"> compareAndSetState(<span class="number">0</span>, acquires)) {</span><br><span class="line"> setExclusiveOwnerThread(current);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="literal">true</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">else</span> <span class="keyword">if</span> (current == getExclusiveOwnerThread()) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 重入：state 累加</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">nextc</span> <span class="operator">=</span> c + acquires;</span><br><span class="line"> setState(nextc);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="literal">true</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="literal">false</span>;</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>非公平锁</strong>：去掉 <code>hasQueuedPredecessors()</code> 检查，新线程直接 CAS 抢锁，插队成功就获取</p> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>性能差异</strong>：非公平锁吞吐量更高（减少线程切换），但可能导致队列尾部线程饥饿。默认 <code>ReentrantLock()</code> 是非公平的</li> <li><strong>与 <code>synchronized</code> 对比</strong>：AQS 支持超时获取 (<code>tryLock(timeout)</code>)、可中断获取 (<code>lockInterruptibly</code>)、条件变量 (<code>Condition</code>)——这些都是 <code>synchronized</code> 不具备的</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>公平锁 vs 非公平锁选型依据</strong>：不是简单的”非公平更快”。具体决策参考下表：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>场景</th> <th>推荐策略</th> <th>原因</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>分布式锁客户端（ZooKeeper/etcd 封装层）</td> <td>公平锁</td> <td>客户端间需公平竞争，防止某个客户端永远抢不到锁</td> </tr> <tr> <td>本地资源池（连接池、内存缓存）</td> <td>非公平锁</td> <td>吞吐优先，短暂的 unfairness 可接受</td> </tr> <tr> <td>定时任务调度（同一任务多节点争抢）</td> <td>公平锁</td> <td>避免某个节点因饥饿导致任务超时未被调度</td> </tr> <tr> <td>高吞吐消息处理（Kafka 消费线程）</td> <td>非公平锁 + <code>tryLock(timeout)</code></td> <td>吞吐第一，超时未获取直接跳过</td> </tr> </tbody></table> </li> <li><p><strong>Condition 的坑</strong>：<code>signal()</code> 之后并非立即执行——只是将等待队列中的节点转移到同步队列，被 signal 的线程和其他正在 acquire 的线程一起竞争。踩坑案例：某消息推送服务使用 <code>Condition.await()</code> 做批量消费，每次 <code>signalAll()</code> 后只有一个线程抢到锁，其余被 signal 的线程回到等待队列——本该并行处理的消息变成了串行。修复方案：改用 <code>signal()</code> 逐个唤醒，或者使用 <code>Semaphore</code> 代替 Condition。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>AQS 队列头节点丢失的踩坑</strong>：<code>ReentrantLock</code> 的 <code>lockInterruptibly()</code> 在中断时会将当前节点从等待队列移除，但如果节点恰好是 head，会导致头指针悬空，极端情况下触发 NPE。JDK 9 已修复（JDK-8154414），低版本用户要注意。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>监控指标</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>指标</th> <th>获取方式</th> <th>告警阈值</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>队列等待线程数</td> <td><code>ReentrantLock.getQueueLength()</code></td> <td>持续 > 10 需关注</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Condition 等待线程数</td> <td><code>getWaitQueueLength(condition)</code></td> <td>持续增长需排查</td> </tr> <tr> <td>持有锁时间</td> <td>通过 AOP 埋点统计</td> <td>P99 > 100ms 告警</td> </tr> </tbody></table> </li> <li><p><strong>面试金句（升级版）</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“ReentrantLock 在生产中的选型不是简单的’非公平更快’。我维护过一个分布式任务调度系统，使用公平锁确保了每个 Worker 节点都能分配到任务，避免了非公平锁下的任务饥饿。Condition 的 signal 只是节点转移，不是立即执行——这个语义差异在实现批量消费时踩过大坑。”</p> </blockquote> </li> </ul> <h3 id="3-CountDownLatch、CyclicBarrier、Semaphore-的区别？"><a href="#3-CountDownLatch、CyclicBarrier、Semaphore-的区别？" class="headerlink" title="3. CountDownLatch、CyclicBarrier、Semaphore 的区别？"></a>3. <code>CountDownLatch</code>、<code>CyclicBarrier</code>、<code>Semaphore</code> 的区别？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>工具</th> <th>作用</th> <th>可重用</th> <th>核心方法</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>CountDownLatch</code></td> <td>等待 N 个线程完成</td> <td><strong>否</strong></td> <td><code>countDown()</code>, <code>await()</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>CyclicBarrier</code></td> <td>N 个线程互相等待到齐</td> <td><strong>是</strong></td> <td><code>await()</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>Semaphore</code></td> <td>控制并发访问数</td> <td><strong>是</strong></td> <td><code>acquire()</code>, <code>release()</code></td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// CountDownLatch: 主线程等待 3 个子任务完成</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">CountDownLatch</span> <span class="variable">latch</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">CountDownLatch</span>(<span class="number">3</span>);</span><br><span class="line">executor.submit(() -> { doWork(); latch.countDown(); }); <span class="comment">// ×3</span></span><br><span class="line">latch.await(); <span class="comment">// 阻塞直到 count == 0</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// CyclicBarrier: 3 个线程互相等待，到齐后一起执行</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">CyclicBarrier</span> <span class="variable">barrier</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">CyclicBarrier</span>(<span class="number">3</span>, () -> log(<span class="string">"全部到齐！"</span>));</span><br><span class="line">executor.submit(() -> { doWork(); barrier.await(); }); <span class="comment">// ×3</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 可重复使用第二轮</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Semaphore: 限流，最多 5 个线程同时访问</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">Semaphore</span> <span class="variable">semaphore</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Semaphore</span>(<span class="number">5</span>);</span><br><span class="line">semaphore.acquire(); <span class="comment">// 获取许可</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> { doWork(); } <span class="keyword">finally</span> { semaphore.release(); }</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <h2 id="0x02-线程池"><a href="#0x02-线程池" class="headerlink" title="0x02 线程池"></a>0x02 线程池</h2><h3 id="4-ThreadPoolExecutor-的-7-个参数及工作流程？"><a href="#4-ThreadPoolExecutor-的-7-个参数及工作流程？" class="headerlink" title="4. ThreadPoolExecutor 的 7 个参数及工作流程？"></a>4. ThreadPoolExecutor 的 7 个参数及工作流程？</h3><figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">ThreadPoolExecutor(</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">int</span> corePoolSize, <span class="comment">// 核心线程数</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">int</span> maximumPoolSize, <span class="comment">// 最大线程数</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">long</span> keepAliveTime, <span class="comment">// 空闲线程存活时间</span></span><br><span class="line"> TimeUnit unit,</span><br><span class="line"> BlockingQueue<Runnable> workQueue, <span class="comment">// 等待队列</span></span><br><span class="line"> ThreadFactory threadFactory,</span><br><span class="line"> RejectedExecutionHandler handler <span class="comment">// 拒绝策略</span></span><br><span class="line">)</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>工作流程</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">提交任务 → </span><br><span class="line"> 核心线程 < corePoolSize? → 创建核心线程执行（即使有空闲线程）</span><br><span class="line"> 队列没满？ → 放入队列</span><br><span class="line"> 最大线程 < maximumPoolSize? → 创建非核心线程</span><br><span class="line"> 执行拒绝策略</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>四种拒绝策略</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><code>AbortPolicy</code>（默认）：抛 <code>RejectedExecutionException</code></li> <li><code>CallerRunsPolicy</code>：由提交任务的线程自己执行（天然限流）</li> <li><code>DiscardPolicy</code>：静默丢弃</li> <li><code>DiscardOldestPolicy</code>：丢弃队列最老的任务，重试提交</li> </ul> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：不要用 <code>Executors.newFixedThreadPool()</code> 和 <code>Executors.newCachedThreadPool()</code>——前者无界队列可能 OOM，后者无限线程创建。必须用 <code>new ThreadPoolExecutor()</code> 显式指定参数</li> <li><strong>大小公式</strong>：CPU 密集型 <code>coreSize = CPU核数 + 1</code>；IO 密集型 <code>coreSize = CPU核数 × 2</code></li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>生产级参数制定方法</strong>：不要迷信”CPU密集=cores+1, IO密集=cores×2”这个简单公式。真实场景中线程池承载的通常是混合负载，需要基于 <strong>实际压测</strong> 制定参数：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 生产级参数制定示例（基于压测结果）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 场景：订单处理服务，线程池同时处理 DB 读写（IO）+ 金额计算（CPU）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 压测结果：8C16G 机器，队列深度 200 时吞吐最大，延迟最低</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">ThreadPoolExecutor</span> <span class="variable">executor</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ThreadPoolExecutor</span>(</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="number">8</span>, <span class="comment">// corePoolSize = CPU 核数（保证 CPU 充分使用）</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="number">16</span>, <span class="comment">// maximumPoolSize = 2 × CPU 核数（应对突发流量）</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="number">60L</span>, TimeUnit.SECONDS,</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ArrayBlockingQueue</span><>(<span class="number">200</span>), <span class="comment">// 有界队列，防止 OOM</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ThreadFactoryBuilder</span>().setNameFormat(<span class="string">"order-pool-%d"</span>).build(),</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">CallerRunsPolicy</span>() <span class="comment">// 拒绝时降级：提交线程自己执行</span></span><br><span class="line">);</span><br><span class="line">executor.prestartAllCoreThreads(); <span class="comment">// 预热：提前创建核心线程</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>线程池预热</strong>：<code>prestartAllCoreThreads()</code> 在服务启动时立即创建所有核心线程，避免第一个请求到达时因线程创建产生延迟。踩坑案例：某网关服务上线后前 30 秒的请求延迟高达 2s，GC 日志无异常——JFR 显示是线程创建耗时。加上 <code>prestartAllCoreThreads()</code> 后首请求延迟降至 50ms。类似的，<code>prestartCoreThread()</code> 逐个预热（适用于需要阶梯式初始化的场景）。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>线程池监控（线上必设）</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>指标</th> <th>获取方式</th> <th>告警阈值</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>活跃线程数</td> <td><code>executor.getActiveCount()</code></td> <td>> corePoolSize × 0.8</td> <td>线程资源吃紧</td> </tr> <tr> <td>队列积压</td> <td><code>executor.getQueue().size()</code></td> <td>> 队列容量 × 0.7</td> <td>处理速度跟不上入队速度</td> </tr> <tr> <td>拒绝次数</td> <td>封装 Handler 计数器</td> <td>> 0</td> <td>系统过载，需扩容或限流</td> </tr> <tr> <td>最大池大小</td> <td><code>executor.getLargestPoolSize()</code></td> <td>> corePoolSize</td> <td>曾触发创建临时线程</td> </tr> <tr> <td>完成任务数</td> <td><code>executor.getCompletedTaskCount()</code></td> <td>速率突降</td> <td>可能线程被阻塞或死锁</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 生产级包装：带监控的线程池</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">MonitoredThreadPool</span> <span class="keyword">extends</span> <span class="title class_">ThreadPoolExecutor</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">AtomicLong</span> <span class="variable">rejectedCount</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">AtomicLong</span>();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> String poolName;</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="title function_">MonitoredThreadPool</span><span class="params">(..., String poolName)</span> { <span class="built_in">super</span>(...); <span class="built_in">this</span>.poolName = poolName; }</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">rejectedExecution</span><span class="params">(Runnable r, ThreadPoolExecutor e)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> rejectedCount.incrementAndGet();</span><br><span class="line"> log.warn(<span class="string">"[{}] Task rejected, total={}"</span>, poolName, rejectedCount.get());</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">super</span>.rejectedExecution(r, e); <span class="comment">// 或自定义降级</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 通过 Micrometer/Prometheus 暴露指标</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">registerMetrics</span><span class="params">(MeterRegistry registry)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> Gauge.builder(poolName + <span class="string">".active"</span>, <span class="built_in">this</span>, ThreadPoolExecutor::getActiveCount).register(registry);</span><br><span class="line"> Gauge.builder(poolName + <span class="string">".queue"</span>, <span class="built_in">this</span>, e -> e.getQueue().size()).register(registry);</span><br><span class="line"> Gauge.builder(poolName + <span class="string">".rejected"</span>, rejectedCount, AtomicLong::get).register(registry);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>面试金句（升级版）</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“线程池参数没有银弹公式——我在八个生产服务中总结出的规律是：压测定基线、监控保稳定、预热防抖动。<code>prestartAllCoreThreads()</code> 被我列为所有线上服务的启动标配，它能消除上线后前 30 秒的’冷启动’延迟。队列必须是有界的——<code>newFixedThreadPool</code> 的无界队列是 OOM 的温床。拒绝策略我倾向 <code>CallerRunsPolicy</code>，因为它不仅降级，还天然限流——提交线程变慢，迫使上游背压。”</p> </blockquote> </li> </ul> <h3 id="5-如何优雅关闭线程池？"><a href="#5-如何优雅关闭线程池？" class="headerlink" title="5. 如何优雅关闭线程池？"></a>5. 如何优雅关闭线程池？</h3><figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 标准优雅关闭流程</span></span><br><span class="line">executor.shutdown(); <span class="comment">// 不再接受新任务，已提交的继续执行</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (!executor.awaitTermination(<span class="number">30</span>, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {</span><br><span class="line"> executor.shutdownNow(); <span class="comment">// 尝试中断正在执行的任务</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (!executor.awaitTermination(<span class="number">10</span>, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {</span><br><span class="line"> log.error(<span class="string">"线程池未能完全关闭"</span>);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">} <span class="keyword">catch</span> (InterruptedException e) {</span><br><span class="line"> executor.shutdownNow();</span><br><span class="line"> Thread.currentThread().interrupt();</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>关键区别</strong>：<code>shutdown()</code> 不中断正在执行的线程，<code>shutdownNow()</code> 调用 <code>Thread.interrupt()</code> 中断。被 <code>shutdownNow()</code> 中断的线程如果吞掉 <code>InterruptedException</code> 则不会停止。</p> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>关闭顺序的坑</strong>：如果服务中多个线程池存在依赖关系（例如：生产者线程池 → 队列 → 消费者线程池），必须先关闭生产者再关闭消费者。某支付结算服务曾因先 shutdown 消费者线程池，导致生产者仍在提交任务到阻塞队列，消费者已关闭——任务堆积最终触发拒绝策略，产生大量支付结果未处理的脏数据。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>线程池泄露排查</strong>：服务下线后发现 JVM 进程未退出，<code>jstack</code> 看到线程池的 worker 线程仍在阻塞等待队列任务。原因是 <code>shutdown()</code> 后队列中有未处理任务，但 <code>awaitTermination</code> 超时时间设得太短，代码直接走 catch 分支忽略了。修复方案：超时后调用 <code>shutdownNow()</code> 清空队列，然后 <code>List<Runnable> remaining = executor.shutdownNow()</code> 记录未执行任务日志，由人工确认补偿。</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 增强版：带任务追踪的关闭</span></span><br><span class="line">ShutdownResult <span class="title function_">shutdownPool</span><span class="params">(ThreadPoolExecutor executor, String poolName)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> executor.shutdown();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (!executor.awaitTermination(<span class="number">30</span>, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {</span><br><span class="line"> List<Runnable> remaining = executor.shutdownNow();</span><br><span class="line"> log.warn(<span class="string">"[{}] {} tasks drained and cancelled"</span>, poolName, remaining.size());</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (!executor.awaitTermination(<span class="number">10</span>, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {</span><br><span class="line"> log.error(<span class="string">"[{}] Force shutdown failed"</span>, poolName);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> ShutdownResult.PARTIAL;</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">catch</span> (InterruptedException e) {</span><br><span class="line"> executor.shutdownNow();</span><br><span class="line"> Thread.currentThread().interrupt();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> ShutdownResult.INTERRUPTED;</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> ShutdownResult.CLEAN;</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>Java 19+ 的改进</strong>：<code>ExecutorService</code> 在 JDK 19 引入了 <code>close()</code> 方法（实现 <code>AutoCloseable</code>），配合 try-with-resources 可以自动关闭：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> (<span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">executor</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 使用完毕后自动调用 shutdown() + awaitTermination()</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>面试金句（升级版）</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“优雅关闭线程池本质是’先断粮、再收队、后清理’。<code>shutdown()</code> 断新任务，<code>awaitTermination</code> 等现有任务收尾，超时后用 <code>shutdownNow()</code> 强制收回——但收回的任务必须记录日志，确保可以人工补偿。我遇到过因为关闭顺序反了导致支付数据丢失的 P0 事故，从此所有线程池关闭逻辑都加了任务追踪。”</p> </blockquote> </li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x03-JVM-内存模型"><a href="#0x03-JVM-内存模型" class="headerlink" title="0x03 JVM 内存模型"></a>0x03 JVM 内存模型</h2><h3 id="6-JVM-运行时数据区有哪些？各自存什么？"><a href="#6-JVM-运行时数据区有哪些？各自存什么？" class="headerlink" title="6. JVM 运行时数据区有哪些？各自存什么？"></a>6. JVM 运行时数据区有哪些？各自存什么？</h3><figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">┌─────────────────────────────────┐</span><br><span class="line">│ 线程共享区域 │</span><br><span class="line">│ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ 堆 │ │ 方法区 │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ (Heap) │ │(元空间) │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ 对象实例 │ │ 类元数据 │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │ 数组 │ │ 常量池 │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ │</span><br><span class="line">└─────────────────────────────────┘</span><br><span class="line">┌─────────────────────────────────┐</span><br><span class="line">│ 线程私有区域 │</span><br><span class="line">│ ┌────────┐┌────────┐┌───────┐ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │虚拟机栈 ││本地方法栈││程序计数器│ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │栈帧 ││(Native)││(PC) │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ │局部变量表││ ││ │ │</span><br><span class="line">│ └────────┘└────────┘└───────┘ │</span><br><span class="line">└─────────────────────────────────┘</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <ul> <li><strong>堆</strong>：<code>new</code> 出来的对象和数组。GC 的主要战场，分年轻代(Eden+S0+S1)和老年代</li> <li><strong>方法区（元空间）</strong>：类的结构信息（字段、方法、常量池）、JIT 编译后的代码缓存。JDK 8+ 用本地内存实现，不再有 <code>-XX:MaxPermSize</code></li> <li><strong>虚拟机栈</strong>：每个方法执行时创建栈帧，存局部变量表、操作数栈、方法返回地址。<code>StackOverflowError</code> 和它的关系最大</li> <li><strong>本地方法栈</strong>：<code>native</code> 方法使用的栈</li> <li><strong>程序计数器</strong>：当前线程执行的字节码行号</li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x04-GC-调优"><a href="#0x04-GC-调优" class="headerlink" title="0x04 GC 调优"></a>0x04 GC 调优</h2><h3 id="7-G1-GC-的核心原理是什么？什么时候选-G1？"><a href="#7-G1-GC-的核心原理是什么？什么时候选-G1？" class="headerlink" title="7. G1 GC 的核心原理是什么？什么时候选 G1？"></a>7. G1 GC 的核心原理是什么？什么时候选 G1？</h3><p>G1 将堆划分为大小相等的 Region（默认 2048 个，每个 1-32MB）：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">┌──┬──┬──┬──┬──┬──┬──┬──┐</span><br><span class="line">│E │S │O │E │H │E │O │O │ E=Eden, S=Survivor, O=Old, H=Humongous</span><br><span class="line">└──┴──┴──┴──┴──┴──┴──┴──┘</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>核心流程</strong>（Mixed GC）：</p> <ol> <li><strong>初始标记</strong>（STW，随 Young GC 一起）：标记 GC Roots 直接可达对象</li> <li><strong>并发标记</strong>：三色标记法，与用户线程并发</li> <li><strong>最终标记</strong>（STW，短）：处理并发期间的变化（SATB 快照）</li> <li><strong>筛选回收</strong>（STW）：选垃圾最多的 Region 回收（Garbage-First 的由来）</li> </ol> <p><strong>选型标准</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>堆 > 4GB → G1（CMS 在大堆下碎片化严重）</li> <li>延迟要求 < 200ms → G1（可设置 <code>-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis</code>）</li> <li>JDK 9+ → G1 是默认 GC</li> <li>堆 < 4GB 且对吞吐量要求高 → Parallel GC</li> </ul> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># G1 典型配置</span></span><br><span class="line">-XX:+UseG1GC</span><br><span class="line">-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 <span class="comment"># 目标暂停时间</span></span><br><span class="line">-XX:G1HeapRegionSize=4m <span class="comment"># Region 大小</span></span><br><span class="line">-XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=45 <span class="comment"># 并发标记触发阈值</span></span><br><span class="line">-Xms4g -Xmx4g</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>Region 大小对大对象的致命影响</strong>：G1 的 Region 大小决定了”大对象（Humongous）”的判定阈值——超过 Region 大小 50% 的对象直接分配到 Humongous Region。Humongous Region 的 GC 效率极差：Mixed GC 中需要扫描整个大对象区域；Full GC 时大对象区域可能成为碎片化源头，导致晋升失败（Promotion Failed）。</p> <ul> <li><strong>踩坑案例</strong>：某广告推荐服务（JDK 11，G1，堆 8GB）每天下午高峰出现 3-5 次 Full GC，每次 STW 长达 5-8 秒。排查发现：推荐模型更新的 byte[] 缓存平均大小为 3.2MB，而 G1 默认 Region 大小按堆推算约为 4MB（8GB / 2048）。3.2MB > 4MB × 50%（2MB），触发了 Humongous 分配。高峰期 100+ 个大对象同时分配，Humongous Region 快速耗尽，触发 Full GC。修复方案：将 <code>-XX:G1HeapRegionSize</code> 从默认的 4MB 增大到 8MB，使大对象判定阈值升至 4MB，3.2MB 的缓存不再被视为大对象，Full GC 消失。</li> </ul> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>堆大小</th> <th>默认 Region 数</th> <th>默认 Region 大小</th> <th>Humongous 阈值</th> <th>建议</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>4GB</td> <td>2048</td> <td>2MB</td> <td>1MB</td> <td>有 1-2MB 对象时调大到 4MB</td> </tr> <tr> <td>8GB</td> <td>2048</td> <td>4MB</td> <td>2MB</td> <td>有 2-4MB 对象时调大到 8MB</td> </tr> <tr> <td>16GB</td> <td>2048</td> <td>8MB</td> <td>4MB</td> <td>有 4-8MB 对象时调大到 16MB</td> </tr> <tr> <td>32GB</td> <td>2048</td> <td>16MB</td> <td>8MB</td> <td>注意大 Region 可能增加暂停时间</td> </tr> </tbody></table> </li> <li><p><strong>G1 Mixed GC 触发频率调优</strong>：<code>-XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=85</code>（默认 85%）控制 Mixed GC 只回收存活对象占比低于 85% 的 Region。如果线上 Mixed GC 回收效果差（回收前后堆占用变化不大），可以降低此阈值到 65%。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>操作检查清单</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查看实际 Humongous 分配情况</span></span><br><span class="line">jstat -gcutil <pid> 1000 <span class="comment"># 观察 FGCT（Full GC 时间）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查看大对象统计（JDK 11+）</span></span><br><span class="line">jcmd <pid> GC.heap_info | grep -i humongous</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># GC 日志分析（开启 GC 日志）</span></span><br><span class="line">-Xlog:gc*:file=gc.log:<span class="keyword">time</span>,level,tags</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 日志中搜索 "Humongous" 了解大对象分配情况</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 搜索 "Pause Full" 了解 Full GC 根因</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>面试金句（升级版）</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“G1 的 Region 大小不是随便选的——它直接决定什么对象算’大对象’。我遇到过广告推荐服务因为缓存对象刚好超过 Region 50% 阈值，导致频繁触发 Humongous Region 分配和 Full GC。把 Region 从 4MB 调到 8MB 后 Full GC 完全消失。调 G1 的第一步不是改暂停时间，而是确认 Region 大小和你的对象大小匹配。”</p> </blockquote> </li> </ul> <h3 id="8-OOM-排查流程？"><a href="#8-OOM-排查流程？" class="headerlink" title="8. OOM 排查流程？"></a>8. OOM 排查流程？</h3><figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. 获取 heap dump（启动参数自动 dump）</span></span><br><span class="line">-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -XX:HeapDumpPath=/tmp/heapdump.hprof</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. 手动 dump（jmap 或 arthas）</span></span><br><span class="line">jmap -dump:live,format=b,file=heap.hprof <pid></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. 分析（MAT / JProfiler / VisualVM）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 重点看：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - Dominator Tree: 最大内存占用对象</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - Leak Suspects: 自动检测内存泄漏</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - Path to GC Roots: 谁引用着这个大对象</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>常见 OOM 原因</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>堆溢出</strong>：ThreadLocal 没 remove、集合类无限增长、缓存没上限</li> <li><strong>元空间溢出</strong>：动态生成大量类（CGLIB 代理、Groovy 脚本）</li> <li><strong>直接内存溢出</strong>：NIO 的 DirectByteBuffer 没释放（<code>-XX:MaxDirectMemorySize</code>）</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>踩坑案例：ThreadLocal 泄漏导致 Full GC 风暴</strong>：某风控规则引擎服务（JDK 8，4C8G × 12 节点）上线一周后频繁触发 Full GC（每 10 分钟一次），每次 STW 3-5 秒。<code>jmap -histo:live</code> 显示 <code>char[]</code> 和 <code>HashMap$Node</code> 对象数量异常。MAT 分析 Dominator Tree 发现：<code>ThreadLocalMap$Entry</code> 占用了约 60% 的堆空间，每个 Entry 的 value 都是一个包含 <code>Map<String, Object></code> 的风控上下文对象。根因：规则引擎在处理每个请求时 <code>ThreadLocal.set(contextMap)</code> 存储上下文，但请求结束后未在 <code>finally</code> 中 <code>remove()</code>。Tomcat 的请求处理线程是复用的——线程不销毁，ThreadLocalMap 持续增长，OOM 只是时间问题。修复方案：在请求过滤器的 finally 块中 <code>tl.remove()</code>，同时增加 Arthas 监控 <code>ognl '#threadLocals=@ThreadLocal@threadLocalMap'</code> 实时检查泄漏。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>OOM 排查三板斧</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>步骤</th> <th>工具</th> <th>关键操作</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>第一板斧：快速定位</td> <td><code>jmap -histo:live <pid></code></td> <td>查看存活对象类型分布，找到异常增长的对象</td> </tr> <tr> <td>第二板斧：获取快照</td> <td><code>jmap -dump:live,format=b,file=/tmp/heap.hprof <pid></code></td> <td>注意 live 参数会触发 Full GC（生产慎用）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>第三板斧：深入分析</td> <td>MAT / JProfiler</td> <td>Dominator Tree → Leak Suspects → Path to GC Roots</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 生产中推荐使用 jcmd 替代 jmap（更安全，无需触发 Full GC 进程挂载）</span></span><br><span class="line">jcmd <pid> GC.heap_dump /tmp/heap.hprof</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 线上环境用 Arthas 实时排查</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查看 Top 20 大对象</span></span><br><span class="line">dashboard</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查看 ThreadLocalMap 内容</span></span><br><span class="line">ognl <span class="string">'#map=@java.lang.ThreadLocal@threadLocalMap, #map.entrySet().iterator'</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>面试金句（升级版）</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“OOM 排查最重要的是’让证据完整’——<code>-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError</code> 是所有线上服务的必配参数。我处理过最典型的 OOM 是 ThreadLocal 泄漏：规则引擎服务上线一周后 Full GC 爆发，MAT 一查 ThreadLocalMap 占堆 60%。根因就是 request 处理完没 remove。从此所有 ThreadLocal 使用都加 try-finally 模板——这是团队的铁律。”</p> </blockquote> </li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-设计模式"><a href="#0x05-设计模式" class="headerlink" title="0x05 设计模式"></a>0x05 设计模式</h2><h3 id="0x07-ConcurrentHashMap-JUC-集合"><a href="#0x07-ConcurrentHashMap-JUC-集合" class="headerlink" title="0x07 ConcurrentHashMap & JUC 集合"></a>0x07 ConcurrentHashMap & JUC 集合</h2><h3 id="11-ConcurrentHashMap-1-7-vs-1-8-底层原理对比"><a href="#11-ConcurrentHashMap-1-7-vs-1-8-底层原理对比" class="headerlink" title="11. ConcurrentHashMap 1.7 vs 1.8 底层原理对比"></a>11. ConcurrentHashMap 1.7 vs 1.8 底层原理对比</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：ConcurrentHashMap 在 JDK 1.7 和 1.8 中的底层实现有什么区别？为什么 JDK 1.8 要重构？</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>JDK 1.7</strong>：采用 Segment（分段锁）+ HashEntry 数组。默认 16 个 Segment，每个 Segment 继承 ReentrantLock，锁粒度较粗。get 操作无锁（volatile 保证可见性），put 操作对单个 Segment 加锁。</li> <li><strong>JDK 1.8</strong>：摒弃 Segment，采用 Node + CAS + synchronized。锁粒度精确到每个数组元素（桶）。put 时如果桶为空使用 CAS 无锁插入；如果桶不为空则对桶首节点 synchronized 加锁。</li> <li><strong>优势</strong>：锁粒度更细，并发度从 16 提升到数组长度；synchronized 在 JDK 1.8 有偏向锁/轻量级锁优化，性能不低于 ReentrantLock；空间占用更小（省略 Segment 对象）。</li> </ul> <p><strong>示例</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// JDK 1.8 putVal 核心逻辑</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">final</span> V <span class="title function_">putVal</span><span class="params">(K key, V value, <span class="type">boolean</span> onlyIfAbsent)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (key == <span class="literal">null</span> || value == <span class="literal">null</span>) <span class="keyword">throw</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">NullPointerException</span>();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">hash</span> <span class="operator">=</span> spread(key.hashCode());</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">binCount</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="number">0</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">for</span> (Node<K,V>[] tab = table;;) {</span><br><span class="line"> Node<K,V> f; <span class="type">int</span> n, i, fh; K fk; V fv;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (tab == <span class="literal">null</span> || (n = tab.length) == <span class="number">0</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> tab = initTable();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">else</span> <span class="keyword">if</span> ((f = tabAt(tab, i = (n - <span class="number">1</span>) & hash)) == <span class="literal">null</span>) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (casTabAt(tab, i, <span class="literal">null</span>, <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Node</span><K,V>(hash, key, value)))</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">break</span>; <span class="comment">// CAS 无锁插入</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">else</span> <span class="keyword">if</span> ((fh = f.hash) == MOVED)</span><br><span class="line"> tab = helpTransfer(tab, f);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">else</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">V</span> <span class="variable">oldVal</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="literal">null</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">synchronized</span> (f) { <span class="comment">// 仅对桶首节点加锁</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// ...</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：当 hash 冲突严重导致链表过长时，1.8 引入了红黑树（链表长度 ≥ 8 时树化），而 1.7 的 Segment 内部仍是数组+链表，极端情况下 get 退化到 O(n)。此外，1.8 的 resize 支持多线程协助迁移（helpTransfer），1.7 的 rehash 是单线程完成的。</li> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：1.8 的 <code>size()</code> 方法通过 CounterCell 数组分段计数 + <code>sumCount()</code> 累加，避免全局锁；1.7 的 <code>size()</code> 先尝试无锁统计两次，若不一致则锁所有 Segment。1.8 在扩容时用 <code>ForwardingNode</code>（MOVED）通知其他线程跳过已迁移的桶。</li> <li><strong>对比延伸</strong>：ConcurrentHashMap 1.8 的设计思路与 Java 8 HashMap 的红黑树改造一脉相承——用更精细的锁（CAS + synchronized 桶锁）代替粗粒度的分段锁。这与 LongAdder 替代 AtomicLong 的思路类似：分段计数减少 CAS 竞争。</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：1.8 中 <code>ConcurrentHashMap</code> 的 <code>computeIfAbsent</code> 方法在 JDK 8 早期版本存在死循环 Bug（JDK-8062841），升级到 JDK 8u102+ 即可修复。高并发场景下，应避免在 <code>computeIfAbsent</code> 的回调函数中再次操作同一个 Map。</li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“ConcurrentHashMap 1.8 的重构核心思路是’细粒度锁 + 无锁 CAS + 多线程协作’。锁粒度从 Segment（默认 16 个）细化到每个桶（数组长度个），并发度提升了一个数量级。更重要的是 1.8 引入了红黑树和 ForwardingNode，解决了长链表遍历和并发扩容两个历史痛点。”</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="12-JVM-垃圾收集器选型与调优"><a href="#12-JVM-垃圾收集器选型与调优" class="headerlink" title="12. JVM 垃圾收集器选型与调优"></a>12. JVM 垃圾收集器选型与调优</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：生产环境中如何选择 JVM 垃圾收集器？G1 和 ZGC 的区别是什么？给出选型表和调优参数。</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：</p> <p><strong>各收集器特点</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>收集器</th> <th>线程模型</th> <th>适用堆大小</th> <th>STW 目标</th> <th>场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>Serial GC</td> <td>单线程</td> <td>< 100MB</td> <td>秒级</td> <td>测试环境、单核</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Parallel GC</td> <td>多线程</td> <td>< 4GB</td> <td>秒级</td> <td>批处理、吞吐优先（Java 8 默认）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>G1</td> <td>多线程+并发</td> <td>4GB~64GB</td> <td>200ms 可控</td> <td>通用、延迟敏感</td> </tr> <tr> <td>ZGC</td> <td>并发（读屏障）</td> <td>TB 级</td> <td>< 10ms</td> <td>超低延迟、超大堆</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>选型建议</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>堆 < 4GB、追求吞吐 → Parallel</li> <li>堆 4GB~64GB、延迟敏感 → G1</li> <li>堆 > 64GB、超低延迟 → ZGC（JDK 21+ 推荐）</li> </ul> <p><strong>调优参数</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># G1 调优</span></span><br><span class="line">-XX:+UseG1GC</span><br><span class="line">-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 <span class="comment"># 目标最大停顿</span></span><br><span class="line">-XX:G1HeapRegionSize=4M <span class="comment"># Region 大小</span></span><br><span class="line">-XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=45 <span class="comment"># 触发并发标记的堆占用</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># ZGC 调优</span></span><br><span class="line">-XX:+UseZGC</span><br><span class="line">-XX:ConcGCThreads=4 <span class="comment"># 并发 GC 线程数</span></span><br><span class="line">-Xlog:gc*:file=gc.log:<span class="keyword">time</span>,level <span class="comment"># GC 日志</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 通用</span></span><br><span class="line">-Xms4g -Xmx4g</span><br><span class="line">-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError</span><br><span class="line">-XX:HeapDumpPath=/tmp/heapdump.hprof</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：当堆大小处于 4GB 边界时，G1 的 Region 数量不足（默认 2048 个，每个最小 1MB），并发标记周期可能过于频繁。此时建议手动调小 <code>-XX:G1HeapRegionSize</code> 或换用 ZGC。此外，ZGC 在 JDK 15-17 期间对超大堆（>1TB）的压缩指针支持尚不完善，JDK 21+ 才真正成熟。</li> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：G1 采用 SATB（Snapshot-At-The-Beginning）算法维护并发标记的稳定性，而非 CMS 的增量更新。SATB 在并发阶段记录所有引用变更，最终标记阶段处理，避免了 CMS 的”并发模式失败”（Concurrent Mode Failure）。ZGC 则使用染色指针（Colored Pointers）+ 读屏障（Load Barrier），在对象引用中编码状态位，无需对象头标记。</li> <li><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Parallel → G1 → ZGC 的演进实质是”吞吐优先 → 延迟可控 → 极低延迟”的取舍。Parallel 追求”最快干完所有活”，G1 追求”每次停不超过 200ms”，ZGC 追求”几乎不停”。大数据批处理（Spark ETL）适合 Parallel，实时服务（Flink 在线推理）适合 G1/ZGC。</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：G1 在写密集型应用（如 Kafka 生产者日志）中可能出现”全堆标记”频繁触发的问题，可调大 <code>-XX:G1ReservePercent=15</code> 或调高 <code>-XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=55</code>。ZGC 在 JDK 17 之前不支持 <code>-XX:-UseCompressedOops</code> 的场景，大堆时必须仔细测试。</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>（补充）：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>ZGC 在 JDK 21+ 的改进：分代 ZGC（JEP 439）</strong>：<br>JDK 21 引入的分代 ZGC 是 ZGC 面世以来最重要的优化——它区分年轻代和老年代，让 ZGC 也能像 G1 一样针对”朝生夕死”的对象做高效回收。</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>ZGC（JDK 17，非分代）</th> <th>ZGC（JDK 21+，分代）</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>全堆标记频率</td> <td>每次 GC 都扫描全堆</td> <td>只扫描年轻代（大部分对象已死）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>大堆吞吐（128GB+）</td> <td>CPU 开销高（全堆并发标记）</td> <td>年轻代标记快 4-5 倍</td> </tr> <tr> <td>内存开销</td> <td>需要额外堆的 15-20% 作为预留</td> <td>只需额外 3-5%</td> </tr> <tr> <td>启动参数</td> <td><code>-XX:+UseZGC</code></td> <td><code>-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational</code>（JDK 21 默认启用）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>适用堆大小</td> <td>> 100GB</td> <td>任意大小（> 4GB 推荐）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>踩坑案例</strong>：某实时风控服务（堆 128GB，JDK 17，ZGC）在双 11 高峰期间 CPU 飙升至 90%+，其中 ZGC 并发标记线程消耗了约 40% 的 CPU。升级到 JDK 21 分代 ZGC 后，同样的流量负载下 GC CPU 开销从 40% 降至 12%，P99 延迟从 15ms 降至 6ms。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>G1 和 ZGC 的生产选型决策树</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">堆 > 4GB?</span><br><span class="line"> ├── 否 → Parallel GC（吞吐优先）</span><br><span class="line"> └── 是 → 延迟要求 < 10ms?</span><br><span class="line"> ├── 否 → G1（默认选型）</span><br><span class="line"> └── 是 → 堆 > 100GB?</span><br><span class="line"> ├── 否 → ZGC（分代）</span><br><span class="line"> └── 是 → ZGC（非分代，注意 CPU 预留）</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>操作检查清单</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 确认 ZGC 版本（JDK 21+ 才支持分代）</span></span><br><span class="line">java -version</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 验证 ZGC 是否启用分代模式</span></span><br><span class="line">jcmd <pid> VM.flags | grep ZGenerational</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># GC 日志分析（判断 GC 是否瓶颈）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 年轻代 GC 频率过高 → 增大新生代</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 并发标记时间过长 → 增加 ConcGCThreads</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Full GC 出现 → 排查大对象分配或内存泄漏</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 核心监控指标</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - GC 暂停时间（P99 < 目标值）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - GC CPU 开销（应 < 总 CPU 的 20%）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># - 堆使用率趋势（持续上升 = 泄漏）</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>面试金句（升级版）</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“分代 ZGC 是 JDK 21 给 GC 领域最大的礼物——它解决了 ZGC 诞生以来最大的痛点：全堆并发标记的 CPU 开销。我们团队在双 11 实测升级 JDK 21 后 GC CPU 开销从 40% 降到了 12%。分代 ZGC 的推出意味着：2026 年的生产环境，堆 > 4GB 的在线服务，默认选 G1，延迟敏感选 ZGC（JDK 21+ 分代），批处理选 Parallel。CMS？已经可以彻底告别了。”</p> </blockquote> </li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“GC 选型本质是延迟与吞吐的 trade-off。Parallel 是’大力出奇迹’——用更多线程并行回收，停得久但干得多；G1 是’分而治之’——分 Region 优先回收垃圾最多的区域，让暂停时间可控；ZGC 是’暗度陈仓’——染色指针配合读屏障，让 GC 几乎与业务线程并发执行，暂停降至 10ms 以下。2026 年的生产标准配置：批处理用 Parallel，在线服务用 G1，超低延迟用 ZGC。”</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="13-Java-8-Stream-API-与并行流原理"><a href="#13-Java-8-Stream-API-与并行流原理" class="headerlink" title="13. Java 8 Stream API 与并行流原理"></a>13. Java 8 Stream API 与并行流原理</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：Java 8 Stream 的惰性求值是如何实现的？并行流（parallelStream）底层使用什么线程池？有哪些常见的陷阱？</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>惰性求值</strong>：Stream 分为中间操作（filter、map）和终端操作（collect、forEach）。中间操作只构建操作流水线（Sink 链），不实际计算；终端操作触发完整计算。</li> <li><strong>Spliterator</strong>：可分割迭代器，支持 <code>trySplit()</code> 方法将数据拆分为子任务，实现分治并行。</li> <li><strong>ForkJoinPool</strong>：并行流默认使用 <code>ForkJoinPool.commonPool()</code>，线程数为 <code>Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors() - 1</code>。</li> <li><strong>陷阱</strong>：IO 密集型任务不适合并行流（线程池被 IO 阻塞浪费 CPU）；共享可变状态（如 ArrayList）在并行流中线程不安全；数据量小时并行流比串行更慢（线程切换和拆分开销）。</li> </ul> <p><strong>示例</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 反例：并行流 + 共享可变状态</span></span><br><span class="line">List<Integer> list = <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ArrayList</span><>();</span><br><span class="line">IntStream.range(<span class="number">0</span>, <span class="number">10000</span>).parallel().forEach(list::add); <span class="comment">// 线程不安全！</span></span><br><span class="line">System.out.println(list.size()); <span class="comment">// 可能 < 10000</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 正例：使用 Collector 或 reduce 等线程安全方式</span></span><br><span class="line">List<Integer> safe = IntStream.range(<span class="number">0</span>, <span class="number">10000</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .parallel()</span><br><span class="line"> .boxed()</span><br><span class="line"> .collect(Collectors.toList()); <span class="comment">// 线程安全</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 反例：并行流中的阻塞 IO</span></span><br><span class="line">IntStream.range(<span class="number">0</span>, <span class="number">100</span>).parallel().forEach(i -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">String</span> <span class="variable">result</span> <span class="operator">=</span> httpClient.get(<span class="string">"https://api.example.com/data/"</span> + i); <span class="comment">// 阻塞 commonPool!</span></span><br><span class="line">});</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 正确做法：使用自定义 ForkJoinPool</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">ForkJoinPool</span> <span class="variable">customPool</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ForkJoinPool</span>(<span class="number">100</span>);</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> customPool.submit(() -></span><br><span class="line"> IntStream.range(<span class="number">0</span>, <span class="number">100</span>).parallel().forEach(i -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">String</span> <span class="variable">result</span> <span class="operator">=</span> httpClient.get(<span class="string">"https://api.example.com/data/"</span> + i);</span><br><span class="line"> })</span><br><span class="line"> ).get();</span><br><span class="line">} <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> customPool.shutdown();</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：<code>findFirst()</code> 在并行流中比 <code>findAny()</code> 慢得多——<code>findFirst()</code> 需要保持 encounter order，拆分和合并时强制有序，破坏了并行优势。数据量小于 10,000 元素时，并行流通常比串行慢。<code>limit(n)</code> 在并行流中可能消耗比 n 更多的元素（拆分后再合并取前 n）。</li> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：Stream 的惰性求值是通过 <code>ReferencePipeline</code> 内部维护的 <code>Sink</code> 链实现的。每个中间操作创建新的 pipeline stage，终端操作调用 <code>evaluate()</code> 时，触发 <code>wrapAndCopyInto()</code> 将 Sink 链串联执行。<code>Spliterator.trySplit()</code> 的拆分质量（SUBSIZED / ORDERED 等特性标志）直接决定并行效率。</li> <li><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Stream 的并行模型与 ForkJoinPool 的工作窃取（Work-Stealing）算法紧密相关。与 Scala 的 <code>Future.sequence</code>、Kotlin 的 <code>Flow</code> 对比：Stream 是 push-based（数据推给操作），<code>Flow</code> 是 pull-based（操作拉取数据），在背压场景下 <code>Flow</code> 更灵活。</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：Web 应用中应避免在 Tomcat 请求线程中直接使用 <code>parallelStream()</code>——它会和 Tomcat 线程竞争 commonPool。如果确需使用，建议自定义 ForkJoinPool 隔离。大数据 ETL 场景下，Stream API 适合中小数据集（百万级），千万级以上应使用 Spark DataFrame。</li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“Java 8 Stream 的惰性求值是’先搭管道，再放水’——中间操作只描述要做什么，终端操作才真正执行。并行流的本质是 ForkJoinPool 进行分治，数据量不够大、CPU 不够多、或任务中包含阻塞 IO 时，并行比串行更慢。记住：<code>parallelStream()</code> 不是银弹，它只适用于 CPU 密集型且数据量足够大的场景。”</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x0A-ThreadLocal-内存管理"><a href="#0x0A-ThreadLocal-内存管理" class="headerlink" title="0x0A ThreadLocal & 内存管理"></a>0x0A ThreadLocal & 内存管理</h2><h3 id="14-ThreadLocal-内存泄漏原理"><a href="#14-ThreadLocal-内存泄漏原理" class="headerlink" title="14. ThreadLocal 内存泄漏原理"></a>14. ThreadLocal 内存泄漏原理</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：ThreadLocal 为什么会发生内存泄漏？如何避免？</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：<br>ThreadLocal 的内存泄漏源于其内部存储结构的引用设计：</p> <ul> <li>ThreadLocalMap 的 Entry 继承 <code>WeakReference<ThreadLocal></code>，key（ThreadLocal 对象）是弱引用，value 是强引用。</li> <li>当 <code>ThreadLocal</code> 对象不再被外部强引用后，GC 会回收 key（变为 null），但 value 仍有强引用链：<code>Thread → ThreadLocalMap → Entry → value</code>。</li> <li>线程池场景最为致命——核心线程长期存活，线程的 ThreadLocalMap 永远不会被回收，key=null 的 Entry 持续堆积，value 无法释放，最终 OOM。</li> </ul> <p><strong>解决方案</strong>：</p> <ol> <li>每次使用后显式调用 <code>TL.remove()</code> </li> <li>Try-finally 确保：</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">ThreadLocal<MyObject> tl = <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ThreadLocal</span><>();</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> tl.set(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">MyObject</span>());</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// ... 业务逻辑</span></span><br><span class="line">} <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> tl.remove(); <span class="comment">// 务必在 finally 中清理</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <ol start="3"> <li>JDK 内部做了防御：<code>get()</code>/<code>set()</code>/<code>remove()</code> 时会遍历 Entry 数组，清理 key=null 的过期 Entry（<code>expungeStaleEntry()</code> 方法），但不保证一定会调用到。</li> </ol> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：使用 <code>InheritableThreadLocal</code> 时，子线程会复制父线程的 ThreadLocalMap，如果父线程反复创建子线程（如线程池提交新任务），会导致大量复制和内存泄漏。JDK 21 的 <code>ScopedValue</code> 是更好的替代方案。</li> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：ThreadLocalMap 的 Entry 数组初始容量 16，负载因子 2/3。<code>expungeStaleEntry()</code> 不仅清理当前 stale slot，还会遍历后续 Entry 重新哈希（rehash），这是 ThreadLocalMap 不使用链表而用开放地址法的原因。</li> <li><strong>对比延伸</strong>：ThreadLocal 的弱引用设计与 Netty 的 <code>FastThreadLocal</code> 形成对比——Netty 用数组替代 Map，直接通过 index 访问，空间换时间。<code>ScopedValue</code>（JDK 21, JEP 429）比 ThreadLocal 更轻量：不可变、不泄漏、不限制虚拟线程使用。</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：Spring 的 <code>RequestContextHolder</code>、<code>TransactionSynchronizationManager</code> 底层都依赖 ThreadLocal，使用完后框架会主动清理。但如果自定义 ThreadLocal 存储用户信息、TraceId、SQL 连接等资源，必须确保在请求结束或线程归还池前 <code>remove()</code>。Arthas 的 <code>ognl</code> 命令行可以实时查看 ThreadLocalMap 内容来排查泄漏。</li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“ThreadLocal 内存泄漏的根源是’弱引用的 key 和强引用的 value 生命周期不同步’。key 被 GC 回收后，value 仍然活在 Thread 的引用链中。线程池放大了这个问题——线程不销毁，泄漏持续累积。解决方案简单但关键：<code>try{set()}finally{remove()}</code>，这是使用 ThreadLocal 的铁律。”</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x0B-Java-虚拟线程（Virtual-Threads）"><a href="#0x0B-Java-虚拟线程（Virtual-Threads）" class="headerlink" title="0x0B Java 虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）"></a>0x0B Java 虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）</h2><h3 id="15-Java-虚拟线程（Virtual-Threads）原理与大数据应用"><a href="#15-Java-虚拟线程（Virtual-Threads）原理与大数据应用" class="headerlink" title="15. Java 虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）原理与大数据应用"></a>15. Java 虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）原理与大数据应用</h3><p><strong>难度</strong>：⭐⭐⭐<br><strong>问题</strong>：JDK 21 正式发布的虚拟线程（Virtual Threads / Project Loom）是什么？与传统平台线程相比的优势是什么？在大数据 IO 密集型场景下如何应用？</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：</p> <p>虚拟线程（JEP 444，JDK 21 GA）是 Java 的轻量级用户态线程，由 JVM 调度而非 OS 内核调度。一个平台线程（Platform Thread）对应一个 OS 线程，而数百万虚拟线程可以复用在少量平台线程（Carrier Thread）上。</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ol> <li>虚拟线程由 <code>ForkJoinPool</code>（默认 <code>commonPool</code>）中的 carrier 线程执行</li> <li>遇到阻塞操作（网络 IO、文件 IO、<code>BlockingQueue.take()</code>）时，虚拟线程自动 yield，carrier 被释放去执行其他虚拟线程</li> <li>阻塞恢复后，虚拟线程重新挂载到某个 carrier 上继续执行</li> <li>整个过程对业务代码完全透明——写同步阻塞代码即可享受异步性能</li> </ol> <p><strong>平台线程 vs 虚拟线程对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>平台线程</th> <th>虚拟线程</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>调度者</td> <td>OS 内核</td> <td>JVM（ForkJoinPool）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>数量上限</td> <td>几千（受限于栈内存 1MB+）</td> <td>百万级（栈仅几百字节）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>创建开销</td> <td>高（系统调用 + 1MB 栈预分配）</td> <td>极低（堆内分配，微秒级）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>上下文切换</td> <td>微秒级（内核态）</td> <td>纳秒级（用户态）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>适用场景</td> <td>CPU 密集型</td> <td>IO 密集型（最佳）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>阻塞行为</td> <td>阻塞 OS 线程</td> <td>仅阻塞虚拟线程本身</td> </tr> <tr> <td>调试友好性</td> <td>栈深度清晰</td> <td>栈深度清晰（不丢失）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>大数据场景应用</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br><span class="line">27</span><br><span class="line">28</span><br><span class="line">29</span><br><span class="line">30</span><br><span class="line">31</span><br><span class="line">32</span><br><span class="line">33</span><br><span class="line">34</span><br><span class="line">35</span><br><span class="line">36</span><br><span class="line">37</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 场景1：Kafka 高并发消费者（IO 密集）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 传统方式：每个分区一个线程，受限于线程数</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 虚拟线程方式：每个记录一个任务，无数量限制</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> (<span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">executor</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">while</span> (<span class="literal">true</span>) {</span><br><span class="line"> ConsumerRecords<String, <span class="type">byte</span>[]> records = consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(<span class="number">100</span>));</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">for</span> (ConsumerRecord<String, <span class="type">byte</span>[]> record : records) {</span><br><span class="line"> executor.submit(() -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 每个 record 在独立的虚拟线程中处理</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// IO 阻塞（写 DB、调用外部 API）时自动 yield</span></span><br><span class="line"> processRecord(record);</span><br><span class="line"> });</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 场景2：Flink AsyncIO 的替代思路（简化异步编程）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 传统 Flink AsyncIO 需要回调或 CompletableFuture 编排</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 虚拟线程下可以直接写同步代码：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">VirtualThreadMapFunction</span> <span class="keyword">extends</span> <span class="title class_">RichMapFunction</span><Event, Result> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">transient</span> ExecutorService vtExecutor;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">open</span><span class="params">(Configuration params)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> vtExecutor = Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor();</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> Result <span class="title function_">map</span><span class="params">(Event event)</span> <span class="keyword">throws</span> Exception {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 在虚拟线程中提交异步 RPC 调用，代码是同步的</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">UserInfo</span> <span class="variable">user</span> <span class="operator">=</span> userService.getUser(event.userId); <span class="comment">// RPC 阻塞</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">ProductInfo</span> <span class="variable">product</span> <span class="operator">=</span> productService.getProduct(event.productId); <span class="comment">// RPC 阻塞</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> combine(event, user, product);</span><br><span class="line"> }, vtExecutor).get(); <span class="comment">// 等待结果时当前虚拟线程 yield</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>注意事项（Pitfalls）</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><strong>CPU 密集任务</strong>不适合——虚拟线程不减少 CPU 计算量，且多了调度开销</li> <li><strong>synchronized 钉住（Pinning）</strong>：synchronized 块内阻塞会钉住 carrier 线程，应改用 <code>ReentrantLock</code></li> <li><strong>线程局部变量（ThreadLocal）</strong>：虚拟线程数量极大，ThreadLocal 可能导致严重内存泄漏</li> <li><strong>池化虚拟线程无意义</strong>：虚拟线程创建/销毁轻量，不应池化（<code>Executors.newCachedThreadPool()</code> 或 <code>newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()</code>）</li> </ol> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>synchronized 钉住（Pinning）的实测影响</strong>：JDK 21 中虚拟线程遇到 synchronized 块内的阻塞操作（如 IO）时，整个 Carrier 线程被”钉住”无法被其他虚拟线程使用。实测数据：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>场景</th> <th>吞吐（TPS）</th> <th>P99 延迟</th> <th>备注</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>虚拟线程 + synchronized（钉住）</td> <td>2,800</td> <td>850ms</td> <td>Carrier 线程被浪费等待</td> </tr> <tr> <td>虚拟线程 + ReentrantLock（不钉住）</td> <td>15,200</td> <td>45ms</td> <td>阻塞时 yield，Carrier 释放</td> </tr> <tr> <td>平台线程 + synchronized</td> <td>4,500</td> <td>210ms</td> <td>无钉住问题但线程数受限</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p>踩坑案例：某 API 网关服务将 Tomcat 线程池切换为虚拟线程后，TPS 不升反降——追踪发现大多数 Handler 使用了 <code>synchronized</code> 同步块（Spring <code>@Transactional</code> 在底层使用 synchronized），导致 Carrier 线程被频繁钉住。修复方案：将同步块改为 <code>ReentrantLock</code>，或使用 <code>-Djdk.tracePinnedThreads=full</code> 启动参数打印钉住线程的堆栈信息辅助排查。</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 开启 Pin 线程追踪（生产调试用）</span></span><br><span class="line">-Djdk.tracePinnedThreads=full</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 日志中搜索 "PinnedThread" 可以看到具体钉住的栈帧</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>虚拟线程 + Spring Boot Tomcat 集成现状</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>Spring Boot 3.2+</strong>：支持 <code>spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true</code> 一键启用虚拟线程 Tomcat</li> <li><strong>Spring Boot 3.3+</strong>：支持虚拟线程 + Jetty/Undertow</li> <li><strong>兼容性红线</strong>：<ul> <li><code>@Async</code> 方法中使用 synchronized → 钉住</li> <li>Tomcat 的请求线程以虚拟线程运行，但 <code>BlockingQueue.take()</code> 在虚拟线程中 await 时不钉住（已优化）</li> <li>使用传统 <code>ThreadLocal</code>（如 <code>RequestContextHolder</code>）→ 百万级请求可能产生大量 ThreadLocal 对象</li> <li>Spring Security 的 <code>SecurityContextHolder</code> 默认使用 ThreadLocal → 切换到 <code>MODE_INHERITABLETHREADLOCAL</code> 或虚拟线程安全模式</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># application.yml - Spring Boot 3.2+ 虚拟线程配置</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">spring:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">threads:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">virtual:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">enabled:</span> <span class="literal">true</span> <span class="comment"># 一行开启虚拟线程</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># 需要额外注意：</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># - 检查所有 ThreadLocal 使用，确保 try-finally remove</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># - 用 ReentrantLock 替换 synchronized</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># - 数据库连接池大小建议增大（虚拟线程可以支持更多并发连接）</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </li> <li><p><strong>虚拟线程 + ThreadLocal 的内存泄漏风险</strong>：<br>虚拟线程的杀手级场景是”百万级并发”。但如果每个虚拟线程都塞了一个 ThreadLocal 对象——假设 100 万虚拟线程，每个 ThreadLocal 持有 10KB 数据，内存占用高达：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">1,000,000 × 10KB = ~10GB</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>而虚拟线程的栈仅几百字节，这意味着 <strong>ThreadLocal 数据量可能超过虚拟线程栈本身 100 倍</strong>。更关键的是：虚拟线程使用 <code>ForkJoinPool</code> 的 Carrier 线程来执行，而 Carrier 线程是有限的（通常 = CPU 核数）。虚拟线程之间复用 Carrier 线程时，ThreadLocal 的关联关系是”虚拟线程 → ThreadLocalMap”而非”Carrier 线程 → ThreadLocalMap”——这意味着每个虚拟线程的 ThreadLocal 数据随着虚拟线程的挂载/卸载在 Carrier 之间”漂移”，数据一致性问题 + 内存泄漏风险叠加。</p> <p><strong>最佳实践</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>方案</th> <th>适用场景</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>ScopedValue</code>（JDK 21, JEP 429）</td> <td>新的线程上下文传递</td> <td>不可变、不泄露、与虚拟线程完美配合</td> </tr> <tr> <td>ThreadLocal + try-finally</td> <td>必须使用 ThreadLocal 的遗留代码</td> <td>严格 remove，无例外</td> </tr> <tr> <td>减少 ThreadLocal 数据量</td> <td>优化任意场景</td> <td>只存 ID/key，不存完整上下文对象</td> </tr> </tbody></table> </li> <li><p><strong>面试金句（升级版）</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“虚拟线程不是银弹。我亲眼见过 API 网关切到虚拟线程后 TPS 反而下降——查了一天发现是 synchronized 钉住了 Carrier。<code>ReentrantLock</code> 和虚拟线程是天生一对。ThreadLocal 在百万级虚拟线程下是内存炸弹——一个虚拟线程 10KB ThreadLocal 数据 × 100 万 = 10GB。JDK 21 的 <code>ScopedValue</code> 才是虚拟线程的上下文传递方案，ThreadLocal 应该逐步淘汰。Spring Boot 3.2+ 一行配置就能启用虚拟线程，但前提是你过了兼容性审计。”</p> </blockquote> </li> </ul> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：synchronized 钉住（Pinning）在 JDK 21 中仍未彻底解决——当虚拟线程在 synchronized 块中执行阻塞 IO 时，整个 carrier 线程被钉住，可能阻塞其他虚拟线程。<code>ReentrantLock</code> 在 JDK 21 中已优化为支持虚拟线程 yield。另外，<code>Thread.sleep()</code> 在虚拟线程中不会钉住 carrier，而 <code>Object.wait()</code> 仍然会。</li> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：虚拟线程的挂载/卸载由 <code>VirtualThread</code> 的 <code>yield</code> 和 <code>run</code> 方法控制，核心是 <code>java.lang.VirtualThread</code> 内部的状态机（NEW→STARTED→RUNNING→YIELDING→RUNNING→TERMINATED）。<code>Unsafe</code> 的 <code>park</code>/<code>unpark</code> 对操作系统级线程和虚拟线程有完全不同的实现路径。</li> <li><strong>对比延伸</strong>：虚拟线程和 Go 的 Goroutine 思路相似，但 Go 是语言级自带调度器，Java 是在 JDK 库层面实现的，更灵活但需要应用适配。相比 Scala 的 <code>Future</code> 和 Kotlin 的协程（基于 CPS 变换），虚拟线程是”无侵入式”的——不需要修改源代码的异步模型。</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：Kafka 消费者场景中，每条消息一个虚拟线程是可行的（数百万条也无压力），但要小心每条消息处理时可能创建新的数据库连接——连接池大小也需要同步扩大。Flink 用户自定义函数中使用虚拟线程时，需注意 Flink 的 Checkpoint 屏障与虚拟线程的交互（阻塞时是否会影响 Checkpoint 对齐）。</li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“虚拟线程将 Java 的并发模型从’以线程为中心’转向’以任务为中心’——开发者写同步阻塞代码就能获得异步框架的性能。大数据场景中，Kafka 消费者、HTTP/RPC 调用、数据库写入等 IO 密集环节是最大受益者。但需要警惕：synchronized 钉住和 ThreadLocal 滥用是虚拟线程最容易踩的两个坑。Flink 社区已开始探索在虚拟线程上运行用户自定义函数，以简化 AsyncIO 编程模型。”</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x0C-Java-17-21-新特性实战"><a href="#0x0C-Java-17-21-新特性实战" class="headerlink" title="0x0C Java 17/21 新特性实战"></a>0x0C Java 17/21 新特性实战</h2><h3 id="16-Java-17-21-Record、Pattern-Matching-与-Sealed-Class-在大数据开发中的实战应用"><a href="#16-Java-17-21-Record、Pattern-Matching-与-Sealed-Class-在大数据开发中的实战应用" class="headerlink" title="16. Java 17/21 Record、Pattern Matching 与 Sealed Class 在大数据开发中的实战应用"></a>16. 和流处理开发中如何具体应用？相比传统的 Lombok + 手写 if-else 方案有什么优势？</p> <p><strong>解析</strong>：</p> <p><strong>Java 新特性概述</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>特性</th> <th>引入版本</th> <th>核心概念</th> <th>大数据场景价值</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>Record</strong></td> <td>Java 14 Preview → 16 GA</td> <td>透明数据载体，自动生成构造器/equals/hashCode/toString</td> <td>替代 POJO/Lombok，零样板代码定义事件对象</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Pattern Matching for instanceof</strong></td> <td>Java 16</td> <td>类型检查 + 自动转型合一</td> <td>简化异构数据流的分支处理逻辑</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Pattern Matching for Switch</strong></td> <td>Java 17 Preview → 21 GA</td> <td>Switch 作为表达式 + 模式匹配 + Null 安全</td> <td>替代 if-else 链，类型安全的枚举/密封类分发</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Sealed Class</strong></td> <td>Java 15 Preview → 17 GA</td> <td>限制类的继承层次，编译期确定所有子类型</td> <td>定义封闭事件类型（如订单状态机），Pattern Matching 配合无遗漏检查</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Sequenced Collection</strong></td> <td>Java 21</td>
