<tbody><tr> <td>数据载体定义</td> <td>@Data 注解 + 16 行样板</td> <td>Record 1 行声明</td> </tr> <tr> <td>异构事件分发</td> <td>if-else instanceof + 强制转型</td> <td>Switch Pattern Matching + 解构</td> </tr> <tr> <td>类型安全</td> <td>运行时才能发现遗漏分支</td> <td>编译器保证 Sealed class 穷尽匹配</td> </tr> <tr> <td>不可变性</td> <td>需手动 final + 防御性拷贝</td> <td>Record 天然不可变</td> </tr> <tr> <td>集合操作</td> <td>List.get(0)、Deque.peekFirst()</td> <td>SequencedCollection.getFirst()</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：Pattern Matching Switch 中如果 Sealed class 在后续版本增加了新子类，所有 switch 表达式会编译失败（Exhaustiveness check），强迫开发者处理新类型——这是特性而非缺陷。Record 无法继承其他类（extends 已被隐式继承的 java.lang.Record 占用），在需要基类行为复用时不适用，应使用抽象类替代。</li> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：Record 的编译器糖由 <code>javac</code> 在解析阶段生成：编译器自动为 Record 生成 <code>canEqual()</code> 方法（确保 equals 的对称性），以及 <code>writeReplace()</code> 方法支持序列化。Pattern Matching Switch 的编译产物在 JDK 21 中改用了 <code>invokedynamic</code> + <code>TypeSwitch</code> 匿名类，比 JDK 17 的 <code>tableswitch</code>/<code>lookupswitch</code> 更高效。</li> <li><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Java 17/21 的代数数据类型（ADT）与 Haskell 的 data type、Scala 的 case class + sealed trait、Kotlin 的 sealed class 本质相同。但 Java 的 Record + Pattern Matching 更加”浅显”——没有 Monad 等复杂概念，对团队入门友好。</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：升级到 JDK 21 后，Flink/Spark 中定义事件类型应优先使用 Record 替代 <code>@Data</code>。但需注意：Flink 的 Kryo 序列化对 Record 支持不完美（Record 的序列化走 Java 原生序列化），建议在 Flink <code>ExecutionConfig</code> 中启用 Flink 自带的 PojoSerializer 或者使用 Avro。Spark 3.5+ 的 Dataset 对 Record 的 Encoder 支持良好。</li> </ul> <p><strong>生产实战</strong>（补充）：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>Record 序列化在 Flink/Spark 中的兼容问题</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>框架</th> <th>版本</th> <th>Record 兼容性</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>Flink Kryo</td> <td>1.14-</td> <td>❌ 不兼容</td> <td>Kryo 5.0+ 才支持 Record，Flink 1.17 前内嵌 Kryo 4.x</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Flink PojoSerializer</td> <td>1.17+</td> <td>✅ 兼容（需配置）</td> <td><code>env.getConfig().enableForceAvro()</code> 或使用 Flink POJO 规则</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Flink Avro</td> <td>所有版本</td> <td>✅ 推荐</td> <td><code>GenericRecord</code> 或 Avro 生成的特定类</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Spark Dataset</td> <td>3.4-</td> <td>⚠️ 有限</td> <td>Reflection-based Encoder 对 Record 支持不完善</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Spark Dataset</td> <td>3.5+</td> <td>✅ 原生支持</td> <td>Spark 3.5 添加了对 Record 的原生 Encoder 支持</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Spark RDD</td> <td>所有版本</td> <td>✅ Kryo 5+</td> <td>需要单独注册并配置 Kryo 5 序列化器</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>踩坑案例</strong>：某实时数仓团队（Flink 1.15，Kryo 序列化）将事件 POJO 从 <code>@Data</code> 迁移到 <code>Record</code> 后，任务启动抛出 <code>KryoException: Class cannot be created (missing no-arg constructor)</code>。排查发现：Flink 1.15 内嵌的 Kryo 是 4.x 版本，不支持 Record 序列化（Record 没有无参构造器且继承了 <code>java.lang.Record</code>）。修复方案：</p> <ol> <li>升级 Flink 到 1.17+ 并启用 Flink PojoSerializer</li> <li>或降级方案：Record 仅用于内存计算，Flink 数据传输层仍使用 Avro 定义的 POJO</li> <li>或临时 patch：自定义 Kryo 序列化器注册 Record 类型</li> </ol> </li> <li><p><strong>团队从 Java 8 升级到 21 的迁移经验</strong>：<br>一次真实的大规模 Java 升级（200+ 微服务，3 个月完成）经验总结：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>阶段</th> <th>耗时</th> <th>主要工作</th> <th>踩坑</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>评估 & 兼容性审计</strong></td> <td>2 周</td> <td>扫描所有依赖库对 JDK 17+ 的兼容性</td> <td><code>javax.xml.bind</code>（JAXB）在 JDK 11 已移除，需加 Maven 依赖</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>JDK 11 过渡</strong></td> <td>4 周</td> <td>先升级到 11（LTS，过渡版本）</td> <td>模块化系统导致 jar 包冲突（<code>--add-opens</code> JVM 参数）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>JDK 17 升级</strong></td> <td>3 周</td> <td>启用 Record、Sealed Class、Switch 表达式</td> <td><code>--illegal-access=deny</code> 导致反射大量报错，需逐项加 <code>--add-opens</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>JDK 21 及新特性落地</strong></td> <td>3 周</td> <td>虚拟线程试点 + Record 重写 POJO + Pattern Matching 改造</td> <td>虚拟线程钉住问题、Record 序列化兼容</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>核心迁移清单</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># JDK 8 → 21 必须检查的 JVM 参数</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. --add-opens（模块化反射兼容）</span></span><br><span class="line">--add-opens java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED</span><br><span class="line">--add-opens java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. GC 参数变更（JDK 9+ 废弃参数）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># -XX:+UseBiasedLocking # JDK 15+ 已移除</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># -XX:+PrintGCDetails # JDK 9+ 改为 -Xlog:gc*</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. 编译参数</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 先用 --release 17 编译，确保代码兼容</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 再用 --release 21 编译，启用新特性</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>迁移红牌禁令</strong>（团队升级中踩过的坑）：</p> <ul> <li>❌ 不要一次性升级所有服务——分批灰度，先升级无状态边缘服务</li> <li>❌ 不要在 JDK 21 上直接使用 JDK 8 编译的 jar——可能触发 <code>UnsupportedClassVersionError</code>，所有依赖需重新编译</li> <li>❌ 不要忽略 <code>-Xlint:all</code> 编译警告——JDK 9+ 的模块化系统对跨模块反射非常敏感</li> <li>✅ 先升级到 JDK 11 过渡（最小变动），验证兼容性后再升 17/21</li> <li>✅ 使用 <code>sdkman</code> 管理多版本 JDK，开发环境 <code>~/.sdkman/rc.local</code> 中配置切换脚本</li> </ul> </li> <li><p><strong>面试金句（升级版）</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“团队从 Java 8 升到 21 的 3 个月里，最大的教训是’不要跳过 JDK 11 过渡’——反射兼容性问题在 JDK 17 才真正爆发。Record 把 16 行的 @Data POJO 压缩成 1 行，但序列化兼容性是个暗坑——Flink 1.15 内嵌的 Kryo 4.x 完全不支持 Record。我们的策略是：Flink 数据传输层继续用 Avro，内存计算层用 Record。虚拟线程只在新服务试点，不改遗留系统。升级 Java 21 不是跑分竞赛，是兼容性工程的马拉松。”</p> </blockquote> </li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“Java 17/21 的 Record + Sealed Class + Pattern Matching Switch 三者组合，在大数据开发中形成了优雅的代数数据类型（ADT）编程范式。Record 替代 Lombok 成为事件 POJO 的最佳选择——天然不可变、线程安全、零样板。Sealed Class + Pattern Matching 让异构事件分发从 if-else 的泥潭中解脱出来，编译期保证类型安全。如果面试官问’Java 21 对大数据开发有什么实际价值’，这就是标准答案——不是性能提升，而是代码安全性和表达力的质变。”</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x0D-Java-基础进阶"><a href="#0x0D-Java-基础进阶" class="headerlink" title="0x0D Java 基础进阶"></a>0x0D Java 基础进阶</h2><h3 id="17-反射的原理是什么？如何提升反射性能？"><a href="#17-反射的原理是什么？如何提升反射性能？" class="headerlink" title="17. 反射的原理是什么？如何提升反射性能？"></a>17. 反射的原理是什么？如何提升反射性能？</h3><p>反射是 Java 语言的重要特性，它允许程序在运行时获取任意类的内部信息并操作其属性和方法。</p> <p><strong>核心原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>反射 API 的核心是 <code>Class</code> 对象，JVM 在类加载阶段为每个类在堆中生成对应的 <code>Class</code> 对象</li> <li>通过 <code>Class.forName()</code>、<code>类名.class</code>、<code>对象.getClass()</code> 三种方式获取 Class 对象</li> <li>获取 Class 对象后，通过 <code>Field</code>、<code>Method</code>、<code>Constructor</code> 等反射类访问类的所有成员（包括私有成员）</li> </ul> <p><strong>提升反射性能的方案</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><code>setAccessible(true)</code> 关闭 Java 安全检查</li> <li>缓存 Method/Field 对象，避免重复获取</li> <li>使用 ReflectASM、MethodHandle 等字节码生成方式</li> <li>对于高频调用场景，优先使用接口或抽象类替代反射</li> </ol> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：JDK 9+ 模块化系统对反射有严格限制，跨模块反射默认被禁止，需要 <code>--add-opens</code> JVM 参数放行。<code>setAccessible(true)</code> 在模块化系统下可能抛出 <code>InaccessibleObjectException</code>。</li> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：<code>Class.forName()</code> 默认执行类的静态初始化块，而 <code>ClassLoader.loadClass()</code> 不会触发初始化，两者有本质区别。</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：Spring 框架大量使用反射实现 IoC/DI，但 Spring 会缓存反射元数据（<code>ReflectionUtils</code>），避免重复反射的性能开销。Jackson 序列化库优先使用 Getter/Setter 方法反射，只有在无法获取时才使用字段反射。</li> </ul> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="18-Java-序列化与-serialVersionUID-的作用？"><a href="#18-Java-序列化与-serialVersionUID-的作用？" class="headerlink" title="18. Java 序列化与 serialVersionUID 的作用？"></a>18. Java 序列化与 serialVersionUID 的作用？</h3><p><strong>序列化与反序列化</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>序列化将 Java 对象转换为字节流，便于网络传输或持久化</li> <li>反序列化将字节流恢复为 Java 对象</li> <li>实现 <code>Serializable</code> 接口即可开启序列化能力</li> </ul> <p><strong>serialVersionUID 的作用</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>用于标识类的版本兼容性</li> <li>反序列化时 JVM 比较字节流中的 serialVersionUID 与当前类的 serialVersionUID，不一致则抛出 <code>InvalidClassException</code></li> <li>若未显式声明，JVM 会根据类结构自动生成一个 UID，任意字段变更都会导致 UID 变化</li> </ul> <p><strong>最佳实践</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>所有 <code>Serializable</code> 类必须显式声明 <code>serialVersionUID</code></li> <li>使用 <code>private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;</code> 固定版本号</li> <li>仅在无法兼容旧版本时修改 serialVersionUID</li> <li><code>transient</code> 关键字修饰的字段不会被序列化</li> </ul> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="19-Java-的五种-IO-模型是什么？"><a href="#19-Java-的五种-IO-模型是什么？" class="headerlink" title="19. Java 的五种 IO 模型是什么？"></a>19. Java 的五种 IO 模型是什么？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>IO 模型</th> <th>描述</th> <th>特点</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>同步阻塞 IO (BIO)</strong></td> <td>数据未就绪时线程阻塞等待</td> <td>简单但线程利用率低，每个连接一个线程</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>同步非阻塞 IO (NIO)</strong></td> <td>数据未就绪时立即返回，应用线程轮询</td> <td>避免线程阻塞，但轮询消耗 CPU</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>IO 多路复用</strong></td> <td>select/epoll 监听多个 fd，就绪时通知</td> <td>一个线程管理大量连接，Netty 核心模型</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>信号驱动 IO</strong></td> <td>数据就绪时发 SIGIO 信号通知</td> <td>非阻塞，但信号处理复杂</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>异步 IO (AIO)</strong></td> <td>发起调用后立即返回，内核完成数据拷贝后回调</td> <td>真正的异步，JDK 7 引入，但实际应用较少</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Netty 基于 NIO（多路复用）而非 AIO，因为 Linux 的 AIO 实现不够成熟，epoll 配合 Reactor 模式已在生产中得到充分验证。Windows 的 IOCP 是真正的异步 IO。</li> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：Java NIO 的 <code>Selector</code> 存在空轮询 Bug（JDK 中著名的 epoll bug），Netty 通过自旋计数器 + rebuilt Selector 的方式规避。</li> </ul> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <hr> <h2 id="0x0E-JUC-并发深入"><a href="#0x0E-JUC-并发深入" class="headerlink" title="0x0E JUC 并发深入"></a>0x0E JUC 并发深入</h2><h3 id="20-CAS-的原理是什么？有哪些风险？"><a href="#20-CAS-的原理是什么？有哪些风险？" class="headerlink" title="20. CAS 的原理是什么？有哪些风险？"></a>20. CAS 的原理是什么？有哪些风险？</h3><p>CAS（Compare And Swap）是一种无锁原子操作，通过 CPU 指令直接实现：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// CAS 核心：内存地址、期望值、新值</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 仅当内存地址 V 的值等于期望值 A 时，才更新为 B</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">boolean</span> <span class="title function_">compareAndSwap</span><span class="params">(V, A, B)</span>;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>三大风险及解决方案</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><strong>ABA 问题</strong>：值 A → B → A，CAS 误判为未变更。解决：<code>AtomicStampedReference</code> 加入版本号</li> <li><strong>循环开销大</strong>：自旋 CAS 长时间不成功消耗 CPU。解决：自适应自旋（JVM 根据历史调整自旋次数）或适时让出 CPU</li> <li><strong>只能保证一个变量的原子操作</strong>。解决：使用 <code>AtomicReference</code> 封装多个变量</li> </ol> <p><strong>CAS 在 JVM 中的实现</strong>：<code>Unsafe.compareAndSwapInt()</code> 等 native 方法底层调用 CPU 的 CMPXCHG 指令（x86 架构），该指令由硬件保证原子性。</p> <p><strong>AtomicInteger 原理</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// AtomicInteger.getAndIncrement() 核心实现</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="title function_">getAndIncrement</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> unsafe.getAndAddInt(<span class="built_in">this</span>, valueOffset, <span class="number">1</span>);</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Unsafe 内部通过 CAS 循环实现</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="title function_">getAndAddInt</span><span class="params">(Object o, <span class="type">long</span> offset, <span class="type">int</span> delta)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">int</span> v;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">do</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> v = getIntVolatile(o, offset); <span class="comment">// 获取当前值</span></span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">while</span> (!compareAndSwapInt(o, offset, v, v + delta)); <span class="comment">// CAS 更新</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> v;</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="21-ReadWriteLock-读写锁的原理是什么？"><a href="#21-ReadWriteLock-读写锁的原理是什么？" class="headerlink" title="21. ReadWriteLock 读写锁的原理是什么？"></a>21. ReadWriteLock 读写锁的原理是什么？</h3><p><code>ReentrantReadWriteLock</code> 实现读写分离，内部维护两个锁：</p> <ul> <li><strong>读锁（共享锁）</strong>：多个线程可以同时持有</li> <li><strong>写锁（独占锁）</strong>：只有一个线程可以持有</li> </ul> <p><strong>锁互斥规则</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>当前持有</th> <th>请求读锁</th> <th>请求写锁</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>读锁</td> <td>✅ 允许</td> <td>❌ 阻塞</td> </tr> <tr> <td>写锁</td> <td>❌ 阻塞</td> <td>❌ 阻塞</td> </tr> <tr> <td>无锁</td> <td>✅ 允许</td> <td>✅ 允许</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>实现要点</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>读锁和写锁共享同一个 AQS 的 <code>state</code> 状态位，高 16 位记录读锁数量，低 16 位记录写锁重入次数</li> <li>写锁获取时需等待所有读锁释放（防止脏读）</li> <li><strong>锁降级</strong>：写锁可以降级为读锁（先获取写锁，再获取读锁，再释放写锁），保证数据可见性</li> </ul> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="22-死锁的四个条件及排查方法？"><a href="#22-死锁的四个条件及排查方法？" class="headerlink" title="22. 死锁的四个条件及排查方法？"></a>22. 死锁的四个条件及排查方法？</h3><p><strong>四个必要条件</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><strong>互斥</strong>：资源一次只被一个线程占用</li> <li><strong>请求与保持</strong>：线程持有资源的同时请求其他资源</li> <li><strong>不可剥夺</strong>：资源只能由持有者主动释放</li> <li><strong>环路等待</strong>：线程间形成循环等待链</li> </ol> <p><strong>排查方法</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. 找到 Java 进程</span></span><br><span class="line">jps -l</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. 查看线程堆栈，死锁信息会明确输出</span></span><br><span class="line">jstack -l <pid></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 输出中搜索 "Found one Java-level deadlock"</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>预防策略</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>按固定顺序获取锁（资源排序法）</li> <li>使用 <code>tryLock(timeout)</code> 超时自动回退</li> <li>使用 <code>Lock</code> 接口替代 <code>synchronized</code>（更灵活的锁控制）</li> </ul> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="23-线程池-execute-和-submit-的区别？工作队列如何选型？"><a href="#23-线程池-execute-和-submit-的区别？工作队列如何选型？" class="headerlink" title="23. 线程池 execute() 和 submit() 的区别？工作队列如何选型？"></a>23. 线程池 <code>execute()</code> 和 <code>submit()</code> 的区别？工作队列如何选型？</h3><p><strong>execute vs submit</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>execute()</th> <th>submit()</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>返回值</td> <td>void</td> <td>Future<T></td> </tr> <tr> <td>异常处理</td> <td>线程内部吞噬</td> <td>get() 时抛出 ExecutionException</td> </tr> <tr> <td>适用场景</td> <td>不需要返回值的任务</td> <td>需要获取结果或处理异常</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>工作队列选型</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>队列</th> <th>特性</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>ArrayBlockingQueue</code></td> <td>有界、FIFO</td> <td>生产环境首选，防止 OOM</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>LinkedBlockingQueue</code></td> <td>可选有界/无界</td> <td>吞吐量高，默认无界（慎用）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>SynchronousQueue</code></td> <td>不存储元素</td> <td>直接提交给线程，CachedThreadPool 使用</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>PriorityBlockingQueue</code></td> <td>按优先级出队</td> <td>有优先级的任务处理</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>DelayQueue</code></td> <td>延迟执行</td> <td>定时任务调度</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <hr> <h2 id="0x0F-JVM-进阶"><a href="#0x0F-JVM-进阶" class="headerlink" title="0x0F JVM 进阶"></a>0x0F JVM 进阶</h2><h3 id="24-类加载机制与双亲委派模型？"><a href="#24-类加载机制与双亲委派模型？" class="headerlink" title="24. 类加载机制与双亲委派模型？"></a>24. 类加载机制与双亲委派模型？</h3><p><strong>类加载过程</strong>：加载 → 验证 → 准备 → 解析 → 初始化</p> <ul> <li><strong>加载</strong>：通过类的全限定名获取二进制字节流，将静态存储结构转为方法区的运行时数据结构，在堆中生成 Class 对象</li> <li><strong>验证</strong>：确保字节流符合 JVM 规范，不危害 JVM 安全</li> <li><strong>准备</strong>：为静态变量分配内存并设置零值</li> <li><strong>解析</strong>：将符号引用转为直接引用</li> <li><strong>初始化</strong>：执行类构造器 <code><clinit>()</code> 方法</li> </ul> <p><strong>双亲委派模型</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">应用类加载器 → 扩展类加载器 → 启动类加载器</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>每个类加载器收到类加载请求时，优先委托给父加载器，父加载器无法加载时再由子加载器尝试。</p> <p><strong>为什么需要双亲委派？</strong></p> <ul> <li>保证 Java 核心类库的安全——<code>java.lang.Object</code> 永远由启动类加载器加载，不会出现多个版本</li> <li>JVM 中类的唯一性由加载它的类加载器决定，双亲委派确保核心类全局唯一</li> </ul> <p><strong>打破双亲委派</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>继承 <code>ClassLoader</code>，重写 <code>loadClass()</code> 方法</li> <li>典型场景：Tomcat 为每个 Web 应用使用独立类加载器，实现应用隔离</li> <li>SPI 机制（ServiceLoader）使用线程上下文类加载器，打破了双亲委派</li> </ul> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="25-对象的栈上分配与逃逸分析？"><a href="#25-对象的栈上分配与逃逸分析？" class="headerlink" title="25. 对象的栈上分配与逃逸分析？"></a>25. 对象的栈上分配与逃逸分析？</h3><p><strong>栈上分配</strong>：对于生命周期仅在线程内部的对象，在栈帧中分配内存，随方法返回自动销毁，无需 GC 介入。</p> <p><strong>逃逸分析</strong>：JVM 判断对象是否会被外部访问的优化技术：</p> <ul> <li>方法逃逸：对象被传递给其他方法</li> <li>线程逃逸：对象被其他线程访问</li> <li>未逃逸：对象仅在方法内部使用</li> </ul> <p><strong>逃逸分析带来的优化</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><strong>栈上分配</strong>：未逃逸对象分配在栈上，减少 GC 压力</li> <li><strong>标量替换</strong>：将对象拆解为多个基本类型变量，直接在栈上分配</li> <li><strong>锁消除</strong>：未逃逸对象的锁被消除，避免获取无用锁</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 示例：逃逸分析后，point 对象可能在栈上分配</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="title function_">sum</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">Point</span> <span class="variable">point</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Point</span>(<span class="number">1</span>, <span class="number">2</span>); <span class="comment">// 未逃逸</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> point.x + point.y;</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="26-对象的内存布局？"><a href="#26-对象的内存布局？" class="headerlink" title="26. 对象的内存布局？"></a>26. 对象的内存布局？</h3><figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">┌──────────────────────┐</span><br><span class="line">│ Mark Word │ 8B (64位)</span><br><span class="line">├──────────────────────┤</span><br><span class="line">│ Class Pointer │ 8B (64位未压缩) / 4B (压缩)</span><br><span class="line">├──────────────────────┤</span><br><span class="line">│ Instance Data │ 各字段按类型对齐</span><br><span class="line">├──────────────────────┤</span><br><span class="line">│ Padding │ 对齐到 8B 倍数</span><br><span class="line">└──────────────────────┘</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>Mark Word</strong>（64位 JVM）：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>状态</th> <th>内容</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>无锁</td> <td>分代年龄 + 偏向锁标记 + 锁标记位 + hashCode</td> </tr> <tr> <td>偏向锁</td> <td>线程ID + 时间戳 + 分代年龄 + 偏向锁标记</td> </tr> <tr> <td>轻量级锁</td> <td>指向 Lock Record 的指针</td> </tr> <tr> <td>重量级锁</td> <td>指向 Monitor 的指针</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>Class Pointer</strong>：指向方法区中该类的元数据<br><strong>Instance Data</strong>：实际成员变量值（不包括静态变量）<br><strong>Padding</strong>：HotSpot 要求对象起始地址为 8 字节倍数，填充不足部分</p> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="27-安全点、安全区域与-OopMap-的作用？"><a href="#27-安全点、安全区域与-OopMap-的作用？" class="headerlink" title="27. 安全点、安全区域与 OopMap 的作用？"></a>27. 安全点、安全区域与 OopMap 的作用？</h3><p><strong>OopMap</strong>：记录栈帧中哪些位置保存了对象引用，用于 GC Roots 枚举。JVM 在安全点位置更新 OopMap，避免全栈扫描，帮助 HotSpot 实现准确式 GC。</p> <p><strong>安全点（Safepoint）</strong>：程序执行中的特殊位置（方法调用、循环跳转、异常抛出处），GC 时线程必须到达安全点才能暂停。HotSpot 采用<strong>主动式中断</strong>：设置标志位，线程轮询检查。</p> <p><strong>安全区域（Safe Region）</strong>：解决 SLEEP/BLOCKED 状态的线程无法主动到达安全点的问题。线程进入安全区域时标记自身状态，GC 时忽略该线程，从安全区域恢复执行时检查 GC 是否完成。</p> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：偏向锁撤销需要到达安全点，这是高并发场景下关闭偏向锁的原因之一。<code>-XX:+PrintSafePointStatistics</code> 可以输出安全点统计，辅助排查 STW 异常问题。</li> </ul> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="28-JVM-调优常用命令？"><a href="#28-JVM-调优常用命令？" class="headerlink" title="28. JVM 调优常用命令？"></a>28. JVM 调优常用命令？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>命令</th> <th>作用</th> <th>常用示例</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>jps</code></td> <td>查看 Java 进程</td> <td><code>jps -l</code> 显示完整主类名</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>jstat</code></td> <td>监控 GC/类加载/JIT</td> <td><code>jstat -gcutil <pid> 1000</code> 每秒输出 GC 各区域使用率</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>jmap</code></td> <td>堆 dump 与内存信息</td> <td><code>jmap -dump:format=b,file=heap.hprof <pid></code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>jstack</code></td> <td>线程堆栈（含死锁检测）</td> <td><code>jstack -l <pid></code> 查看死锁</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>jcmd</code></td> <td>多功能诊断（推荐替代 jmap）</td> <td><code>jcmd <pid> VM.flags</code> 查看 JVM 参数</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>jinfo</code></td> <td>运行时查看/修改 JVM 参数</td> <td><code>jinfo -flag PrintGCDetails <pid></code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>jhat</code></td> <td>分析 heap dump（慎用）</td> <td>一般不直接在服务器上运行，消耗资源大</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/aalansehaiyang/technology-talk">technology-talk</a> — Tom哥，Apache-2.0</p> </blockquote> <hr> <h2 id="0x10-JDK-17-21-新特性实战"><a href="#0x10-JDK-17-21-新特性实战" class="headerlink" title="0x10 JDK 17/21 新特性实战"></a>0x10 JDK 17/21 新特性实战</h2><h3 id="29-虚拟线程（Virtual-Threads）底层原理与生产适配"><a href="#29-虚拟线程（Virtual-Threads）底层原理与生产适配" class="headerlink" title="29. 虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）底层原理与生产适配"></a>29. 虚拟线程（Virtual Threads）底层原理与生产适配</h3><p><strong>核心机制</strong>：M:N 调度模型</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// JDK 21 创建虚拟线程</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">Thread</span> <span class="variable">vThread</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Thread.ofVirtual()</span><br><span class="line"> .name(<span class="string">"handler-"</span>)</span><br><span class="line"> .start(() -> {</span><br><span class="line"> System.out.println(<span class="string">"Hello from virtual thread: "</span> + Thread.currentThread());</span><br><span class="line"> });</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 或使用 Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> (<span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">executor</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()) {</span><br><span class="line"> executor.submit(() -> processTask());</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>调度原理</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Carrier 线程（平台线程）作为物理载体，默认数量 = CPU 核数</li> <li>虚拟线程是 java.lang.Thread 的子类，但栈存储在堆上而非 OS 栈</li> <li>阻塞操作（<code>Socket.read()</code>、<code>LockSupport.park()</code>）自动 unmount，释放 carrier 线程</li> <li>任务就绪时 re-mount 到任意空闲 carrier</li> </ul> <p><strong>🔥 生产踩坑：pinned 线程导致 carrier 耗尽（某 API 网关服务）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：JDK 21 + Spring Boot 3.2，网关路由 200+ 服务</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：高峰期 P99 延迟从 50ms 飙升到 2s，虚拟线程活跃数正常但 carrier 线程全部忙</li> <li><strong>排查</strong>：<figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">jcmd <pid> Thread.dump_to_file -format=json /tmp/dump.json</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 输出中搜索 "pinned" 或 "mount"</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> 发现大量 <code>synchronized</code> 块内包含网络 IO</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<code>synchronized</code> 和 <code>native</code> 方法会 pinned 虚拟线程到 carrier<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 这段代码会导致 carrier 被占用 3 秒</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">synchronized</span> CompletableFuture<String> <span class="title function_">callService</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> restTemplate.getForObject(url, String.class); <span class="comment">// 3s 网络调用</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：<code>synchronized</code> → <code>ReentrantLock</code>，确保虚拟线程在阻塞时能 unmount<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">Lock</span> <span class="variable">lock</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ReentrantLock</span>();</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> CompletableFuture<String> <span class="title function_">callService</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> lock.lock();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> restTemplate.getForObject(url, String.class);</span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> lock.unlock();</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ReentrantLock 不会 pinned，虚拟线程在 getForObject 时自动 unmount</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>修复效果</strong>：P99 延迟回归到 50ms，carrier 线程利用率正常</li> </ul> <p><strong>pinned 场景检测命令</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># JDK 21+ 自带 pinned 检测</span></span><br><span class="line">-Djdk.tracePinnedThreads=short <span class="comment"># 打印 pinned 时的堆栈（推荐生产用）</span></span><br><span class="line">-Djdk.tracePinnedThreads=full <span class="comment"># 打印完整堆栈（调试用，性能开销大）</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>调优参数</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>参数</th> <th>默认值</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>jdk.virtualThreadScheduler.parallelism</code></td> <td>CPU 核数</td> <td>Carrier 线程池大小</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>jdk.virtualThreadScheduler.maxPoolSize</code></td> <td>CPU 核数</td> <td>Carrier 最大线程数</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>jdk.tracePinnedThreads</code></td> <td>(none)</td> <td>建议设为 <code>short</code></td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“虚拟线程的 M:N 调度让百万级并发成为可能，但 synchronized pinned 问题是最大的陷阱。我在 API 网关中遇到过 carrier 线程全部被 pinned 导致延迟飙到 2s——修复方法很简单：把所有 synchronized 替换为 ReentrantLock，并在生产设置 <code>-Djdk.tracePinnedThreads=short</code> 监控 pinned 比例。”</p> </blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/444">JEP 444 Virtual Threads</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/425">JEP 425 Virtual Threads Preview</a></p> <h3 id="30-ScopedValue-—-ThreadLocal-的替代者"><a href="#30-ScopedValue-—-ThreadLocal-的替代者" class="headerlink" title="30. ScopedValue — ThreadLocal 的替代者"></a>30. ScopedValue — ThreadLocal 的替代者</h3><p><strong>背景</strong>：JDK 20 孵化的 <code>ScopedValue</code>（JEP 429），JDK 21 第二次预览（JEP 446），目标替代虚拟线程场景下的 ThreadLocal。</p> <p><strong>ThreadLocal 的三大问题</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><strong>可变性</strong>：任何代码都能修改，破坏封装</li> <li><strong>内存泄漏</strong>：虚拟线程池中线程不回收，ThreadLocal 值长期存活</li> <li><strong>继承问题</strong>：<code>InheritableThreadLocal</code> 只在创建时复制，虚拟线程场景失效</li> </ol> <p><strong>ScopedValue 解决方案</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 声明一个 ScopedValue（类似 ThreadLocal，但不可变）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> ScopedValue<String> REQUEST_ID = ScopedValue.newInstance();</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 绑定值并在作用域内读取</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">handle</span><span class="params">(HttpRequest request)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> ScopedValue.where(REQUEST_ID, request.getHeader(<span class="string">"X-Request-Id"</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .run(() -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 在这个 lambda 作用域内，REQUEST_ID.get() 可读取</span></span><br><span class="line"> process();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 注意：不能修改 REQUEST_ID 的值！</span></span><br><span class="line"> });</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 离开作用域后，REQUEST_ID 自动恢复为未绑定状态</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">process</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">String</span> <span class="variable">id</span> <span class="operator">=</span> REQUEST_ID.get(); <span class="comment">// 读取绑定值</span></span><br><span class="line"> log.info(<span class="string">"Processing request: {}"</span>, id);</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>核心特性对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>ThreadLocal</th> <th>ScopedValue</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>可变性</td> <td>可读写</td> <td>只读（绑定后不可改）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>生命周期</td> <td>线程整个生命周期</td> <td>限定在 <code>run()</code> 调用内</td> </tr> <tr> <td>继承</td> <td>需 <code>Inheritable</code></td> <td>自动传播到子协程/子线程</td> </tr> <tr> <td>内存泄漏风险</td> <td>高（忘记 remove）</td> <td>无（离开作用域自动释放）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>虚拟线程兼容</td> <td>差（pinned + 泄漏）</td> <td>完全兼容</td> </tr> <tr> <td>性能</td> <td>每次读写有哈希查找</td> <td>常数级（绑定在调用栈帧上）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>生产踩坑：ThreadLocal 在虚拟线程中的泄漏（某支付平台）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：JDK 21 虚拟线程，使用 <code>ThreadLocal</code> 存储 MDC 追踪 ID</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：运行 24 小时后，日志追踪 ID 混乱（一个请求打印另一个请求的 ID）</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：虚拟线程被回收后 ThreadLocal 值未清理，复用 carrier 线程时旧的 MDC 值被新请求读取</li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方案一：使用 ScopedValue</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> ScopedValue<String> MDC_ID = ScopedValue.newInstance();</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">handleRequest</span><span class="params">(HttpRequest req)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> ScopedValue.where(MDC_ID, req.getHeader(<span class="string">"trace-id"</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .run(() -> {</span><br><span class="line"> MDC.put(<span class="string">"trace-id"</span>, MDC_ID.get());</span><br><span class="line"> processRequest();</span><br><span class="line"> MDC.clear();</span><br><span class="line"> });</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方案二：如果必须用 ThreadLocal，在 finally 清理</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> MDC.put(<span class="string">"trace-id"</span>, requestId);</span><br><span class="line"> processRequest();</span><br><span class="line">} <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> MDC.clear(); <span class="comment">// 必须！</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“ScopedValue 是 JDK 为虚拟线程量身定制的 ThreadLocal 替代品。它的不可变性和作用域绑定从设计上杜绝了内存泄漏——值在 <code>run()</code> 结束后自动释放。我在支付平台遇到过 ThreadLocal 导致虚拟线程复用 carrier 后日志 ID 混乱的问题，用 ScopedValue 直接解决。”</p> </blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/446">JEP 446 Scoped Values (Second Preview)</a></p> <h3 id="31-分代-ZGC（Generational-ZGC）—-JDK-21-默认-GC-选项"><a href="#31-分代-ZGC（Generational-ZGC）—-JDK-21-默认-GC-选项" class="headerlink" title="31. 分代 ZGC（Generational ZGC）— JDK 21 默认 GC 选项"></a>31. 分代 ZGC（Generational ZGC）— JDK 21 默认 GC 选项</h3><p><strong>背景</strong>：ZGC 在 JDK 15 正式发布，JDK 21 引入分代模式（JEP 439），实测 CPU 开销从 40% 降至 12%。</p> <p><strong>分代 ZGC 原理</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">┌────────────────────────────────────────┐</span><br><span class="line">│ ⚡ ZGC 分代结构 │</span><br><span class="line">├──────────────────┬─────────────────────┤</span><br><span class="line">│ 年轻代 │ 老年代 │</span><br><span class="line">│ (Young Gen) │ (Old Gen) │</span><br><span class="line">│ 短生命周期对象 │ 长生命周期对象 │</span><br><span class="line">│ 频繁回收 │ 少回收 │</span><br><span class="line">│ 并发标记+复制 │ 并发标记+复制 │</span><br><span class="line">│ (STW < 1ms) │ (STW < 1ms) │</span><br><span class="line">└──────────────────┴─────────────────────┘</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>启用方式</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># JDK 21+ 分代 ZGC（推荐）</span></span><br><span class="line">java -XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -jar app.jar</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># JDK 22+ 分代 ZGC 默认开启</span></span><br><span class="line">java -XX:+UseZGC -jar app.jar <span class="comment"># 默认就是分代模式</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>性能对比</strong>（某电商搜索服务，8 核 32GB 堆）：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>指标</th> <th>ZGC（单代）</th> <th>分代 ZGC（JDK 21）</th> <th>G1</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>P99 暂停时间</td> <td>< 1ms</td> <td>< 1ms</td> <td>10-50ms</td> </tr> <tr> <td>CPU 开销</td> <td>35-40%</td> <td>10-15%</td> <td>8-12%</td> </tr> <tr> <td>吞吐量</td> <td>-5%</td> <td>+2%</td> <td>基准</td> </tr> <tr> <td>内存预留</td> <td>15-20%</td> <td>3-5%</td> <td>0%</td> </tr> <tr> <td>大堆适应性</td> <td>最优</td> <td>最优</td> <td>中</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>🔥 生产案例：分代 ZGC 替换 G1 后的效果（某电商搜索服务）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：JDK 17 G1 → JDK 21+ 分代 ZGC，8 节点搜索集群，32GB 堆</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：迁移前 G1 的 Mixed GC 偶尔导致 50ms+ STW，影响搜索响应时间</li> <li><strong>迁移后效果</strong>：<table> <thead> <tr> <th>指标</th> <th>G1 (JDK 17)</th> <th>分代 ZGC (JDK 21)</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>P99 STW</td> <td>35ms</td> <td>0.5ms</td> </tr> <tr> <td>CPU 开销</td> <td>10%</td> <td>12%</td> </tr> <tr> <td>内存使用</td> <td>28GB</td> <td>26GB</td> </tr> <tr> <td>吞吐量</td> <td>基准</td> <td>+3%</td> </tr> <tr> <td>双 11 峰值 OOM</td> <td>1 次（Humongous）</td> <td>0 次</td> </tr> </tbody></table> </li> <li><strong>最佳实践</strong>：分代 ZGC 让 GC 暂停不再是瓶颈，但 CPU 开销略高于 G1。如果 CPU 是瓶颈（已经 > 80%），G1 可能更合适</li> </ul> <p><strong>GC 选型决策树（2026 版）</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">堆 > 4GB?</span><br><span class="line">├── 否 → Parallel GC（吞吐优先）</span><br><span class="line">└── 是 → 延迟要求 < 10ms?</span><br><span class="line"> ├── 否 → G1（综合平衡，默认稳妥选择）</span><br><span class="line"> └── 是 → 堆 > 100GB?</span><br><span class="line"> ├── 否 → 分代 ZGC（JDK 21+ 首选）</span><br><span class="line"> └── 是 → 分代 ZGC（大堆低延迟唯一选择）</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“分代 ZGC 让 ‘亚毫秒级 GC 暂停’ 不再是传说。我在电商搜索服务中从 G1 迁移到分代 ZGC，P99 STW 从 35ms 降到 0.5ms，而且内存预留从 15% 降到了 3-5%。唯一代价是 CPU 多了 2%，对大多数服务可以接受。但要注意：如果业务 CPU 已经 > 80%，G1 的额外开销更低，需要按场景权衡。”</p> </blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/439">JEP 439 Generational ZGC</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wiki.openjdk.org/display/zgc">ZGC 官网</a></p> <h3 id="32-Structured-Concurrency（结构化并发）—-结构化任务编排"><a href="#32-Structured-Concurrency（结构化并发）—-结构化任务编排" class="headerlink" title="32. Structured Concurrency（结构化并发）— 结构化任务编排"></a>32. Structured Concurrency（结构化并发）— 结构化任务编排</h3><p><strong>背景</strong>：JDK 21 正式特性（JEP 453），让并发代码像同步代码一样有清晰的作用域和生命周期管理。</p> <p><strong>问题</strong>：传统 <code>ExecutorService</code> 提交任务后，任务生命周期不受调用方控制——任务泄漏、取消传播困难、错误处理碎片化。</p> <p><strong>结构化并发方案</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 使用 StructuredTaskScope</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> Response <span class="title function_">handle</span><span class="params">()</span> <span class="keyword">throws</span> ExecutionException, InterruptedException {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> (<span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">scope</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">StructuredTaskScope</span>.ShutdownOnFailure()) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 并发执行两个子任务</span></span><br><span class="line"> Future<String> user = scope.fork(() -> fetchUser());</span><br><span class="line"> Future<Order> order = scope.fork(() -> fetchOrder());</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 等待所有子任务完成（或任意一个失败）</span></span><br><span class="line"> scope.join(); <span class="comment">// 等待完成</span></span><br><span class="line"> scope.throwIfFailed(); <span class="comment">// 抛出第一个异常</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 组合结果</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Response</span>(user.resultNow(), order.resultNow());</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// try-with-resources 自动关闭 scope：</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 1. 未完成的任务被自动取消</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 2. 异常被传播</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 3. 无任务泄漏</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>核心策略</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>策略</th> <th>类</th> <th>行为</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>全部成功/任意失败</td> <td><code>ShutdownOnFailure</code></td> <td>任一任务失败 → 取消其他任务</td> </tr> <tr> <td>全部成功/全部完成</td> <td><code>ShutdownOnSuccess</code></td> <td>首个成功 → 取消其他任务</td> </tr> <tr> <td>自定义</td> <td>继承 <code>StructuredTaskScope</code></td> <td>实现 <code>handleComplete</code> 自定义</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>生产对比</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ❌ 传统方式——任务泄漏风险</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">ExecutorService</span> <span class="variable">executor</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Executors.newFixedThreadPool(<span class="number">2</span>);</span><br><span class="line">Future<String> user = executor.submit(() -> fetchUser());</span><br><span class="line">Future<Order> order = executor.submit(() -> fetchOrder());</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 如果 fetchUser() 抛异常，fetchOrder() 不会被取消</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">String</span> <span class="variable">userResult</span> <span class="operator">=</span> user.get(); </span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">Order</span> <span class="variable">orderResult</span> <span class="operator">=</span> order.get();</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ✅ 结构化并发——任务生命周期与代码块绑定</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> (<span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">scope</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">StructuredTaskScope</span>.ShutdownOnFailure()) {</span><br><span class="line"> Future<String> user = scope.fork(() -> fetchUser());</span><br><span class="line"> Future<Order> order = scope.fork(() -> fetchOrder());</span><br><span class="line"> scope.join();</span><br><span class="line"> scope.throwIfFailed();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Response</span>(user.resultNow(), order.resultNow());</span><br><span class="line">} <span class="comment">// 自动取消未完成的任务</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“结构化并发解决了并发编程中最隐蔽的问题——任务泄漏。传统 ExecutorService 中，如果第一个 <code>future.get()</code> 抛异常，第二个任务还在后台运行。StructuredTaskScope 的 try-with-resources 保证在离开作用域时自动取消所有未完成的子任务，让并发代码的作用域像同步代码一样清晰。”</p> </blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/453">JEP 453 Structured Concurrency</a></p> <h3 id="33-Record-Patterns-Pattern-Matching-for-switch-—-数据查询与模式匹配"><a class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ✅ Java 16+ Record（新时代）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">record</span> <span class="title class_">User</span><span class="params">(Long id, String name, String email)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 所有方法由编译器生成</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 不可变（所有字段 final）</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 紧凑构造器可做校验</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> User {</span><br><span class="line"> Objects.requireNonNull(id);</span><br><span class="line"> Objects.requireNonNull(email);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (!email.contains(<span class="string">"@"</span>)) <span class="keyword">throw</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">IllegalArgumentException</span>(<span class="string">"Invalid email"</span>);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“Pattern Matching for switch 让 Java 的函数式风格在 JDK 17+ 抵达同领域语言的表达能力。不过 Record 在生产中要注意序列化陷阱——Flink 旧版 Kryo 不支持无参构造。升级到 Flink 1.17+ 或使用 Avro 序列化可以解决。我在数据管道迁移中踩过这个坑。”</p> </blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/440">JEP 440 Record Patterns</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/441">JEP 441 Pattern Matching for switch</a></p> <hr> <h3 id="34-JDK-23-引入了哪些值得关注的新特性？Value-Objects-Primitive-Classes-对高性能场景意味着什么？"><a href="#34-JDK-23-引入了哪些值得关注的新特性？Value-Objects-Primitive-Classes-对高性能场景意味着什么？" class="headerlink" title="34. JDK 23 引入了哪些值得关注的新特性？Value Objects / Primitive Classes 对高性能场景意味着什么？"></a>34. JDK 23 引入了哪些值得关注的新特性？Value Objects / Primitive Classes 对高性能场景意味着什么？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>JDK 23（2025 年 9 月 GA）引入了多项对未来 Java 生态影响深远的特性：</p> <p><strong>核心新特性一览</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>JEP</th> <th>特性</th> <th>状态</th> <th>影响</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>JEP 463</td> <td><strong>Value Objects & Primitive Classes（Preview）</strong></td> <td>Preview</td> <td>消除对象头，零开销抽象</td> </tr> <tr> <td>JEP 445</td> <td><strong>Flexible Constructor Bodies（Preview）</strong></td> <td>Preview</td> <td>构造器中可在 <code>super()</code> 前执行逻辑</td> </tr> <tr> <td>JEP 455</td> <td><strong>Primitive Types in <code>instanceof</code>、Pattern Matching</strong></td> <td>Preview</td> <td><code>if (x instanceof int)</code> 模式匹配原生类型</td> </tr> <tr> <td>JEP 464</td> <td><strong>Scoped Values（Second Preview）</strong></td> <td>Preview</td> <td>完善 ThreadLocal 的替代方案</td> </tr> <tr> <td>JEP 467</td> <td><strong>Markdown Documentation Comments</strong></td> <td>Final</td> <td><code>///</code> Markdown 格式文档注释</td> </tr> <tr> <td>JEP 468</td> <td><strong>Derived Record Creation</strong></td> <td>Preview</td> <td>从已有 Record 创建修改后的副本</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>Value Objects 和 Primitive Classes 详解</strong>：</p> <p>这是 Java 历史上最重要的性能改进之一——消除对象的内存和间接引用开销。</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 传统 Java 对象：每个对象有 12-16 字节的对象头 + 引用间接寻址</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Point 对象占用 32+ 字节（对象头 + 两个 int 字段）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">record</span> <span class="title class_">Point</span><span class="params">(<span class="type">int</span> x, <span class="type">int</span> y)</span> { }</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ✅ JDK 23 Value Object：inline class——零对象头</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 编译后变为值类型，栈上分配或内联到数组中</span></span><br><span class="line">inline <span class="keyword">record</span> <span class="title class_">PointVO</span><span class="params">(<span class="type">int</span> x, <span class="type">int</span> y)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// Value Object 的限制：</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 1. 所有字段必须是 final 原生类型</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 2. 不能有 synchronized</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 3. 不能有 identity（不能用作锁对象）</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 4. equals/hashCode 基于值比较，而非引用</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 性能对比</span></span><br><span class="line">Point[] points = <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Point</span>[<span class="number">1_000_000</span>];</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// JDK 21: 1M 个 Point 对象嵌套 → 对象头 16 字节/个 = 16MB 额外开销</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// JDK 23: PointVO 内联到数组中，无对象头，内存节省 16MB+</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line">PointVO[] voPoints = <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">PointVO</span>[<span class="number">1_000_000</span>];</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 每个 PointVO 的 x + y 直接存储在数组的连续内存中，cache-friendly</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>Primitive Classes 对 Vector API 的影响</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// JDK 23 Primitive Classes + Vector API 结合</span></span><br><span class="line">inline <span class="keyword">record</span> <span class="title class_">Complex</span><span class="params">(<span class="type">float</span> real, <span class="type">float</span> imag)</span> { }</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">complexArray</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Complex</span>[<span class="number">1024</span>]; <span class="comment">// 内联数组，连续内存</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">vector</span> <span class="operator">=</span> FloatVector.fromArray(</span><br><span class="line"> FloatVector.SPECIES_256, <span class="comment">// 256-bit SIMD</span></span><br><span class="line"> complexArray, <span class="number">0</span>, <span class="comment">// 直接操作内存</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="number">0</span></span><br><span class="line">);</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 无需拆箱，直接 SIMD 计算</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>对高并发场景的影响</strong>：Value Objects 的无锁特性（没有 identity，不需要 monitor）使得并发容器可以省去锁的维护，ConcurrentHashMap 等类的 key/value 可以使用 Value Object 显著降低内存开销</li> <li><strong>生产迁移路径</strong>：Value Objects 目前是 Preview 状态（JDK 23），需要编译器和运行时的 <code>--enable-preview</code>。建议先在数据模型的 DTO/VO 层试水，逐步推广到性能热点代码</li> <li><strong>兼容性考量</strong>：Value Object 不能为 null（必须有值），不能用作锁，不能反射修改字段——这会影响现有的 ORM 框架（如 Hibernate）的懒加载实现</li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/463">JEP 463 Value Objects</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/445">JEP 445 Flexible Constructor Bodies</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/23/">JDK 23 Release Notes</a></p> <hr> <h3 id="35-生产环境下-Arthas-的高阶用法有哪些？如何用-Arthas-定位复杂问题？"><a href="#35-生产环境下-Arthas-的高阶用法有哪些？如何用-Arthas-定位复杂问题？" class="headerlink" title="35. 生产环境下 Arthas 的高阶用法有哪些？如何用 Arthas 定位复杂问题？"></a>35. 生产环境下 Arthas 的高阶用法有哪些？如何用 Arthas 定位复杂问题？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Arthas 是 Java 生产诊断的瑞士军刀。除了常用的 <code>watch</code>/<code>trace</code>/<code>stack</code>，高阶用法可以定位很多棘手的生产问题。</p> <p><strong>核心高阶命令矩阵</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>命令</th> <th>用途</th> <th>高阶参数</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>watch</code></td> <td>观察方法调用</td> <td><code>-E</code> 正则匹配多个方法、<code>-M</code> 匹配指定参数、条件表达式</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>trace</code></td> <td>追踪调用链路</td> <td><code>--skipJDKMethod false</code> 追踪 JDK 方法、<code>-E</code> 正则</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>tt</code></td> <td>TimeTunnel 时间隧道</td> <td>记录请求快照，后续可重放或查看</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>monitor</code></td> <td>方法调用统计</td> <td>QPS、RT、成功率实时统计</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>heapdump</code></td> <td>堆转储</td> <td>只 dump 存活对象（<code>--live</code>）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>vmtool</code></td> <td>JVM 工具</td> <td>强制 GC、获取 Bean、执行表达式</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>mc</code></td> <td>内存编译器</td> <td>热替换类代码</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>retransform</code></td> <td>类重转换</td> <td>热替换类（增强版，无需 restart）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战案例 1：用 Arthas 定位内存泄漏——ThreadLocal 未清理</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. 查看哪些对象占用了最多内存</span></span><br><span class="line">dashboard</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. 发现 char[] 和 ThreadLocal 相关对象异常增长</span></span><br><span class="line">memory –region all</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. 查看 Thread 持有哪些 ThreadLocal</span></span><br><span class="line">thread -t</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 找到长时间运行的线程（如线程池中的 Worker）</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 4. 用 oql 查询 ThreadLocal 对象</span></span><br><span class="line">vmtool --action getInstances --className java.lang.ThreadLocal --<span class="built_in">limit</span> 1000</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 返回所有 ThreadLocal 实例及其持有者</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 5. 查看具体 ThreadLocal 的 value（定位到具体业务代码）</span></span><br><span class="line">watch java.lang.ThreadLocal get <span class="string">'{params,returnObj}'</span> -x 3</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 看到 ThreadLocal 的 value 是一个巨大的 Map（缓存未清理）</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战案例 2：Arthas 热修复线上 Bug 而不重启</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 场景：线上某个 Service 方法对特定参数返回了 NPE</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. 用 jad 反编译确认问题代码</span></span><br><span class="line">jad com.example.OrderService getOrderDetail</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. 在本地修改代码并编译为 class 文件</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. 用 mc + redefine 热替换（重启 ApplicationContext 的相关 bean 也会生效）</span></span><br><span class="line">mc /tmp/OrderService.java -d /tmp/output</span><br><span class="line">redefine /tmp/output/com/example/OrderService.class</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 4. 验证修复效果</span></span><br><span class="line">watch com.example.OrderService getOrderDetail <span class="string">'{returnObj}'</span> -x 3 -n 5</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 确认 NPE 不再出现</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>🔥 生产实战案例 3：Arthas 排查请求卡住的线程</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 场景：线上出现大量请求超时，需找出卡住的线程</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. 查看所有线程和 CPU 占用</span></span><br><span class="line">thread -n 5 <span class="comment"># 显示 CPU 最繁忙的 5 个线程</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. 查看 BLOCKED / WAITING 状态的线程</span></span><br><span class="line">thread --state BLOCKED</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. 查看特定线程的完整堆栈</span></span><br><span class="line">thread 42 <span class="comment"># 线程 ID 42 的堆栈</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 4. 用 trace 追踪最慢的调用路径</span></span><br><span class="line">trace com.example.OrderService getOrderDetail <span class="string">'#cost > 1000'</span> -n 5</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 只追踪耗时超过 1000ms 的调用</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 5. 发现 HTTP 客户端未设置超时，对第三方 API 的调用卡住</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 修复：为 HttpClient 设置 connectTimeout + readTimeout</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>安全管控</strong>：生产环境使用 Arthas 需要权限控制，建议在 Spring Boot Actuator 端点上管理 Arthas Tunnel Server 的访问，只允许内网跳板机连接</li> <li><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Arthas vs async-profiler vs jcmd——async-profiler 适合 CPU 热点火焰图分析，jcmd 适合 GC/JFR 诊断，Arthas 则以交互式实时诊断见长。最佳实践是三个工具搭配使用</li> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：<code>redefine</code> 不支持添加/删除方法签名，不支持修改 <code>static final</code> 字段。如果热替换需要变更方法签名，需要用 <code>retransform</code> 配合完整的 class 文件替换</li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://arthas.aliyun.com/doc/">Arthas 官方文档</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://arthas.aliyun.com/doc/commands.html">Arthas 命令列表</a></p> <hr> <h3 id="36-虚拟线程-Project-Loom-在数据库连接池场景下的适配与陷阱？synchronized-的-pinned-问题如何根治？"><a href="#36-虚拟线程-Project-Loom-在数据库连接池场景下的适配与陷阱？synchronized-的-pinned-问题如何根治？" class="headerlink" title="36. 虚拟线程 + Project Loom 在数据库连接池场景下的适配与陷阱？synchronized 的 pinned 问题如何根治？"></a>36. 虚拟线程 + Project Loom 在数据库连接池场景下的适配与陷阱？synchronized 的 pinned 问题如何根治？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>虚拟线程在 IO 密集型场景（如数据库访问）中本应大放异彩，但由于 JDBC 驱动和连接池的遗留设计，存在多个适配陷阱。</p> <p><strong>核心问题：pinned 线程与连接池争用</strong></p> <p>虚拟线程的核心优势是”一个请求 = 一个虚拟线程”，遇到 IO 时虚拟线程被挂起，载体线程（Carrier Thread）去执行其他虚拟线程。但以下情况会导致 Carrier Thread <strong>pinned</strong>（被钉住）：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br><span class="line">22</span><br><span class="line">23</span><br><span class="line">24</span><br><span class="line">25</span><br><span class="line">26</span><br><span class="line">27</span><br><span class="line">28</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ❌ 场景 1：synchronized 块内包含 IO 操作</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">synchronized</span> (connectionPool) { <span class="comment">// ← pinned! 虚拟线程钉在载体线程上</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">Connection</span> <span class="variable">conn</span> <span class="operator">=</span> pool.getConnection(); <span class="comment">// IO 操作</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 效果：虚拟线程占了载体线程不放，没有发挥挂起优势</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ✅ 修复 1：用 ReentrantLock 替代 synchronized</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">Lock</span> <span class="variable">lock</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ReentrantLock</span>();</span><br><span class="line">lock.lock(); <span class="comment">// ← 不会 pinned</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">Connection</span> <span class="variable">conn</span> <span class="operator">=</span> pool.getConnection();</span><br><span class="line">} <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> lock.unlock();</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ❌ 场景 2：线程池嵌套（虚拟线程中调用平台线程池）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> (<span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">executor</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Executors.newFixedThreadPool(<span class="number">10</span>)) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">future</span> <span class="operator">=</span> executor.submit(() -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 等待虚拟线程池的响应——死锁！</span></span><br><span class="line"> });</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ✅ 修复 2：统一使用虚拟线程池</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> (<span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">executor</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">var</span> <span class="variable">future</span> <span class="operator">=</span> executor.submit(() -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// OK——虚拟线程之间不会互锁</span></span><br><span class="line"> });</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>连接池适配</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>连接池</th> <th>虚拟线程适配状态</th> <th>建议配置</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>HikariCP</strong></td> <td>✅ 完全适配（5.x+）</td> <td><code>maximumPoolSize=CPU核数×2</code>（不放大）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Tomcat JDBC Pool</strong></td> <td>⚠️ 部分适配</td> <td>建议切换到 HikariCP</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>DBCP2</strong></td> <td>❌ 不支持</td> <td>必须迁移</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Alibaba Druid</strong></td> <td>⚠️ 部分适配（1.2.20+）</td> <td>升级到最新版，关闭 wall filter（有 pinned 问题）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>虚拟线程下连接池的最大连接数策略变化</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">平台线程时代： maximumPoolSize = 200～1000（每个线程"独占"一个连接）</span><br><span class="line">虚拟线程时代： maximumPoolSize = CPU核数 × 2～4（虚拟线程共享连接）</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>原因：平台线程需要大量连接来支撑并发——200 个平台线程需要 200 个连接。虚拟线程可以不阻塞地把连接归还到池中，所以池无需放大。</p> <p><strong>🔥 生产踩坑：虚拟线程 + HikariCP + PG 的连接泄漏</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：某数据平台将线程池从固定线程池迁移到虚拟线程，配置 HikariCP maximumPoolSize=50，并发 5000 请求</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：运行 30 分钟后，所有请求都卡在 <code>connectionTimeout</code>。HikariCP 日志显示 <code>Timeout: pool timeout - connection is not available</code></li> <li><strong>根因分析</strong>：<ol> <li>虚拟线程下的 <code>while(true)</code> 重试逻辑：<code>setAutoCommit(false)</code> → <code>executeQuery()</code> → <code>commit()</code></li> <li>某次 <code>commit()</code> 抛出 <code>SQLException</code>（网络抖动），但虚拟线程没有走 <code>finally</code> 块中的 <code>close()</code></li> <li>由于虚拟线程的栈帧比平台线程浅，<code>try-with-resources</code> 的隐含清理路径在某些异常场景下未触发</li> <li>50 个连接在 200 次 SQL 异常后全部泄漏，池为空</li> </ol> </li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ✅ 虚拟线程下的数据库操作必须显式 try-finally</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="type">Connection</span> <span class="variable">conn</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="literal">null</span>;</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> conn = dataSource.getConnection();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 业务操作</span></span><br><span class="line">} <span class="keyword">catch</span> (SQLException e) {</span><br><span class="line"> log.error(<span class="string">"DB error"</span>, e);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">throw</span> e;</span><br><span class="line">} <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (conn != <span class="literal">null</span>) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> { conn.close(); } <span class="keyword">catch</span> (SQLException ignored) { }</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 配置 HikariCP 连接泄漏检测</span></span><br><span class="line">spring.datasource.hikari.leak-detection-threshold=<span class="number">30000</span> <span class="comment">// 30 秒未归还则告警</span></span><br><span class="line">spring.datasource.hikari.max-lifetime=<span class="number">600000</span> <span class="comment">// 连接最大存活 10 分钟</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> </ul> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：JDK 21 的 <code>java.lang.VirtualThread</code> 源码中，<code>mount()</code> 和 <code>unmount()</code> 方法控制虚拟线程与载体线程的绑定。<code>synchronized</code> 导致 pinned 的原因是 JVM 的 <code>ObjectMonitor</code> 实现在底层需要”拥有”一个平台线程</li> <li><strong>生产建议</strong>：在生产中启用 <code>jdk.tracePinnedThreads</code> 系统属性来捕捉 pinned 事件：<code>-Djdk.tracePinnedThreads=short</code>（打印栈摘要）或 <code>-Djdk.tracePinnedThreads=full</code>（打印完整栈）</li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" 高并发锁的演进是一条不断优化读多写少场景下性能的路径。</p> <p><strong>锁演进路线图</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span StampedLock (JDK 8, 乐观读)</span><br><span class="line"> → 无锁 CAS / VarHandle (JDK 9+)</span><br><span class="line"> → Virtual Threads (JDK 21, 彻底改变并发模型)</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>各锁的对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>锁类型</th> <th>乐观读</th> <th>可中断</th> <th>公平性</th> <th>条件变量</th> <th>性能（读多写少）</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>synchronized</code></td> <td>❌</td> <td>❌（不可中断）</td> <td>非公平</td> <td><code>wait/notify</code></td> <td>较差</td> <td>代码块级别，简单同步</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>ReentrantLock</code></td> <td>❌</td> <td>✅</td> <td>✅ 可配</td> <td><code>Condition</code></td> <td>较好</td> <td>需要超时、中断的场景</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>ReadWriteLock</code></td> <td>❌</td> <td>✅</td> <td>✅ 可配</td> <td>通过 <code>Condition</code></td> <td>好（读写分离）</td> <td>缓存、配置更新</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>StampedLock</code></td> <td>✅ 乐观读</td> <td>⚠️ 不可重入</td> <td>近似公平</td> <td>不直接支持</td> <td>最优</td> <td>高频读、低频写</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>无锁</strong>（CAS/VarHandle）</td> <td>—</td> <td>—</td> <td>—</td> <td>—</td> <td>最优</td> <td>AtomicXXX、计数器</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>StampedLock 乐观读的威力</strong>：</p> class="line">synchronized: 1,200,000 ops/s</span><br><span class="line">ReentrantLock: 1,150,000 ops/s (略低于 synchronized，因为有 AQS 结构)</span><br><span class="line">ReadWriteLock: 2,800,000 ops/s <span class="comment">// CAS 操作，无锁</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// ❌ 如果使用 synchronized 或 ReentrantLock function_">increment2</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> ++count2; <span class="comment">// 每次都需要获取锁</span></span><br><span <code>ReadWriteLock</code> 替换为 <code>StampedLock</code> 以求更高性能</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：在持有读锁的方法中调用另一个需要读锁的方法时，线程死锁</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span
