class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="type">StampedLock</span> <span class="variable">lock</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">StampedLock</span>();</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">methodA</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">long</span> <span class="variable">stamp</span> <span class="operator">=</span> lock.readLock();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> methodB(); <span class="comment">// ❌ 再次尝试获取读锁——StampedLock 不可重入，死锁！</span></span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> lock.unlockRead(stamp);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">methodB</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">long</span> <span class="variable">stamp</span> <span class="operator">=</span> lock.readLock(); <span class="comment">// 等待 methodA 释放锁——但 methodA 在等 methodB 完成</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// DEADLOCK!</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：<ol> <li>提取共享读锁的 stamp 作为参数传入</li> <li>或退化为 <code>ReentrantReadWriteLock</code>（支持重入）</li> <li>或重新设计避免锁嵌套</li> </ol> </li> </ul> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>选型建议</strong>：<ul> <li>99% 的场景用 <code>synchronized</code> 就够了——JVM 一直在优化它（偏向锁、轻量级锁、重量锁的自动升级）</li> <li>需要超时/中断时用 <code>ReentrantLock</code></li> <li>缓存读取（读 > 80%）用 <code>StampedLock</code> 的乐观读</li> <li>热点计数器用 <code>LongAdder</code>（比 <code>AtomicLong</code> 在高并发时性能更好，striped CAS 减少冲突）</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>代码可维护性</strong>：锁优化是有成本的。<code>StampedLock</code> 的正确使用需要仔细设计 API 边界，不可重入特性容易引入 bug。除非基准测试证明是瓶颈，否则优先用 <code>synchronized</code></li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/21/docs/api/java.base/java/util/concurrent/locks/StampedLock.html">StampedLock Javadoc</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://jcip.net/">Java Concurrency in Practice Ch.13</a></p> <hr> <h3 id="38-生产-JVM-内存泄漏深度排查——Direct-Memory-Metaspace-ThreadLocal-的定位与修复"><a href="#38-生产-JVM-内存泄漏深度排查——Direct-Memory-Metaspace-ThreadLocal-的定位与修复" class="headerlink" title="38. 生产 JVM 内存泄漏深度排查——Direct Memory / Metaspace / ThreadLocal 的定位与修复"></a>38. 生产 JVM 内存泄漏深度排查——Direct Memory / Metaspace / ThreadLocal 的定位与修复</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>Java 内存泄漏不限于堆内存，Direct Memory、Metaspace、ThreadLocal 是三个最常见但容易被忽略的泄漏源。</p> <p><strong>三种泄漏源对比</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>泄漏类型</th> <th>内存区域</th> <th>GC 影响</th> <th>常见原因</th> <th>默认限制</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>堆内存泄漏</strong></td> <td>Heap</td> <td>GC 越来越频繁</td> <td>集合未清理、缓存无限增长</td> <td><code>-Xmx</code> 限制</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Direct Memory 泄漏</strong></td> <td>堆外（Native）</td> <td>GC 不感知</td> <td>Netty ByteBuf、NIO Buffer 未释放</td> <td><code>-XX:MaxDirectMemorySize</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>Metaspace 泄漏</strong></td> <td>堆外（Native）</td> <td>Full GC 触发卸载</td> <td>动态类加载、CGlib 代理、Groovy 脚本</td> <td><code>-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>ThreadLocal 泄漏</strong></td> <td>Heap</td> <td>GC 无法回收</td> <td>线程池中线程长期存活，Entry 的 value 永远可达</td> <td>不受限</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>Direct Memory 泄漏定位</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 症状：进程 RSS 远大于 -Xmx，但 heap dump 显示堆内存正常</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 定位步骤：</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. 查看 Direct Buffer 的统计</span></span><br><span class="line">jcmd <pid> VM.native_memory baseline</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># ...</span></span><br><span class="line">jcmd <pid> VM.native_memory detail.diff</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. 通过 JMX MBean 查看 Direct Buffer 已分配量</span></span><br><span class="line">jconsole <pid> → MBeans → java.nio.BufferPool -> direct</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. 代码层面的排查：Netty 的 ByteBuf 分配器</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 在代码中启用 Netty 的 leack detection</span></span><br><span class="line">-Dio.netty.leakDetectionLevel=paranoid</span><br><span class="line">-Dio.netty.leakDetectionTargetReports=<span class="literal">true</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 日志会输出泄漏的 ByteBuf 创建位置</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>🔥 案例：Netty 接收缓冲区未释放导致 OOM</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：某即时通讯服务使用 Netty 处理 WebSocket 连接，峰值 50 万连接</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：运营 8 小时后，进程 RSS 从 4GB 增长到 16GB，远超 <code>-Xmx=4g</code></li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ❌ 错误代码：channelRead 中未释放 msg</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">channelRead</span><span class="params">(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, Object msg)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">ByteBuf</span> <span class="variable">buf</span> <span class="operator">=</span> (ByteBuf) msg;</span><br><span class="line"> handleMessage(buf);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 没有调用 ReferenceCountUtil.release(msg)</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// Netty 的引用计数器不为 0，Direct Memory 持续增长</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ✅ 正确代码</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">channelRead</span><span class="params">(ChannelHandlerContext ctx, Object msg)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">ByteBuf</span> <span class="variable">buf</span> <span class="operator">=</span> (ByteBuf) msg;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> handleMessage(buf);</span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> ReferenceCountUtil.release(msg); <span class="comment">// 必须释放</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>启示</strong>：使用 Netty 的 <code>SimpleChannelInboundHandler</code> 可以自动管理引用计数</li> </ul> <p><strong>Metaspace 泄漏定位</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 症状：JVM 持续进行 Full GC（Metaspace 的 GC 是 Full GC），Old Gen 使用率低</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 定位步骤：</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 1. 监控 Metaspace 使用量</span></span><br><span class="line">jstat -gc <pid> 5s</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># MC（Metaspace Capacity）和 MU（Metaspace Utilization）持续增长</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 2. 查看加载/卸载的类数量</span></span><br><span class="line">jstat -class <pid></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># Loaded > Unloaded，说明类被持续加载但未被卸载</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 3. Dump 类的元空间信息</span></span><br><span class="line">jcmd <pid> VM.classloaders</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 4. 查看哪个 ClassLoader 泄露了</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 通常在 Groovy 脚本编译、CGlib 代理（Spring AOP）、动态生成代理类时出现</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 检查是否在重复创建 ClassLoader 但没有关闭</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>🔥 案例：Groovy Shell 动态编译导致 Metaspace OOM</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：规则引擎中使用 GroovyShell 编译用户输入的脚本</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：每执行一次规则，Metaspace 增长 2-3MB，48 小时后 Metaspace OOM</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：<figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ❌ 每次创建一个新的 GroovyShell</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> Object <span class="title function_">executeScript</span><span class="params">(String script)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">GroovyShell</span> <span class="variable">shell</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">GroovyShell</span>(); <span class="comment">// 创建新 ClassLoader</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> shell.evaluate(script);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// shell 和其 ClassLoader 永远不会被 GC 回收</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 每次编译生成大量 class 文件进入 Metaspace</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ✅ 缓存 GroovyShell</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">GroovyShell</span> <span class="variable">SHARED_SHELL</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">GroovyShell</span>();</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> Object <span class="title function_">executeScript</span><span class="params">(String script)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> SHARED_SHELL.evaluate(script);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 复用同一个 ClassLoader，不会产生新的类</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> </ul> <p><strong>ThreadLocal 泄漏定位</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br><span class="line">21</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 症状：堆内存持续增长，但 Old Gen 回收不掉某些对象</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 定位：</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 1. 通过 heap dump 查找 ThreadLocalMap 中的超大 entry</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 使用 Eclipse MAT 的 OQL：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// SELECT * FROM java.lang.ThreadLocal$Entry e WHERE e.value != null</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 2. 或者在线用 Arthas：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// vmtool --action getInstances --className java.lang.ThreadLocal --limit 100</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 3. 排查代码：</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ❌ 错误：用了 ThreadLocal 但没有在 finally 中 remove</span></span><br><span class="line">ThreadLocal<BigData> context = <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ThreadLocal</span><>();</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> context.set(loadBigData()); <span class="comment">// 巨大对象</span></span><br><span class="line"> process();</span><br><span class="line">} <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 忘记 remove！线程池中的线程永不释放这个对象</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 当线程归还到线程池后，下次请求复用这个线程时，value 仍然存在</span></span><br><span class="line"> context.remove(); <span class="comment">// ✅ 必须调用 remove</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产预警</strong>：不要等到 OOM 才查内存泄漏。设置 <code>-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -XX:HeapDumpPath=/tmp</code>，同时配置基于 JMX 的内存使用率告警（如 Old Gen > 80% 告警）</li> <li><strong>工具链推荐</strong>：<ul> <li>堆泄漏：Eclipse MAT -> Histogram -> Dominator Tree -> GC Roots</li> <li>Direct Memory：Netty leak detector + Native Memory Tracking (<code>-XX:NativeMemoryTracking=detail</code>)</li> <li>Metaspace：<code>jcmd <pid> VM.metaspace</code> + <code>jcmd <pid> GC.class_stats</code></li> <li>ThreadLocal：Arthas <code>vmtool</code> 或 heap dump 的 ThreadLocalMap 分析</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://netty.io/wiki/reference-counted-objects.html">Netty Reference Counting</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/21/docs/specs/man/jcmd.html">JVM Native Memory Tracking</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://eclipse.dev/mat/">Eclipse MAT Guide</a></p> class="post-meta-item-text">分类于</span> <span itemprop="about" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Thing"> <a href="/categories/%E5%90%8E%E7%AB%AF/" itemprop="url" rel="index"><span itemprop="name">后端</span></a> </span> </span> </div> </div> </header> <div class="post-body" itemprop="articleBody"> <blockquote> <p>Spring Boot 高级面试全解，覆盖自动配置原理、Starter 机制、Actuator 监控、性能调优和常见生产踩坑。面向高级研发，侧重源码理解和架构设计。</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x00-自动配置原理"><a href="#0x00-自动配置原理" class="headerlink" title="0x00 自动配置原理"></a>0x00 自动配置原理</h2><h3 id="1-SpringBootApplication-注解到底做了什么？"><a href="#1-SpringBootApplication-注解到底做了什么？" class="headerlink" title="1. @SpringBootApplication 注解到底做了什么？"></a>1. <code>@SpringBootApplication</code> 注解到底做了什么？</h3><p>拆解：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">@SpringBootApplication</span> <span class="comment">// 等价于下面三个注解的组合</span></span><br><span class="line"> = <span class="meta">@SpringBootConfiguration</span> <span class="comment">// → @Configuration，标记配置类</span></span><br><span class="line"> + <span class="meta">@EnableAutoConfiguration</span> <span class="comment">// → 触发自动配置</span></span><br><span class="line"> + <span class="meta">@ComponentScan</span> <span class="comment">// → 扫描当前包及子包的组件</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>关键在于 <code>@EnableAutoConfiguration</code>：</p> <ol> <li>通过 <code>@Import(AutoConfigurationImportSelector.class)</code> 导入选择器</li> <li>选择器读取 <code>META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports</code>（Spring Boot 3.x）或 <code>spring.factories</code>（2.x）</li> <li>加载全部候选配置类（约 150+）</li> <li>通过 <code>@ConditionalOnClass</code>、<code>@ConditionalOnMissingBean</code> 等条件注解过滤</li> <li>最终只加载符合当前环境的配置</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 典型的条件自动配置示例</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@AutoConfiguration</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@ConditionalOnClass({ DataSource.class, EmbeddedDatabaseType.class })</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@EnableConfigurationProperties(DataSourceProperties.class)</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">DataSourceAutoConfiguration</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Bean</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@ConditionalOnMissingBean</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> DataSource <span class="title function_">dataSource</span><span class="params">(DataSourceProperties properties)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 创建 DataSource</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>边界情况</strong>：第三方 Starter 的 <code>AutoConfiguration.imports</code> 可能定义了你不想要的 Bean。排除方式：<code>@SpringBootApplication(exclude = {XXXAutoConfiguration.class})</code> 或在 <code>application.properties</code> 中 <code>spring.autoconfigure.exclude=...</code></li> <li><strong>源码层面</strong>：Spring Boot 3.x 换用 <code>.imports</code> 文件替代 <code>spring.factories</code> 是为了减少类加载开销——<code>spring.factories</code> 需要加载所有文件中的所有行，<code>.imports</code> 只加载对应文件</li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/docs/current/reference/html/auto-configuration.html">Spring Boot 自动配置文档</a></p> <h3 id="2-如何自定义一个-Starter？"><a href="#2-如何自定义一个-Starter？" class="headerlink" title="2. 如何自定义一个 Starter？"></a>2. 如何自定义一个 Starter？</h3><p>三步：</p> <p><strong>1. 创建 autoconfigure 模块</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">@AutoConfiguration</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@EnableConfigurationProperties(MyStarterProperties.class)</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@ConditionalOnClass(MyService.class)</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">MyStarterAutoConfiguration</span> {</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Bean</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@ConditionalOnMissingBean</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> MyService <span class="title function_">myService</span><span class="params">(MyStarterProperties props)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">MyService</span>(props.getUrl(), props.getTimeout());</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "my.starter")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">MyStarterProperties</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">String</span> <span class="variable">url</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="string">"http://localhost:8080"</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">timeout</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="number">3000</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// getters/setters</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>2. 创建 spring 配置文件</strong>：<code>META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports</code> 中写入 <code>com.example.MyStarterAutoConfiguration</code></p> <p><strong>3. 可选依赖 BOM</strong>：如果提供版本管理，创建 <code>spring-boot-starter-my</code> 的 pom 依赖 autoconfigure 模块</p> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/docs/current/reference/html/features.html#features.developing-auto-configuration">Creating Your Own Starter</a></p> <hr> <h2 id="0x01-核心机制"><a href="#0x01-核心机制" class="headerlink" title="0x01 核心机制"></a>0x01 核心机制</h2><h3 id="3-Spring-Boot-的异常处理机制是什么？"><a href="#3-Spring-Boot-的异常处理机制是什么？" class="headerlink" title="3. Spring Boot 的异常处理机制是什么？"></a>3. Spring Boot 的异常处理机制是什么？</h3><p>三层异常处理：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">27</span><br><span class="line">28</span><br><span class="line">29</span><br><span class="line">30</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 1. @ExceptionHandler — 控制器级别</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@RestController</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">OrderController</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@ExceptionHandler(OrderNotFoundException.class)</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND)</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> ErrorResponse <span class="title function_">handleNotFound</span><span class="params">(OrderNotFoundException e)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ErrorResponse</span>(<span class="number">404</span>, e.getMessage());</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 2. @ControllerAdvice — 全局级别</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@RestControllerAdvice</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">GlobalExceptionHandler</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span function_">handleValidation</span><span class="params">(MethodArgumentNotValidException e)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">String</span> <span class="variable">msg</span> .collect(Collectors.joining(<span class="string">", "</span>));</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class="meta">@ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> ErrorResponse <span class="title function_">handleAll</span><span class="params">(Exception e)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ErrorResponse</span>(<span BasicErrorController — Spring Boot 默认兜底</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 当没有任何 @ExceptionHandler 处理时，由 BasicErrorController 接管</span></span><br><span class="line"><span href="https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/docs/current/reference/html/web.html#web.servlet.spring-mvc.error-handling">Spring Boot Error Handling</a></p> <h3 id="4-ConfigurationProperties-vs-Value-怎么选？"><a href="#4-ConfigurationProperties-vs-Value-怎么选？" class="headerlink" title="4. @ConfigurationProperties vs @Value 怎么选？"></a>4. <code>@ConfigurationProperties</code> vs <code>@Value</code> 怎么选？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th><code>@ConfigurationProperties</code></th> <th><code>@Value</code></th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>绑定方式</td> <td>按前缀批量绑定（类型安全）</td> <td>逐个注入</td> </tr> <tr> <td>松散绑定</td> <td>支持（<code>my-prop</code> → <code>myProp</code>）</td> <td>不支持</td> </tr> <tr> <td>校验</td> <td>支持 JSR303 <code>@Validated</code></td> <td>不支持</td> </tr> <tr> <td>复杂类型</td> <td>支持 List/Map/嵌套对象</td> <td>仅支持简单类型</td> </tr> <tr> <td>适用场景</td> <td>一组相关配置</td> <td>单个独立配置</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// @ConfigurationProperties: 适合有前缀的一组配置</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "app.pool")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">PoolProperties</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">coreSize</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="number">10</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">maxSize</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="number">50</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">Duration</span> <span class="variable">keepAlive</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Duration.ofSeconds(<span class="number">60</span>);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 支持嵌套</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">Retry</span> <span class="variable">retry</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Retry</span>();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">Retry</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">maxAttempts</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="number">3</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// @Value: 适合零散的单个配置</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Value("${app.pool.core-size}")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">int</span> coreSize;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>生产经验</strong>：<code>@ConfigurationProperties</code> 需要启用 <code>@EnableConfigurationProperties</code> 或注册为 Bean，否则不生效。最常见踩坑：写了 <code>@ConfigurationProperties</code> 但忘了加 <code>@Component</code> 或 <code>@EnableConfigurationProperties</code></li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x02-Actuator-与监控"><a href="#0x02-Actuator-与监控" class="headerlink" title="0x02 Actuator 与监控"></a>0x02 Actuator 与监控</h2><h3 id="5-Actuator-有哪些关键端点？生产环境如何安全暴露？"><a href="#5-Actuator-有哪些关键端点？生产环境如何安全暴露？" class="headerlink" title="5. Actuator 有哪些关键端点？生产环境如何安全暴露？"></a>5. Actuator 有哪些关键端点？生产环境如何安全暴露？</h3><p>常用端点：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>端点</th> <th>用途</th> <th>风险等级</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>/health</code></td> <td>健康检查（K8s liveness/readiness）</td> <td>低</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>/info</code></td> <td>应用信息</td> <td>低</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>/metrics</code></td> <td>JVM/HTTP/DB 指标</td> <td>中</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>/env</code></td> <td>环境变量和配置</td> <td><strong>高</strong>（可能泄露密码）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>/threaddump</code></td> <td>线程转储</td> <td>中</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>/heapdump</code></td> <td>堆转储（敏感数据）</td> <td><strong>高</strong></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>/loggers</code></td> <td>动态调整日志级别</td> <td>中</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>/mappings</code></td> <td>所有请求映射</td> <td>低</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>生产安全配置</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">management:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">endpoints:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">web:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">exposure:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment"># 生产环境：只暴露健康检查和指标</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">include:</span> <span class="string">health,info,metrics,prometheus</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">endpoint:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">health:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">show-details:</span> <span class="string">when-authorized</span> <span class="comment"># 有权限才显示详情</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">probes:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">enabled:</span> <span class="literal">true</span> <span class="comment"># K8s 探针</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>架构设计</strong>：管理端口和生产端口分离是最佳实践——<code>management.server.port=8081</code>，生产端口 8080 走业务流量，管理端口 8081 只对内网开放</li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x03-Spring-Boot-3-x-迁移要点"><a href="#0x03-Spring-Boot-3-x-迁移要点" class="headerlink" title="0x03 Spring Boot 3.x 迁移要点"></a>0x03 Spring Boot 3.x 迁移要点</h2><h3 id="6-Spring-Boot-2-x-→-3-x-有哪些-Breaking-Changes？"><a href="#6-Spring-Boot-2-x-→-3-x-有哪些-Breaking-Changes？" class="headerlink" title="6. Spring Boot 2.x → 3.x 有哪些 Breaking Changes？"></a>6. Spring Boot 2.x → 3.x 有哪些 Breaking Changes？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>变更</th> <th>2.x</th> <th>3.x</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>Java 基线</td> <td>Java 8/11</td> <td><strong>Java 17+</strong></td> </tr> <tr> <td>Jakarta EE</td> <td><code>javax.*</code></td> <td><strong><code>jakarta.*</code></strong></td> </tr> <tr> <td>自动配置注册</td> <td><code>spring.factories</code></td> <td><strong><code>AutoConfiguration.imports</code></strong></td> </tr> <tr> <td>可观测性</td> <td>无统一 API</td> <td><strong>Micrometer Observation API</strong></td> </tr> <tr> <td>AOT 编译</td> <td>不支持</td> <td>原生支持 GraalVM Native Image</td> </tr> <tr> <td>虚拟线程</td> <td>不支持</td> <td>支持 Virtual Threads</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>HttpMethod</code></td> <td><code>PATCH</code> 不存在</td> <td>新增 <code>PATCH</code></td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>实际踩坑</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>大量第三方库的 <code>javax.servlet</code> 依赖需要替换为 <code>jakarta.servlet</code></li> <li>如果有自定义 <code>spring.factories</code>，必须迁移到 <code>.imports</code> 文件</li> <li><code>spring-security</code> 的配置方式有较大变化（lambda DSL）</li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/wiki/Spring-Boot-3.0-Migration-Guide">Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide</a></p> <hr> <h2 id="0x04-性能调优"><a href="#0x04-性能调优" class="headerlink" title="0x04 性能调优"></a>0x04 性能调优</h2><h3 id="7-Spring-Boot-应用常见性能瓶颈及优化？"><a href="#7-Spring-Boot-应用常见性能瓶颈及优化？" class="headerlink" title="7. Spring Boot 应用常见性能瓶颈及优化？"></a>7. Spring Boot 应用常见性能瓶颈及优化？</h3><p><strong>1. 数据库连接池</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">spring.datasource.hikari:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">maximum-pool-size:</span> <span class="number">20</span> <span class="comment"># 不要瞎设 200，看实际并发</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">minimum-idle:</span> <span class="number">5</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">connection-timeout:</span> <span class="number">3000</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">idle-timeout:</span> <span class="number">600000</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>2. Tomcat 线程池</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">server.tomcat:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">threads.max:</span> <span class="number">200</span> <span class="comment"># 默认 200，高并发场景可调高</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">accept-count:</span> <span class="number">100</span> <span class="comment"># 等待队列长度</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">connection-timeout:</span> <span class="number">20000</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>3. JVM 调优</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -Xms2g -Xmx2g</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>4. 缓存策略</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Cacheable(value = "orders", key = "#id")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> Order <span class="title function_">getOrder</span><span class="params">(Long id)</span> { ... }</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>5. 异步处理</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Async</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> CompletableFuture<Result> <span class="title function_">processAsync</span><span class="params">()</span> { ... }</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>架构设计</strong>：不要盲目增加线程数。Tomcat 线程数 × 平均 RT(秒) = 理论并发 QPS。如果 RT=200ms，200 线程 = 1000 QPS。超过这个值先看 RT 能不能降，再看能不能加线程</li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-经典-Bug"><a href="#0x05-经典-Bug" class="headerlink" title="0x05 经典 Bug"></a>0x05 经典 Bug</h2><h3 id="Bug-1：-Transactional-失效"><a href="#Bug-1：-Transactional-失效" class="headerlink" title="Bug 1：@Transactional 失效"></a>Bug 1：<code>@Transactional</code> 失效</h3><p><strong>现象</strong>：方法上加了 <code>@Transactional</code>，异常抛出后数据没有回滚。</p> <p><strong>根因</strong>（三种常见情况）：</p> <ol> <li><strong>同类内部调用</strong>：Spring AOP 代理只拦截外部调用</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">outer</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="built_in">this</span>.inner(); <span class="comment">// 内部调用，不经过代理，@Transactional 失效！</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Transactional</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">inner</span><span class="params">()</span> { ... }</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <ol start="2"> <li><strong>非 public 方法</strong>：CGLIB 代理只能代理 public 方法</li> <li><strong>checked exception 不回滚</strong>：默认只对 RuntimeException 和 Error 回滚</li> </ol> <p><strong>修复</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 1. 自注入绕过代理限制</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Service</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">OrderService</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Autowired</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> OrderService self; <span class="comment">// 注入代理</span></span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">outer</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> self.inner(); <span class="comment">// 通过代理调用</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Transactional</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">inner</span><span class="params">()</span> { ... }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 2. 指定回滚异常类型</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">process</span><span class="params">()</span> { ... }</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="Bug-2：循环依赖导致启动失败"><a href="#Bug-2：循环依赖导致启动失败" class="headerlink" title="Bug 2：循环依赖导致启动失败"></a>Bug 2：循环依赖导致启动失败</h3><p><strong>现象</strong>：<code>BeanCurrentlyInCreationException</code></p> <p><strong>根因</strong>：A 依赖 B，B 依赖 A，构造器注入时形成死循环。</p> <p><strong>修复</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方案1：改用 @Lazy</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Component</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">A</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> B b;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="title function_">A</span><span class="params">(<span class="meta">@Lazy</span> B b)</span> { <span class="built_in">this</span>.b = b; }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方案2：用 Setter/Field 注入代替构造器注入</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方案3：提取公共逻辑到第三个类 C，打破循环</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <hr> <h2 id="0x06-场景设计"><a href="#0x06-场景设计" title="设计一个支持灰度发布的配置中心"></a>设计一个支持灰度发布的配置中心</h3><p><strong>需求</strong>：配置变更不能全量生效，需要按比例灰度。</p> <p><strong>方案</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "app.feature")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@RefreshScope</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">FeatureConfig</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> Map<String, FeatureRule> rules = <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">HashMap</span><>();</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="type">boolean</span> <span class="title function_">isEnabled</span><span class="params">(String feature, String userId)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">FeatureRule</span> <span class="variable">rule</span> <span class="operator">=</span> rules.get(feature);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">if</span> (rule == <span class="literal">null</span>) <span class="keyword">return</span> <span class="literal">false</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 按 userId 哈希做灰度</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="type">int</span> <span class="variable">hash</span> <span class="operator">=</span> Math.abs(userId.hashCode()) % <span class="number">100</span>;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> hash < rule.getPercentage();</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">FeatureRule</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">int</span> percentage; <span class="comment">// 0-100</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">boolean</span> enabled;</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>配合 Nacos/Apollo 配置中心热更新，修改 <code>app.feature.rules.new-feature.percentage=10</code> 即可让 10% 用户看到新功能，无需重启。</p> <hr> <h2 id="0x07-小结"><a href="#0x07-小结" class="headerlink" title="0x07 小结"></a>0x07 小结</h2><p>Spring Boot 面试重点：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>方向</th> <th>核心</th> <th>考察点</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>自动配置</td> <td><code>@EnableAutoConfiguration</code> + 条件注解</td> <td>原理理解，不是背配置</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Starter</td> <td>META-INF + <code>@ConfigurationProperties</code></td> <td>模块化设计能力</td> </tr> <tr> <td>生产化</td> <td>Actuator + 优雅下线 + 健康检查</td> <td>K8s 集成经验</td> </tr> <tr> <td>调优</td> <td>连接池 + 线程池 + JVM</td> <td>不是背参数，是理解公式</td> </tr> <tr> <td>异常</td> <td><code>@ControllerAdvice</code> + 代理原理</td> <td>AOP 理解深度</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <hr> <h2 id="0x08-基础面试问答（补充）"><a href="#0x08-基础面试问答（补充）" class="headerlink" title="0x08 基础面试问答（补充）"></a>0x08 基础面试问答（补充）</h2><blockquote> <p>以下题目整理自 Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》系列，补充一些基础但常考的面试题。</p> </blockquote> <h3 id="8-Spring-Boot-常用注解有哪些？"><a href="#8-Spring-Boot-常用注解有哪些？" class="headerlink" title="8. Spring Boot 常用注解有哪些？"></a>8. Spring Boot 常用注解有哪些？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>注解</th> <th>说明</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><code>@SpringBootApplication</code></td> <td>组合注解，定义在 main 方法入口类，包含 <code>@SpringBootConfiguration</code> + <code>@EnableAutoConfiguration</code> + <code>@ComponentScan</code></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>@EnableAutoConfiguration</code></td> <td>开启自动配置，通过 <code>META-INF/spring.factories</code> 或 <code>.imports</code> 加载候选配置类</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>@Value</code></td> <td>从 <code>application.properties/yml</code> 注入单个配置值</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="xxx")</code></td> <td>按前缀批量注入配置到 POJO，类型安全</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>@RestController</code></td> <td>组合 <code>@Controller</code> + <code>@ResponseBody</code>，用于 API 接口</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>@SpringBootTest</code></td> <td>测试注解，提供 Spring 容器上下文</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <h3 id="9-Spring-Boot-配置加载顺序是怎样的？"><a href="#9-Spring-Boot-配置加载顺序是怎样的？" class="headerlink" title="9. Spring Boot 配置加载顺序是怎样的？"></a>9. Spring Boot 配置加载顺序是怎样的？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>优先级从高到低：</p> <ol> <li><strong>命令行参数</strong>（最高优先级）：<code>java -jar app.jar --server.port=8081</code></li> <li><strong>JNDI 属性</strong>：<code>java:comp/env</code></li> <li><strong>系统环境变量</strong>：<code>SERVER_PORT</code></li> <li><strong><code>application-{profile}.properties/yml</code></strong>：多环境配置文件</li> <li><strong><code>application.properties/yml</code></strong>：主配置文件</li> <li><strong><code>@PropertySource</code></strong> 注解指定的配置</li> <li><strong>Spring 默认配置</strong>：<code>spring-boot-autoconfigure</code> 中的默认值</li> </ol> <p><strong>补充说明</strong>：YAML 文件比 properties 文件晚加载，所以 properties 中的配置会覆盖 yaml 中的同名配置。Spring Boot 2.x 起推荐统一使用一种格式。</p> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <h3 id="10-Spring-Boot-的运行方式有哪些？"><a href="#10-Spring-Boot-的运行方式有哪些？" class="headerlink" title="10. Spring Boot 的运行方式有哪些？"></a>10. Spring Boot 的运行方式有哪些？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><strong>直接执行 main 方法</strong>：在 IDE 中运行 <code>@SpringBootApplication</code> 类的 main 方法</li> <li><strong>Maven/Gradle 插件运行</strong>：<code>mvn spring-boot:run</code> 或 <code>gradle bootRun</code></li> <li><strong>打包后运行</strong>：<code>mvn package</code> → <code>java -jar target/app.jar</code></li> <li><strong>部署到外置容器</strong>：打成 war 包部署到 Tomcat/Jetty（较少用，Spring Boot 提倡内嵌容器）</li> </ol> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：生产环境应使用 <code>java -jar</code> 配合 Systemd/Supervisor 做进程管理，不要用 <code>mvn spring-boot:run</code>。在 K8s 中配合 <code>PreStop</code> 钩子和 <code>SIGTERM</code> 信号实现优雅下线。</p> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <h3 id="11-bootstrap-properties-和-application-properties-有何区别？"><a href="#11-bootstrap-properties-和-application-properties-有何区别？" class="headerlink" title="11. bootstrap.properties 和 application.properties 有何区别？"></a>11. <code>bootstrap.properties</code> 和 <code>application.properties</code> 有何区别？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th><code>bootstrap.properties</code></th> <th><code>application.properties</code></th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>加载顺序</strong></td> <td>先加载（父 ApplicationContext）</td> <td>后加载（子 ApplicationContext）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>用途</strong></td> <td>引导阶段配置，如配置中心地址、加密密钥</td> <td>常规应用配置</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>覆盖规则</strong></td> <td>bootstrap 中的属性不能被 application 覆盖</td> <td>可以被 profile 和环境变量覆盖</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>常用场景</strong></td> <td>Spring Cloud Config / Nacos 配置中心的连接信息</td> <td>业务相关的常规配置</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>注意</strong>：Spring Boot 2.4+ 引入了新的配置加载方式，可以通过 <code>spring.config.import</code> 替代 bootstrap 的功能。Spring Cloud 2020.0+ 也支持这种方式。</p> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <h3 id="12-Spring-Boot-如何实现统一参数校验？"><a href="#12-Spring-Boot-如何实现统一参数校验？" class="headerlink" title="12. Spring Boot 如何实现统一参数校验？"></a>12. Spring Boot 如何实现统一参数校验？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>使用 <code>@Validated</code> 注解配合 JSR-303 验证注解：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 第一步：引入依赖</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// <dependency></span></span><br><span class="line"><span ResponseBodyAdvice 自动包装）。</p> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <h3 id="14-Spring-Boot-如何实现定时任务？"><a href="#14-Spring-Boot-如何实现定时任务？" class="headerlink" title="14. Spring Boot 如何实现定时任务？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <p>两种方式：</p> <p><strong>方式一：@Scheduled 注解（推荐，Spring 原生支持）</strong></p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Component</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">ScheduledTasks</span> {</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Scheduled(fixedRate = 5000)</span> <span class="comment">// 每 5 秒执行一次</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">reportCurrentTime</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> System.out.println(<span class="string">"现在时间："</span> + <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Date</span>());</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Scheduled(cron = "0 0 2 * * ?")</span> <span class="comment">// 每天凌晨 2 点执行</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">cleanExpiredData</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 清理过期数据</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>需要在启动类添加 <code>@EnableScheduling</code> 开启定时任务支持。</p> <p><strong>方式二：Quartz（适合复杂调度需求）</strong></p> <p>适用于需要持久化、动态调整 Cron 表达式、分布式场景。</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">MyJob</span> <span class="keyword">implements</span> <span class="title class_">Job</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">execute</span><span class="params">(JobExecutionContext context)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 业务逻辑</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>单机场景用 <code>@Scheduled</code> 足够，注意方法不能有入参、不能有返回值</li> <li>集群场景必须加分布式锁（如 Redis 锁）防止多节点重复执行</li> <li><code>@Scheduled</code> 默认使用单线程执行器，多个定时任务会互相阻塞，可通过 <code>@Async</code> 或自定义 <code>TaskScheduler</code> 改为线程池</li> </ul> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <h3 Spring Boot 如何实现异步调用？"></a>15. class="meta">@EnableAsync</span> <span class="comment">// 开启异步支持</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">Application</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">main</span><span class="params">(String[] args)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> SpringApplication.run(Application.class, args);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="keyword">public</span> CompletableFuture<String> <span class="title function_">processAsync</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 耗时操作</span></span><br><span class="line"> Thread.sleep(<span class="number">5000</span>);</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> CompletableFuture.completedFuture(<span class="string">"处理完成"</span>);</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Async</span> <span class="comment">// 也支持 void 方法</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">sendNotification</span><span class="params">()</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 发送通知</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>默认使用 <code>SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor</code>（每次创建新线程），生产环境应自定义线程池</li> <li><code>@Async</code> 在同一类内部调用会失效（AOP 代理机制），需要注入自身代理或抽到另一个类</li> <li>异常处理：<code>@Async</code> 方法的异常不会被调用方捕获，需要自定义 <code>AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler</code></li> </ul> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <h3 id="16-如何在-Spring-Boot-启动时运行特定的代码？"><a Spring Boot 打成的 jar 和普通 jar 有什么区别？"></a>17. Spring Boot 打成的 jar 和普通 jar 有什么区别？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>普通 jar</th> <th>Spring Boot 可执行 jar</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>解压结构</strong></td> <td>直接是包名 + 代码</td> <td><code>BOOT-INF/classes/</code> 下是代码</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>可执行性</strong></td> <td>不能直接 <code>java -jar</code></td> <td>可通过 <code>java -jar</code> 运行</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>可被引用</strong></td> <td>可以被其他项目依赖</td> <td>默认不能被其他项目直接引用</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>包含依赖</strong></td> <td>不包含第三方依赖</td> <td>内嵌所有依赖（fat jar）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>如果需要同时支持可执行和被依赖</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight xml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="tag"><<span class="name">plugin</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">groupId</span>></span>org.springframework.boot<span class="tag"></<span class="name">groupId</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">artifactId</span>></span>spring-boot-maven-plugin<span class="tag"></<span class="name">artifactId</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">executions</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">execution</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">goals</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">goal</span>></span>repackage<span class="tag"></<span class="name">goal</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"></<span class="name">goals</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">configuration</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">classifier</span>></span>exec<span class="tag"></<span class="name">classifier</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"></<span class="name">configuration</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"></<span class="name">execution</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"></<span class="name">executions</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"></<span class="name">plugin</span>></span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>这样会生成两个 jar：<code>xxx.jar</code>（可被依赖）和 <code>xxx-exec.jar</code>（可执行）。</p> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <h3 id="19-Spring-Boot-的安全防护方法有哪些？"><a href="#19-Spring-Boot-的安全防护方法有哪些？" class="headerlink" title="19. Spring Boot 的安全防护方法有哪些？"></a>19. Spring Boot 的安全防护方法有哪些？</h3><p><strong>标准答案</strong>：</p> <ol> <li><strong>HTTPS</strong>：生产环境强制 HTTPS，配置 SSL 证书</li> <li><strong>CSRF 保护</strong>：Spring Security 默认开启 CSRF 防护</li> <li><strong>XSS 防护</strong>：使用内容安全策略（CSP）头</li> <li><strong>依赖安全</strong>：定期使用 Snyk 或 OWASP Dependency-Check 扫描依赖漏洞</li> <li><strong>版本升级</strong>：保持 Spring Boot 及所有依赖的最新稳定版本</li> <li><strong>Actuator 安全</strong>：生产环境只暴露最小端点，管理端口与业务端口分离</li> <li><strong>输入校验</strong>：对用户输入做白名单校验，防止 SQL 注入和命令注入</li> </ol> <p>出处：Tom哥《Spring Boot 那点破事》</p> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-Spring-Boot-3-x-新特性与迁移"><a href="#0x05-Spring-Boot-3-x-新特性与迁移" class="headerlink" title="0x05 Spring Boot 3.x 新特性与迁移"></a>0x05 Spring Boot 3.x 新特性与迁移</h2><h3 id="20-Virtual-Threads（虚拟线程）与-Spring-Boot-3-2-整合"><a href="#20-Virtual-Threads（虚拟线程）与-Spring-Boot-3-2-整合" class="headerlink" title="20. Virtual Threads（虚拟线程）与 Spring Boot 3.2+ 整合"></a>20. Virtual Threads（虚拟线程）与 Spring Boot 3.2+ 整合</h3><p><strong>背景</strong>：JDK 21 正式发布 Virtual Threads（JEP 444），Spring Boot 3.2 起通过 <code>spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true</code> 一键开启。</p> <p><strong>配置方式</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># application.yaml — 一键开启虚拟线程</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">spring:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">threads:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">virtual:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">enabled:</span> <span class="literal">true</span> <span class="comment"># Spring Boot 3.2+</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>开启后以下组件自动使用虚拟线程：</p> <ul> <li><strong>Tomcat</strong>：<code>protocol-handler</code> 每个请求一个虚拟线程（替代平台线程池）</li> <li><strong>@Async</strong>：异步任务运行在虚拟线程</li> <li><strong>@Scheduled</strong>：定时任务使用虚拟线程</li> <li><strong>RabbitMQ/Kafka 监听器</strong>：消息消费在虚拟线程</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tomcat 线程模型变化</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 传统线程池模式（Tomcat 默认）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">server:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">tomcat:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">threads:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">max:</span> <span class="number">200</span> <span class="comment"># 平台线程，内存开销大</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">min-spare:</span> <span class="number">10</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 虚拟线程模式（Spring Boot 3.2+）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">spring:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">threads:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">virtual:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">enabled:</span> <span class="literal">true</span> <span class="comment"># Tomcat 的 max/min-spare 配置失效</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">server:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">tomcat:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">threads:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">max:</span> <span class="number">0</span> <span class="comment"># 虚拟模式下 Tomcat 线程池设置不再生效</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 因为虚拟线程无内存开销，可以创建数百万个</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>🔥 生产踩坑：虚拟线程下的三大陷阱</strong></p> <p><strong>案例 1：synchronized 导致虚拟线程 pinned（某电商支付服务）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：Spring Boot 3.2 + JDK 21 虚拟线程，支付服务 50 台集群</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：开启虚拟线程后吞吐量下降 40%，线程 dump 显示大量虚拟线程处于 <code>CARRIER</code> 状态</li> <li><strong>排查</strong>：<figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 查看虚拟线程是否被 pinned</span></span><br><span class="line">jcmd <pid> Thread.dump_to_file -format=json /tmp/threads.json</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 搜索 "pinned" 或 "carrier" 关键词</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：支付模块在 <code>synchronized</code> 块内调用了远程服务——虚拟线程被 pinned 到 carrier 线程，3s 的 RPC 调用占用了 carrier 线程</li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：将 <code>synchronized</code> 替换为 <code>ReentrantLock</code><figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 坏：synchronized 会 pinned 虚拟线程</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">synchronized</span> PaymentResult <span class="title function_">process</span><span class="params">(PaymentReq req)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> paymentClient.call(req); <span class="comment">// 3s 的远程调用</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 好：ReentrantLock 不会 pinned</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> <span class="type">Lock</span> <span class="variable">lock</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ReentrantLock</span>();</span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> PaymentResult <span class="title function_">process</span><span class="params">(PaymentReq req)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> lock.lock();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> paymentClient.call(req);</span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">finally</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> lock.unlock();</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>修复效果</strong>：吞吐量恢复，P99 延迟从 800ms 降至 200ms</li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 2：ThreadLocal 内存泄漏（某内容推荐服务）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：使用 <code>ThreadLocal</code> 存储请求追踪 ID，开启虚拟线程后出现 OOM</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：虚拟线程池不回收线程，<code>ThreadLocal</code> 值在虚拟线程生命周期内一直存在。百万级请求创建百万级虚拟线程、百万个 ThreadLocal 实例</li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：<figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 方案一：虚拟线程仍可能复用 carrier 线程，ThreadLocal 值需手动清理</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方案二：用 ScopedValue（JDK 21+）替代 ThreadLocal</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ThreadLocal version（不适合虚拟线程）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> ThreadLocal<String> requestId = <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">ThreadLocal</span><>();</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// ScopedValue version（推荐 JDK 21+）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="keyword">static</span> <span class="keyword">final</span> ScopedValue<String> REQUEST_ID = ScopedValue.newInstance();</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">handleRequest</span><span class="params">(HttpRequest request)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> ScopedValue.where(REQUEST_ID, request.getHeader(<span class="string">"X-Request-Id"</span>))</span><br><span class="line"> .run(() -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 在这个 lambda 中可以用 REQUEST_ID.get() 获取值</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 离开作用域自动释放，不会泄漏</span></span><br><span class="line"> process();</span><br><span class="line"> });</span><br><span class="line">}</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>最佳实践</strong>：<ul> <li>虚拟线程场景下完全禁止 <code>ThreadLocal</code>（JDK 官方也建议迁移到 <code>ScopedValue</code>）</li> <li>如果必须用，在 finally 块中显式 <code>remove()</code></li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>案例 3：池化资源（连接池/线程池）与虚拟线程不兼容（某社交平台）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：数据库连接池 HikariCP，每个请求获取连接后等待数据库响应</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：数据库连接池被占满，新的请求等待连接超时</li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：传统模式下 200 个平台线程共用 50 个连接，现在 10 万个虚拟线程同时竞争 50 个连接——连接池被击穿</li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：调大连接池 + 缩短连接持有时间<figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">spring:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">datasource:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">hikari:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">maximum-pool-size:</span> <span class="number">100</span> <span class="comment"># 从 50 提升到 100</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">minimum-idle:</span> <span class="number">20</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">idle-timeout:</span> <span class="number">300000</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">connection-timeout:</span> <span class="number">5000</span> <span class="comment"># 5s 连接超时</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">max-lifetime:</span> <span class="number">600000</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>最佳实践</strong>：虚拟线程场景下连接池需要调大 2-3 倍，并设置更短的超时时间</li> </ul> <p><strong>Virtual Threads 兼容性审计清单</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> <code>synchronized</code> 块/方法 → 替换为 <code>ReentrantLock</code> / <code>StampedLock</code></li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> <code>ThreadLocal</code> 使用 → 替换为 <code>ScopedValue</code>（JDK 21+）</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> 池化资源（连接池、线程池）→ 调大 2-3 倍</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> <code>ThreadPoolTaskExecutor</code> → 移除自定义线程池（虚拟线程用默认即可）</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> 第三方库兼容性 → 检查依赖是否支持虚拟线程（Netty/Undertow 默认支持）</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> 监控指标 → 检查虚拟线程活跃数、队列深度、pinned 次数</li> </ul> <p><strong>面试金句</strong>：</p> <blockquote> <p>“虚拟线程不是银弹。我在 Spring Boot 3.2 生产中遇到三个核心坑：synchronized 导致 pinned（吞吐下降 40%）、ThreadLocal 内存泄漏（百万实例 OOM）、连接池被击穿（10 万虚拟线程争 50 个连接）。迁移顺序：先审计所有 synchronized + ThreadLocal，再调大连接池，最后一键开启 <code>spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true</code>。”</p> </blockquote> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://spring.io/blog/2023/11/07/spring-boot-3-2-0-available-now">Spring Boot 3.2 Virtual Threads</a> | <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/444">JEP 444</a></p> <h3 id="21-Spring-Boot-3-x-从-2-x-迁移全指南"><a href="#21-Spring-Boot-3-x-从-2-x-迁移全指南" class="headerlink" title="21. Spring Boot 3.x 从 2.x 迁移全指南"></a>21. Spring Boot 3.x 从 2.x 迁移全指南</h3><p><strong>核心变更清单</strong>：</p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>变更项</th> <th>Spring Boot 2.x</th> <th>Spring Boot 3.x</th> <th>迁移影响</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>Java 基线</td> <td>JDK 8/11/17</td> <td>JDK 17+</td> <td>必须升级 JDK</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Jakarta EE</td> <td>javax.*</td> <td>jakarta.*</td> <td>包名全局替换</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Hibernate</td> <td>5.x</td> <td>6.x</td> <td>大量 API 变更</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Spring Security</td> <td>5.x</td> <td>6.x</td> <td>配置变化大</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Actuator 端点</td> <td><code>/actuator/</code></td> <td><code>/actuator/</code>（路径不变但返回格式微调）</td> <td>兼容性好</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>spring.factories</code></td> <td>自动配置加载</td> <td><code>META-INF/spring/*.imports</code></td> <td>第三方 Starter 需更新</td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>@ConstructorBinding</code></td> <td>需要显式</td> <td>默认启用</td> <td>配置类简化</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>迁移红牌禁令</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>❌ <strong>不要一次性升级所有服务</strong> — 分批灰度，先升级无状态边缘服务</li> <li>❌ <strong>不要忽略 <code>-Xlint:all</code> 编译警告</strong> — 模块化系统对跨模块反射敏感</li> <li>❌ <strong>不要跳过 JDK 过渡版本</strong> — JDK 8 → 21 直接升级风险极高</li> <li>✅ 先升级到 JDK 11 → 17 过渡，验证兼容性后再升级到 JDK 21</li> <li>✅ 使用 <code>sdkman</code> 管理多版本 JDK，配置切换脚本</li> </ul> <p><strong>🔥 迁移踩坑案例：javax → jakarta 包名替换遗漏（某物流平台）</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>场景</strong>：50+ 微服务从 Spring Boot 2.7 迁移到 3.1，3 个月迁移窗口</li> <li><strong>症状</strong>：第 5 个服务上线后，订单导入功能偶发 ClassNotFoundException</li> <li><strong>排查</strong>：<figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 用 jdeps 检查引用</span></span><br><span class="line">jdeps --multi-release 17 -apionly order-service.jar | grep javax</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># 输出显示某第三方 jar 仍引用了 javax.persistence</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>根因</strong>：个别微服务依赖的第三方 jar 未更新到 Jakarta 版本</li> <li><strong>修复</strong>：<figure class="highlight xml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"><!-- 使用 Maven 的 javax-to-jakarta 迁移工具 --></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"><<span class="name">plugin</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">groupId</span>></span>org.apache.maven.plugins<span class="tag"></<span class="name">groupId</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">artifactId</span>></span>maven-jdeps-plugin<span class="tag"></<span class="name">artifactId</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">version</span>></span>3.1.2<span class="tag"></<span class="name">version</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">configuration</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">multiRelease</span>></span>17<span class="tag"></<span class="name">multiRelease</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"><<span class="name">apiOnly</span>></span>true<span class="tag"></<span class="name">apiOnly</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="tag"></<span class="name">configuration</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="tag"></<span class="name">plugin</span>></span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"><!-- 或使用 OpenRewrite 自动迁移 --></span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"><!-- mvn -U org.openrewrite.maven:rewrite-maven-plugin:run \</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"> -Drewrite.activeRecipes=org.openrewrite.java.spring.boot3.UpgradeSpringBoot_3_0 --></span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure></li> <li><strong>修复效果</strong>：全量扫描后修复 12 个依赖，迁移完成率 100%</li> </ul> <p><strong>迁移后验证清单</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> <code>mvn compile -Xlint:all</code> 无编译警告</li> <li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> 所有 <code>javax.*</code> class="string"><includeContext>false</includeContext></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="string"><fieldNames></span></span><br><span class="line"> <span
