<blockquote> <p>本文是 Spring Cloud Alibaba 生态的面试全解手册，覆盖 Nacos、Sentinel、Seata、RocketMQ、Dubbo、Gateway 六大组件的核心原理、高频面试题、经典线上 Bug 和场景设计题。每题答案均经过验证，附参考来源。面试前通读这一篇即可。</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x00-Nacos-—-服务发现与配置中心"><a href="#0x00-Nacos-—-服务发现与配置中心" class="headerlink" title="0x00 Nacos — 服务发现与配置中心"></a>0x00 Nacos — 服务发现与配置中心</h2><h3 id="1-Nacos-的-AP-和-CP-模式分别用于什么场景？切换方式是什么？"><a href="#1-Nacos-的-AP-和-CP-模式分别用于什么场景？切换方式是什么？" class="headerlink" title="1. Nacos 的 AP 和 CP 模式分别用于什么场景？切换方式是什么？"></a>1. Nacos 的 AP 和 CP 模式分别用于什么场景？切换方式是什么？</h3><p>Nacos 是目前国内微服务体系的事实标准注册中心，同时支持 <strong>AP（临时实例）</strong> 和 <strong>CP（持久实例）</strong>。</p> <p><strong>AP 模式</strong> — 对应服务发现，默认行为：</p> <ul> <li>实例通过心跳续约（5s），15s 无心跳则自动剔除</li> <li>节点间通过 Distro 协议异步同步注册信息</li> <li>类似 Eureka 的自保护：网络分区时优先保证注册和发现可用</li> <li>适合：无状态微服务，服务实例频繁上下线</li> </ul> <p><strong>CP 模式</strong> — 对应配置管理和 DNS 场景：</p> <ul> <li>使用简化 Raft 协议，写操作必须经过 Leader</li> <li>网络分区时少数派拒绝写入，保证一致性</li> <li>适合：配置变更、服务元数据等需要强一致的场景</li> </ul> <p><strong>切换方式</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment"># AP 模式（默认，临时实例）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">spring.cloud.nacos.discovery.ephemeral=true</span></span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># CP 模式（持久实例）</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="string">spring.cloud.nacos.discovery.ephemeral=false</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>Nacos 2.x 后通信协议从 HTTP 升级为长连接 gRPC，单机可支撑 10w+ 实例。</p> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://nacos.io/docs/latest/architecture/">Nacos 官方架构文档</a></p> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：网络分区时，AP 模式下不同分区的节点各自独立接收注册，分区恢复后通过 Distro 协议做最终一致合并。如果同一服务在两个分区分别注册了不同实例列表，合并策略是「全量保留」而非「冲突裁决」——这可能导致消费者看到已下线的旧实例。生产上需要在客户端加健康检查兜底。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>源码层面</strong>：Nacos 的一致性协议切换核心在 <code>ConsistencyService</code> 接口，AP 实现为 <code>DistroConsistencyServiceImpl</code>，CP 实现为 <code>RaftConsistencyServiceImpl</code>。临时实例的 <code>ephemeral=true</code> 通过 <code>Instance.isEphemeral()</code> 判断，路由到不同的 <code>ClientManager</code> 处理。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>对比延伸</strong>：Consul 的 CP 模式基于完整 Raft（非简化版），支持多 DC 的 WAN Gossip。但 Consul 不支持 AP 模式切换——它要么 CP 要么什么都不给。Nacos 的灵活性在此占优，但也意味着使用者必须理解 CAP 才能正确配置。</p> </li> </ul> <h3 id="2-Nacos-配置中心的热更新是如何实现的？"><a href="#2-Nacos-配置中心的热更新是如何实现的？" class="headerlink" title="2. Nacos 配置中心的热更新是如何实现的？"></a>2. Nacos 配置中心的热更新是如何实现的？</h3><p>核心机制：</p> <ol> <li><strong>长轮询（1.x）</strong>：客户端发起 HTTP 请求到服务端，服务端持有连接 29.5s，期间配置有变更则立即返回，否则超时后返回 304 让客户端再次发起</li> <li><strong>gRPC 长连接（2.x）</strong>：客户端与服务端建立双向流，服务端主动推送变更通知</li> <li><strong>Spring 集成</strong>：<code>@RefreshScope</code> 或 <code>@NacosValue</code> 注解的 Bean 会在收到变更通知后重新初始化</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方式1：@RefreshScope — Spring Cloud 标准方式</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@RefreshScope</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@RestController</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">ConfigController</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Value("${app.timeout:3000}")</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">private</span> <span class="type">int</span> timeout;</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 配置变更后，下次调用自动获取新值</span></span><br><span class="line">}</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 方式2：Nacos 原生 Listener</span></span><br><span class="line">configService.addListener(<span class="string">"dataId"</span>, <span class="string">"group"</span>, <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">Listener</span>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">receiveConfigInfo</span><span class="params">(String configInfo)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 处理配置变更</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">});</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>注意</strong>：<code>@RefreshScope</code> 会为每个 Bean 创建代理，有性能开销，高频调用的 Bean 不建议使用。</p> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://nacos.io/docs/latest/ecology/use-nacos-with-spring-cloud/">Nacos Spring Cloud 文档</a></p> <h3 id="3-Nacos-和-Eureka-的核心区别是什么？"><a href="#3-Nacos-和-Eureka-的核心区别是什么？" class="headerlink" title="3. Nacos 和 Eureka 的核心区别是什么？"></a>3. Nacos 和 Eureka 的核心区别是什么？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>Nacos</th> <th>Eureka</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>CAP</td> <td>AP + CP 可切换</td> <td>AP only</td> </tr> <tr> <td>健康检查</td> <td>TCP/HTTP/MySQL 多种</td> <td>仅 HTTP 心跳</td> </tr> <tr> <td>配置中心</td> <td>内置</td> <td>无（需集成 Spring Cloud Config）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>通信协议</td> <td>gRPC 长连接（2.x）</td> <td>HTTP 短连接</td> </tr> <tr> <td>实例规模</td> <td>10w+ / 节点</td> <td>~5000 / 节点</td> </tr> <tr> <td>控制台</td> <td>完善的管理 UI</td> <td>基本的 Dashboard</td> </tr> <tr> <td>维护状态</td> <td>阿里持续活跃维护</td> <td>Netflix 停止维护</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>一句话</strong>：Nacos = Eureka + Config + 管理面板，是 Eureka 的超集。</p> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://nacos.io/docs/latest/overview/">Nacos vs Eureka vs Consul</a></p> <hr> <h2 id="0x01-Sentinel-—-流量控制与熔断降级"><a href="#0x01-Sentinel-—-流量控制与熔断降级" class="headerlink" title="0x01 Sentinel — 流量控制与熔断降级"></a>0x01 Sentinel — 流量控制与熔断降级</h2><h3 id="4-Sentinel-的滑动窗口限流原理是什么？"><a href="#4-Sentinel-的滑动窗口限流原理是什么？" class="headerlink" title="4. Sentinel 的滑动窗口限流原理是什么？"></a>4. Sentinel 的滑动窗口限流原理是什么？</h3><p>Sentinel QPS 限流基于 <strong>滑动窗口计数器</strong>（<code>LeapArray</code>）：</p> <ul> <li>将 1 秒时间窗口切分为 N 个格子（默认 2 格，每格 500ms）</li> <li>每个格子维护一个 LongAdder 计数器</li> <li>请求到来时，遍历当前窗口内所有有效格子，累加计数</li> <li>超过阈值则触发限流</li> </ul> <p>三种限流效果：</p> <ul> <li><strong>快速失败</strong>：直接抛 <code>FlowException</code></li> <li><strong>Warm Up</strong>：预热模式，阈值从 <code>count/3</code> 线性增长到 <code>count</code></li> <li><strong>排队等待</strong>：匀速排队（漏桶算法），请求超过超时时间才失败</li> </ul> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="type">FlowRule</span> <span class="variable">rule</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">FlowRule</span>(<span class="string">"hello"</span>);</span><br><span class="line">rule.setGrade(RuleConstant.FLOW_GRADE_QPS); <span class="comment">// QPS 模式</span></span><br><span class="line">rule.setCount(<span class="number">10</span>); <span class="comment">// 阈值 10 QPS</span></span><br><span class="line">rule.setControlBehavior(RuleConstant.CONTROL_BEHAVIOR_WARM_UP);</span><br><span class="line">rule.setWarmUpPeriodSec(<span class="number">10</span>); <span class="comment">// 预热 10 秒</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://sentinelguard.io/docs/flow-control/">Sentinel Flow Control</a></p> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：默认 2 格（每格 500ms）的粒度对突发流量不敏感——如果前 500ms 已经用完所有配额，后 500ms 的请求全被拒绝，即使这 1 秒的整体 QPS 远低于阈值。实际应用中应根据流量特征调整 <code>sampleCount</code>。API 网关类建议 10-20 格，让限流更平滑。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>源码层面</strong>：<code>LeapArray</code> 的核心是 <code>currentWindow()</code> 方法——根据当前时间戳计算窗口下标，如果窗口过期则调用 <code>resetWindow()</code> 清零计数器。这里使用 <code>LongAdder</code> 而非 <code>AtomicLong</code> 是为了减少高并发下的 CAS 竞争。Warm Up 效果背后是 Guava 的 <code>SmoothWarmingUp</code> 算法——令牌桶的变种，冷启动时令牌生成速率从低到高逐渐增加。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>生产经验</strong>：很多人把 Sentinel 限流阈值设在 QPS=1000 就以为万事大吉。但如果下游单接口 RT=200ms，1000 QPS 意味着 200 个并发线程在等待——线程池瞬间打满。正确做法是 QPS 阈值 ≤ 线程池大小 ÷ 平均 RT，即 <code>count ≤ threads / (rt/1000)</code>。</p> </li> </ul> <h3 id="5-Sentinel-的熔断降级有哪三种策略？各自适用什么场景？"><a href="#5-Sentinel-的熔断降级有哪三种策略？各自适用什么场景？" class="headerlink" title="5. Sentinel 的熔断降级有哪三种策略？各自适用什么场景？"></a>5. Sentinel 的熔断降级有哪三种策略？各自适用什么场景？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>策略</th> <th>判断依据</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>慢调用比例</strong></td> <td>慢调用数 / 总调用数 > 阈值</td> <td>下游服务响应变慢（如 DB 慢查询）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>异常比例</strong></td> <td>异常数 / 总调用数 > 阈值</td> <td>下游偶发性故障</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>异常数</strong></td> <td>异常数绝对值 > 阈值</td> <td>低流量接口（比例不敏感）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="type">DegradeRule</span> <span class="variable">rule</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">DegradeRule</span>(<span class="string">"resource"</span>);</span><br><span class="line">rule.setGrade(RuleConstant.DEGRADE_GRADE_RT); <span class="comment">// 慢调用比例</span></span><br><span class="line">rule.setCount(<span class="number">100</span>); <span class="comment">// 最大 RT 100ms</span></span><br><span class="line">rule.setSlowRatioThreshold(<span class="number">0.5</span>); <span class="comment">// 50% 慢调用触发熔断</span></span><br><span class="line">rule.setTimeWindow(<span class="number">10</span>); <span class="comment">// 熔断 10 秒</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>核心逻辑</strong>：Sentinel 熔断器是<strong>半开-全开-全关</strong>三段式，不是 Hystrix 的半开试探模式。熔断时间窗口结束后自动恢复，不需要单独的探测请求。</p> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://sentinelguard.io/docs/circuit-breaking/">Sentinel Circuit Breaking</a></p> <h3 id="6-Sentinel-和-Hystrix-的本质区别？"><a href="#6-Sentinel-和-Hystrix-的本质区别？" class="headerlink" title="6. Sentinel 和 Hystrix 的本质区别？"></a>6. Sentinel 和 Hystrix 的本质区别？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>维度</th> <th>Sentinel</th> <th>Hystrix</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>隔离策略</td> <td>信号量隔离（无额外线程）</td> <td>线程池隔离（额外线程开销大）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>规则管理</td> <td>控制台实时推送，动态热更新</td> <td>静态配置，修改需重启</td> </tr> <tr> <td>熔断策略</td> <td>3 种（慢调用/异常比例/异常数）</td> <td>1 种（异常比例）</td> </tr> <tr> <td>流量整形</td> <td>预热、匀速排队、冷启动</td> <td>无</td> </tr> <tr> <td>扩展性</td> <td>SPI 插件机制</td> <td>接口实现</td> </tr> <tr> <td>维护状态</td> <td>阿里开源活跃维护</td> <td>Netflix 停止维护</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>选型建议</strong>：2026 年新项目优先 Sentinel。Hystrix 仅遗留系统还在跑。</p> <hr> <h2 id="0x02-Seata-—-分布式事务"><a href="#0x02-Seata-—-分布式事务" class="headerlink" title="0x02 Seata — 分布式事务"></a>0x02 Seata — 分布式事务</h2><h3 id="7-Seata-的四种事务模式分别是什么？如何选型？"><a href="#7-Seata-的四种事务模式分别是什么？如何选型？" class="headerlink" title="7. Seata 的四种事务模式分别是什么？如何选型？"></a>7. Seata 的四种事务模式分别是什么？如何选型？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>模式</th> <th>侵入性</th> <th>性能</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>AT</strong></td> <td>零侵入</td> <td>中等</td> <td>纯关系型数据库操作</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>TCC</strong></td> <td>高（需实现 Try/Confirm/Cancel）</td> <td>高</td> <td>涉及 Redis/MQ/第三方 RPC</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>SAGA</strong></td> <td>中（需实现正向+补偿）</td> <td>高</td> <td>长事务（分钟级）</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>XA</strong></td> <td>零侵入</td> <td>低</td> <td>强一致性要求（金融）</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <p><strong>选型决策树</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>纯 DB 操作 → AT（前提：SQL 可被解析）</li> <li>涉及外部资源（Redis/MQ/RPC）→ TCC</li> <li>长事务（分钟级）→ SAGA 或最终一致性消息</li> <li>金融级强一致 → XA（但很少用）</li> </ul> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://seata.io/zh-cn/docs/overview/what-is-seata.html">Seata 官方文档</a></p> <h3 id="8-Seata-AT-模式的实现原理是什么？为什么需要全局锁？"><a href="#8-Seata-AT-模式的实现原理是什么？为什么需要全局锁？" class="headerlink" title="8. Seata AT 模式的实现原理是什么？为什么需要全局锁？"></a>8. Seata AT 模式的实现原理是什么？为什么需要全局锁？</h3><p>AT 模式核心是<strong>自动补偿</strong>，两阶段实现：</p> <p><strong>一阶段</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>Seata 拦截业务 SQL，解析出前后镜像存入 <code>undo_log</code> 表</li> <li>将业务 SQL + undo_log 在同一本地事务中提交</li> <li>注册分支事务到 TC（Transaction Coordinator）</li> </ul> <p><strong>二阶段</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>成功</strong>：TC 通知各分支删除 undo_log（异步，无阻塞）</li> <li><strong>失败</strong>：TC 通知各分支根据 undo_log 反向生成回滚 SQL 并执行</li> </ul> <p><strong>全局锁的必要性</strong>：<br>在一阶段提交后、二阶段完成前，其他事务可能修改同一行数据。全局锁保证在全局事务未结束时，其他事务不能写入已被 AT 模式锁定的数据行，防止脏写。</p> <p><strong>脏写防护</strong>：如果全局锁获取失败 → 重试 → 超时则回滚本地事务并上报 TC。</p> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://seata.io/zh-cn/docs/dev/mode/at-mode.html">Seata AT Mode</a></p> <p><strong>深入思考</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>边界情况</strong>：AT 模式的前提是数据库支持 ACID 事务且 SQL 能被正确解析。以下场景 AT 会失效：(1) 使用了存储过程/函数——Seata 无法解析内部 SQL；(2) <code>SELECT ... FOR UPDATE</code> 行锁——可能与全局锁冲突；(3) 分库分表后的跨库事务——每个库的 undo_log 独立，回滚时无法保证原子性。遇到这些场景必须切换到 TCC 或 SAGA。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>源码层面</strong>：SQL 解析的核心是 <code>SQLRecognizerFactory</code>，通过 Druid 的 SQL Parser 解析出表名、WHERE 条件、更新字段。前后镜像的生成在 <code>BaseTransactionalExecutor</code> 中——先 <code>SELECT * FROM table WHERE ... FOR UPDATE</code>（加行锁+拿前镜像），执行业务 SQL，再 <code>SELECT * FROM table WHERE ...</code>（拿后镜像）。正是这个 <code>FOR UPDATE</code> 和全局锁的双重保障防止了脏写。</p> </li> <li><p><strong>对比延伸</strong>：AT 和 XA 都是两阶段，但本质不同。XA 的一阶段是 prepare（不提交），二阶段是 commit/rollback——数据库连接一直持有，资源锁定时间长。AT 的一阶段直接提交本地事务，只靠后镜像做回滚——连接的持有时间极短。这就是为什么 AT 的性能远好于 XA，代价是需要 undo_log 表和 SQL 解析能力。</p> </li> </ul> <hr> <h2 id="0x03-RocketMQ-—-消息驱动"><a href="#0x03-RocketMQ-—-消息驱动" class="headerlink" title="0x03 RocketMQ — 消息驱动"></a>0x03 RocketMQ — 消息驱动</h2><h3 id="9-RocketMQ-如何保证消息不丢失？"><a href="#9-RocketMQ-如何保证消息不丢失？" class="headerlink" title="9. RocketMQ 如何保证消息不丢失？"></a>9. RocketMQ 如何保证消息不丢失？</h3><p>需要从三个环节保障：</p> <p><strong>生产者（发送端）</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 同步发送 + 重试</span></span><br><span class="line">producer.send(msg, <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">SendCallback</span>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">onSuccess</span><span class="params">(SendResult result)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 确认发送成功</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">onException</span><span class="params">(Throwable e)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 重试或记录失败</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">});</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>Broker（存储端）</strong>：</p> <ul> <li>同步刷盘（<code>flushDiskType=SYNC_FLUSH</code>）：写入 PageCache 后强制 fsync</li> <li>主从同步（<code>brokerRole=SYNC_MASTER</code>）：Master 写入后等待 Slave 确认</li> </ul> <p><strong>消费者（消费端）</strong>：</p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">consumer.registerMessageListener((MessageListenerOrderly) (msgs, context) -> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 处理消息</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> ConsumeOrderlyStatus.SUCCESS; <span class="comment">// 成功后才提交 offset</span></span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">catch</span> (Exception e) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> ConsumeOrderlyStatus.SUSPEND_CURRENT_QUEUE_A_MOMENT; <span class="comment">// 稍后重试</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">});</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>一句话</strong>：一端发确认 + 一端存可靠 + 一端消费确认 = 全链路不丢。</p> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://rocketmq.apache.org/docs/">RocketMQ 官方文档</a></p> <h3 id="10-RocketMQ-的事务消息是怎么实现的？"><a href="#10-RocketMQ-的事务消息是怎么实现的？" class="headerlink" title="10. RocketMQ 的事务消息是怎么实现的？"></a>10. RocketMQ 的事务消息是怎么实现的？</h3><p>事务消息用于解决<strong>本地事务 + 消息发送</strong>的原子性问题。流程如下：</p> <ol> <li>生产者发送 <strong>half 消息</strong>（prepare 状态，消费者不可见）</li> <li>执行<strong>本地事务</strong></li> <li>根据本地事务结果：成功 → commit（消息可见），失败 → rollback（消息删除）</li> <li>Broker 定期回查生产者：如果 half 消息长时间未确认（默认 60s），回调 <code>checkLocalTransaction()</code> 确认状态</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br><span class="line">12</span><br><span class="line">13</span><br><span class="line">14</span><br><span class="line">15</span><br><span class="line">16</span><br><span class="line">17</span><br><span class="line">18</span><br><span class="line">19</span><br><span class="line">20</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="type">TransactionMQProducer</span> <span class="variable">producer</span> <span class="operator">=</span> <span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">TransactionMQProducer</span>(<span class="string">"tx_group"</span>);</span><br><span class="line">producer.setTransactionListener(<span class="keyword">new</span> <span class="title class_">TransactionListener</span>() {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> LocalTransactionState <span class="title function_">executeLocalTransaction</span><span class="params">(Message msg, Object arg)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">try</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 执行本地事务</span></span><br><span class="line"> orderService.createOrder();</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> LocalTransactionState.COMMIT_MESSAGE;</span><br><span class="line"> } <span class="keyword">catch</span> (Exception e) {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> LocalTransactionState.ROLLBACK_MESSAGE;</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> LocalTransactionState <span class="title function_">checkLocalTransaction</span><span class="params">(MessageExt msg)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 回查：查询本地事务执行状态</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">return</span> orderService.isOrderCreated(msg.getKeys())</span><br><span class="line"> ? LocalTransactionState.COMMIT_MESSAGE</span><br><span class="line"> : LocalTransactionState.ROLLBACK_MESSAGE;</span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line">});</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><strong>核心设计</strong>：half 消息不是真实消息，是占位符。只有 commit 后才对消费者可见。</p> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://rocketmq.apache.org/docs/featureBehavior/04transaction">RocketMQ Transaction Message</a></p> <hr> <h2 id="0x04-Dubbo-—-RPC-通信"><a href="#0x04-Dubbo-—-RPC-通信" class="headerlink" title="0x04 Dubbo — RPC 通信"></a>0x04 Dubbo — RPC 通信</h2><h3 id="11-Dubbo-的服务调用流程是怎样的？"><a href="#11-Dubbo-的服务调用流程是怎样的？" class="headerlink" title="11. Dubbo 的服务调用流程是怎样的？"></a>11. Dubbo 的服务调用流程是怎样的？</h3><p>完整链路（以 Dubbo 3 + Nacos 为例）：</p> <figure class="highlight plaintext"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">Consumer → Proxy → Cluster → Filter Chain → </span><br><span class="line"> LoadBalance → Protocol(Invoker) → NettyClient → Provider</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>关键步骤：</p> <ol> <li><strong>代理层</strong>：Consumer 通过 <code>@DubboReference</code> 生成动态代理</li> <li><strong>路由层</strong>：从 Registry（Nacos）获取 Provider 列表，经过路由规则过滤</li> <li><strong>负载均衡</strong>：从候选列表中选择一个 Provider</li> <li><strong>协议层</strong>：序列化请求，通过 Netty 发送</li> <li><strong>Filter 链</strong>：Provider 端依次执行 Filter（可插拔，用于监控/限流/鉴权）</li> <li><strong>反射调用</strong>：最终执行 Provider 实现</li> </ol> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Consumer 侧</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@DubboReference(version = "1.0.0", timeout = 3000, </span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta"> cluster = "failfast", loadbalance = "roundrobin")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> OrderService orderService;</span><br><span class="line"></span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment">// Provider 侧</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@DubboService(version = "1.0.0")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">OrderServiceImpl</span> <span class="keyword">implements</span> <span class="title class_">OrderService</span> { ... }</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://dubbo.apache.org/zh-cn/docs/">Dubbo 官方文档</a></p> <h3 id="12-Dubbo-的负载均衡策略有哪些？"><a href="#12-Dubbo-的负载均衡策略有哪些？" class="headerlink" title="12. Dubbo 的负载均衡策略有哪些？"></a>12. Dubbo 的负载均衡策略有哪些？</h3><table> <thead> <tr> <th>策略</th> <th>原理</th> <th>适用场景</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td><strong>Random</strong>（默认）</td> <td>加权随机</td> <td>通用，各节点配置相同</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>RoundRobin</strong></td> <td>加权轮询</td> <td>请求处理时间均匀</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>LeastActive</strong></td> <td>最小活跃数（inflight 请求最少）</td> <td>长连接、处理时间不均</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>ConsistentHash</strong></td> <td>一致性哈希（同参数请求总打到同一节点）</td> <td>有状态服务、缓存亲和</td> </tr> <tr> <td><strong>ShortestResponse</strong></td> <td>最短响应时间（Dubbo 3.2+）</td> <td>自适应，兼顾延迟和负载</td> </tr> </tbody></table> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="comment">// 指定负载均衡策略</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">@DubboReference(loadbalance = "consistenthash")</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">private</span> OrderService orderService;</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://dubbo.apache.org/zh-cn/docs/advanced/loadbalance/">Dubbo LoadBalance</a></p> <hr> <h2 id="0x05-Spring-Cloud-Gateway-—-API-网关"><a href="#0x05-Spring-Cloud-Gateway-—-API-网关" class="headerlink" title="0x05 Spring Cloud Gateway — API 网关"></a>0x05 Spring Cloud Gateway — API 网关</h2><h3 id="13-Gateway-的三大核心组件是什么？请求处理流程是怎样的？"><a href="#13-Gateway-的三大核心组件是什么？请求处理流程是怎样的？" class="headerlink" title="13. Gateway 的三大核心组件是什么？请求处理流程是怎样的？"></a>13. Gateway 的三大核心组件是什么？请求处理流程是怎样的？</h3><p><strong>三大组件</strong>：</p> <ul> <li><strong>Route</strong>：路由定义（ID + URI + Predicates + Filters）</li> <li><strong>Predicate</strong>：断言（请求匹配条件，如 class="line"> 目标微服务 → Response Filter 链 → Response</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br><span class="line">10</span><br><span class="line">11</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">spring:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">cloud:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">gateway:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">routes:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="attr">id:</span> <span class="string">order-service</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">uri:</span> <span class="string">lb://order-service</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">predicates:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="string">Path=/api/order/**</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">filters:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="string">StripPrefix=1</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="string">AddRequestHeader=X-Source,</span> <span class="string">gateway</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>参考：<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://docs.spring.io/spring-cloud-gateway/docs/current/reference/html/">Spring Cloud Gateway Docs</a></p> <h3 id="14-Gateway-如何实现动态路由？"><a href="#14-Gateway-如何实现动态路由？" class="headerlink" title="14. Gateway 如何实现动态路由？"></a>14. Gateway 如何实现动态路由？</h3><p>两种方案：</p> <p><strong>方案1：Nacos Config + RefreshRoutesEvent</strong></p> <figure class="highlight java"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">@Component</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">DynamicRouteListener</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@EventListener</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">void</span> <span class="title function_">onRouteRefresh</span><span class="params">(RefreshRoutesEvent event)</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> <span class="comment">// 路由自动刷新</span></span><br><span class="line"> }</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="meta">@Component</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="keyword">public</span> <span class="keyword">class</span> <span class="title class_">NacosRouteDefinitionRepository</span> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">implements</span> <span class="title class_">RouteDefinitionRepository</span> {</span><br><span class="line"> </span><br><span class="line"> <span class="meta">@Override</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="keyword">public</span> Flux<RouteDefinition> <span class="title function_">getRouteDefinitions</span><span
