itemprop="url">Hexo博客重建记录</a> </h2> <div class="post-meta-container"> <div class="post-meta"> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">发表于</span> <time title="创建时间：2019-09-14 16:15:16" itemprop="dateCreated datePublished" datetime="2019-09-14T16:15:16+08:00">2019-09-14</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar-check"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">更新于</span> <time title="修改时间：2026-06-06 21:30:00" itemprop="dateModified" datetime="2026-06-06T21:30:00+08:00">2026-06-06</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-folder"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">分类于</span> <span itemprop="about" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Thing"> <a href="/categories/fortest/" itemprop="url" rel="index"><span itemprop="name">fortest</span></a> </span> </span> </div> </div> </header> <div class="post-body" itemprop="articleBody"> <blockquote> <p>本文记录了从 GitHub Pages 构建产物逆向还原 Hexo 博客的完整过程。适用于源文件丢失、域名过期后重新搭建的场景。</p> </blockquote> <h2 id="0x00-背景"><a href="#0x00-背景" class="headerlink" title="0x00 背景"></a>0x00 背景</h2><p>之前的 Hexo 博客因域名过期且源文件丢失，GitHub Pages 仓库只剩构建产物（即 <code>public/</code> 目录内容）和各篇文章的 HTML 文件。需要从零重建。</p> <p>旧站信息：</p> <ul> <li>站点名：xiaoxin1024’s Blog</li> <li>描述：大海里的一粒沙</li> <li>主题：NexT Pisces</li> <li>仓库：liuerge/liuerge.github.io（master 分支）</li> </ul> <h2 id="0x01-环境准备"><a href="#0x01-环境准备" class="headerlink" title="0x01 环境准备"></a>0x01 环境准备</h2><p>确保以下工具已安装：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">node -v <span class="comment"># 需要 Node.js 12+</span></span><br><span class="line">npm -v <span class="comment"># 随 Node.js 一起安装</span></span><br><span class="line">git --version <span class="comment"># Git 用于部署</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>安装 Hexo CLI：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">npm install -g hexo-cli</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h2 id="0x02-重建步骤"><a href="#0x02-重建步骤" class="headerlink" title="0x02 重建步骤"></a>0x02 重建步骤</h2><h3 id="1-从-HTML-反推信息"><a href="#1-从-HTML-反推信息" class="headerlink" title="1. 从 HTML 反推信息"></a>1. 从 HTML 反推信息</h3><p>先浅克隆旧仓库，分析 <code>index.html</code> 和各文章页面：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">git <span class="built_in">clone</span> --depth=1 https://github.com/liuerge/liuerge.github.io.git</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>从 HTML 中提取关键信息：</p> <ul> <li><code><title></code> → 站点名</li> <li><code><meta name="description"></code> → 站点描述</li> <li><code><meta name="keywords"></code> → 文章标签</li> <li><code>.post-body</code> → 文章正文</li> <li>主题识别：<code><html class="theme-next pisces"></code> → NexT Pisces</li> </ul> <h3 id="2-初始化-Hexo-项目"><a href="#2-初始化-Hexo-项目" class="headerlink" title="2. 初始化 Hexo 项目"></a>2. 初始化 Hexo 项目</h3><figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">hexo init blog</span><br><span class="line"><span class="built_in">cd</span> blog</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="3-安装并配置主题"><a href="#3-安装并配置主题" class="headerlink" title="3. 安装并配置主题"></a>3. 安装并配置主题</h3><figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">npm install hexo-theme-next</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>修改 <code>_config.yml</code>：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">theme:</span> <span class="string">next</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">title:</span> <span class="string">xiaoxin1024's</span> <span class="string">Blog</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">subtitle:</span> <span class="string">'the life i want，there is not shortcut.'</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">description:</span> <span class="string">'大海里的一粒沙'</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">author:</span> <span class="string">xiaoxin1024</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">language:</span> <span class="string">zh-CN</span> <span class="comment"># 注意：NexT 用 zh-CN 而非 zh-Hans</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">timezone:</span> <span class="string">'Asia/Shanghai'</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">url:</span> <span class="string">https://liuerge.github.io</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>复制主题配置到站点根目录：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="built_in">cp</span> node_modules/hexo-theme-next/_config.yml _config.next.yml</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>在 <code>_config.next.yml</code> 中启用 Pisces 方案：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">scheme:</span> <span class="string">Pisces</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>启用菜单项：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">menu:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">home:</span> <span class="string">/</span> <span class="string">||</span> <span class="string">fa</span> <span class="string">fa-home</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">about:</span> <span class="string">/about/</span> <span class="string">||</span> <span class="string">fa</span> <span class="string">fa-user</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">tags:</span> <span class="string">/tags/</span> <span class="string">||</span> <span class="string">fa</span> <span class="string">fa-tags</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">categories:</span> <span class="string">/categories/</span> <span class="string">||</span> <span class="string">fa</span> <span class="string">fa-th</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">archives:</span> <span class="string">/archives/</span> <span class="string">||</span> <span class="string">fa</span> <span class="string">fa-archive</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="4-还原文章"><a href="#4-还原文章" class="headerlink" title="4. 还原文章"></a>4. 还原文章</h3><p>从旧仓库的 HTML 中提取 <code>.post-body</code> 内容，清理 HTML 标签和实体，整理成 Markdown 格式。需要注意：</p> <ul> <li>代码块用 <code>```</code> 包裹</li> <li>语言代码用 <code>zh-CN</code>（NexT 只识别 zh-CN/zh-HK/zh-TW）</li> <li>post 文件名不要带日期前缀，Hexo 会从 front-matter 的 date 生成 permalink</li> </ul> <p>每篇文章的 front-matter：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">---</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">title:</span> <span class="string">文章标题</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">date:</span> <span class="number">2019-08-13 20:05:07</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">tags:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="string">标签</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">categories:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="bullet">-</span> <span class="string">分类</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">---</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="5-创建页面"><a href="#5-创建页面" class="headerlink" title="5. 创建页面"></a>5. 创建页面</h3><figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">hexo new page about</span><br><span class="line">hexo new page tags</span><br><span class="line">hexo new page categories</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>tags 和 categories 页面需要设置 <code>type</code>：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="meta">---</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">title:</span> <span class="string">标签</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">type:</span> <span class="string">"tags"</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="meta">---</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="6-配置-GitHub-Pages-部署"><a href="#6-配置-GitHub-Pages-部署" class="headerlink" title="6. 配置 GitHub Pages 部署"></a>6. 配置 GitHub Pages 部署</h3><p>安装部署插件：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">npm install hexo-deployer-git --save</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p><code>_config.yml</code> 中添加：</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">deploy:</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">type:</span> <span class="string">git</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">repo:</span> <span class="string">https://github.com/liuerge/liuerge.github.io.git</span></span><br><span class="line"> <span class="attr">branch:</span> <span class="string">master</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="7-部署"><a href="#7-部署" class="headerlink" title="7. 部署"></a>7. 部署</h3><figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">hexo clean</span><br><span class="line">hexo generate</span><br><span class="line">hexo deploy</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h2 id="0x03-踩坑记录"><a href="#0x03-踩坑记录" class="headerlink" title="0x03 踩坑记录"></a>0x03 踩坑记录</h2><h3 id="语言显示异常"><a href="#语言显示异常" class="headerlink" title="语言显示异常"></a>语言显示异常</h3><p>NexT 的语言文件命名是 <code>zh-CN.yml</code>，如果写 <code>zh-Hans</code> 会匹配不到，回退到字母序第一个语言（孟加拉语 bn），导致界面文字乱码。</p> <p><strong>解决</strong>：<code>_config.yml</code> 中 <code>language: zh-CN</code></p> <h3 id="GitHub-邮箱隐私保护"><a href="#GitHub-邮箱隐私保护" class="headerlink" title="GitHub 邮箱隐私保护"></a>GitHub 邮箱隐私保护</h3><p>如果 GitHub 开启了 “Block command line pushes that expose my email”，推送时使用私人邮箱会被拒绝。</p> <p><strong>解决</strong>：使用 GitHub 提供的 noreply 邮箱：</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">git config --global user.email <span class="string">"ID+USERNAME@users.noreply.github.com"</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h3 id="Token-不要写在配置文件里"><a href="#Token-不要写在配置文件里" class="headerlink" title="Token 不要写在配置文件里"></a>Token 不要写在配置文件里</h3><p><code>hexo-deployer-git</code> 支持在 repo URL 中嵌入 token，但这会泄露。建议用 SSH key 或 git credential helper。</p> <h2 id="0x04-常用命令"><a href="#0x04-常用命令" class="headerlink" title="0x04 常用命令"></a>0x04 常用命令</h2><figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">hexo n <span class="string">"文章标题"</span> <span class="comment"># 新建文章</span></span><br><span class="line">hexo s <span class="comment"># 本地预览 http://localhost:4000</span></span><br><span class="line">hexo clean && hexo d <span class="comment"># 清理缓存并部署</span></span><br><span class="line">hexo g <span class="comment"># 仅生成静态文件</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> </div> <footer class="post-footer"> <div class="post-eof"></div> </footer> </article> </div> <div class="post-block"> <article itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Article" class="post-content" lang=""> <link itemprop="mainEntityOfPage" href="https://liuerge.github.io/2019/08/18/Centos6-7%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85Elasticsearch-6-1-3/"> <span hidden itemprop="author" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Person"> <meta itemprop="image" content="/images/avatar.gif"> <meta itemprop="name" content="xiaoxin1024"> </span> <span hidden itemprop="publisher" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Organization"> <meta itemprop="name" content="xiaoxin1024's Blog"> <meta itemprop="description" content="大海里的一粒沙"> </span> <span hidden itemprop="post" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/CreativeWork"> <meta itemprop="name" content=" | xiaoxin1024's Blog"> <meta itemprop="description" content=""> </span> <header class="post-header"> <h2 class="post-title" itemprop="name headline"> <a href="/2019/08/18/Centos6-7%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85Elasticsearch-6-1-3/" class="post-title-link" itemprop="url">Centos6.7安装Elasticsearch 6.1.3</a> </h2> <div class="post-meta-container"> <div class="post-meta"> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">发表于</span> <time title="创建时间：2019-08-18 23:00:29" itemprop="dateCreated datePublished" datetime="2019-08-18T23:00:29+08:00">2019-08-18</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar-check"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">更新于</span> <time title="修改时间：2026-06-08 09:24:42" itemprop="dateModified" datetime="2026-06-08T09:24:42+08:00">2026-06-08</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-folder"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">分类于</span> <span itemprop="about" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Thing"> <a href="/categories/fortest/" itemprop="url" rel="index"><span itemprop="name">fortest</span></a> </span> </span> </div> </div> </header> <div class="post-body" itemprop="articleBody"> <h2 id="0x00-前知"><a href="#0x00-前知" class="headerlink" title="0x00 前知"></a>0x00 前知</h2><p>1，该ES6.1.3需要适配的JDK版本为1.8+</p> <p>2，本文安装前JDK环境已配置好，如无配置，请自行谷歌并配置好JDK环境</p> <p>3，该ES6.1.3不能使用root用户启动，所以需要新建一个elasticsearch用户执行ES所在目录，本文使用elsearch</p> <h2 id="0x01-开始安装"><a href="#0x01-开始安装" class="headerlink" title="0x01 开始安装"></a>0x01 开始安装</h2><p>1，解压 tar -zxf esxxx -C /opt/app</p> <p>2，chown -R elsearch:elsearch esxxx</p> <p>3，修改配置文件 cd /esxxx/config vi elasticsearch.yml “[]”内为提示内容，不是修改的内容，谨记</p> <figure class="highlight yaml"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br><span class="line">3</span><br><span class="line">4</span><br><span class="line">5</span><br><span class="line">6</span><br><span class="line">7</span><br><span class="line">8</span><br><span class="line">9</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line"><span class="attr">cluster.name:</span> <span class="string">my-test-application</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">node.name:</span> <span class="string">node-1</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">path.data:</span> <span class="string">/data/elsearch6/data</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">path.logs:</span> <span class="string">/data/elsearch6/logs</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">bootstrap.system_call_filter:</span> <span class="literal">false</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">bootstrap.memory_lock:</span> <span class="literal">false</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">network.host:</span> <span class="number">192.168</span><span class="number">.91</span><span class="number">.163</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">http.cors.enabled:</span> <span class="literal">true</span></span><br><span class="line"><span class="attr">http.cors.allow-origin:</span> <span class="string">"*"</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <h2 id="0x02-异常"><a href="#0x02-异常" class="headerlink" title="0x02 异常"></a>0x02 异常</h2><p>1，max number of threads [2048] for user [elsearch] is too low, increase to at least [4096]</p> <p>vi /etc/security/limits.d/90-nproc.conf </p> <ul> <li>soft nofile 65536</li> <li>hard nofile 131072</li> <li>soft nproc 4096</li> <li>hard nproc 4096</li> </ul> <p>如果无效，修改 vi /etc/security/limits.conf 修改elsearch的limit<br>elsearch hard nofile 131072<br>elsearch soft nproc 4096<br>elsearch soft nofile 65536</p> <h2 id="0x03-安装-head"><a href="#0x03-安装-head" class="headerlink" title="0x03 安装 head"></a>0x03 安装 head</h2><p>1，需要node，去node官网下载node，如果下载的是XZ格式的还需要安装XZ格式的解压器[yum install xz]</p> <p>2，配置node的环境变量</p> <p>3，安装npm</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">npm install -g cnpm --registry=https://registry.npm.taobao.org</span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>4，使用npm安装grunt</p> <p>npm install -g grunt</p> <p>npm install -g grunt-cli –registry=<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://registry.npm.taobao.org/">https://registry.npm.taobao.org</a> –no-proxy</p> <p>5，确认是否安装成功</p> <figure class="highlight bash"><table><tr><td class="gutter"><pre><span class="line">1</span><br><span class="line">2</span><br></pre></td><td class="code"><pre><span class="line">node -v</span><br><span class="line"><span class="comment"># v10.16.0</span></span><br></pre></td></tr></table></figure> <p>6，下载head插件源码</p> <p>wget <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/mobz/elasticsearch-head/archive/master.zip">https://github.com/mobz/elasticsearch-head/archive/master.zip</a></p> <p>uzip msater.zip</p> <p>7，依赖</p> <p>进入上面解压后的目录，执行以下命令<br>npm install</p> <p>如果网速过慢失败–可以使用下面的<br>npm install -g cnpm –registry=<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://registry.npm.taobao.org/">https://registry.npm.taobao.org</a></p> <p>8，结合ES</p> <p>1,先停掉ES<br>2,修改es的配置文件[前面的那个]<br>添加–注意”:”后面有一个空格<br>http.cors.enabled: true<br>http.cors.allow-origin: “*”</p> <p>2,修改head中的文件 vi Gruntfile.js<br>找到connect:Server,添加hostname<br>connect: {<br> server: {<br> options: {<br> hostname: ‘0.0.0.0’,<br> port: 9100,<br> base: ‘.’,<br> keepalive: true<br> }<br> }<br> }<br>hostname改为’0.0.0.0’和’*’均可，看应用场景</p> <p>9，启动</p> <p>先启动ES<br>bin/elasticsearch -d</p> <p>然后在head目录下启动<br>nohup npm run start &</p> <p>10，访问</p> <p>打开<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="http://192.168.91.163:9100/">http://192.168.91.163:9100/</a></p> <h2 id="0x04-安装-IK"><a href="#0x04-安装-IK" class="headerlink" title="0x04 安装 IK"></a>0x04 安装 IK</h2><p>支持两种形式的安装</p> <p>1，以plugin方式安装</p> <p>进入ES的bin路径，执行以下命令：<br>elasticsearch-plugin install <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/medcl/elasticsearch-analysis-ik/releases/download/v6.1.3/elasticsearch-analysis-ik-6.1.3.zip">https://github.com/medcl/elasticsearch-analysis-ik/releases/download/v6.1.3/elasticsearch-analysis-ik-6.1.3.zip</a></p> <p>执行完毕，重启ES，ik安装完毕</p> <p>2，手动安装</p> <p>：注意版本号要求一致<br>1,在 <a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/medcl/elasticsearch-analysis-ik/releases%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E8%BF%99%E4%B8%AA%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%E7%9A%84IK%E5%92%8CEs%E7%9A%84%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%E5%AF%B9%E5%BA%94%E5%85%B3%E7%B3%BB%E4%B8%80%E8%87%B4%EF%BC%8C%E6%9C%AC%E6%96%87%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8es">https://github.com/medcl/elasticsearch-analysis-ik/releases下载这个版本的IK和Es的版本对应关系一致，本文使用es</a> 6.1.3，下载后<br>2，解压到ES_HOME/plugins/ik 目录下面(直接包含一个conf文件夹和一堆.jar包)<br>3，重新启动ES<br>4，如果 看到try load config ….IK相关信息，说明启动完成后和安装IK插件完成。或者访问<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="http://spark01:9200/_cat/plugins">http://spark01:9200/_cat/plugins</a> 出现node-1 analysis-ik 6.1.3即为完成安装</p> <p>3，验证</p> <p>curl -H “Content-Type: application/json” -XPOST “<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="http://spark01:9200/_analyze?pretty=true">http://spark01:9200/_analyze?pretty=true</a>“ -d ‘{“text”:”helloworld,我是一个粉刷匠”}’</p> <p>{<br> “tokens” : [<br> {<br> “token” : “helloworld”,<br> “start_offset” : 0,<br> “end_offset” : 10,<br> “type” : “<ALPHANUM>“,<br> “position” : 0<br> },<br> {<br> “token” : “我”,<br> “start_offset” : 11,<br> “end_offset” : 12,<br> “type” : “<IDEOGRAPHIC>“,<br> “position” : 1<br> },<br> {<br> “token” : “是”,<br> “start_offset” : 12,<br> “end_offset” : 13,<br> “type” : “<IDEOGRAPHIC>“,<br> “position” : 2<br> },<br> {<br> “token” : “一”,<br> “start_offset” : 13,<br> “end_offset” : 14,<br> “type” : “<IDEOGRAPHIC>“,<br> “position” : 3<br> },<br> {<br> “token” : “个”,<br> “start_offset” : 14,<br> “end_offset” : 15,<br> “type” : “<IDEOGRAPHIC>“,<br> “position” : 4<br> },<br> {<br> “token” : “粉”,<br> “start_offset” : 15,<br> “end_offset” : 16,<br> “type” : “<IDEOGRAPHIC>“,<br> “position” : 5<br> },<br> {<br> “token” : “刷”,<br> “start_offset” : 16,<br> “end_offset” : 17,<br> “type” : “<IDEOGRAPHIC>“,<br> “position” : 6<br> },<br> {<br> “token” : “匠”,<br> “start_offset” : 17,<br> “end_offset” : 18,<br> “type” : “<IDEOGRAPHIC>“,<br> “position” : 7<br> }<br> ]<br>}</p> </div> <footer class="post-footer"> <div class="post-eof"></div> </footer> </article> </div> <div class="post-block"> <article itemscope itemprop="publisher" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Organization"> <meta itemprop="name" content="xiaoxin1024's Blog"> <meta itemprop="description" content="大海里的一粒沙"> </span> <span hidden itemprop="post" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/CreativeWork"> <meta itemprop="name" content=" | xiaoxin1024's Blog"> <meta itemprop="description" content=""> </span> <header class="post-header"> <h2 class="post-title" itemprop="name headline"> <a href="/2019/08/13/%E4%B9%A6%E7%B1%8D%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90/" class="post-title-link" itemprop="url">书籍推荐</a> </h2> <div class="post-meta-container"> <div class="post-meta"> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">发表于</span> <time title="创建时间：2019-08-13 20:05:07" itemprop="dateCreated datePublished" datetime="2019-08-13T20:05:07+08:00">2019-08-13</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-calendar-check"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">更新于</span> <time title="修改时间：2026-06-08 09:24:42" itemprop="dateModified" datetime="2026-06-08T09:24:42+08:00">2026-06-08</time> </span> <span class="post-meta-item"> <span class="post-meta-item-icon"> <i class="far fa-folder"></i> </span> <span class="post-meta-item-text">分类于</span> <span itemprop="about" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Thing"> <a href="/categories/fortest/" itemprop="url" rel="index"><span itemprop="name">fortest</span></a> </span> </span> </div> </div> </header> <div class="post-body" itemprop="articleBody"> <h2 id="0x00-概述"><a href="#0x00-概述" class="headerlink" title="0x00 概述"></a>0x00 概述</h2><p>初次推荐书籍，这里我看的书籍也不多，目前也在充实自己中，欢迎大家推荐和自荐~</p> <p>补充，推荐的书籍，各大商城均有销售，价格起伏不定，请适时下手~</p> <p>以下按照数据中转的流程推荐书籍~</p> <h2 id="0x01-书单"><a href="#0x01-书单" class="headerlink" title="0x01 书单"></a>0x01 书单</h2><p>一、《深入理解Kafka核心设计与实践原理》 Kafka类书籍个人入门推荐5星</p> <p>厮大著作的书基于Kafka2.0~ 此书基础扎实，适合小白入门，相关慨念颇多，涉及Kafka的架构设计和很多高级应用，读此一本计科了解Kafka的整体架构和理念，建议配合书上搭建源码环境进行学习，效果更佳~</p> <p>二、《HBase不睡觉书》HBase类书籍个人入门推荐五星</p> <p>杨曦大佬著作的书，适合小白和有一定基础的工程师入门，书中知识点比较琐碎，但是按照杨大佬的推荐，阅读此书时，需要有选择性的阅读，不适合从头开始看(如果你有基础)。看完确实对Hbase的架构有了一定的认识，还对Hbase的发展有了一定的了解~</p> <p>三、《大数据之路：阿里巴巴大数据实践》数仓类书籍个人推荐超5星</p> <p>这本介绍了阿里大数据的最佳实践，适合小白和数仓工程师阅读，书中案例结合阿里遇到的问题进行将结合阐述，在数据模型的设计和相关的平台体系建设都有相应的实践。很多大佬都强烈推荐这一本书,哈哈~</p> </div> <footer class="post-footer"> <div
